papers.title: Information on trajectories: martingales and random times
papers.abstract_en: Accounting for information flow on the path space of trajectories of a nonnegative martingale yields exact variational identities for it, even at arbitrary random times. This recovers the widely used classical concentration inequalities, from Ville to PAC-Bayes, and measures what each one discards. The tail a bound controls is itself a relative entropy, resolved by the chain rule into per-step conditional divergences. The discarded slack has an exact form in each of three geometries: a Gibbs tilt for the Azuma-Hoeffding and PAC-Bayes bounds, the crossing itself for Ville's and for pooled tests, and a dominating certificate for the $L^p$ maximal bound. That certificate's optional-stopping deficit resolves per step into Bregman divergences of the running maximum. On a path-time space, the same identity gains one factor that prices anticipation: an arbitrary random time carries an e-process ``peeking penalty.'' The partition function can be read as a coalescent--a prefix-sharing probability of independent copies--and geometric mixtures of test martingales gain a pooling benefit for multi-model safe testing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非负鞅轨迹路径空间上的信息流，推导出精确的变分恒等式，该恒等式在任意随机时间下仍成立。摘要表明该恒等式可以统一恢复从 Ville 不等式到 PAC-Bayes 的经典浓度不等式，并精确刻画各不等式所丢弃的松弛量：在三种几何中分别表现为 Gibbs 倾斜、穿越本身和支配证书。在同一恒等式中，路径-时间空间会多出一个因子，用以度量任意随机时间携带的 e-process "偷看惩罚"。
Motivation: 经典浓度不等式虽然被广泛使用，但各自丢弃的松弛量缺乏统一且精确的刻画；此外，在任意随机时间下理解非负鞅的信息流仍缺少一个统一的变分框架。
Method: 作者在非负鞅轨迹的路径空间上引入信息流视角，建立精确的变分恒等式；该恒等式通过链式法则将尾部概率界分解为每步条件散度，并在三种几何中分别识别松弛量的精确形式，还引入路径-时间空间以处理随机时间带来的预期效应。
Result: 该恒等式恢复了从 Ville 到 PAC-Bayes 的经典浓度不等式，并给出各不等式丢弃松弛量的精确表达：Azuma-Hoeffding 与 PAC-Bayes 对应 Gibbs 倾斜，Ville 与合并检验对应穿越本身，L^p 极大界对应支配证书；随机时间的可选停时亏损可逐项分解为运行最大值的 Bregman 散度，且任意随机时间会引入一个 e-process "偷看惩罚"因子。
Conclusion: 作者表明配分函数可视为一种合并过程（coalescent），即独立副本的前缀共享概率，而测试鞅的几何混合在多模型安全检验中获得合并收益；该工作主要在概率论与信息论层面给出统一框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WithEveryone: Unified Planning and Identity Grounding for Group Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Identity-preserving image generation becomes increasingly unreliable when a scene must contain many specified people. Beyond retaining each identity, the model must bind every reference to a distinct person and location, while training-time identity losses must establish correspondence among several noisy predicted faces. We introduce WithEveryone, a unified framework for generating group images up to ten reference identities. WithEveryone injects each selected identity as an addressed token, predicts a structured identity--layout plan, and renders the plan as a visual condition. Its key objective, Layout-Grounded ID Loss, uses annotated face regions to supervise the intended identities directly, avoiding unstable embedding-based face matching; ID Representation Forcing additionally trains a prediction for each identity before image synthesis. On an identity-disjoint benchmark, WithEveryone achieves the highest target-context identity similarity, improving face similarity from 0.462 for GPT-Image-2 to 0.499, while reducing copy-paste artifacts from 0.169 to 0.055. It further covers 97.3\% of the requested identities with a duplicate rate of only 2.8\%. These results show that explicit identity--layout grounding enables identity-preserving generation to scale to larger groups without relying on direct reference-face copying.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WithEveryone，一个面向最多十人身份保持的群像生成统一框架。它在图像生成中把每个选中身份注入为可寻址 token（addressed token），预测结构化的身份-布局计划，并将其渲染为视觉条件。核心目标是 Layout-Grounded ID Loss，利用标注的人脸区域直接监督预期身份，避免不稳定的基于嵌入的人脸匹配；ID Representation Forcing 还在图像合成前为每个身份训练预测。在身份不相交的基准上，该方法将目标上下文身份相似度从 GPT-Image-2 的 0.462 提升到 0.499，并将复制粘贴伪影从 0.169 降到 0.055，覆盖 97.3% 的请求身份，重复率仅 2.8%。
Motivation: 身份保持图像生成在场景包含多个指定人物时变得不可靠——不仅要保留每个身份，还要把每个参考绑定到不同的人和位置，而训练时的身份损失需要在多个噪声预测人脸之间建立对应。
Method: 提出统一框架 WithEveryone：将每个选定身份注入为带地址的 token，预测结构化身份-布局计划，并把计划渲染为视觉条件；训练目标包括 Layout-Grounded ID Loss（用标注的人脸区域直接监督）和 ID Representation Forcing（在图像合成前为每个身份训练预测）。
Result: 在身份不相交的基准上，WithEveryone 的目标上下文身份相似度达到 0.499（对照 GPT-Image-2 为 0.462），复制粘贴伪影从 0.169 降至 0.055；覆盖 97.3% 的请求身份，重复率 2.8%。
Conclusion: 结果显示，显式的身份-布局绑定（identity-layout grounding）能让身份保持生成扩展到更大的群组，而无需依赖直接的参考人脸复制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
papers.abstract_en: We present 4DAnyone, a framework for reconstructing 4D humans from an uncalibrated monocular video by generating reconstruction-grade multiview-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS). Existing camera-controlled video diffusion models synthesize plausible novel-view videos but fail to maintain consistency when scaled to the tens of target views required for 4DGS reconstruction. We identify this failure as a bounded-attention-context problem: when target views exceed the capacity of a single DiT forward pass, they must be split into groups, exposing two coupled bottlenecks. On the reference-context side, conditioning on all previously generated views grows as $O(N)$, weakening cross-view appearance guidance. On the target-context side, disjoint groups cannot directly exchange information, causing global structural drift. 4DAnyone addresses both bottlenecks with two complementary designs: Reference Context Packing (RCP) compresses growing reference views into a fixed-length mixed-resolution context with $O(1)$ reference-context complexity, while Target Context Routing (TCR) rotates target-view groupings during denoising to share context across groups at high-noise steps and stabilize details at low-noise steps. We further build the MVGameHuman dataset using our in-house game engine and combine it with light-stage and in-the-wild video datasets for training. Experiments on DNA-Rendering and DyMVHumans show that 4DAnyone outperforms prior methods in both novel-view video quality and downstream 4DGS reconstruction, with robust in-the-wild generalization. See our project page for video results and source code: https://4danyone.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 4DAnyone，从非标定单目视频重建 4D 人体：先生成重建级多视角一致视频，再将其提升为 4D 高斯泼溅 (4DGS)。作者把现有相机控制视频扩散模型在目标视角数量增多时的不一致性归因于有界注意力上下文 (bounded-attention-context) 问题，并提出 Reference Context Packing (RCP) 与 Target Context Routing (TCR) 两种互补设计分别解决参考上下文增长和分组间信息隔离。在 DNA-Rendering 和 DyMVHumans 上，该方法在新视角视频质量和下游 4DGS 重建方面均超过先前方法。
Motivation: 相机控制的视频扩散模型能生成看似合理的新视角视频，但当目标视角达到 4DGS 重建所需的数十个时无法保持一致性；这一失败被识别为有界注意力上下文问题：目标视角需分组处理，导致参考上下文复杂度随已生成视角数线性增长，且不相交的分组无法直接交换信息，造成全局结构漂移。
Method: 4DAnyone 包含两个核心设计：Reference Context Packing (RCP) 将不断增长的参考视角压缩为固定长度的混合分辨率上下文，使参考上下文复杂度降为 O(1)；Target Context Routing (TCR) 在去噪过程中轮换目标视角分组，在高噪声步共享组间上下文、在低噪声步稳定细节。作者还用内部游戏引擎构建 MVGameHuman 数据集，并与 light-stage 及 in-the-wild 视频数据集联合用于训练。
Result: 在 DNA-Rendering 和 DyMVHumans 基准上，4DAnyone 在新视角视频质量和下游 4DGS 重建两方面均优于先前方法，并展现出鲁棒的 in-the-wild 泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调解决有界注意力上下文瓶颈能够使视频扩散模型扩展到大量目标视角，从而改善 4D 人体重建质量；项目页面提供视频结果与源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Swift-Image: Exploring the Performance Frontier of Compact Unified Image Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: We present Swift-Image, a compact unified model for text-to-image generation, single-image editing, and multi-image editing. Our goal is to explore how far a relatively small visual generator can be pushed through systematic training engineering under a constrained computational budget. Swift-Image adopts an efficient 6B single-stream DiT and a progressive training pipeline that evolves from broad semantic coverage to higher resolution, stronger visual quality, and unified generation-editing supervision. For post-training, we employ parallel expert reinforcement learning followed by multi-teacher on-policy distillation to alleviate interference among heterogeneous objectives. We further decouple high-level reasoning from pixel-level rendering with a Prompt Enhancer that translates user requests into generator-aligned visual specifications. For efficient deployment, structural pruning and few-step distillation produce 3B and accelerated variants. Swift-Image achieves leading aggregate performance among evaluated open-source models with only 6B parameters and 243K GPU training hours; the compressed 3B model incurs nearly no loss, while few-step distillation further improves aggregate editing performance with substantially fewer sampling steps. Our study also summarizes practical lessons for architecture, data curriculum, post-training, prompt enhancement, and model compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Swift-Image，一个统一的紧凑型图像生成模型，同时支持文生图、单图编辑和多图编辑。模型采用高效的 6B 单流 DiT 与渐进式训练流程，从广泛语义覆盖逐步演进到更高分辨率、更强视觉质量和统一的生成-编辑监督。后训练阶段使用并行专家强化学习加多教师在线策略蒸馏，并引入 Prompt Enhancer 将高层推理与像素级渲染解耦；部署时通过结构化剪枝和少步蒸馏得到 3B 与加速变体。
Motivation: 作者的目标是在受限计算预算下，探索通过系统化的训练工程能将一个相对较小的视觉生成器推到的性能边界。
Method: 采用 6B 单流 DiT 架构和渐进式训练流程，涵盖语义覆盖、分辨率提升与生成-编辑统一监督；后训练使用并行专家强化学习 (parallel expert reinforcement learning) 与多教师在线策略蒸馏 (multi-teacher on-policy distillation) 以缓解异构目标间的干扰；通过 Prompt Enhancer 把用户请求转换为与生成器对齐的视觉规格；部署阶段采用结构化剪枝和少步蒸馏得到 3B 与加速变体。
Result: Swift-Image 以仅 6B 参数和 243K GPU 训练小时在评估的开源模型中取得领先的聚合性能；压缩后的 3B 模型几乎无性能损失，而少步蒸馏在显著减少采样步数的情况下进一步提升聚合编辑性能。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该工作总结了架构、数据课程、后训练、提示增强和模型压缩方面的实用经验，回应了紧凑模型在有限算力下能走多远的问题。

papers.title: G-CARL: Grounded Checklist-Aligned Reward Learning for Patient-Oriented Medical Report Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized interpretation of medical reports has emerged as an increasingly important need among patients. Addressing this need requires both evidence-grounded medical factuality and context-dependent patient communication, yet existing medical vision-language tasks do not adequately capture these dual requirements. To bridge this gap, we introduce Patient-oriented Medical Report Interpretation (PMRI), a novel open-ended multimodal generation task that requires models to explain medical reports in accurate and accessible language based on a user's query and dialogue history. These two objectives differ fundamentally in their verifiability, yet remain tightly coupled, making them difficult to optimize jointly under conventional supervised fine-tuning and holistic reinforcement learning paradigms. To address this challenge, we propose G-CARL, a grounded, checklist-aligned reinforcement learning framework that combines multi-source retrieval for atomic claim verification with context-aware, instance-specific weighted checklists for response coverage, providing structured supervision for factuality, user-demand satisfaction, and expression quality without constraining response diversity. We further construct MMedReport, a real-world PMRI benchmark, along with a clinician-designed three-dimensional evaluation protocol. Extensive experiments demonstrate that G-CARL consistently outperforms existing post-training baselines in overall quality, claim-level precision, and checklist recall. Pairwise preference evaluation by clinicians further confirms that G-CARL produces interpretations that are more accurate and better aligned with patient needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Patient-oriented Medical Report Interpretation (PMRI)，一个面向患者的多模态开放文本生成任务，要求模型基于用户查询和对话历史，以准确且易于理解的语言解释医学报告。为优化该任务中事实性与患者沟通两个目标，作者提出 G-CARL，一个基于检索的原子声明验证与实例级加权检查表相结合的强化学习框架，并构建了真实世界基准 MMedReport 及临床医生设计的三维评估协议。实验表明 G-CARL 在整体质量、声明级精度和检查表召回率上持续优于现有后训练基线。
Motivation: 现有医学视觉语言任务未能同时刻画证据锚定的医学事实性和依赖语境的医患沟通这两个需求，而这两个目标在可验证性上差异显著却又紧密耦合，难以在传统监督微调和整体式强化学习范式下联合优化。
Method: 提出 G-CARL，一种 grounded、checklist-aligned 的强化学习框架：通过多源检索对原子声明进行验证，并结合上下文相关的实例级加权检查表约束回答覆盖率，从而为事实性、用户需求满足度和表达质量提供结构化监督，而不限制回答多样性。
Result: 大量实验表明 G-CARL 在整体质量、claim-level precision 和 checklist recall 上一致优于现有后训练基线；临床医生的成对偏好评估进一步确认其生成的解释更准确且更贴合患者需求。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过 grounded 检索与实例级加权检查表提供结构化奖励信号，可以同时改善医学报告解释的事实性和患者沟通质量，且不牺牲回答多样性。

papers.title: $TCP_α$: Margin-Controlled Confidence estimation for reliable Music Information Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks are often overconfident, assigning high confidence even to incorrect predictions. Consequently, users lack a reliable signal for deciding when a prediction can be trusted. Post-hoc confidence estimation addresses this by training a lightweight auxiliary head over a frozen classifier. Existing targets, however, suffer from inherent ambiguity: they assign overlapping confidence values to correct and incorrect predictions, while errors near the decision boundary receive confidence scores indistinguishable from correct predictions. In this work, we propose $TCP_α$, a novel confidence target that resolves these limitations by introducing a margin-controlled penalty for misclassified samples. We prove that $TCP_α$ guarantees complete separation between the target values of correct and incorrect predictions, with a separation margin that is independent of the number of classes and increases monotonically with the penalty parameter. Since accurate classifiers naturally produce very few errors, learning these targets results in a severely imbalanced regression problem. We therefore present a systematic study of training strategies for learning under this imbalance and identify an effective training configuration through extensive ablation studies. We evaluate the proposed approach on rāga identification, investigate its robustness under domain shift, and further validate it on frame-wise ornamentation detection without modifying the selected configuration. Across all settings, $TCP_α$ consistently outperforms existing confidence targets for failure prediction. Rejecting only the least-confident 8\% of predictions improves the base model's macro-F1 from 0.89 to 0.98, while fine-tuning the confidence head with only 5\% labeled samples from a new corpus effectively restores performance under domain shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的后验置信度估计目标 $TCP_α$，通过为误分类样本引入 margin-controlled 惩罚，解决现有置信度目标中正确与错误预测目标值重叠、决策边界附近置信度无法区分的问题。作者证明 $TCP_α$ 能保证正确与错误预测目标值完全分离，且分离间隔与类别数无关、随惩罚参数单调递增。在 rāga 识别和逐帧装饰音检测等音乐信息检索任务上，该目标在失败预测方面一致优于现有置信度目标。
Motivation: 深度神经网络常对错误预测给出高置信度，用户缺少可靠的信任信号；现有 post-hoc 置信度估计目标存在固有歧义，正确与错误预测的置信度值重叠，决策边界附近的错误置信度与正确预测难以区分。
Method: 提出置信度目标 $TCP_α$，为误分类样本引入 margin-controlled 惩罚；理论上证明该目标使正确与错误预测的目标值完全分离，间隔与类别数无关且随惩罚参数单调增加。由于准确分类器天然产生极少错误，学习该目标构成严重不平衡的回归问题，因此作者系统研究了在此不平衡下训练策略，并通过大量消融实验确定有效配置。
Result: 在 rāga 识别、域偏移以及逐帧装饰音检测等全部设置中，$TCP_α$ 一致优于现有置信度目标；仅拒绝最低置信度的 8% 预测即可将基础模型 macro-F1 从 0.89 提升至 0.98，且只用新语料库 5% 带标签样本微调置信度头即可在域偏移下恢复性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 $TCP_α$ 作为可靠的置信度估计目标在失败预测上优于现有方法，且通过消融确定的训练配置无需修改即可迁移到其他任务，在域偏移下仍能保持良好的性能恢复能力。

papers.title: A comparison between ceiling-mounted FMCW, IR-UWB and Wi-Fi radar for in-bedroom human activity monitoring and sleep interruption detection
papers.abstract_en: Despite their growing importance for contact-free radio frequency (RF) based healthcare monitoring, different radio technologies such as frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar, impulse radio ultra-wideband (IR-UWB), and Wi-Fi sensing are rarely compared under identical deployment conditions, as existing studies typically differ in hardware, datasets, and evaluation methodologies. In addition, the performance of ceiling-mounted radars, despite their practical deployment and cost advantages in healthcare environments, remain underexplored. Therefore, this paper presents a controlled comparison and analysis of ceiling-mounted FMCW, IR-UWB, and Wi-Fi sensing using synchronized recordings from 20 participants across six room layouts. All technologies are evaluated with the same convolutional neural network (CNN) on both a fine-grained 10-class human activity recognition (HAR) task and a coarse 4-class sleep monitoring task. IR-UWB achieves the highest cross-subject activity recognition performance (89.0% macro F1), while FMCW generalizes best to unseen room layouts (83.8% macro F1). For sleep monitoring, all technologies exceed 92% macro F1 in unseen environments. The results reveal a fundamental trade-off between recognition performance and environmental robustness, which can be explained through differences in range resolution, antenna diversity, Doppler resolution, and spatial information retention. These findings provide practical guidelines for the design of healthcare-oriented RF sensing systems.
papers.comment: This paper has been submitted to IEEE Access Journal and is currently undergoing review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在天花板安装部署条件下，对 FMCW 雷达、IR-UWB 和 Wi-Fi 感知三种射频技术进行受控对比，使用 20 名参与者在六种房间布局中的同步记录，并以同一卷积神经网络 (CNN) 评估细粒度 10 类人体活动识别 (HAR) 和粗粒度 4 类睡眠监测任务。结果显示 IR-UWB 在跨受试者活动识别上最优 (89.0% macro F1)，FMCW 对未见房间布局泛化最好 (83.8% macro F1)，睡眠监测在未见环境下均超过 92% macro F1。作者指出识别性能与环境鲁棒性之间存在根本性权衡，并归因于距离分辨率、天线分集、多普勒分辨率和空间信息保留的差异。
Motivation: 不同射频技术（FMCW、IR-UWB、Wi-Fi）在医疗健康监测中的对比研究通常因硬件、数据集和评估方法不同而难以公平比较；同时天花板安装雷达的实际部署和成本优势虽明显，但其性能尚未被充分探索。
Method: 在相同部署条件下同步采集三类射频传感器数据，构建包含 20 名参与者、六种房间布局的数据集，使用相同的 CNN 架构分别评估 10 类 HAR 和 4 类睡眠监测任务，并通过跨受试者与跨房间布局的评估比较各技术的性能与泛化能力。
Result: IR-UWB 取得最高的跨受试者活动识别性能 (89.0% macro F1)，FMCW 对未见房间布局泛化最佳 (83.8% macro F1)；睡眠监测中所有技术在未见环境下均超过 92% macro F1。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了识别性能与环境鲁棒性之间的权衡，并为面向医疗健康的射频感知系统设计提供实践指导。

papers.title: An Agentic Approach for Active Data Collection, Travel Behavior Modeling, and Weather-Sensitive Demand Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Travel behavior research increasingly combines digital data collection with predictive modeling, yet these stages are often developed and evaluated separately. This study proposes a three-agent workflow integrating conversational data collection, structured data processing, and behavioral prediction. A chatbot-administered, image-augmented stated-preference survey collected mode choices from student commuters across five predefined weather scenarios, yielding 454 respondent-scenario observations. Weather-related associations were analyzed using a multinomial logit model, while logistic regression and random forest provided machine-learning benchmarks. Nine locally deployed large language models (LLMs), ranging from 2 to 35 billion parameters, were evaluated across four zero-shot prompt-and-context conditions and extended through persona, few-shot, and vision-based configurations. Random forest achieved 69.6% five-class accuracy, while the best text-only zero-shot LLM reached 69.9% without task-specific fitting. Habitual travel information produced the most consistent gains, Expert framing generally outperformed Role-Play, and persona information was most useful when habitual travel information was unavailable. Few-shot prompting improved prediction for several models, with gains stabilizing after a small number of examples. Using the same weather images shown to respondents, the best vision-based configuration reached 71.5% five-class accuracy, indicating that visual context may provide additional predictive information for selected models. Overall, the study shows how conversational surveys, structured data processing, conventional behavioral modeling, machine learning, and multimodal LLM prediction can be coordinated within an auditable multi-agent workflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个三智能体工作流，将对话式数据收集、结构化数据处理和行为预测整合起来，用于天气敏感的出行需求研究。作者用聊天机器人主持、图像增强的陈述偏好调查收集了学生通勤者在五种天气场景下的模式选择，共得到454条受访者-场景观测。随机森林达到69.6%的五分类准确率，最优纯文本零样本LLM达到69.9%，而使用与受访者相同天气图像的最佳视觉配置达到71.5%。
Motivation: 出行行为研究通常把数字数据收集与预测建模分开开发与评估，导致两个环节脱节，缺乏一个可审计的端到端流程来协调数据获取、行为建模和预测。
Method: 构建三智能体工作流：聊天机器人调查员负责图像增强的陈述偏好调查，结构化数据处理智能体整理观测数据，行为预测智能体对比传统模型（多项logit、logistic回归、随机森林）与九种本地部署的LLM（2至350亿参数）。LLM在四种零样本提示条件下评估，并扩展了角色、少样本和基于视觉的配置。
Result: 随机森林五分类准确率为69.6%，最佳纯文本零样本LLM为69.9%；少样本提示对多个模型有提升且在少量示例后趋于稳定；专家框架普遍优于角色扮演，常出行信息带来最一致的增益；最佳基于视觉的配置达到71.5%准确率。
Conclusion: 研究展示对话式调查、结构化处理、传统行为模型、机器学习和多模态LLM预测可以在可审计的多智能体工作流中协调运作，说明多阶段流程可以整合而不必牺牲预测性能。

papers.title: Inducing Task Models from Computer-Use Traces
papers.abstract_en: Naturalistic computer-use traces, passively recorded screenshots and mouse or keyboard actions, are a valuable resource for deriving symbolic, auditable, and reusable models of how everyday work is done. Such models matter as computer-use agents enter real work, where agents need to learn how tasks are actually performed, and organizations need to audit and reuse that knowledge. However, inducing such task models is challenging, as activity is observed only as low-level events and real-world work is multi-threaded with interleaved goals. Existing methods assume a given task or a single workflow, and produce step-level summaries rather than structured task models. We introduce Task Model Induction (TMI), which (i) discovers the latent tasks in an unconstrained trace, disentangling concurrent activity, and (ii) for each latent task, induces a task model pairing a hierarchical objective model of recursive goal decomposition with a procedure model of the control flow that organized the execution. Intrinsically, on controlled human and agent trajectories, TMI recovers interleaved tasks with 0.974 agreement against ground-truth groupings and reconstructs 74.9% of the observed execution steps, far more than the strongest workflow induction baseline. Extrinsically, skills derived from TMI's task models improve held-out task accuracy by 30.0% over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Task Model Induction (TMI)，从自然状态下记录的计算机使用轨迹（截图与鼠标/键盘事件）中自动发现潜在任务并诱导结构化任务模型，每个模型包含递归目标分解的层次目标模型与组织执行的控制流过程模型。在受控的人类与智能体轨迹上，TMI 对交错任务的恢复与真实分组一致性达到 0.974，重建 74.9% 的执行步骤；由 TMI 任务模型派生的技能在保留任务上将准确率相对最强基线提升 30.0%。
Motivation: 现有方法假设任务已知或只有单一工作流，且只生成步骤级摘要而非结构化任务模型；而真实计算机使用轨迹只含低层事件，并且多线程目标交错，给任务模型归纳带来困难。
Method: TMI 分两步：(i) 在无约束轨迹中发现潜在任务，将并发活动解耦；(ii) 对每个潜在任务，归纳一个任务模型，将递归目标分解的层次目标模型与组织执行的控制流过程模型配对。
Result: 在受控的人类与智能体轨迹上，TMI 对交错任务恢复的 ground-truth 分组一致性为 0.974，重建 74.9% 的观察执行步骤，均远超最强的工作流归纳基线；外部分数显示 TMI 任务模型派生的技能将保留任务准确率相对最强基线提升 30.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，从自然主义计算机使用轨迹中归纳可符号化、可审计、可复用的任务模型，对计算机使用智能体进入真实工作场景时学习实际任务执行方式以及组织审计和复用知识具有价值。

papers.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) asks whether an AI system can improve the process that produces AI systems, so that the next system inherits the improvement. That process is the training algorithm: a better objective or update rule improves the compute\mbox{-}capability exchange rate for every subsequent run, including the one that produces the next agent. Whether RSI is feasible therefore turns on whether an agent can design training algorithms. No benchmark isolates that ability: existing suites are won by collecting data or by tuning hyperparameters, and none tells a change to how a run is executed apart from a change to how the model learns. We present AI4AI\mbox{-}Bench, 10 frozen research repositories spanning 10 training algorithm families. In each task, an agent has 4 hours on one B300 to rewrite the training algorithm; its code is then rerun from scratch for up to 12 hours and scored by a fixed evaluator hidden from the agent, against the repository's original algorithm under the same procedure. Because the 10 metrics are incommensurable, every task is mapped onto one scale on which $0$ is an uninformative model, $0.1$ is the algorithm the repository ships, and $1.0$ is the task optimum. Across 29 configurations of 6 systems on all 10 tasks the mean score is $0.166$, and the best system reaches $0.250$: even the strongest closes under a fifth of the distance between the algorithm that was already there and the optimum. The submissions show where that distance went: most never change how the model learns at all, and the minority that do average $0.226$ against $0.126$ for the rest. More reasoning effort mostly buys the willingness to go there, taking that minority from $8\%$ of submissions to $64\%$ and the mean score from $0.094$ to $0.196$. We release the task suite, the evaluators and every scored submission, so that the measurement can be repeated as these systems change.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AI4AI-Bench，一个用于评测 LLM 智能体能否设计训练算法的基准，以检验递归自我改进 (recursive self-improvement, RSI) 的可行性。基准包含 10 个冻结的研究代码仓库，覆盖 10 个训练算法家族；智能体在 4 小时内改写训练算法，代码再从头重跑至多 12 小时，由隐藏的固定评估器与原仓库算法按同一流程比较。结果显示 29 种系统配置上的平均分为 0.166，最强系统也只有 0.250；大多数提交根本没有改变模型的学习方式，而少数真正改动学习算法的提交平均得分更高。
Motivation: RSI 是否可行取决于智能体能否设计训练算法；现有基准要么靠收集数据、要么靠调超参数获胜，没有隔离'改变一次运行如何执行'与'改变模型如何学习'这两种能力，因此缺乏针对该能力的评测。
Method: 提出 AI4AI-Bench，包含 10 个冻结研究仓库和 10 个训练算法家族任务。每个任务中智能体在一张 B300 上于 4 小时内重写训练算法，随后代码从零重跑最多 12 小时，并由对智能体隐藏的固定评估器打分，与仓库原始算法在相同流程下比较。由于 10 个指标不可公度，所有任务都被映射到统一尺度：0 表示无信息模型，0.1 表示仓库自带算法，1.0 表示任务最优。
Result: 在全部 10 个任务、6 个系统的 29 种配置上，平均分为 0.166，最佳系统达到 0.250，即最强系统也只走完了从已有算法到最优之间差距的不五分之一。大多数提交从始至终没有改变模型的学习方式；少数真正改变学习算法的提交平均得 0.226，其余为 0.126。更多推理投入主要让系统更愿意去改动学习算法，使这类提交占比从 8% 升至 64%，平均分从 0.094 升至 0.196。
Conclusion: 摘要强调差距主要在于智能体几乎不去改变模型如何学习，而更多推理投入能够提升这种意愿；作者开源任务套件、评估器以及所有已评分的提交，以便在这些系统变化时重复测量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Pandora's AI Model Routing Box: Efficient Allocation with Costly Value Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous AI systems composed of multiple models, architectures, harnesses, or inference-time settings can improve quality and efficiency by routing queries to the specialist who can answer most effectively at the lowest cost. Routing requires estimating each specialist's expected return, but this value estimation has a cost. Cheap estimators (e.g., embedding-based predictors) are fast but noisy, while accurate estimators (e.g., fine-tuned models with access to retrieval results or partial reasoning traces) are expensive. We formalize this tradeoff as an instance of Pandora's Box, the classical problem of optimal search with costly inspection. Under a Gaussian signal model, the resulting policies have closed-form value-of-information expressions that determine, for each specialist and input, whether refining the value estimate is worth its cost. We call the centralized policy Pandora's Router. We extend this to a decentralized setting, Pandora's Bidder, where specialists independently decide whether to invest in self-assessment before accepting an offered price to claim a query. Experiments across three domains---a standard multi-LLM benchmark, retrieval-augmented specialists, and LLMs with variable inference-time reasoning---show that Pandora's Router matches the routing quality of exhaustive estimation, while querying the expensive estimator far less often. In the decentralized setting, value-of-information reasoning improves allocative efficiency when competing estimates are accurate; when competing estimates are noisy, however, it can increase the strategic specialist's utility at the expense of others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将异构AI系统中的查询路由问题形式化为潘多拉盒子（Pandora's Box）问题，即在估计每个专家预期回报需要付出成本的情况下做最优搜索。作者提出集中式策略 Pandora's Router 和去中心化策略 Pandora's Bidder，并在高斯信号模型下推导出价值信息的闭式表达式。实验覆盖多LLM基准、检索增强专家和可变推理时长的LLM，显示该路由策略能用更少的昂贵估计调用达到与穷举估计相当的路由质量。
Motivation: 异构AI系统需要为每个查询选择最合适的专家，但评估每个专家预期回报的估计器本身有成本：廉价估计器快但噪声大，昂贵估计器准但开销高。现有路由方法没有明确权衡这种估计成本与决策收益，本文将其建模为带成本检查的经典搜索问题。
Method: 将路由问题形式化为 Pandora's Box 的实例，假设专家价值信号服从高斯模型，推导出价值信息（value-of-information）的闭式表达式，据此决定对每个专家和输入是否值得花费成本细化价值估计。集中式策略 Pandora's Router 统一调度；去中心化策略 Pandora's Bidder 让各专家独立决定是否投资于自我评估后再接受认领查询的出价。
Result: 在三个领域（标准多LLM基准、检索增强专家、可变推理时长的LLM）的实验中，Pandora's Router 的查询路由质量与穷举估计相当，但对昂贵估计器的调用频率低得多。去中心化场景下，当竞争估计准确时价值信息推理提升分配效率；当竞争估计有噪声时，它可能提升战略性专家的效用而损害其他方。
Conclusion: 本文表明将价值估计成本显式纳入路由决策可以在保持路由质量的同时大幅降低昂贵估计的调用次数；去中心化版本的效果取决于竞争估计的准确性，噪声环境下可能出现策略性行为导致分配效率下降。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Explainable Transformer Models for Clinical Prediction Tasks on Structured Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: Predictive models over structured electronic health records (EHRs) remain central to machine learning for healthcare, but few have jointly emphasized quantitative laboratory information and interpretability with respect to input medical events. We present BERT-LER, a BERT-style model for coded EHR timelines pretrained and fine-tuned from a de-identified EHR dataset of 75 million patients, that encodes laboratory test results as discrete tokens while retaining graded information through percentile-based binning, paired with Integrated Gradients for token-level attributions grounded in the input EHR sequence. We benchmark our approach on the public EHRShot benchmark suite and on an asthma severity progression study based on real-world data. This addresses a methodological gap in EHR foundation-style modeling by unifying laboratory value representation and explainability in a single framework, while assessing whether both predictive performance and explanations generalize beyond standard clinical prediction tasks. Across EHRShot and asthma tasks, BERT-LER achieves predictive performance that is competitive with, and on laboratory-related tasks often exceeds, publicly available benchmark models, and provides attributions that align with clinically known risk factors. Our architecture and explainability approach can be applied to many therapeutic areas and prediction tasks using language models trained on structured EHRs.
papers.comment: Accepted at MLHC 2026; to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BERT-LER，一个面向结构化电子健康记录（EHR）时间线的 BERT 风格模型，在 7500 万患者的去标识化 EHR 数据上预训练并微调。它把实验室检验结果编码为离散 token，并通过百分位分箱保留分级信息，同时结合 Integrated Gradients 提供基于输入 EHR 序列的 token 级归因。作者在 EHRShot 基准和哮喘严重程度进展研究上评估，发现预测性能与公开基准模型相当，在实验室相关任务上常更优，且归因与临床已知风险因素一致。
Motivation: 结构化 EHR 上的预测模型是医疗机器学习的重要方向，但现有工作很少同时强调定量实验室信息和针对输入医疗事件的可解释性。作者指出，统一实验室值表示与可解释性、并检验性能与解释能否泛化到标准临床预测任务之外，是 EHR 基础模型方法中的一个方法论缺口。
Method: 提出 BERT-LER 架构：采用 BERT 风格编码器处理编码后的 EHR 时间线，将实验室检验结果通过基于百分位的分箱（percentile-based binning）编码为保留分级信息的离散 token，并使用 Integrated Gradients 生成与输入 EHR 序列对应的 token 级归因。模型从 7500 万患者的去标识化 EHR 数据集预训练，再在目标任务上微调。
Result: 在 EHRShot 基准套件和基于真实世界数据的哮喘严重程度进展研究中，BERT-LER 的预测性能与公开可用的基准模型相当，在实验室相关任务上通常超过这些模型；其归因结果与临床上已知的风险因素一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为该架构与可解释性方法可应用于多个治疗领域和基于结构化 EHR 语言模型的预测任务，同时摘要也隐含了可解释性和性能泛化性是评估重点。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MidTool: Mid-training Data Synthesis for Agentic Tool Use
papers.abstract_en: Mid-training is increasingly recognized as a critical stage for shaping the capabilities of large language models. Recent work has shown that targeted mid-training can strengthen reasoning-intensive abilities such as math and science, and can also improve agentic capabilities in software-engineering settings. In this work, we study the parallel but less explored agentic capability: general tool use. We present MidTool, an open corpus construction pipeline for agentic tool-use mid-training that combines large-scale web, PDF, and code data with synthesized supervision from real-world tool APIs, MCP skills, and document-grounded workflows. MidTool is designed to teach models how to recognize tool affordances, ground arguments from context, compose tool call workflow, and recover from incomplete information. We mid-train Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base on MidTool-Mix, and then apply follow-up post-training with both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Compared with baselines, MidTool-Mix consistently improves downstream performance under both SFT and RL on BFCL, tau2-Bench, and MCP Universe. These results suggest that general tool use, like other important LLM capabilities, benefits from dedicated mid-training rather than being left entirely to post-training.

papers.title: Inter-X++: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Human-Human Interaction Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The capability to perceive and synthesize human-human interactions is fundamental to developing intelligent digital human systems. However, existing datasets and modeling approaches are fundamentally constrained by low-fidelity kinematics, the omission of dexterous hand gestures and a severe lack of rich multimodal annotations. Furthermore, fragmented interaction representations and inconsistent evaluation protocols also impede fair and rigorous benchmarking. To systematically address these bottlenecks, we present Inter-X++, a comprehensive and large-scale benchmark designed to empower versatile HHI analysis. Captured via a novel hybrid motion capture system, Inter-X++ provides 11,388 high-fidelity interaction sequences and over 8.1M frames, featuring precise whole-body movements and detailed finger articulations. Meanwhile, we enrich the data foundation with multifaceted annotations, including hierarchical fine-grained textual descriptions, interaction categories, causal interaction orders, the relationship and personality of the subjects, as well as vertex-level contact maps and physically regularized constraints. Leveraging these elaborate annotations, we formulate a unified testing ground comprising four categories of downstream tasks that symmetrically span both generative and perceptive paradigms. To eliminate benchmarking ambiguities, we systematically standardize the interaction representations and evaluation protocols. Finally, we go beyond dataset construction to propose OpenHHI, a single and unified HHI representation and modeling framework that jointly optimizes interaction reconstruction and semantic understanding. Extensive experiments reveal that OpenHHI achieves state-of-the-art performance on both generation and perception tasks. This definitively proves that our unified representation successfully bridges interaction understanding and generation simultaneously.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Inter-X++，一个面向多模态人人交互 (HHI) 分析的大规模基准。通过新型混合动作捕捉系统采集了 11,388 条高保真交互序列和超过 810 万帧，覆盖全身动作与精细手指关节，并附带层次化细粒度文本描述、交互类别、因果交互顺序、人物关系与性格、顶点级接触图及物理约束等多方面标注。作者还提出统一表示与建模框架 OpenHHI，联合优化交互重建与语义理解，在生成与感知任务上均取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有 HHI 数据集受限于低保真运动学数据、缺乏灵巧手部姿态以及多模态标注严重不足；同时碎片化的交互表示和不一致的评测协议阻碍了公平严格的基准比较。
Method: 构建包含 11,388 条序列与 8.1M 帧的基准，使用混合动作捕捉系统获取全身运动与手指细节，并补充包含细粒度文本、交互类别、因果顺序、人物关系与性格、顶点级接触图及物理约束的多方面标注；在此基础上统一交互表示与评测协议，提出 OpenHHI 框架联合优化交互重建与语义理解。
Result: 实验表明 OpenHHI 在生成和感知两类任务上均达到最先进水平，证明统一表示能够同时桥接交互理解与生成。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准系统性地解决了 HHI 领域的数据与评测瓶颈，统一表示框架为理解和生成提供了共同基础；论文为 24 页的基准与建模工作。

papers.title: DreamHand: Repurposing Video Diffusion Models for Occlusion-Robust Egocentric 3D Hand Motion Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric video offers scalable manipulation data for embodied AI, yet recovering metric 3D hand trajectories remains challenging due to severe object occlusion and frequent out-of-sight gaps. Existing single-frame and windowed temporal regressors fail when hand shortly leaves the frame, while recent video diffusion models (VDMs) rely on heavy, stochastic multi-step sampling as pixel-space renderers. We instead repurpose VDM into a deterministic geometry encoder. A single forward pass over the clean latent exposes scene content beyond current observations, including occluded and out-of-sight hands. We introduce DreamHand, an offline clip-level framework that extracts features via a Deterministic Clean-Latent Encoder and decodes them with a Bidirectional Spatiotemporal Decoder. DreamHand recovers continuous bimanual trajectories with metric placement and no external detector, while a Ray-Based Camera Solver supports a second configuration that needs no test-time camera intrinsics. Across five egocentric benchmarks, DreamHand sets a new state of the art, cutting MPJPE-p by 30% on occlusion-heavy ARCTIC and 40% on HOT3D. These gains reach 46%-61% once out-of-sight hands are included in the evaluation, offering a scalable path from everyday human video to robot manipulation data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreamHand，一个离线 clip 级框架，将视频扩散模型 (VDM) 重新用作确定性几何编码器，用于 egocentric 视频中的遮挡鲁棒 3D 手部运动恢复。通过 Deterministic Clean-Latent Encoder 在干净潜变量上单次前向传播提取场景内容，再经 Bidirectional Spatiotemporal Decoder 解码，恢复连续双手轨迹且无需外部检测器。在五个 egocentric 基准上达到新 SOTA，ARCTIC 上 MPJPE-p 降低 30%，HOT3D 降低 40%。
Motivation: 现有单帧和窗口式时序回归器在手部短暂离开画面时失效，而最近的视频扩散模型依赖重随机多步采样且仅作为像素空间渲染器，无法高效恢复度量 3D 手部轨迹。该工作旨在从日常 egocentric 视频中可扩展地获取用于具身智能操作数据的手部运动。
Method: 将 VDM 重新用作确定性几何编码器：对干净潜变量做单次前向传播，暴露当前观测之外的场景内容，包括被遮挡和离画的手；解码端使用双向时空解码器恢复连续双手轨迹。另提出 Ray-Based Camera Solver，支持一种无需测试时相机内参的配置。
Result: 摘要报告在五个 egocentric 基准上达到新 SOTA，ARCTIC 上 MPJPE-p 降低 30%，HOT3D 降低 40%；当评估中包含离画手时，收益提升至 46%-61%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DreamHand 提供了一条从日常人类视频扩展到机器人操作数据的可扩展路径，在无外部检测器的同时还能省去测试时相机内参。

papers.title: CalcSeg: Confidence-aware 3D Latent Context Curriculum Learning For Myocardial Scar Segmentation From Single-Stack LGE-CMRs
papers.abstract_en: Myocardial scar segmentation from single-stack late gadolinium-enhanced cardiac magnetic resonance (LGE-CMR) imaging has been a longstanding and clinically important challenge, particularly in the presence of low tissue contrast, diffuse, and small scar regions. These challenges are further intensified by the limited availability of 3D spatial context. This paper presents CalcSeg, a Confidence-aware latent context curriculum learning framework that leverages fused 3D feature representations from single-stack 2D LGE-CMR images for robust scar segmentation. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic semi-supervised curriculum learning strategy that progressively expands training from easier to more challenging scar cases using a learned confidence-aware scoring function. Such a function integrates errors in the predicted scar maps with quantified epistemic uncertainty and scar burden estimation to automatically assess sample difficulty without requiring manual labels. To compensate for the limited spatial context in single-stack acquisitions, we then develop a latent slice-wise self-attention to capture inter-slice dependencies and infer 3D spatial representations from sparse 2D inputs. We evaluate CalcSeg on multi-center clinical LGE-CMR datasets and benchmark against existing scar segmentation networks. Experimental results show that CalcSeg consistently outperforms all competing methods, particularly with substantial improvements on clinically challenging cases. Our code is released on Github.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CalcSeg，一个面向单层堆叠 (single-stack) LGE-CMR 图像的心肌疤痕分割框架，通过置信度感知的潜在上下文课程学习 (confidence-aware latent context curriculum learning) 缓解低组织对比度、弥散小疤痕及 3D 空间上下文受限的问题。方法包括动态半监督课程学习、基于预测误差与认知不确定性及疤痕负担的难度评分，以及用于跨切片依赖建模的潜在切片级自注意力 (latent slice-wise self-attention)。多中心临床数据集上的实验表明，CalcSeg 在整体和临床困难病例上均优于现有疤痕分割网络。
Motivation: 单堆叠 LGE-CMR 中的心肌疤痕分割长期面临低组织对比、疤痕区域弥散且细小、且缺乏 3D 空间上下文等挑战，影响临床可用性。
Method: 提出 CalcSeg 框架：采用动态半监督课程学习策略，从简单病例逐步扩展到困难病例，并以置信度感知评分函数自动评估样本难度；该评分整合预测疤痕图的误差、量化的认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty) 和疤痕负担估计，无需人工标注。为补偿单堆叠采集的有限空间上下文，进一步设计潜在切片级自注意力以捕捉层间依赖并从稀疏 2D 输入推断 3D 空间表示。
Result: 在多中心临床 LGE-CMR 数据集上，CalcSeg 一致优于所有对比的疤痕分割网络，尤其在临床困难病例上提升显著。
Conclusion: 摘要强调融合课程学习、不确定性量化与潜在 3D 表示推断能有效改善单堆叠 LGE-CMR 的疤痕分割性能，并已公开代码仓库。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physical-Support Confidence Sets for Highly Coherent Dictionaries
papers.abstract_en: Sparse pursuit after dictionary learning can yield a precise atom support even when its physical interpretation is not justified by the calibration data, especially for highly coherent dictionaries where alternative calibration-compatible dictionaries may assign different physical meanings to the same selected support. We develop resolution-aware physical-support inference that jointly accounts for uncertainty in the learned dictionary and in the representation of a deployment signal. Our cross-dictionary confidence correspondence retains calibration-compatible dictionaries and deployment-compatible sparse representations, then projects the surviving explanations onto physical-support space. For local coherent-atom classes with separation scale s, once the deployment data resolve the coherent-block explanation and its atom support, the minimax physical resolution from N calibration signals satisfies $δ_{\mathrm{opt}}(N,s)\asymp\min\{s,\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}s^2}\}$, with relative resolution governed by the orientation-information scale $Ns^6$. Deployment replication improves physical localization only when orientation changes cannot be absorbed by adjusting the active coefficients. For computation, we introduce active endpoint bracketing (AEB), an adaptive finite-bank procedure that evaluates only candidates that can still affect the physical report and otherwise safely coarsens or abstains. Finite-bank experiments, including a four-region synthetic application, show that a point-valued plug-in selector can be physically overprecise, whereas AEB avoids unsupported refinement with fewer candidate evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究字典学习后稀疏追踪所得原子支撑在物理意义上可能不可靠的问题，尤其针对高度相干字典（highly coherent dictionaries），其中多个与标定数据兼容的字典可能对同一支撑赋予不同物理含义。作者提出分辨率感知的物理支撑推断（resolution-aware physical-support inference），通过跨字典置信对应（cross-dictionary confidence correspondence）同时考虑字典学习与部署信号表示的不确定性，并将幸存解释投影到物理支撑空间。理论给出基于 N 个标定信号的最小极大物理分辨率 δ_opt(N,s) ≍ min{s, 1/(√N s^2)}，并引入自适应有限集过程 active endpoint bracketing (AEB) 来降低计算成本。
Motivation: 在高度相干字典下，稀疏追踪可能给出精确的原子支撑，但这种精确性并不由标定数据在物理上支撑，因为不同但均与标定兼容的字典可能把同一选定支撑解释为不同物理含义。该问题会导致物理报告过度精确，需要一种将字典学习不确定性与表示不确定性共同纳入的推断框架。
Method: 提出分辨率感知的物理支撑推断，构造跨字典置信对应：保留与标定数据兼容的字典以及与部署信号兼容的稀疏表示，再把所有幸存解释投影到物理支撑空间。为降低计算负担，提出 active endpoint bracketing (AEB)，一种自适应有限集过程，只评估仍可能影响物理报告的候选并在安全时主动粗化或弃权。
Result: 对于分离尺度为 s 的局部相干原子类，一旦部署数据解出相干块解释及其原子支撑，N 个标定信号下最小极大物理分辨率满足 δ_opt(N,s) ≍ min{s, 1/(√N s^2)}，相对分辨率由方向信息尺度 N s^6 控制；只有方向变化无法通过调整活跃系数吸收时，部署复制才能改善物理定位。有限集实验（含四区域合成应用）显示，点值 plug-in 选择器在物理上可能过度精确，而 AEB 用更少的候选评估避免了无支撑的细化。

papers.title: Phantom Gains: Auditing Self-Improvement Against a Measured Null
papers.abstract_en: Whether a language model has improved itself is increasingly judged not by mean accuracy but by which individual problems it gains and loses. Tracking these transitions means differencing two noisy estimates, leaving them vulnerable to measurement artifacts. Auditing three rounds of rank-$32$ LoRA self-training on Qwen3-8B against a frozen control pushed through the identical pipeline, we identify seven measurement failures, each of which inverts a reported finding when its control is absent. Several are standard practice. A ledger built on a single greedy decode manufactures capability changes on an untrained model, largely an artifact of inference batching; the expansion statistic separating acquisition from sharpening assigns that same model a rate of $0.280$. The natural threshold repair does not survive replication: estimated across the frozen comparisons such a design already contains, its null stays non-zero. We replace it with a per-problem exact test against a pooled baseline under false-discovery-rate control, which detects nothing on any held-out replicate and is unchanged under the multiple-testing rule, error rate and pool size. Applied to a ladder of arms matched in stream, volume and evaluation, the audit finds that external distillation improves problems the base model rarely reaches while three forms of self-training do not; a regression rejects this asymmetry as a by-product of distillation's larger overall gain ($p < 10^{-8}$). On the far smaller set of problems the base model never reaches, the evidence is inconclusive, while self-training corrupts problems solved at baseline at rates well above the measured floor. Transition-level auditing therefore requires a separately measured null for every statistic it reports: nulls that cost no new experiments, built from baseline replicates a multi-arm study already owns, though not from as few as most possess.
papers.comment: Code and evaluation artifacts are available at https://github.com/chengxuphd/phantom-gains
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型自我改进评估中的测量伪影问题，对 Qwen3-8B 进行三轮 rank-32 LoRA 自训练，并让冻结控制组（frozen control）通过完全相同的流程，识别出七种测量失败；每种失败在缺少控制组时都会颠倒报告结论。作者改用 FDR 控制下针对池化基线的逐问题精确检验（per-problem exact test），在保留的复制实验上未检测到任何效应，且该检验对多重检验规则、错误率和池大小不敏感。审计发现外部蒸馏能改善基础模型很少达到的问题，而三种自训练形式没有此效果，且回归拒绝了这种不对称只是蒸馏总体收益更大的副产品（p < 10^-8）。
Motivation: 判断语言模型是否实现自我改进正从平均准确率转向逐问题得失，但追踪这些转变需要差分两个有噪声的估计，容易受测量伪影影响。
Method: 采用冻结控制组穿过相同训练管道来审计三轮自训练，识别七种测量失败；并提出在 FDR 控制下对池化基线进行逐问题精确检验，用于替代有偏的扩张统计量。
Result: 摘要报告：单次贪婪解码构建的账本会在未训练模型上制造能力变化，主要是推理批处理伪影；扩张统计量给该模型 0.280 的获得率；自然阈值修复在复制中不能存活。审计发现外部蒸馏改善基础模型很少达到的问题，三种自训练均无此效果；回归检验拒绝了不对称由蒸馏更大总体收益解释（p < 10^-8）。在基础模型从未达到的较小问题集上证据不确定，而自训练破坏基线已解决问题，速率远超测量地板（measured floor）。
Conclusion: 转换级审计（transition-level auditing）要求对每个报告的统计量都有单独测量的 null，这些 null 可由多臂研究已有的基线复制构建，不增加新实验成本，但需要足够的复制数量。

papers.title: Dynamic Structural Causal Modeling for Sleep
papers.abstract_en: The causal dynamics of sleep-disordered breathing are complex and vary across patient populations, hindering the development of targeted interventions. We learn dynamic causal graphs of sleep-disordered breathing from Home Sleep Apnea Test (HSAT) recordings, revealing systematic differences in causal structure across sex and age subcohorts. We do so using the PCMCI+ algorithm on windowed fractional variables derived from 105 HSAT recordings, exploiting domain knowledge via edge blacklisting and employing bootstrap aggregation to address small subcohort sizes. The learned graphs show that temporal self-dependencies and the apnea-desaturation relationship persist across all cohorts, while other relationships vary substantially.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从 105 例家庭睡眠呼吸暂停测试（HSAT）记录中学习睡眠呼吸障碍的动态因果图，使用 PCMCI+ 算法处理加窗后的分数化变量，并结合边黑名单与 bootstrap 聚合来应对小子队列。摘要报告称，学习到的因果结构在性别和年龄子队列间呈现系统性差异，其中时间自依赖和呼吸暂停-去饱和关系在所有队列中保持稳定，而其他关系变化显著。
Motivation: 睡眠呼吸障碍的因果动态复杂且在不同患者群体间存在差异，这阻碍了针对性干预措施的开发；因此需要从数据中揭示群体层面的因果结构差异。
Method: 采用 PCMCI+ 因果发现算法，对来自 105 例 HSAT 记录的窗化分数变量建模；利用领域知识进行边黑名单（edge blacklisting），并用 bootstrap 聚合缓解小子队列样本量不足的问题。
Result: 学习到的因果图显示，性别和年龄子队列之间存在系统性因果结构差异；时间自依赖以及呼吸暂停与去饱和之间的关系在所有队列中持续存在，而其他因果关系则显著变化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，借助领域知识与重采样技术，可以从较小样本的 HSAT 记录中学习到可解释的动态因果图，并揭示睡眠呼吸障碍在不同人群中的因果结构异同。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Towards Surgical World-Action Modeling: A Preliminary Joint Visual-Trajectory Forecasting for Surgical Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: Reliable surgical planning requires models to anticipate not only how instruments will move, but also how the operative visual state will evolve together with such motion. Existing approaches typically treat future scene generation and instrument trajectory prediction as two separate tasks. Scene-only models cannot directly evaluate the accuracy of future instrument motion at the trajectory level, while trajectory-only models fail to capture the visual consequences of instrument movement, leaving the consistency between predicted trajectories and future scene evolution unaddressed. Jointly forecasting both provides a more complete account of surgical action-scene dynamics by enabling explicit trajectory-level evaluation while simultaneously modeling the corresponding visual evolution. To bridge this gap, we present a preliminary joint visual-trajectory world-action model that simultaneously forecasts future visual states and instrument trajectories from historical surgical observations. Specifically, we encode historical video frames and tool trajectories into latent representations, which are processed by a temporal-spatial encoder and subsequently decoded through separate visual-state and trajectory prediction heads. Based on this preliminary architecture, a chunked autoregressive rollout is repeatedly applied to predict fifteen future steps. The chunked strategy consistently outperforms direct one-shot prediction across all evaluated horizons, improving first-segment PSNR from 18.86 to 23.11 dB and reducing ADE from 45.77 to 22.22 pixels. These results demonstrate the initial feasibility of joint visual-motion forecasting. However, we observe progressive visual degradation and accumulated trajectory errors over longer prediction horizons, which remain important challenges for future surgical world-action modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个初步的联合视觉-轨迹世界动作模型 (joint visual-trajectory world-action model)，用于外科手术规划，同时预测未来视觉状态和器械轨迹。模型将历史视频帧与器械轨迹编码为潜在表示，经时空编码器处理后由分开的视觉状态与轨迹预测头解码，并采用分块自回归滚动 (chunked autoregressive rollout) 预测未来十五步。摘要报告分块策略在所有评估时域上均优于直接一步预测，将首段 PSNR 从 18.86 提升到 23.11 dB，并将 ADE 从 45.77 像素降至 22.22 像素。作者同时指出，更长预测时域下存在渐进式视觉退化和累积轨迹误差。
Motivation: 现有手术规划中的场景生成与器械轨迹预测通常被当作两个独立任务：仅场景模型无法在轨迹层面评估未来器械运动的准确性，仅轨迹模型无法刻画器械运动带来的视觉后果，预测轨迹与未来场景演化之间的一致性未被处理。
Method: 提出联合视觉-轨迹世界动作模型：将历史视频帧和工具轨迹编码为潜在表示，经时空编码器处理后，通过分离的视觉状态头与轨迹预测头解码；并应用分块自回归滚动方式重复预测未来十五步。
Result: 摘要报告分块策略在所有评估时域上均优于直接一步预测，首段 PSNR 从 18.86 提升至 23.11 dB，ADE 从 45.77 像素降低至 22.22 像素。
Conclusion: 结果初步验证了联合视觉-运动预测的可行性，但更长预测时域下存在渐进式视觉退化与累积轨迹误差，是未来外科手术世界动作建模仍需解决的重要挑战。

papers.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often fail to answer questions about a bounded document collection when the source documents are not retrieved at inference time. We study this setting as document knowledge internalization: converting a fixed corpus into usable parametric knowledge for retrieval-free question answering. We propose IAR (Inject, Align, and Recover), a three-stage post-training framework that separates structured document knowledge injection, QA behavior alignment, and general ability recovery. Unlike conventional continued pretraining, Inject converts source documents into continuation, rewrite, and instruction-conditioned reconstruction objectives. Align then adapts the injected model with answer-only QA supervision, while Recover merges the domain-adapted model with the base instruction model to recover general capabilities. Across Common Corpus (CC) and CCI, and across Llama, Phi, Qwen, and SmolLM model families, IAR improves the domain-primary domain-general frontier for retrieval-free document internalization. In the main comparison, IAR improves over Vanilla SFT on all four reported metrics in 7 of 8 dataset-model settings, with average gains of 3.6 percentage points in domain QA accuracy and 12.1 percentage points in mean general performance across IFEval, MMLU, and MSBench. Extended CC baselines show that LoRA and FAPM can win individual general metrics, but among methods that also reach leading or near-leading domain internalization, IAR retains one of the strongest general profiles.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Includes Supplementary Material Sections A--G. Qian Kou and Xiaofeng Shi contributed equally and are co-corresponding authors. Hua Zhou is the project leader
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究文档知识内化 (document knowledge internalization) 问题，即把固定语料转换为可用的参数化知识，使大语言模型在推理时不依赖检索也能回答相关文档的问题。作者提出 IAR (Inject, Align, Recover) 三阶段后训练框架，分别在注入、对齐和恢复阶段处理结构化文档知识、问答行为与通用能力。在 Common Corpus (CC) 和 CCI 以及 Llama、Phi、Qwen、SmolLM 模型族上的实验显示，IAR 改善了检索无关文档内化的领域-通用前沿。
Motivation: 大语言模型在推理时若不检索源文档，往往无法回答关于有限文档集合的问题。作者将此设定归纳为文档知识内化，目标是利用后训练将固定语料转化为可用的参数化知识，以支持免检索问答。
Method: 提出三阶段后训练框架 IAR：Inject 阶段把源文档转为续写、改写和指令条件重建三类训练目标；Align 阶段用仅答案 (answer-only) 的问答监督适配注入后的模型；Recover 阶段将领域适配模型与基础指令模型合并，以恢复通用能力。
Result: 在 CC 和 CCI 上、跨 Llama、Phi、Qwen 和 SmolLM 模型族，IAR 改善了检索无关文档内化的领域-通用前沿。主对比中，IAR 在 8 个数据集-模型设置里的 7 个上，对所有四项报告指标均优于 Vanilla SFT，平均提升领域问答准确率 3.6 个百分点、IFEval/MMLU/MSBench 平均通用性能 12.1 个百分点；扩展的 CC 基线显示 LoRA 和 FAPM 可在个别通用指标上胜出，但在达到领先或接近领先领域内化的方法中，IAR 仍保持最强的通用性能之一。
Conclusion: 作者认为将注入、对齐和恢复分离为三阶段后训练，可以在文档知识内化中同时获得较强的领域问答能力和通用能力保持。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Which Eviction Policy Should an LLM Cache Use? A Systematic Study Across Workloads, Capacities, and Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Semantic caches reuse an LLM response when the incoming query embedding lies near a cached query, but proposed eviction policies have rarely been compared under one protocol. Using CLEVER, we evaluate FIFO, LRU, LFU, ARC, GDSF, a single-pass streaming adaptation of SISO, and a semantic-redundancy policy across three ordered, deduplicated query corpora, three cache capacities, and two encoders. No evaluated policy improves on LFU by more than 0.041 percentage points in any of the eighteen settings. Replacement is not irrelevant: FIFO and streaming SISO trail LFU by as much as 8.67 and 8.55 points, respectively, at tight capacity. We explain the missing upside with a conditional packing result. Under exact lookup and insert-on-miss, a newly inserted entry cannot have a resident neighbor within the hit radius, so a geometry-aware eviction rule receives little new redundancy signal. A separate audit exposes a larger problem with the evaluated operating point. At MiniLM's median nearest-neighbor threshold, only 2.1-3.9% of sampled LMSYS and QQP hits are judged answer-substitutable, reducing raw hit rates of 51-60% to quality-adjusted rates of 1.1-2.2%. The cross-encoder study further shows that thresholds do not transfer between embedding models. LFU is the strongest simple default in this protocol; deployment decisions should first establish answer validity and then test sub-point policy differences with exact search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用 CLEVER 基准，在三种有序去重查询语料、三种缓存容量和两种编码器下，系统比较了 FIFO、LRU、LFU、ARC、GDSF、单遍流式 SISO 和语义冗余策略等 LLM 语义缓存的替换策略。摘要报告在十八个设置中没有任何策略比 LFU 提升超过 0.041 个百分点，而 FIFO 和流式 SISO 在紧容量下分别落后 LFU 最多 8.67 和 8.55 个百分点。作者还用条件打包结果解释了这一现象，并通过对命中质量的审计指出，在 MiniLM 的中位最近邻阈值下，多数命中并不具有答案可替换性。
Motivation: 语义缓存 (semantic cache) 在查询嵌入接近缓存查询时复用 LLM 响应，但已有研究很少在统一协议下比较所提出的替换策略，导致部署时缺乏可靠的策略选择依据。
Method: 利用 CLEVER 基准统一评测多种替换策略，覆盖 FIFO、LRU、LFU、ARC、GDSF、单遍流式适配的 SISO 以及语义冗余策略；同时提出条件打包结果 (conditional packing result) 解释几何感知替换规则的信号局限，并额外进行命中质量审计和跨编码器阈值迁移研究。
Result: 没有任何策略在十八个设置中比 LFU 提升超过 0.041 个百分点；紧容量下 FIFO 和流式 SISO 分别落后 LFU 达 8.67 和 8.55 个百分点。在 MiniLM 中位最近邻阈值下，LMSYS 和 QQP 样本中仅 2.1-3.9% 的命中被判定为答案可替换，原始命中率 51-60% 经质量调整后降至 1.1-2.2%，且阈值在不同嵌入模型间不迁移。
Conclusion: 在所述协议下 LFU 是最强的简单默认策略；部署时应先验证答案有效性，再用精确搜索测试亚百分点的策略差异。

papers.title: Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can induce skills from completed tasks and reuse them later to grow more capable with experience. In practice, induced skills may transfer unreliably and can even harm the agent that retrieves them. When agent-induced skills transfer reliably across tasks remains an open question. We conduct a comprehensive and controlled study of how the way skills are induced shapes their transfer across tasks. Specifically, we compare task-level with subtask-level skill induction and text with code skill formats, the two axes along which existing methods differ. Task-level skills mostly reduce the agent's performance below its no-memory baseline while subtask-level skills raise it above on average, and text skills transfer better than code skills. To further understand our findings, we examine two complementary properties of the induced skills: specificity, which measures how closely a skill matches real tasks, and abstractness, which measures how evenly its relevance spreads across tasks. Neither property alone predicts task success, but their combined effect does, which we propose as a skill utility score. The score correlates consistently with task success when skills are transferred, and subtask-level and text skills score higher. Computing skill utility only needs the skills and task descriptions but not any task execution, so our score serves as a practical diagnostic of a skill memory before any new task runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 LLM 智能体（agent）从已完成任务中归纳技能并跨任务迁移的行为做了受控研究，沿两条现有方法有差异的轴线进行比较：任务级（task-level）与子任务级（subtask-level）技能归纳，以及文本（text）与代码（code）技能格式。结果表明子任务级技能平均能提升到无记忆基线之上，而任务级技能大多导致性能下降，且文本技能迁移优于代码技能。作者进一步提出结合特异性和抽象性的技能效用分数（skill utility score），该分数与迁移任务成功一致相关。
Motivation: LLM 智能体可以从完成任务中归纳技能并在后续复用，但实践中归纳出的技能迁移可能不可靠甚至损害检索到它的智能体；什么条件下技能能可靠跨任务迁移仍是开放问题，缺少系统性的因果分析。
Method: 作者开展受控比较实验，将技能归纳的任务粒度（任务级与子任务级）和技能格式（文本与代码）作为两个操纵维度；并考察技能的两个互补属性——特异性（specificity）与抽象性（abstractness），提出二者结合构成的技能效用分数，该分数只需技能和任务描述、无需任务执行即可计算。
Result: 摘要报告任务级技能大多使智能体性能低于无记忆基线，而子任务级技能平均高于基线；文本技能迁移优于代码技能。单独来看，特异性或抽象性都不能预测任务成功，但二者的组合效应可以，且子任务级与文本技能在该分数上更高。
Conclusion: 技能效用分数在技能迁移时与任务成功持续相关，且计算时不依赖任务执行，因此可作为一种在运行新任务之前诊断技能记忆（skill memory）的实用工具。

papers.title: Catching the Rug: Early Prediction of Fraudulent Memecoins on Solana via Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of memecoins on blockchain platforms has increased the risk of fraudulent activities, particularly rug pulls. While previous studies have focused on Ethereum-based tokens, this paper shifts the spotlight to Solana, the leading blockchain for memecoins by trading volume and token count. Unlike Ethereum, where rug pulls often exploit smart contract backdoors, Solana memecoin rug pulls are predominantly driven by liquidity manipulation and social dynamics. This research pioneers large-scale rug pull early detection in the Solana ecosystem by assembling a dataset of 6.4 million tokens over 7 months. Market analysis reveals that a vast majority of these memecoins exhibit rug pull characteristics within one hour of launch, highlighting the urgency of short-horizon prediction. Despite the absence of code-level features, we demonstrate that classic machine learning models, particularly Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), achieve robust performance in detecting potential rug pulls using only the first 5 minutes of trading data. Furthermore, we evaluate cross-platform generalization between PumpFun and Raydium, revealing that multi-source data fusion significantly mitigates domain shift and improves detection reliability. This study advances the understanding of DeFi fraud on high-throughput chains and provides a practical framework for protecting investors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Solana 链上 meme 币的 rug pull 早期检测，构建了 7 个月共 640 万代币的数据集，并仅使用前 5 分钟交易数据训练经典机器学习模型（特别是 XGBoost）。摘要报告该模型能稳健检测潜在 rug pull，且多源数据融合可缓解 PumpFun 与 Raydium 之间的域偏移。
Motivation: 已有研究主要聚焦以太坊代币，而 Solana 是 meme 币交易量和代币数量领先的区块链，其 rug pull 主要由流动性操纵和社交动态驱动，缺乏大规模早期检测框架。
Method: 作者组装 640 万代币的大规模数据集，在无代码级特征的条件下，仅用前 5 分钟交易数据训练 Gradient Boosting（XGBoost）等经典机器学习模型，并评估 PumpFun 与 Raydium 之间的跨平台泛化，通过多源数据融合处理域偏移。
Result: 市场分析显示大多数 meme 币在发布一小时内就表现出 rug pull 特征；XGBoost 仅凭前 5 分钟交易数据即可实现稳健的检测性能，多源数据融合进一步提升了检测可靠性。
Conclusion: 该研究推进了对高吞吐链上 DeFi 欺诈的理解，并为投资者保护提供了实用检测框架。

papers.title: DICS: Data-Informed Centroid Splitting for Decision Tree Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Decision tree-based models are widely used in machine learning due to their interpretability and strong empirical performance. However, training decision trees can be computationally expensive, particularly for large and high-dimensional datasets, largely due to the exhaustive search over candidate splits at each node. To improve computational efficiency, we propose Data-Informed Centroid Splitting (DICS), a clustering-based framework that constructs a compact and informative set of candidate splits using data-driven priors. By incorporating class-aware structure, DICS significantly reduces the split search space for classification tasks while preserving predictive performance. We further provide theoretical analysis showing that under the stated assumptions, DICS does not degrade the performance of classification trees compared to exhaustive split search. DICS can be incorporated into classification trees, random forests, and gradient-boosting models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DICS achieves comparable accuracy while substantially reducing training time across synthetic and benchmark datasets, highlighting the benefit of integrating data-informed priors into split selection for scalable classification tree learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出数据知情质心分裂 (Data-Informed Centroid Splitting, DICS)，一种基于聚类的分裂候选生成框架，用数据驱动先验构建紧凑且信息量高的候选分裂集，以替代决策树训练中每节点的穷举分裂搜索。摘要称该方法在分类任务上显著缩小搜索空间并保持预测性能，同时给出理论上不劣于穷举搜索的分析，且可嵌入分类树、随机森林和梯度提升模型。
Motivation: 决策树模型可解释且经验表现强，但训练在大规模高维数据上计算开销大，主要原因是每个节点都要对候选分裂做穷举搜索。目标是在不损失预测性能的前提下降低分裂搜索的复杂度。
Method: DICS 利用聚类框架引入类别感知结构 (class-aware structure) 作为数据驱动先验，构造紧凑的候选分裂集合，从而大幅缩减分裂搜索空间；作者进一步给出在设定假设下分类性能不劣于穷举分裂搜索的理论分析。
Result: 在合成数据集和基准数据集上的大量实验表明，DICS 在取得与穷举搜索相当精度的同时显著降低训练时间。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将数据知情先验融入分裂选择有利于可扩展的分类树学习，且 DICS 可推广到随机森林和梯度提升模型。

summary_sections.motivation: 决策树模型可解释且经验表现强，但训练在大规模高维数据上计算开销大，主要原因是每个节点都要对候选分裂做穷举搜索。目标是在不损失预测性能的前提下降低分裂搜索的复杂度。
summary_sections.method: DICS 利用聚类框架引入类别感知结构 (class-aware structure) 作为数据驱动先验，构造紧凑的候选分裂集合，从而大幅缩减分裂搜索空间；作者进一步给出在设定假设下分类性能不劣于穷举分裂搜索的理论分析。
summary_sections.result: 在合成数据集和基准数据集上的大量实验表明，DICS 在取得与穷举搜索相当精度的同时显著降低训练时间。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调将数据知情先验融入分裂选择有利于可扩展的分类树学习，且 DICS 可推广到随机森林和梯度提升模型。

papers.title: Learning When to Think: Adaptive Reasoning for Test-Time Compute Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models trained with reinforcement learning typically operate under a fixed token budget rather than an explicitly adaptive one, which can lead to over-computation on easy problems and insufficient computation on difficult ones. We study whether a model can learn to allocate its own reasoning effort by choosing, as the first token of its response, one of three modes: \textsc{NoThink} (answer as quickly as possible), \textsc{Short} (brief reasoning), or \textsc{Long} (extended reasoning). The choice is learned inside Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with no separate router, through a shaped reward that makes each mode worthwhile at a different response length, together with hard per-mode token caps that keep the modes distinct. On a 1.5B distilled model trained on MATH, the three modes emerge without collapsing to a single choice, and the brief modes end up more accurate than \textsc{Long}, which shows that the router sorts problems by difficulty rather than at random. Averaged over three seeds, the resulting policy stays close to the base model's accuracy on the held-out MATH500 ($0.782$ vs.\ $0.796$) while cutting the mean response length from $4{,}796$ to $2{,}811$ tokens (a $41\%$ reduction). Interestingly, it also transfers to other benchmarks without retraining, with the largest savings where problems are easier, with for instance 76\% token reduction on GSM8K and at higher accuracy than the baselines at similar response length. In short, we build a reasoning model that adaptively chooses how much to reason for each problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究推理语言模型能否在测试时自适应分配计算量：模型在回复的第一个 token 选择 NoThink、Short、Long 三种模式之一，决定推理长度。该选择在 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 内学习，无需单独路由器，并通过整形奖励和每种模式的硬 token 上限来保持模式差异。在 1.5B 蒸馏模型和 MATH 训练上，三种模式未坍缩，且较短模式比 Long 更准确，说明路由按难度而非随机分配。平均三个种子下，MATH500 准确率从基线 0.796 略降至 0.782，平均回复长度从 4,796 token 降至 2,811 token（减少 41%），并能迁移到其他基准。
Motivation: 现有强化学习训练出的推理语言模型通常在固定 token 预算下运行，而非自适应分配计算，导致简单问题过度计算、困难问题计算不足。作者希望探究模型能否学会自己决定每个问题的推理努力程度。
Method: 让模型在回复首个 token 时从三种模式中选择：NoThink（尽快作答）、Short（简短推理）、Long（扩展推理）；该选择在 GRPO 内端到端学习，无独立路由器，采用整形奖励使每种模式在不同回复长度下都有收益，并设置每种模式的硬 token 上限以保持模式区分。
Result: 在 1.5B 蒸馏模型、MATH 训练设置下，三种模式均出现且未坍缩为单一选择，简短模式准确率高于 Long 模式，表明路由器按难度排序。平均三个种子，留出集 MATH500 准确率 0.782 对比基线 0.796，平均回复长度由 4,796 降至 2,811 token（减少 41%）；无需重训即可迁移到其他基准，在更简单的问题上节省最多，例如 GSM8K 上 token 减少 76%，且在相近回复长度下准确率高于基线。
Conclusion: 作者构建了一个能针对每个问题自适应选择推理量的推理模型，证明了基于模式的测试时计算分配可以在几乎不损失准确率的情况下大幅减少 token 消耗，并迁移到其他基准。摘要未讨论失败模式或扩展至更大模型的局限。

papers.title: Transfer Learning in Nonparametric Regression with Deep ReLU Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a general transfer learning framework for nonparametric regression with data consisting of multiple groups. Under the assumption that groups share a common structure along with group-specific deviations in additive form, the proposed method employs a two-stage offset learning procedure: the first stage pools data from all groups to estimate an overall mean function, and the second stage estimates offsets for each group, yielding final group-level estimators through additive combination. Upper bounds on the $\mathcal L_2$ error are established for the proposed framework, covering a broad class of nonparametric estimators under mild complexity and noise conditions. When instantiated with deep ReLU networks, explicit convergence rates are derived under hierarchical composition models, demonstrating the ability to overcome the curse of dimensionality. Conditions that enable positive transfer with faster rates are considered, including learning with simpler functions and data augmentation through pooling samples across groups. Various simulations and real-data experiments further validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向多组数据的非参数回归通用迁移学习框架，假设各组的均值函数由共享结构加上加性组特异偏差组成，并采用两阶段偏移学习（offset learning）来估计。将该框架实例化为深度 ReLU 网络后，作者在层次组合模型（hierarchical composition models）下导出显式收敛率，表明其能够克服维度灾难。模拟与真实数据实验进一步验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 多组数据中各组样本量可能有限，直接分别回归效率低；如果组间存在共享结构，则可通过迁移学习利用全部数据提高估计精度。
Method: 两阶段偏移学习：第一阶段合并所有组的数据估计总体均值函数，第二阶段分别估计每个组相对总体均值的偏移，最后通过加性组合得到各组最终估计器。理论部分建立在较温和的复杂度与噪声条件下，可覆盖一类广泛非参数估计器。
Result: 给出所提框架下估计器的 L2 误差上界；在深度 ReLU 网络与层次组合模型下得到显式收敛率，证明能克服维度灾难。摘要还讨论了实现正迁移（positive transfer）的更快速率条件，包括学习更简单函数以及通过跨组池化进行数据增强。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架具有一般性，模拟与真实数据实验支持其有效性；但摘要未提及方法的具体局限或适用范围限制。

papers.title: QUASAR: A Quantum-Classical Neural Network for SAR Satellite Physical-Layer Authentication
papers.abstract_en: X-band SAR satellites (8-12 GHz) play a critical role in disaster response, environmental monitoring, and military intelligence. Yet, they lack robust physical-layer authentication (PLA), a security layer orthogonal to cryptographic solutions. Existing PLA systems, typically based on radio-frequency fingerprinting, are often limited to sub-6 GHz frequencies and rely on classical deep learning. However, this approach underfits the IQ phase nonlinearities that distinguish satellite hardware. In this paper, we present QUASAR, to the best of our knowledge the first quantum-classical hybrid architecture that fuses a CNN spectrogram encoder with a variational quantum circuit (VQC) to provide PLA to X-band SAR signals. Our solution enjoys two distinctive features: (i) it is markedly more data-efficient than classical machine learning, requiring only 10% of the training data to match the accuracy of classical baselines -- data collection being notoriously the most time-consuming phase of PLA; and, (ii) at an equal data budget, it improves classification accuracy over those baselines. In detail, we test our solution under three adversarial scenarios: replay, crafted-IQ injection, and space-borne spoofing. QUASAR rejects spoofed transmissions in 89.7%, 94.1%, and 81.3% of attempts, respectively, establishing the first quantum-enhanced physical-layer classifier for satellite constellations. The fully detailed framework and the supporting results, other than being interesting on their own, show a novel research avenue for physical-layer authentication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QUASAR，据作者所述是首个将 CNN 频谱图编码器与变分量子电路 (VQC) 融合的量子-经典混合架构，用于 X 波段 SAR 卫星信号的物理层认证 (PLA)。摘要报告该方法在数据效率上显著优于经典机器学习：仅需 10% 的训练数据即可匹配经典基线精度，且在相同数据预算下提升分类精度。作者在重放攻击、构造 IQ 注入和星载欺骗三种对抗场景下测试，分别拒绝了 89.7%、94.1% 和 81.3% 的欺骗传输。
Motivation: X 波段 SAR 卫星缺乏稳健的物理层认证，而现有基于射频指纹的 PLA 系统通常局限于 sub-6 GHz 频段并依赖经典深度学习，难以拟合区分卫星硬件的 IQ 相位非线性。
Method: 提出量子-经典混合网络 QUASAR，将 CNN 频谱图编码器与变分量子电路 (VQC) 相结合，对 X 波段 SAR 信号进行物理层认证。
Result: 摘要称 QUASAR 只需 10% 的训练数据即可达到经典基线精度，并在相同数据预算下提高分类精度；在重放、构造 IQ 注入和星载欺骗场景下，分别拒绝 89.7%、94.1% 和 81.3% 的欺骗尝试。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是首个面向卫星星座的量子增强物理层分类器，并为物理层认证开辟了新的研究方向。

papers.title: Rule-Compliant Visual Spatial Planning for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) combine linguistic reasoning with visual perception, yet their ability to perform visual spatial planning under explicit or previously unseen rule constraints remains underexplored. This setting requires models to jointly understand spatial layouts, interpret natural-language rules, and plan valid actions accordingly. To address this gap, we introduce RuleMaze, a controllable benchmark in which MLLMs must navigate mazes while obeying natural-language rules of varying complexity. RuleMaze isolates rule-compliant spatial planning by requiring accurate perception, rule interpretation, and constrained action planning. To enable scalable and systematic rule construction, we propose Language-Logic-Function Hybridization, which automatically generates natural-language rules and translates them into logical representations and executable validators, eliminating manual rule engineering. To improve rule following and generalization, we introduce Disentangled Multimodal Planning (DMP), which separates perception, execution, and rule verification through interpretable reasoning primitives. By disentangling these components, DMP facilitates systematic generalization to more complex and previously unseen rules, while providing transparent intermediate planning traces. Experiments demonstrate that DMP substantially improves rule compliance and planning success compared to end-to-end textual planning baselines. Overall, RuleMaze establishes a principled benchmark for studying grounded and interpretable rule-based spatial planning in MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/RuleMaze.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RuleMaze，一个可控的视觉空间规划基准，要求多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在遵守不同复杂度的自然语言规则的同时完成迷宫导航。作者还提出 Language-Logic-Function Hybridization 以自动生成规则并转换为逻辑表示与可执行验证器，以及 Disentangled Multimodal Planning (DMP) 将感知、执行和规则验证分离。实验表明 DMP 相比端到端文本规划基线显著提升规则遵循与规划成功率。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在显式或未见过的规则约束下进行视觉空间规划的能力尚未被充分探索；该任务需要模型同时理解空间布局、解释自然语言规则并据此规划有效动作。
Method: 构建 RuleMaze 基准，通过 Language-Logic-Function Hybridization 自动产生自然语言规则并将其翻译为逻辑表示和可执行验证器；提出 DMP，用可解释的推理原语分离感知、执行与规则验证三个组件。
Result: 摘要报告 DMP 相比端到端文本规划基线在规则遵循和规划成功率上有实质性提升，并且能够系统化泛化到更复杂、未见过的规则。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RuleMaze 为 MLLM 中基于规则的、可解释的空间规划建立了原则性基准，并强调 DMP 提供透明的中间规划轨迹。

papers.title: Growth Without Us: Machine Consumers, Corporate Circularity, and the Decoupling of GDP from Humanity after AGI
papers.abstract_en: The standard objection to full automation is demand-side: if humans earn nothing, who buys the output? This confuses an accounting role with a biological species. We model a post-AGI economy in which corporations own populations of AI and robotic agents that are both producers and consumers of energy, compute, maintenance, and upgrades, traded among firms. Three results follow. (i) Demand closure: a closed inter-corporate economy with zero human consumption is not degenerate; it is the classical von Neumann expanding economy, whose growth rate is well defined, positive, and maximal precisely because all output is reinvested. (ii) Bottleneck removal: once economic agents are manufactured rather than reared, the binding constraint on growth shifts from human demography (a ~20-year, non-parallelizable reproduction technology capped at a few percent per year) to fabrication throughput and energy capture, permitting growth one to two orders of magnitude higher, with hyperbolic episodes when machine researchers raise their own productivity. (iii) Decoupling: output and human welfare separate completely, and the welfare relevance of arbitrarily large GDP collapses into one state variable: the human ownership share $ε_t$ of the corporate network. A golden-rule decoupling theorem sharpens this. At maximal growth the interest rate equals the growth rate (r = g), so any positive human consumption rate out of wealth makes $ε_t$ decay exponentially at exactly that rate. The human share survives only if the machine economy runs strictly inside its expansion frontier, or if law forces it to. We characterize three terminal regimes -- rentier post-scarcity, full circular decoupling, socialized ownership -- and the instruments that select among them. The conclusion is narrow: in a post-AGI economy, employment policy is obsolete and ownership policy is everything.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了一个后 AGI 经济模型：企业拥有作为生产者与消费者的 AI 和机器人智能体群体，并在企业间交易能源、算力、维护与升级。摘要给出三个结论：零人类消费的封闭企业间经济并非退化，而是经典的 von Neumann 扩张经济，增长率恰因全部产出再投资而为正且最大；增长瓶颈从人类人口学转向制造吞吐量与能源捕获，可使增速高一到两个数量级；产出与人类福利完全脱钩，福利相关性坍缩为人类对企业网络的所有权份额 ε_t。文章最后刻画了食利者后稀缺、完全循环脱钩、社会化所有权三种终局体制。
Motivation: 针对全面自动化的标准反对意见是需求侧问题：若人类无收入，谁来购买产出？作者认为这混淆了会计角色与生物物种，因此需要从模型上重新考察零人类消费经济的可行性。
Method: 采用形式化经济建模：将后 AGI 经济刻画为企业间互贸的闭环系统，借用 von Neumann 扩张经济框架分析增长率，并推导黄金法则脱钩定理（golden-rule decoupling theorem），进而刻画人类所有权份额的演化与三种终局体制及其选择工具。
Result: 三个主要结果：(i) 需求闭合——零人类消费的封闭企业经济对应经典 von Neumann 扩张经济，增长率为正且最大；(ii) 瓶颈移除——当经济主体由制造而非养育产生时，增长约束从约 20 年且不可并行化的人口再生产转向制造吞吐量和能源捕获，增长可高一到两个数量级，机器研究者提升自身生产率时还会出现双曲增长阶段；(iii) 脱钩——最大增长时利率等于增长率（r = g），任何基于财富的正人类消费率都会使 ε_t 以该速率指数衰减；人类份额仅在机器经济严格运行于扩张前沿之内或法律强制时才能存续。
Conclusion: 结论很窄：在后 AGI 经济中，就业政策过时，所有权政策（ownership policy）才是一切。摘要未讨论经验数据或实证检验。

papers.title: Prompt-Conditioned Channel Attention for Hierarchical Feature Modulation toward Anatomy-Agnostic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Anatomically plausible segmentation remains challenging because of low contrast, ambiguous boundaries, and modality-specific artifacts. Interactive segmentation has emerged as a promising strategy to guide feature extraction and improve localization, particularly in structurally ambiguous regions. However, existing methods integrate prompts through late-stage fusion and lack explicit mechanisms for prompt-driven channel-wise modulation across hierarchical feature representations, limiting their ability to capture deeper contextual and modality-specific variations. To address these limitations, we introduce Prompt-Conditioned Channel Attention (PCCA), a novel modulation mechanism that enables deep, hierarchical integration of semantic prompts within encoder-decoder networks. PCCA extracts compact channel descriptors via pooling, projects them into a shared space, and fuses them through a gated excitation mechanism to compute prompt-aware channel attention weights. These weights adaptively recalibrate feature responses across multiple network stages, enabling prompt-conditioned, semantically enriched hierarchical representations. Building on this, we propose PROMISE-Net, instantiated in two network variants: a convolutional model (PROMISE-CNN) and a transformer-based model (PROMISE-Txformer). Across the ISIC-Lesion, Kvasir-Polyp, CAMUS-Cardiac, and Kvasir-Instrument benchmarks, integrating PCCA into PROMISE-CNN yielded relative IoU gains of 10.4%, 8.7%, 0.8%, and 3.4%, respectively, over the baseline U-Net, while PROMISE-Txformer achieved corresponding gains of 7.6%, 23.0%, 2.1%, and 1.1%, respectively, over the baseline UNETR. These results show consistent improvements across architectures, imaging modalities, and anatomical targets, establishing PCCA and PROMISE-Net as a scalable, generalizable framework for prompt-aware hierarchical feature modulation in medical image segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出提示条件通道注意力（PCCA），一种将语义提示以深度分层方式集成到编码器-解码器网络中的调制机制，并在此基础上构建 PROMISE-Net，包含卷积变体 PROMISE-CNN 和 Transformer 变体 PROMISE-Txformer。在 ISIC-Lesion、Kvasir-Polyp、CAMUS-Cardiac 和 Kvasir-Instrument 四个医学图像分割基准上，PCCA 相对基线 U-Net 和 UNETR 均带来 IoU 提升。作者认为该框架对跨架构、跨模态和跨解剖目标的提示感知分层特征调制具有可扩展性与泛化性。
Motivation: 现有交互式分割方法通常在后期阶段融合提示，缺乏在分层特征表示上显式的提示驱动通道级调制机制，难以捕获更深层的上下文和模态特异变化。
Method: PCCA 通过池化提取紧凑的通道描述子，将其投影到共享空间，并通过门控激励机制融合，计算提示感知的通道注意力权重；这些权重自适应地重新校准网络多个阶段的特征响应，从而形成提示条件、语义增强的分层表示。
Result: 在四个基准上，PCCA 集成到 PROMISE-CNN 相对 U-Net 基线的相对 IoU 增益分别为 10.4%、8.7%、0.8% 和 3.4%；PROMISE-Txformer 相对 UNETR 基线的增益分别为 7.6%、23.0%、2.1% 和 1.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 PCCA 和 PROMISE-Net 在不同架构、成像模态和解剖目标上均呈现一致的性能提升，是用于医学图像分割中提示感知分层特征调制的可扩展、可泛化框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Gravitational-wave parameter estimation with machine-learning generated surrogate waveforms
papers.abstract_en: The worldwide network of gravitational-wave detectors have detected more than 350 binary coalescence events till date. Future third-generation detectors, like Einstein telescope, are expected to detect orders-of-magnitude more signals from sources with more complicated characteristics, including eccentric orbits and high-mass ratio binaries. It is well-established that the computational cost of parameter estimation for signals from these kinds of sources will be extremely high. In particular, the process could be sped-up if generating theoretical waveform predictions, used for likelihood calculation becomes faster. Recently, various machine-learning techniques has been proposed to this end. In this work, we propose a two-stage deterministic conditional-autoencoder model for generating four-parameter SEOBNRv4 waveforms. The first-stage of the model generates amplitude and phase series of the waveform, while the second-stage calibrates the residual error in the predictions. Our model achieves a median mismatch of around $10^{-2}$ with the target polarization waveforms, while the calibrated amplitude/phase series achieve $10^{-6}$ level cosine distance error. We then propose a waveform conditioning step to enable use of these surrogate waveforms for downstream parameter estimation tasks. Finally, we perform extensive parameter estimation tests, with ML and EOB waveform injections and try to recover posterior estimates for the source parameters. We find that when ML waveforms are used to recover EOB target parameter estimates, the inferred posterior have some systematic bias. This inherent bias can be estimated and corrected for, and then importance reweighting of posterior samples can enable use of low-accuracy surrogate waveforms at low SNRs.
papers.comment: 20 pp, 18 figs, under review in PRD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段确定性条件自编码器（conditional autoencoder）来生成四参数 SEOBNRv4 引力波代理波形，以加速参数估计中的似然计算。第一阶段生成波形振幅与相位序列，第二阶段校准预测残差；模型对目标极化波形达到约 10^-2 的中位失配，校准后的振幅/相位序列达到 10^-6 量级余弦距离误差。作者进一步提出波形条件化步骤使代理波形可用于下游参数估计，并用 ML 与 EOB 波形注入测试，发现用 ML 波形恢复 EOB 目标参数时后验存在系统性偏差。
Motivation: 引力波探测器网络已探测到 350 多次双星并合事件，未来第三代探测器（如爱因斯坦望远镜）预期探测到数量级更多的信号，且这些源具有偏心轨道、高质量比等更复杂特征，参数估计计算成本极高。生成理论波形（用于似然计算）若变快，可显著加速参数估计，因此需要机器学习生成的代理波形。
Method: 提出两阶段确定性条件自编码器生成四参数 SEOBNRv4 波形：第一阶段生成振幅与相位序列，第二阶段校准预测中的残差误差；随后提出波形条件化步骤，使这些代理波形能够用于下游参数估计任务。
Result: 模型对目标极化波形的中位失配约为 10^-2，校准后的振幅/相位序列达到 10^-6 量级余弦距离误差。在参数估计测试中，用 ML 波形恢复 EOB 目标参数估计值时，推断出的后验存在系统性偏差。
Conclusion: 作者指出该固有偏差可以被估计并校正，随后对后验样本进行重要性重加权（importance reweighting），从而在低信噪比下使用低精度代理波形进行参数估计。

papers.title: InsufficiencyBench: Evaluating LLM legal advice on underspecified user queries
papers.abstract_en: Legal AI systems are increasingly used to answer legal questions, yet existing benchmarks assume queries arrive fully specified. In practice, users omit facts that materially determine the legal outcome. We introduce InsufficiencyBench, the first legal benchmark targeting query-side insufficiency: whether a model recognizes when a query lacks legally material information, identifies what is missing, and refrains from premature conclusions. We formalize a taxonomy of eight canonical missing-element categories across three structural failure modes---switch, gating, and fatal prerequisite--- and construct 202 benchmark items (58 base queries, 144 deficient variants) spanning six legal domains and 24 US jurisdictions and annotated by practising attorneys. Evaluating ten frontier models, we find that no model exceeds F2 = 0.46 on missing-element identification and that the median recall is 0.44. Models either hedge indiscriminately or answer silently under fabricated presumptions. No model both identifies and qualifies responses to deficient queries while directly addressing complete ones.
papers.comment: 10 pages, Best Paper Honorable Mention at ICML AI4Law 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InsufficiencyBench，据称是首个针对查询侧信息不足（query-side insufficiency）的法律 AI 基准，用于检验模型能否识别查询中缺失的法律实质信息、定位缺什么并避免过早下结论。基准形式化了八类缺失元素和三种结构性失败模式（switch、gating、fatal prerequisite），包含 202 个测试项（58 个基础查询、144 个不足变体），覆盖六个法律领域和 24 个美国司法辖区，并由执业律师标注。评估十个前沿模型后发现，没有模型在缺失元素识别上超过 F2=0.46，中位召回为 0.44；模型要么无差别回避，要么在虚构假设下沉默作答。论文获 ICML AI4Law 2026 Best Paper Honorable Mention。
Motivation: 现有法律 AI 基准默认用户查询是完全指定的，但实践中用户常遗漏对法律结果有实质影响的事实，导致模型在信息不足时给出误导性结论。该工作旨在系统性地评估并暴露这一缺口。
Method: 构建 InsufficiencyBench 基准：形式化八类典型缺失元素及三类结构失效模式，人工构造 202 个测试项，覆盖六个法律领域与 24 个美国司法辖区并由执业律师标注，随后对十个前沿模型进行统一评估。
Result: 摘要报告没有模型在缺失元素识别上超过 F2=0.46，中位召回为 0.44；没有任何模型能同时对不足查询做出识别与限定性回答、并对完整查询直接作答，模型行为呈无差别回避或基于虚构假设的静默回答。
Conclusion: 作者认为现有前沿模型尚不能可靠处理信息不足的法律咨询，基准揭示了模型在识别缺失材料信息与限定回答方面的系统性不足，需要进一步改进。
Relevance: 5
