papers.title: Electronic Navigational Chart Change Classification
papers.abstract_en: Electronic Navigational Charts (ENCs) are geospatial vector datasets used in maritime navigation systems that represent hydrographic and navigational information such as depths, navigational aids, traffic schemes, and hazards. A major challenge for hydrographic offices is determining whether a given chart change poses a critical or non-critical risk to maritime safety. Existing workflows rely heavily on manual review and verification, which is labor-intensive, scales poorly with the volume of incoming chart updates, and introduces inter-analyst inconsistencies. To address this challenge, we propose a method for automated classification of ENC changes. We establish a baseline encoding scheme to translate complex vector data changes into a structured tabular format for classification models. The two crucial components of the encoding scheme include a spatial context encoder to enrich the change representations with surrounding geographic features, and an ENC attribute encoder to represent nuanced attribute-value descriptions of the modified objects. We evaluate the proposed approach across two distinct operational datasets, comprising 1,308 chart pairs containing over 100,000 individual chart modifications. Tuned gradient-boosted trees leveraging the proposed encoding schemes achieve accuracies of 90% and 94% on the two datasets, yielding a 5-7% improvement over default hyperparameterized models trained on encodings without spatial context and attribute embeddings. These results demonstrate the viability of integrating machine learning into operational geospatial pipelines to improve ENC maintenance and enhance maritime safety. Finally, our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of simple location and spatial aggregation methods, providing a foundation for evaluating more sophisticated spatial representation learning techniques for this application.

TL;DR: 本文针对电子海图（Electronic Navigational Charts, ENC）变更分类问题，提出将复杂矢量数据变更编码为结构化表格并用于机器学习分类的方法。作者设计了空间上下文编码器（spatial context encoder）和 ENC 属性编码器（attribute encoder），配合调参后的梯度提升树（gradient-boosted trees），在两个运行数据集上分别达到 90% 和 94% 的准确率。
Motivation: 水文办公室需要判断海图变更对航行安全是否构成关键风险，现有流程高度依赖人工审查，劳动密集、难以随更新量扩展，且不同分析师之间结果不一致。
Method: 提出一种基准编码方案，将海图矢量变更转换为适合分类模型的结构化表格格式；核心组件包括用于融入周边地理要素的空间上下文编码器，以及用于表示修改对象属性值描述的 ENC 属性编码器。
Result: 在包含 1,308 个海图对、超过 100,000 条单独修改的两个运行数据集上，调参后的梯度提升树达到 90% 和 94% 的准确率，比使用默认超参数、且不含空间上下文和属性嵌入的训练模型提升 5–7%。
Conclusion: 结果表明将机器学习集成到运行中的地理空间处理流程是可行的，可改善 ENC 维护并提升海上安全；同时简单的定位与空间聚合方法也有效，为未来更复杂的空间表示学习方法提供了评估基础。

papers.title: Unwarping the Lens: A Physics-Grounded Approach to Video Glasses Removal
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity removal of eyeglasses from video is a major challenge in facial attribute editing, as the underlying facial geometry is often obscured by complex refractive distortions and view-dependent specular reflections. While large-scale generative priors have shown promise in eye-glasses removal via static image inpainting, they often lack the structural constraints necessary to maintain identity, expression, and pose, leading to visible "identity drift" in both static images and dynamic sequences. In this paper, we propose a novel transfer framework that addresses the stochastic nature of generative priors. Our pipeline first extracts high-fidelity synthetic face images from a commercial-grade generative model (Nano Banana, Gemini 3 Pro Image), regularizes them via a three-stage structural filtering process to preserve identity, expression, and pose, and finally applies physically-based simulation of lens optics during training to provide diverse, paired data. This process transfers Nano Banana's photo-realistic, multi-view knowledge into a specialized restoration architecture, JFSnet (Joint Feature-Spatial network). JFSnet integrates DINOv2-based semantic features with a convolutional decoder for spatial reconstruction, leveraging translation equivariance constraints to improve temporal consistency and high-frequency detail preservation. Evaluations on the curated Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ) subset (12,163 images) show that our approach achieves high fidelity and structural accuracy, while maintaining inference speed of 27.68 FPS. In perceptual studies on CelebV-Text video sequences, our results are consistently preferred over diffusion and GAN-based baselines for ocular consistency, temporal stability, and overall restoration quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理的眼镜去除视频处理方法，目标是从动态视频中高保真移除眼镜并保持身份、表情与姿态。方法先用商业级生成模型（Nano Banana、Gemini 3 Pro Image）提取合成人脸图像，经三阶段结构过滤，再在训练中引入基于物理的镜片光学仿真以生成配对数据，最终训练专用修复网络 JFSnet（Joint Feature-Spatial network），融合 DINOv2 语义特征与卷积解码器。在 FFHQ 子集（12,163 张图像）上实现高保真与结构准确，推理速度 27.68 FPS；在 CelebV-Text 视频序列的感知研究中，其在眼部一致性、时间稳定性与整体修复质量上优于扩散和 GAN 基线。
Motivation: 生成式先验在静态图像眼镜去除中虽有潜力，但常缺乏保持身份、表情和姿态的结构约束，导致静态图像和动态序列中出现可见的 identity drift；视频场景下的折射畸变与视角相关镜面反射进一步遮挡面部几何，使高保真移除更具挑战。
Method: 提出一个迁移框架：先从商业级生成模型提取高保真合成人脸图像，经三阶段结构过滤以保留身份、表情和姿态；训练时利用基于物理的镜片光学仿真提供多样化的配对数据，从而把生成模型的照片级多视角知识迁移到专用修复架构 JFSnet。JFSnet 结合基于 DINOv2 的语义特征与卷积解码器进行空间重建，并利用平移等变约束改善时间一致性与高频细节保持。
Result: 在 curated FFHQ 子集（12,163 张图像）上，方法实现高保真与结构准确，推理速度为 27.68 FPS；针对 CelebV-Text 视频序列的感知研究中，结果在眼部一致性、时间稳定性和整体修复质量上持续优于扩散与 GAN 基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法的可取之处在于用结构过滤与物理光学仿真约束生成先验的随机性，从而在保持身份和时序稳定性的同时完成视频眼镜移除，并具备实时推理能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference
papers.abstract_en: Small language models are usually built like large ones and then squeezed onto a CPU afterwards. We did the opposite: we fixed the target first, one user, one token at a time, 4-bit weights, ordinary CPU, and chose the architecture to suit it. The result keeps full attention in only 6 of its 18 blocks. The other 12 use short convolutions whose memory is two timesteps wide no matter how long the conversation gets, so two thirds of the network never re-reads a growing cache. Trained from scratch on 59.9B tokens, the model scores 47.31 on a five-task benchmark against a bar of 42.20 that was fixed before training began. It beats GPT-2 124M, Pythia-160M, OPT-125M and GPT-neo-125M, all trained on three to six times more data, and exceeds MobileLLM-125M's published score despite that model seeing a trillion tokens. Validation bits-per-byte is 0.8685. To check the architecture rather than the training recipe, we trained a conventional all-attention model of the same size on the same data, and wrote down the winning condition before scoring either. The hybrid won the chosen quality metric by 0.81%, matched it on downstream tasks, produced a 6.3% smaller 4-bit file, and decoded 1.76x faster at 2048 tokens of context, 2.08x against an external model of similar size. In every measurement the speed advantage is near zero at an empty context and grows with length, which is what the mechanism predicts and what a merely leaner model would not show. A simple bandwidth calculation predicts only 1.17x, so memory volume alone does not explain the gap. We also report what did not work: an unmitigated 4-bit quality cost, roughly half the convolution channels ending up inert and impossible to remove, and a vocabulary larger than this model size warrants.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Code, weights and the measurement artefacts behind every number: https://github.com/unseen1980/daedalus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Daedalus-150M，一个针对 CPU 推理从零设计的卷积-注意力混合小语言模型。模型 18 个块中只有 6 个使用全注意力，其余 12 个使用短卷积，其记忆宽度固定为两个时间步，避免长对话中重复读取增长的缓存。模型在 59.9B token 上从头训练，在五个任务的基准上得分 47.31，超过固定基线 42.20，并优于 GPT-2 124M、Pythia-160M、OPT-125M 和 GPT-neo-125M 等模型；同时报告了 4-bit 量化代价、部分卷积通道失效等失败经验。
Motivation: 现有小语言模型通常按大模型方式构建后再压缩到 CPU 上运行，作者认为应针对目标硬件反向设计架构。论文针对单用户、单 token 推理、4-bit 权重和普通 CPU 的约束，希望获得在长上下文下推理更快、缓存更小的模型。
Method: 采用卷积-注意力混合架构：18 个块中仅 6 个保留全注意力，其余 12 个使用短卷积，使网络三分之二的部分不随上下文长度增长而重读缓存。模型从零在 59.9B token 上训练，并设置训练前固定的五任务基准分数作为获胜条件；同时训练了同规模的全注意力对照模型以隔离架构与训练配方的影响。
Result: 混合模型在五任务基准上得分 47.31，高于事先固定的 42.20 基线；在质量指标上比同规模全注意力模型高 0.81%，下游任务持平，4-bit 文件小 6.3%，2048 token 上下文下解码快 1.76 倍，对比外部相似规模模型快 2.08 倍。速度优势在空上下文时接近零并随长度增长，带宽计算仅预测 1.17 倍，说明内存量无法完全解释差距。验证集 bits-per-byte 为 0.8685。
Conclusion: 作者强调以目标硬件为先的架构设计有效，但报告了未缓解的 4-bit 质量损失、约一半卷积通道惰性且无法移除、以及词汇表相对模型规模过大等失败经验。

papers.title: RoMAN-Flow: Taming Autoregressive Normalizing Flows for Offline Reinforcement Learning in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning improves robotic policies using previously collected data without further environment interaction. Yet prevalent diffusion- and flow-matching robot policies lack tractable likelihoods, limiting their use in likelihood-based offline RL post-training. AR-NFs offer both expressive action modeling and exact likelihood evaluation, but their sequential sampling incurs substantial sampling overhead during policy optimization and deployment. We present RoMAN-Flow (Robotic Manipulation with Autoregressive Normalizing Flows), an offline reinforcement learning framework that makes AR-NF policies practical for robotic manipulation by addressing this sampling bottleneck in both stages. During policy optimization, RoMAN-Flow employs a sampling-free, advantage-weighted likelihood objective that assigns higher likelihood to high-advantage actions from the offline dataset without sampling from the autoregressive policy. For efficient deployment, it distills the optimized autoregressive policy into a one-step action generator, enabling low-latency action prediction. Experiments across multiple simulated manipulation benchmarks and real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that RoMAN-Flow achieves competitive policy performance while substantially reducing inference latency. Code is available at https://github.com/konnyaku28/RoMAN-Flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoMAN-Flow，一个面向机器人操作的离线强化学习框架，解决自回归归一化流（AR-NFs）在策略优化和部署阶段的顺序采样开销问题。策略优化时采用无采样的优势加权似然目标，部署时把自回归策略蒸馏为一步动作生成器。在多个仿真操作基准和真实机器人平台上，该方法在保持竞争性策略性能的同时显著降低推理延迟。
Motivation: 扩散模型和流匹配（flow-matching）机器人策略缺乏可处理的似然（tractable likelihood），限制了基于似然的离线 RL 后训练；AR-NF 虽能提供精确似然评估但顺序采样开销大，阻碍其实际应用。
Method: RoMAN-Flow 在策略优化阶段使用无采样的优势加权似然目标（advantage-weighted likelihood objective），为离线数据中高优势动作分配更高似然而无需从自回归策略采样；在部署阶段将优化后的自回归策略蒸馏成一步动作生成器（one-step action generator），实现低延迟动作预测。
Result: 摘要报告在多个仿真操作基准和真实机器人平台上，RoMAN-Flow 取得与基线相当的政策性能，同时大幅降低推理延迟（摘要未给出具体量化数字）。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架通过解决采样瓶颈使 AR-NF 策略对机器人操作离线 RL 变得实用，兼顾表达能力与快速部署，并已开源代码。

papers.title: ContractScrub: A benchmark for final review of legal contracts
papers.abstract_en: Legal work, with its heavy reliance on processing large amounts of text, is often considered one of the domains most exposed to the use of LLMs. Contract ``scrubbing,'' the final review of transactional agreements for errors and inconsistencies, is a particularly suitable task for automation, because it is routine, painstaking work requiring detailed attention to long documents. Scrubbing also seems to align naturally with the general capabilities expected of frontier LLMs around long-context reasoning, consistency checking, and named entity recognition (NER). Despite the economic value and potential for automation, no formal evaluations of LLMs performing contract scrubbing have been conducted. We introduce ContractScrub, the first benchmark designed to evaluate contract scrubbing capabilities, comprising contracts hand-crafted by experienced lawyers over diverse error categories such as misuse of defined terms, incorrect references, and inconsistent language. Frontier models perform surprisingly poorly with only one model reaching 0.75 macro average recall despite strong performance on seemingly related general benchmarks, demonstrating the practical limits of current models and the importance of narrowly targeted, domain-specific benchmarks for measuring real-world impact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 ContractScrub，据作者所述是首个针对合同审查 (contract scrubbing) 的基准，用于评估 LLM 对交易协议进行最终复核、找出错误和不一致的能力。基准包含由经验丰富的律师手工构造的合同，覆盖定义术语误用、错误引用和不一致语言等错误类别。作者报告前沿模型表现意外地差，只有一个模型达到 0.75 的宏平均召回率，尽管这些模型在看似相关的通用基准上表现强劲。
Motivation: 合同审查属于高度依赖长文本处理的例行且费力的法律工作，具有明显自动化价值，但此前缺乏对 LLM 在该任务上进行正式评估的基准。
Method: 提出 ContractScrub 基准，由律师手工构造合同，覆盖多种错误类别，如定义术语误用、错误引用和不一致语言，并用前沿模型进行评估。
Result: 前沿模型表现不佳，只有一个模型达到 0.75 的宏平均召回率，尽管其在看似相关的通用基准上表现强劲。

papers.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
papers.abstract_en: Memory has become a key component of large language models, enabling them to retain information and learn from long-term interactions. However, existing memory benchmarks mainly evaluate whether information is correctly extracted, stored, and retrieved, while largely overlooking how retrieved memories reshape model reasoning and affect performance on the current task. We identify memory-induced cognitive traps: even faithfully recorded and semantically relevant memories can distort model reasoning or beliefs and degrade current task performance. To systematically evaluate these failure modes, we introduce MemTrapBench, which covers two forms of cognitive traps: Reasoning Fixation and Belief Distortion. Experiments across two model families and five representative memory frameworks show that MemTrapBench is challenging: all evaluated memory strategies underperform the no-memory setting, with even the strongest methods suffering drops of more than 10%. To mitigate these cognitive traps, we propose AdaptiveMem, a simple yet effective inference-time method that instructs LLMs to avoid memory traps. AdaptiveMem mitigates cognitive traps on MemTrapBench while preserving or improving performance on standard memory benchmarks across diverse memory frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemTrapBench，专门评测大语言模型（LLM）记忆使用中的认知陷阱，涵盖推理固化 (Reasoning Fixation) 与信念扭曲 (Belief Distortion) 两类失败模式。实验在两个模型家族和五种代表性记忆框架上进行，结果显示所有被评估的记忆策略在 MemTrapBench 上都不如无记忆设置，最强方法也下降超过 10%。作者进一步提出推理期 (inference-time) 方法 AdaptiveMem，通过指示 LLM 规避记忆陷阱，在缓解认知陷阱的同时保持或提升标准记忆基准上的表现。
Motivation: 现有记忆基准大多只检查信息是否正确提取、存储和检索，忽略检索到的记忆如何重塑模型推理并影响当前任务表现。作者指出即使记忆记录忠实且语义相关，也可能扭曲推理或信念，从而降低当前任务性能。
Method: 构建 MemTrapBench 基准，覆盖两类认知陷阱：推理固化 (Reasoning Fixation) 与信念扭曲 (Belief Distortion)。针对该问题提出 AdaptiveMem，一种推理期方法，通过指令引导 LLM 识别并避免记忆陷阱。
Result: 在两个模型家族和五种代表性记忆框架上的实验表明，MemTrapBench 很有挑战性：所有记忆策略的表现均低于无记忆设置，最强方法也下降超过 10%。AdaptiveMem 能在 MemTrapBench 上缓解认知陷阱，并在多种记忆框架的标准记忆基准上保持或提升性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调记忆使用评测不能只关注检索保真度，还要关注记忆对当前任务推理的影响；AdaptiveMem 表明简单的推理期干预可以缓解这类认知陷阱。

papers.title: The Third Restructuring of Software Form: From the Three-Tier Architecture to Storage, Models, and Agents
papers.abstract_en: Software form has undergone two paradigm shifts since its inception: Software 1.0, in which instructions determine behavior, and Software 2.0, in which data determines behavior (machine learning). This paper argues that a third shift - Software 3.0, in which context and reasoning determine behavior - is now underway, and contends that its terminal form converges to three elements: a generalized database (the unified abstraction of all persistent state and memory), a large model (the intelligence core that performs reasoning and generation), and an agent (the execution loop connecting the first two). The core argument is as follows: in the traditional three-tier architecture, the user-interface layer will be absorbed by the model's ability to generate interfaces on demand, the business-logic layer will be re-partitioned along "expressibility x criticality" into model reasoning and storage constraints (with residual deterministic logic retained as tools), and only the data layer will be elevated into the sole persistent infrastructure. We formalize this convergence thesis, present a minimal reference architecture, report evidence from real prototypes and a live model, and systematically analyze both the conditions under which it holds and the boundaries where it fails - determinism, cost, security, and verifiability delimit the thesis's domain of applicability. We argue that the thesis holds in task domains that are expressible, verifiable, externally stateful, and tool-complete, and that it will reshape the roles of developers, the database industry, and the software-engineering discipline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出软件形态正在经历第三次范式转移：从 Software 1.0（指令决定行为）和 Software 2.0（数据决定行为）走向 Software 3.0（上下文与推理决定行为），并主张其终态收敛为三个要素：广义数据库、大模型和智能体。作者认为传统三层架构中 UI 层会被模型按需生成界面所吸收，业务逻辑层将按表达力与关键性被重新划分，数据层则上升为唯一持久化基础设施，并给出了该收敛论点的形式化描述与最小参考架构。
Motivation: 软件工程正面临大模型与智能体带来的结构性变化，但缺少一个统一的理论框架来刻画软件形态将如何重组；本文旨在为这一转变提供系统化的论点与边界分析。
Method: 作者形式化地提出 Software 3.0 的收敛论题，给出由广义数据库、大模型与智能体组成的最小参考架构，并通过真实原型和在线模型收集证据，同时分析论点成立的条件与失效边界。
Result: 摘要报告称该论点在可表达、可验证、外部有状态且工具完备的任务域中成立；确定性、成本、安全性与可验证性构成了论点的适用边界，并将重塑开发者角色、数据库产业与软件工程学科。
Conclusion: 作者强调 Software 3.0 的适用范围受限于确定性、成本、安全与可验证性等边界条件，并非普适；其核心判断是软件形态的第三次重构正在发生，且终态将围绕存储、模型与智能体三要素组织。

papers.title: From Agent Behaviour to Agent-Friendly Documentation: An Empirical Study of How Coding Agents Discover, Read, and Write Technical Documentation
papers.abstract_en: Technical documentation is written for human developers, but an increasing share of software changes is now authored by autonomous coding agents. Which documents they consult, when, and what follows remain unknown. We conduct a behaviour-grounded study of agent-documentation interaction across two public datasets: 557 agentic coding sessions from SWE-chat, yielding 94,813 development events including 3,033 documentation interactions; and 33,097 agentic pull requests from AIDev, with 690,260 classified file-level change records. Four findings challenge current documentation practice. First, agents' documentation work is dominated by agent-facing artefacts: instruction files and working notes account for 60.5% of all documentation interactions, versus 10.6% for classical technical documentation and 1.3% for API references. Second, the link between consultation and code editing is unresolved: the adjacent transition probability is 0.002 and the unadjusted three-event lift 1.05, whereas a stage-adjusted model places it above unity (OR 1.33 [1.09, 1.62]); documentation creation is elevated unadjusted (lift 1.67) but its adjusted interval includes unity. Third, no explicit documentation-based validation sequence was observed, and consultation is associated with less immediate testing (lift 0.23, cluster CI 0.08-0.45; adjusted OR 0.39 [0.25, 0.60]). Fourth, consultation is self-initiated (70.2%) far more often than failure-driven (7.5%), and documentation trails code: among multi-commit pull requests changing both, code is touched first 4.7x more often. From these traces we derive a descriptive model of agent-documentation interaction as a two-lobed cycle rather than a linear journey, and show that two widely assumed properties of "agent-friendly" documentation - actionability and verifiability - lack consistent behavioural support. We release our pipeline, coding scheme, and event-level data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过两个公开数据集（SWE-chat 的 557 个代理编码会话，含 94,813 个开发事件与 3,033 次文档交互；AIDev 的 33,097 个代理拉取请求，含 690,260 条文件级变更记录）实证研究自主编码代理如何发现、阅读和撰写技术文档。结果显示代理的文档交互主要面向代理自身的产物：指令文件与工作笔记占 60.5%，经典技术文档占 10.6%，API 参考仅占 1.3%；咨询与代码编辑的关系不明确，也未观察到显式的基于文档的验证序列，咨询多为自我发起而非失败驱动。作者由此提出代理-文档交互的"两叶循环"描述模型，并指出"可操作性"与"可验证性"这两个常见假说缺乏一致的行为支持，同时公开了数据处理流水线、编码方案和事件级数据。
Motivation: 技术文档是为人类开发者编写的，但当前越来越多的软件修改由自主编码代理完成；代理会查阅哪些文档、何时查阅以及查阅后发生什么，仍然完全是未知的。
Method: 基于行为数据的实证研究：对两个公开数据集进行事件级与文件级分析，计算相邻转移概率、lift 和经阶段调整的逻辑回归优势比（adjusted OR），并据此归纳出代理-文档交互的描述性模型（两叶循环）。
Result: 四项主要发现：代理更多使用面向代理的文档（指令文件和工作笔记占 60.5%，API 参考仅 1.3%）；咨询与编辑的关系未定（相邻转移概率 0.002，未调整 lift 1.05，阶段调整后 OR 1.33 [1.09, 1.62]）；咨询与更少的即时测试相关（lift 0.23，调整 OR 0.39 [0.25, 0.60]）；咨询中 70.2% 是自我发起，仅 7.5% 由失败驱动，且多提交 PR 中代码先于文档被修改的频率是后者的 4.7 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为代理-文档交互更像一个两叶循环而非线性旅程，并指出以往对"agent-friendly"文档的两个常见性质假设（actionability 和 verifiability）缺乏一致的行为证据；研究发布其流水线、编码方案与事件级数据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis: Ranking Candidate Drivers by Convergent Cross-Method Evidence from Observational Data
papers.abstract_en: Practitioners inferring causality from observational data usually rely on a single method and treat its output as causal truth. Recent tools select an optimal method for a dataset, and recent ensembles aggregate multiple causal-discovery algorithms into one graph, but little work pools evidence across different mathematical traditions, including non-causal ones. We present Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis (MCES), a framework that ranks which candidate drivers in an observational system are most likely relevant to a set of outcomes, and with what strength of evidence. MCES runs eleven methods across eight mathematical traditions on observational panel data and pools their outputs into a Convergent Evidence Score (CES), a linear opinion pool. CES quantifies convergence of evidence across analytical lenses: the degree to which methods with different assumptions point to the same driver-outcome relationship. It does not claim causal identification in the interventionist sense; it supports hypothesis prioritization, not a transferable probability of causation. MCES first applies Structural-Behavioral Decomposition to remove definitional (algebraic) relationships, then runs all methods, normalizes outputs to [0,1], and pools them. We distinguish MCES from method selection, structural ensembles, prediction ensembles, and literature synthesis. Using synthetic data with embedded ground truth, the Sachs protein-signaling benchmark, six Bayesian-network structure benchmarks, and two further synthetic domains, we show MCES ranks true edges near the top (Precision@5 = 1.0, Precision@10 = 0.96 on the primary scenario), with a low empirical rate of null pairs reaching Moderate-or-higher convergence. Our central point is not that the pool beats every individual method, but that no single method is uniformly best across the evaluated scenarios, so MCES offers a method-agnostic default.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 4 figures, 17 tables. Reference implementation available from the authors on request
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis (MCES)，一个在观测面板数据上对候选驱动因素与结果之间关联强度进行排序的框架。MCES 运行八个数学传统下的十一种方法，将输出标准化到 [0,1] 后通过线性意见池 (linear opinion pool) 汇总为 Convergent Evidence Score (CES)。在嵌入真实标签的合成数据、Sachs 蛋白信号基准、六个贝叶斯网络结构基准等场景中，它能把真实边排在顶部附近。
Motivation: 从观测数据推断因果的实践者通常依赖单一方法并把其输出视为因果真理；现有工作要么为数据集选择最优方法，要么把多个因果发现算法聚合成一张图，但很少有工作跨不同数学传统（包括非因果方法）汇集证据。
Method: MCES 先应用 Structural-Behavioral Decomposition 去除定义性（代数）关系，然后运行八个数学传统下的十一方法，将输出归一化到 [0,1]，再用线性意见池汇总出 CES，以衡量不同假设的方法在多大程度上指向相同的驱动因素-结果关系。
Result: 在主要场景中，MCES 的 Precision@5 为 1.0、Precision@10 为 0.96，且无效配对达到 Moderate-or-higher 收敛水平的经验比率较低；评估覆盖合成数据、Sachs 蛋白信号基准、六个贝叶斯网络结构基准及两个额外合成领域。
Conclusion: 本文核心观点不是集成方法一定优于每个单一方法，而是没有任何单一方法在所有评估场景中一致最优，因此 MCES 提供了一种方法无关 (method-agnostic) 的默认选择；它也明确不主张干预意义上的因果识别，而是支持假设优先级排序。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis (MCES)，一个在观测面板数据上对候选驱动因素与结果之间关联强度进行排序的框架。MCES 运行八个数学传统下的十一种方法，将输出标准化到 [0,1] 后通过线性意见池 (linear opinion pool) 汇总为 Convergent Evidence Score (CES)。在嵌入真实标签的合成数据、Sachs 蛋白信号基准、六个贝叶斯网络结构基准等场景中，它能把真实边排在顶部附近。
summary_sections.motivation: 从观测数据推断因果的实践者通常依赖单一方法并把其输出视为因果真理；现有工作要么为数据集选择最优方法，要么把多个因果发现算法聚合成一张图，但很少有工作跨不同数学传统（包括非因果方法）汇集证据。
summary_sections.method: MCES 先应用 Structural-Behavioral Decomposition 去除定义性（代数）关系，然后运行八个数学传统下的十一方法，将输出归一化到 [0,1]，再用线性意见池汇总出 CES，以衡量不同假设的方法在多大程度上指向相同的驱动因素-结果关系。
summary_sections.result: 在主要场景中，MCES 的 Precision@5 为 1.0、Precision@10 为 0.96，且无效配对达到 Moderate-or-higher 收敛水平的经验比率较低；评估覆盖合成数据、Sachs 蛋白信号基准、六个贝叶斯网络结构基准及两个额外合成领域。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文核心观点不是集成方法一定优于每个单一方法，而是没有任何单一方法在所有评估场景中一致最优，因此 MCES 提供了一种方法无关 (method-agnostic) 的默认选择；它也明确不主张干预意义上的因果识别，而是支持假设优先级排序。

papers.title: Decoding silent reading from non-invasive EEG
papers.abstract_en: Non-invasive decoding of inner speech faces a fundamental data problem: a corpus pairing brain activity with a person's spontaneous inner monologue cannot be collected, and the available proxy paradigms (cued repetitive and retrospectively reported generative inner speech) are slow to acquire, poorly time-locked, and subject compliance is unverifiable. We therefore treat silent reading as a scalable proxy task and ask how much lexical and semantic information a contrastive decoder can extract from it. We report an open-vocabulary analysis of approximately 240,000 word presentations recorded from a single densely-sampled participant across 393 runs (ca. 49 h) of 19-channel dry-electrode EEG. Words from continuous narrative text were presented in rapid serial visual presentation, with typography randomised on every trial to partially decorrelate word identity from low-level visual form. A convolutional EEG encoder, optionally followed by a causal transformer, was trained with a CLIP-style contrastive objective to align short EEG windows with hidden-state embeddings of the presented word taken from a large language model. Decoding, evaluated as word-grouped top-10 retrieval against permutation baselines, was reliably above chance, extended to mid-frequency and rare words, and scaled log-linearly with training-data volume with no sign of saturation. Removing occipital and posterior-temporal electrodes reduced the word-level gain by roughly one third but left context tracking unchanged. Control analyses separate word-level decoding from narrative context tracking and from a non-neural positional prior introduced by the transformer's positional embedding. These results establish that open-vocabulary word-level information is recoverable from EEG during silent reading, and that decoding is data-limited rather than saturated.
papers.comment: 45 pages (including 12 pages of Supplementary Material), 11 figures (including 2 in Supplementary Material)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非侵入式 EEG 解码内心言语所面临的数据采集难题，提出将静默阅读 (silent reading) 作为可扩展的代理任务，并研究对比解码器能从中提取多少词汇与语义信息。作者报告了单名密集采样被试在约 49 小时、393 次运行的 19 通道干电极 EEG 中约 24 万次词呈现的开放词汇分析：单词以快速序列视觉呈现，每次试验随机化字体以部分解耦词身份与低层视觉形式，卷积 EEG 编码器（可选接因果 Transformer）以 CLIP 式对比目标与大型语言模型的词嵌入对齐。结果显示，按词分组的 top-10 检索显著高于置换基线，对中频和稀有词也有效，性能随训练数据量呈对数线性增长且未见饱和；移除枕叶和颞后电极使词级增益减少约三分之一但上下文追踪不变，控制分析将词级解码与叙事上下文追踪及位置嵌入引入的非神经位置先验区分开。
Motivation: 非侵入式内心言语解码面临根本性数据问题：无法收集与自发内心独白配对的大脑活动语料，现有代理范式（提示重复性和回顾性生成性内心言语）采集缓慢、时间锁定差且依从性无法验证，因此需要可扩展且时间可控的代理任务。
Method: 将静默阅读作为大规模代理任务，使用快速序列视觉呈现 (rapid serial visual presentation) 连续叙事文本，并在每次试验随机化字体以解耦词身份与低层视觉形式；采用卷积 EEG 编码器（可选后接因果 Transformer），以 CLIP 式对比目标将短 EEG 窗口与大型语言模型给出的词隐状态嵌入对齐。
Result: 摘要报告开放词汇词级解码（按词分组的 top-10 检索）显著高于置换基线，涵盖中频和稀有词；性能随训练数据量对数线性增长且未饱和；移除枕叶和颞后电极使词级增益减少约三分之一，但上下文追踪不受影响；控制分析区分了词级解码、叙事上下文追踪和位置嵌入引入的非神经位置先验。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果确立了开放词汇词级信息可从静默阅读期间的 EEG 中恢复，并且当前解码受数据量限制而非饱和，暗示更多数据可能带来进一步增益。摘要未讨论具体应用场景或实际脑机接口部署，结论局限于数据受限这一解释。

papers.title: Exact Algebraic Computation of Learning Coefficients for Two-Dimensional Singular Models
papers.abstract_en: Classical information criteria such as the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) rely on regularity assumptions that break down for singular models, leading to incorrect model selection in settings such as deep learning. The Widely Applicable Bayesian Information Criterion (WBIC) relies on local learning coefficients $λ$, which in the analytic case coincides with local Real Log Canonical Thresholds (RLCT) of the Kullback-Leibler divergence of the model, to capture correct marginal likelihood asymptotics. Exact computation of the learning coefficients has been limited to special cases, and only sampling-based estimation methods are generally applicable. We present the first deterministic algorithm that computes local RLCTs exactly for any two-dimensional model whose Kullback-Leibler distance is contact equivalent to a polynomial, derive a bound on its complexity, and demonstrate its effectiveness for a broad class of models, with applications including polynomial neural networks. Beyond providing ground truth to calibrate sampling-based estimators, exact computation reveals algebraic structure in learning coefficients that sampling cannot and out-speeds it in the shallow regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对奇异模型（singular models）中学习系数（learning coefficient）的精确计算问题，提出首个确定性的代数算法，可对任意二维模型在 Kullback-Leibler 距离与多项式接触等价（contact equivalent）时精确计算局部实对数规范阈值（RLCT）。作者给出了复杂度上界，并展示了该方法对一类广泛模型（包括多项式神经网络）的有效性，同时指出精确计算可为采样型估计器提供真值基准，并在浅层结构中快于采样方法。
Motivation: 经典信息准则（如 BIC）依赖正则性假设，在奇异模型（如深度学习）中失效，导致模型选择错误。WBIC 依赖局部学习系数 λ（解析情形下等于 KL 散度局部 RLCT），但精确计算此前仅限特殊情形，一般只能使用基于采样的估计方法。
Method: 提出第一个确定性算法，对任意二维模型在 KL 距离与多项式接触等价时精确计算局部 RLCT；推导了算法复杂度上界，并用包括多项式神经网络在内的模型类别进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告该算法能精确计算局部 RLCT，优于采样方法的估计能力，并在浅层模型（shallow regime）中比采样方法更快，同时可揭示采样方法无法显示的代数结构。
Conclusion: 精确计算学习系数不仅能为采样型估计器提供 ground truth，还能展现学习系数中的代数结构；论文强调这是针对二维模型的确定性算法，并给出了复杂度保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Standardized Framework for Machine Learning in Power System Protection
papers.abstract_en: Studies of machine-learning-based power-system protection increasingly report near-perfect scores, yet the meaning of those scores depends strongly on the evaluation setting. Protection task, physical scope, measurements, timing, targets, preprocessing, and validation often vary jointly and remain incompletely specified. This paper proposes a standardization-oriented framework that treats evaluation design as part of the scientific contribution. It defines seven required study dimensions: protection objective, physical scope, observability, timing and decision windows, targets and sample validity, validation protocol, and evaluation outputs. The framework is instantiated in a bounded case study on the public PROTECT-90 electromagnetic-transient benchmark, comprising 9022 simulated episodes from a 90 kV double-line topology, for onset-conditioned fault classification and localization. Under centralized sensing, simulation-metadata-aligned 20 ms windows, and episode-grouped validation, a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) achieved a five-fold mean macro-averaged F1 score of 0.991 +/- 0.001 for classification and a localization mean absolute error of 10.20 +/- 0.25% of line length (mean +/- std across episode-grouped folds). Extending the decision horizon to 50 ms preserved this task-dependent performance asymmetry, while reduced observability approximately doubled the MLP localization error but had little effect on classification. A synchronized two-ended conventional locator outperformed the learning locators under its richer clean information set, and measurement degradation showed that clean predictive performance did not determine robustness. The framework turns evaluation assumptions into explicit, reproducible evidence and provides a basis for more comparable, auditable evaluation and future certification-oriented assessment of machine-learning protection functions.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 4 figures, 26 tables. Code: https://github.com/julianoelhaf/protection-eval-framework. Dataset: PROTECT-90, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21109169
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器学习电力系统保护研究中评估设定不透明的问题，提出一个标准化评估框架，将评估设计视为科学贡献的一部分。框架定义了七个必需的研究维度，并在公开的 PROTECT-90 电磁暂态基准上进行了有界案例研究，涵盖 9022 个模拟场景。在集中感知、20 ms 窗口和按 episode 分组的验证下，MLP 实现了分类 macro-F1 0.991±0.001，定位平均绝对误差为线路长度的 10.20%±0.25%。
Motivation: 基于机器学习的电力系统保护研究常报告接近完美的分数，但这些分数的含义高度依赖评估设定；保护任务、物理范围、测量、时序、目标、预处理和验证方式往往同时变化且未完整说明，导致结果难以比较和审计。
Method: 提出一个标准化导向的框架，规定七个必需的研究维度：保护目标、物理范围、可观测性、时序与决策窗口、目标与样本有效性、验证协议和评估输出。框架在 PROTECT-90 基准上实例化，用于onset条件触发的故障分类与定位，采用集中感知、对齐仿真元数据的 20 ms 窗口和按 episode 分组的交叉验证。
Result: MLP 在五折交叉验证下取得分类宏平均 F1 0.991±0.001，定位平均绝对误差为线路长度的 10.20%±0.25%。将决策窗口扩展到 50 ms 保持了任务相关的性能不对称性；降低可观测性使 MLP 定位误差约翻倍，但对分类影响很小。同步双端传统定位器在其更丰富的信息集下优于学习型定位器，且测量退化显示干净的预测性能并不能决定鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该框架将评估假设转化为明确、可复现的证据，为更可比、可审计的评估以及未来面向认证的机器学习保护功能评估提供了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ask Self, Ask Others: Relation Is All You Need
papers.abstract_en: Attention directly derives normalized information flow from pairwise scores. We introduce Relation, an alternative token-mixing primitive that first organizes pairwise evidence into explicit Self and Exchange relations and derives information flow afterward. This relational organization gives rise to Full Relation, FlashRelation, Linear Relation, Hybrid Relation, and a KV-style Relation Cache. Across matched decoder-only models at approximately 10M, 30M, and 100M parameters, Full Relation achieves lower final validation NLL than MHA at all three scales. In a fixed-context reference benchmark, FlashRelation is 3.60-4.41x faster than the materialized Full Relation implementation. Across scale-matched production workloads, it reaches 76.4-84.9% of PyTorch FlashAttention throughput while executing the Full Relation operator. Hybrid Relation uses 75% Linear Relation layers and achieves strong language-modeling quality. These results support a relation-first view of token mixing: ask Self, ask Others, then let Flow follow Relation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Relation，一种替代 attention 的 token 混合 (token-mixing) 原语：先将两两证据组织成显式的 Self 与 Exchange 关系，再从关系导出信息流，而非像 attention 那样直接从 pairwise scores 得到归一化信息流。作者由此给出 Full Relation、FlashRelation、Linear Relation、Hybrid Relation 以及 KV 风格 Relation Cache 等变体，并在约 10M、30M、100M 参数的 decoder-only 模型上验证其效果与效率。
Motivation: 现有 attention 直接由两两分数推导归一化信息流，作者认为若先把两两证据组织为显式的 Self 和 Exchange 关系、再据此推导信息流，可以形成更高效且可扩展的 token 混合方式。
Method: 引入 Relation 原语，将 pairwise evidence 明确划分为 Self 与 Exchange 两类关系，随后由关系导出信息流；在此框架下实现 Full Relation、FlashRelation、Linear Relation、Hybrid Relation 及 KV-style Relation Cache 等不同复杂度与用途的变体。
Result: 在约 10M、30M、100M 参数的 decoder-only 模型上，Full Relation 的最终验证 NLL 在三个尺度下均低于 MHA。固定上下文参考基准中，FlashRelation 比物化的 Full Relation 实现快 3.60-4.41 倍；在规模匹配的生产负载上，其吞吐达到 PyTorch FlashAttention 的 76.4-84.9%。Hybrid Relation 使用 75% 的 Linear Relation 层仍保持较强的语言建模质量。
Conclusion: 作者主张 relation-first 的 token 混合观点：先询问自身 (Self)、再询问他人 (Exchange)，然后让信息流 (Flow) 跟随关系；结果表明 Relation 系列在质量和效率上可作为 attention 的可行替代方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel approach to efficient LLM agent harness optimization through adaptive validation task selection. Harness optimization iteratively rewrites the harness code based on validation performance, enabling substantial performance gains without updating the underlying model weights. Existing approaches, however, evaluate a fixed validation set in full at every iteration, incurring substantial evaluation costs even on tasks that become less discriminative as the harness evolves. We propose $\textbf{Task-CoEvolve}$, which co-evolves the validation tasks with the harness by addressing two challenges: selecting informative tasks and estimating full-set performance from partial evaluations. Task-CoEvolve builds on the observation that tasks on which candidate harnesses disagree are more informative for distinguishing among them than tasks that are consistently solved or failed. It uses variance-weighted sampling based on past outcomes to focus evaluation on tasks near the agent's capability frontier, with the sampling distribution adapting as the harness evolves. It then estimates full-set scores from the sampled tasks by accounting for their sampling probabilities, enabling consistent comparisons across iterations despite evaluating different subsets. Experiments on online text classification and Terminal-Bench 2.1 show that Task-CoEvolve consistently outperforms fixed-subset baselines and matches the final performance of full-set search while reducing the number of evaluations during optimization by 80%. Code will be released at https://github.com/Agent4Science-UTokyo/Task-CoEvolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Task-CoEvolve，一种通过自适应验证任务选择来高效优化 LLM agent 的 harness（即智能体运行代码）的方法。它让验证任务与 harness 共同演化，基于候选 harness 在任务上的分歧程度进行方差加权采样，并利用采样概率校正来估计完整验证集得分。实验表明，该方法在在线文本分类和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上匹配全量搜索的最终性能，同时将优化过程中的评估次数减少 80%。
Motivation: 现有的 harness 优化每一轮都在完整固定验证集上评估，即使随着 harness 演化某些任务逐渐失去区分度，仍会消耗高昂评估成本。
Method: Task-CoEvolve 处理两个挑战：选择有信息量的任务，以及从部分评估中估计全量集得分。它基于历史结果使用方差加权采样，将评估集中在智能体能力边界附近、候选 harness 分歧较大的任务上，并依据采样概率校正估计值，从而在不同迭代间保持可比性。
Result: 在在线文本分类和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，Task-CoEvolve 一致优于固定子集基线，达到与全量集搜索相近的最终性能，同时将评估次数减少 80%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将验证任务与 harness 共同演化可以在不牺牲最终性能的前提下大幅降低优化评估成本。

papers.title: DARS: Dual-Level Credit Assignment RL with Structured Reasoning for Instruction-Based Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based image editing uses a planner-renderer pipeline: a vision-language model (VLM) first converts the instruction into an edit plan, and a diffusion model then executes that plan. Training such systems with only final-image rewards is inefficient because a poor edit does not reveal whether additional optimization should place more emphasis on the planner or the renderer, and even planner-dominant cases remain difficult to localize within a free-form reasoning trace. We present DARS, a reinforcement learning framework for dual-level credit assignment in this two-stage setting. Across modules, multi-plan multi-render rollouts estimate between-plan and within-plan reward variability for soft module routing, while rollout mean rewards provide hardness estimates for an adaptive curriculum. Within the planner, a four-field structured reasoning output enables a prefix-gated reward and token-level advantage reweighting, turning outcome-level feedback into localized supervision. Experiments on five benchmarks show that DARS outperforms a Joint~RL baseline with the same backbone, data, reward model, and rollout budget, with the largest gains on reasoning-intensive edits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DARS，一个面向 planner-renderer 两阶段指令编辑管线的强化学习框架，解决最终图像奖励无法回溯到具体模块或推理步骤的问题。DARS 在模块间通过 multi-plan multi-render rollouts 做软路由与自适应课程，在 planner 内部用四字段结构化推理和 token 级优势重加权进行细粒度信用分配。五个基准上的实验表明，在相同资源和奖励设置下 DARS 优于 Joint RL 基线，尤其在推理密集型编辑任务上收益最大。
Motivation: 指令式图像编辑采用 VLM 生成编辑计划、扩散模型执行的两阶段管线，仅用最终图像奖励训练时无法判断错误应归因于 planner 还是 renderer，且自由形式推理轨迹难以定位 planner 内部的失败位置，导致训练效率低下。
Method: DARS 在模块间用 multi-plan multi-render rollouts 估计 plan 之间与 plan 内部的奖励变异性，用于软模块路由，并以 rollout 平均奖励作为难度估计驱动自适应课程；在 planner 内部引入四字段结构化推理输出，配合 prefix-gated reward 与 token 级优势重加权，将结果级反馈转化为局部监督。
Result: 在五个基准上，DARS 在相同 backbone、数据、奖励模型和 rollout 预算下优于 Joint RL 基线，且在推理密集型编辑任务上取得最大提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调双层级信用分配 (dual-level credit assignment) 能有效将结果级奖励转化为模块级与 token 级局部监督，从而提升指令编辑系统的训练效率与性能。

papers.title: G3Ego: Gaze-Guided Graphs for Egocentric Action Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric action understanding is often addressed using large video models pretrained on extensive exocentric datasets. However, many first-person actions depend on a small number of hand-object interactions involving only a few relevant entities. We propose G3Ego, a graph-based framework for egocentric action understanding that uses gaze as a structural cue to identify action-relevant entities in the scene. From sparsely sampled frames, G3Ego constructs action scene graphs from vision-language descriptions, grounded objects, and hand cues, and then prunes irrelevant entities using the camera wearer's gaze. The resulting graph embeddings are temporally aggregated for action recognition and anticipation. Unlike prior work that uses gaze primarily as an auxiliary modality or attention signal, G3Ego incorporates gaze directly into graph construction, producing efficient and interpretable representations focused on action-relevant interactions. Experiments on EGTEA Gaze+ and MECCANO show that G3Ego achieves competitive performance compared with video-based approaches and consistently improves Macro-F1 under class-imbalanced evaluation, while avoiding reliance on computationally expensive video pretraining. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gaze-guided graph representations for egocentric action understanding.
papers.comment: Accepted at the CONTEXTUS Workshop, ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 G3Ego，一个基于图的自我中心动作理解框架，利用 gaze 作为结构线索构建动作场景图。从稀疏采样帧中的视觉语言描述、目标实体和手部线索构建图，再以佩戴者的注视剔除无关实体，最后对图嵌入做时间聚合用于动作识别与预测。在 EGTEA Gaze+ 和 MECCANO 上，该方法与基于视频的方法性能相当，且在类不平衡评估中稳定提升 Macro-F1，且不依赖昂贵的视频预训练。
Motivation: 自我中心动作理解通常依赖大规模外中心视频预训练的大模型，但许多第一人称动作只依赖少量手-物交互，涉及少数相关实体。作者想利用 gaze 作为结构线索来识别动作相关实体，避免计算昂贵的视频预训练。
Method: G3Ego 从稀疏采样帧中，通过视觉语言描述、grounded objects 和 hand cues 构建动作场景图，随后用 camera wearer 的 gaze 剪枝不相关实体。图嵌入在时间上聚合，用于动作识别和预期。与以往把 gaze 当作辅助模态或注意力信号不同，G3Ego 将 gaze 直接用于图构建。
Result: 在 EGTEA Gaze+ 和 MECCANO 上，G3Ego 取得与基于视频方法相当的性能，并在类不平衡评估下一致提高 Macro-F1，同时避免了对计算昂贵的视频预训练的依赖。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 gaze 引导的图表示对自我中心动作理解的有效性；该方法需稀疏帧、可解释性强，但摘要未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Workflow Analysis in Colorectal Surgery: A Multicentric, Cross-Procedural Development and Generalization Study
papers.abstract_en: Minimally invasive colorectal surgeries (MIS-CRS) are characterised by significant variability and inconsistent outcomes. ColoWorkflow, a tool for the video-based assessment (VBA) of MIS-CRS workflow, was recently validated. However, manual VBA is time-consuming, limiting implementation. This study presents AI-ColoWorkflow, a deep learning model for automated surgical workflow analysis across MIS-CRS. Operative videos of MIS-CRS were collected from 4 centres and a publicly available dataset. Phases and steps were manually annotated according to ColoWorkflow. A deep learning model combining a fine-tuned DINOv3 vision transformer for per-frame visual feature extraction with a hierarchical multi-stage temporal convolutional network was jointly optimized for phase and step recognition. The model trained on pooled multicentric data, namely AI-ColoWorkflow was compared against centre-specific and procedure-specific models on a held-out test set. The following metrics were used for evaluation: macro F1 score, balanced accuracy, precision, and recall. AI-ColoWorkflow achieved a macro F1 of 73.01% $\pm$ 10.27 (balanced accuracy 73.43%) for phase recognition and 39.82% $\pm$ 7.06 (balanced accuracy 38.65%) for step recognition. The global model outperformed centre- and procedure-specific models in most experiments except procedure-specific step recognition. In the generalization analysis, mean F1 was 48.42% for phase recognition. AI-ColoWorkflow can reliably recognize MIS-CRS phases. A single model trained on pooled, multicentric, multi-procedural data generalises at least as well as and often better than centre- or procedure-specific models for phase recognition in MIS-CRS, while procedure-specific step models retain advantages for certain procedure types, motivating hybrid training strategies for future surgical AI development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AI-ColoWorkflow，一种基于深度学习的手术视频工作流分析模型，用于微创结直肠手术 (MIS-CRS) 的自动阶段与步骤识别。模型结合微调后的 DINOv3 视觉 Transformer 提取逐帧特征，并用分层多阶段时序卷积网络联合优化阶段与步骤识别，在来自 4 个中心及公开数据集的 pooled 多中心数据上训练。摘要报告阶段识别 macro F1 为 73.01%，步骤识别 macro F1 为 39.82%，并发现全局模型在多数实验中优于中心或术式专属模型。
Motivation: 微创结直肠手术存在显著变异性和不一致的预后，基于视频的工作流评估 (VBA) 虽已得到验证，但手动 VBA 耗时费力，限制了临床落地，因此需要自动化的工作流分析模型。
Method: 收集 4 个中心及公开数据集的 MIS-CRS 手术视频，按 ColoWorkflow 标准人工标注阶段与步骤；构建由微调 DINOv3 视觉 Transformer 和分层多阶段时序卷积网络组成的深度学习模型，对阶段与步骤识别进行联合优化；将 pooled 多中心全局模型与中心专属、术式专属模型在留出测试集上比较。
Result: AI-ColoWorkflow 在阶段识别上达到 macro F1 73.01% ± 10.27（平衡准确率 73.43%），步骤识别上达到 macro F1 39.82% ± 7.06（平衡准确率 38.65%）；除术式专属步骤识别外，全局模型在大多数实验中优于中心和术式专属模型；泛化分析中阶段识别平均 F1 为 48.42%。
Conclusion: AI-ColoWorkflow 能可靠识别 MIS-CRS 的阶段；单一模型在 pooled 多中心、多术式数据上训练后，阶段识别表现通常不逊于甚至优于中心或术式专属模型，而术式专属步骤模型在特定术式中仍有优势，提示未来手术 AI 可采用混合训练策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PelviNeXt: A Modality-Agnostic Hybrid Network for Pelvic Imaging in Women's Health
papers.abstract_en: Women's health remains substantially under-resourced in medical imaging research, with pelvic pathologies such as polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and pelvic fracture both suffering from a scarcity of public, well-annotated benchmark data despite their clinical importance. We introduce PelviNeXt, a modality-agnostic hybrid architecture combining a dense convolutional feature extractor, hierarchical channel-spatial attention (H-CBAM), a multi-scale fusion module (MSFM), and talking-heads multi-head self-attention (TH-MHSA), applied without modification to both pelvic ultrasound and X-ray inputs. While benchmarking PelviNeXt on PCOSGen, the only gynaecologist-annotated public PCOS ultrasound dataset, we identified extensive exact and near-duplicate contamination within and across the dataset. We audit this contamination via perceptual hashing, publicly release a deduplicated version of the dataset, and establish the first integrity-audited evaluation protocol and baseline for PCOSGen under 5-fold cross-validation. On the only publicly available pelvic fracture X-ray dataset (PXR150), PelviNeXt exceeds previously reported state-of-the-art results across accuracy, recall, specificity, and AUROC. Ablation studies confirm that each architectural component contributes to performance on both tasks. Our results demonstrate that a single architecture, applied without task-specific modification, can serve as a reliable foundation for pelvic imaging across modalities in data-scarce, under-researched areas of women's health.

papers.title: DPC-Net: Dual-Prior Collaborative Network for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: All-in-One Image Restoration (AiOIR) aims to handle diverse degradations within a unified model. However, existing methods often overlook image semantics in degradation modeling and lack low-level visual priors during reconstruction, leading to structural distortions and semantic inconsistencies. To address these issues, we propose a novel Dual-Prior Collaborative Network (DPC-Net), which achieves high-quality restoration by jointly exploiting degradation-semantic coupled priors and low-level visual priors. Specifically, degraded images are fed into a Degradation-Aware Network (DAN) to extract degradation-semantic coupled features. To this end, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) supervises DAN by constraining its features distribution, introducing image semantics into the encoding of degradation patterns. A Degradation-Semantic Modulation Module (DSMM) further translates this guidance into degradation-semantic coupling and propagates coupled representations to the decoder. During decoding, knowledge bases provide low-level visual priors, and the Dual-Prior Collaborative Reconstruction Module (DPCR) integrates dual-prior information to guide degradation removal while preserving structure and semantics, producing high-fidelity restored images. Extensive experiments on multiple restoration benchmarks demonstrate that DPC-Net achieves superior performance against state-of-the-art AiOIR methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DPC-Net（Dual-Prior Collaborative Network），用于全合一图像恢复（All-in-One Image Restoration, AiOIR），目标是在统一模型中处理多种退化。该方法联合利用退化-语义耦合先验与低层视觉先验：退化感知网络（DAN）通过视觉语言模型（VLM）约束特征分布来引入图像语义，DSMM 实现退化-语义耦合，解码端由 DPCR 模块融合知识库提供的低层视觉先验以在去除退化的同时保持结构与语义。摘要声称在多个恢复基准上优于现有 AiOIR 方法。
Motivation: 现有 AiOIR 方法在退化建模中往往忽略图像语义，且重建阶段缺少低层视觉先验，导致结构失真和语义不一致。
Method: 将退化图像输入退化感知网络（DAN）提取退化-语义耦合特征；用视觉语言模型（VLM）监督 DAN 的特征分布以引入语义信息；退化-语义调制模块（DSMM）将该指导转化为退化-语义耦合表示并传播给解码器；解码时知识库提供低层视觉先验，双先验协同重建模块（DPCR）整合两类先验来引导退化去除并保持结构和语义。
Result: 摘要报告在多个恢复基准上的大量实验表明 DPC-Net 相对最新 AiOIR 方法取得更优性能，但未给出具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时利用退化-语义耦合先验与低层视觉先验可以实现高保真恢复，在去除退化的同时保持结构完整性与语义一致性。

papers.title: Feature Evolution and Migration during Vision Transformer Training
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel view on feature evolution in Vision Transformers (ViTs) by visualizing the training process over two dimensions -- network depth (layer) and training time (epochs). We employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to extract candidate sparse features from CLS-token representations and compare their activation profiles across epoch--layer pairs. This allows us to study feature-level dynamics that are not directly visible from representation-level similarity measures. Furthermore, we demonstrate how this framework of feature evolution allows us to describe feature migration, the change in the layer where a feature is most detectable during training. Our experiments show that migration is concentrated early in training, occurs more often toward earlier layers than toward deeper layers, and declines as feature organization stabilizes. We further find that deeper layers stabilize earlier and more strongly than shallow layers. The results show that our approach can be employed as a tool for understanding how ViTs learn and evolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种理解 Vision Transformer (ViT) 训练过程中特征演化的新视角：以网络深度（层）和训练时间（epoch）为两个维度可视化训练过程。作者使用稀疏自编码器 (Sparse Autoencoders, SAEs) 从 CLS-token 表示中提取候选稀疏特征，并比较这些特征在不同 epoch-layer 组合下的激活分布。实验表明特征迁移主要发生在训练早期，更多地向更浅层迁移，并随特征组织稳定而减少；深层比浅层更早且更强烈地稳定下来。
Motivation: 现有的表示级相似性度量无法直接揭示训练过程中特征层面的动态变化，难以理解 ViT 在训练期间如何学习与重组特征。
Method: 采用 SAEs 从 ViT 的 CLS-token 表示中提取候选稀疏特征，然后跨 epoch-layer 对比较这些特征的激活分布，从而刻画特征级动态，并定义特征迁移 (feature migration) 为特征最可检测层在训练中的变化。
Result: 实验发现特征迁移集中在训练早期，更常朝向更浅的层发生，且随特征组织稳定而减少；深层相比浅层更早、更强烈地趋于稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要将该框架定位为理解 ViT 学习和特征演化的分析工具，可用于观察特征在网络中迁移和稳定的过程。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration with the Common-Sense Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles require robust perception and decision-making capabilities to operate in diverse and unseen scenarios. While reinforcement learning and rule-based methods can provide effective control and safety mechanisms, their performance may degrade in situations requiring contextual reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding multimodal information and generating contextual reasoning, however, their use for direct vehicle control can introduce latency and hallucination risks. To address these limitations, a hybrid framework is proposed. This system uses an orchestrator to coordinate PPO-trained reinforcement learning and PID control, with LLM common-sense reasoning applied throughout the framework. LLM reasoning is further employed iteratively to refine the RL reward function for dynamic driving environments. The proposed framework is evaluated in highly randomized CARLA scenarios under diverse environmental and traffic conditions. The results demonstrate the potential of integrating LLM-based reasoning with conventional autonomous driving methods while retaining structured control and safety mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶在多样未知场景中的决策问题，提出一个混合框架，用编排器 (orchestrator) 协调 PPO 训练的强化学习和 PID 控制，并将 LLM 常识推理贯穿整个框架，同时迭代地使用 LLM 推理来细化强化学习的奖励函数。在高度随机化的 CARLA 场景和多样环境与交通条件下进行评估，结果表明将 LLM 推理与传统自动驾驶方法整合具有潜力，同时保留了结构化的控制与安全机制。
Motivation: 强化学习与基于规则的方法在需要上下文推理的场景下性能可能下降，而 LLM 虽擅长多模态理解与上下文推理，但直接用于车辆控制会带来延迟和幻觉风险，因此需要一种折中的混合方案。
Method: 提出一个混合框架，由一个编排器协调 PPO 训练的强化学习和 PID 控制，并在整个框架中应用 LLM 常识推理；此外，LLM 推理被迭代地用于针对动态驾驶环境细化 RL 的奖励函数。
Result: 在高度随机化的 CARLA 场景中，于多样环境和交通条件下进行评估；摘要未给出量化指标，仅报告结果展示了整合 LLM 推理与传统自动驾驶方法的潜力，同时保持结构化的控制和安全机制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该混合框架的可行性，表明可以在保留传统控制与安全机制的同时利用 LLM 的上下文推理能力，但未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ID-VTG: Image-Disambiguated Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) faces significant challenges when natural language queries must distinguish between multiple events involving visually similar entities, particularly when relying on fine-grained visual attributes that are difficult to describe accurately in words alone. To address this, we introduce Image-Disambiguated Video Temporal Grounding (ID-VTG), a task that leverages multimodal queries combining a reference image and a text description to precisely localize segments where a specific instance performs a described action. To facilitate research, we construct two benchmarks: IDVTG-Gym, focusing on fine-grained, compositionally ordered gymnastics actions with athletes in similar uniforms; and IDVTG-InternVid, an open-world dataset featuring diverse entities (e.g., humans, animals, fictional characters) and significant temporal distractors. Methodologically, we propose the Visually-Guided Disambiguation Aggregation (VGD-Agg) framework based on a dual-branch fast-slow architecture. The fast branch efficiently generates preliminary event proposals, while the slow branch performs fine-grained frame-level matching between video frames and the reference image. We enhance discriminability via two learnable tokens: a Compare Token, which represents hard negatives to probe for the presence of the target instance (as referred to by the query image), and a Depress Value, which represents text-irrelevant events. Proposals that the Compare Token identifies as lacking the target instance are pushed toward the Depress Value, thus easing disambiguation via the text query. Extensive experiments validate our approach, which achieves state-of-the-art results on the proposed benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/ID-VTG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出图像消歧的视频时间定位（ID-VTG）任务，用参考图像加文本描述的多模态查询来定位视频中特定实例执行指定动作的片段。作者构建了 IDVTG-Gym 和 IDVTG-InternVid 两个基准，并提出基于双分支快慢架构的 VGD-Agg 框架，在提出的基准上取得最佳结果。代码已开源。
Motivation: 视频时间定位（VTG）在查询需要区分外观相似实体的多个事件时很困难，尤其是涉及难以仅用文字准确描述的细粒度视觉属性时，现有方法难以消歧。
Method: 定义 ID-VTG 任务并构建两个基准数据集：IDVTG-Gym 针对穿着相似运动服的细粒度组合体操动作，IDVTG-InternVid 是包含多样实体和时间干扰物的开放世界数据集。提出 VGD-Agg 框架，采用双分支快慢架构：快分支生成初步事件候选，慢分支进行视频帧与参考图像的细粒度匹配；引入 Compare Token 表示难负例以探测目标实例是否存在，并用 Depress Value 表示与文本无关的事件，将缺少目标实例的候选推向该值从而简化文本查询的消歧。
Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在提出的两个基准上取得了最先进的结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合参考图像与文本的多模态查询以及视觉引导消歧机制能有效缓解外观相似实体事件的时间定位歧义；代码可在 GitHub 获取。

summary_sections.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在提出的两个基准上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为结合参考图像与文本的多模态查询以及视觉引导消歧机制能有效缓解外观相似实体事件的时间定位歧义；代码可在 GitHub 获取。

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion Inference-Time Control with Nested Sequential Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: We study inference-time control for text generation in discrete diffusion language models, where the goal is to steer sampling toward sequence-level rewards without retraining. Prior work in this domain has focused on particle-based methods such as best-of-$n$ sampling and bootstrap sequential Monte Carlo, which may suffer from overoptimism and weight degeneracy, respectively. We address these limitations using \emph{nested} sequential Monte Carlo methods. We formulate nested SMC (NSMC) and fully-adapted nested SMC (FA-NSMC) for Feynman--Kac steering, identifying and correcting errors in prior formulations that lead to biased final estimates. We evaluate these methods on toxicity and fluency steering tasks, showing that NSMC and FA-NSMC consistently outperform best-of-$n$ and bootstrap SMC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离散扩散语言模型在文本生成中的推理时控制（inference-time control），目标是在不重训练的情况下把采样引向序列级奖励。作者为 Feynman–Kac 引导提出嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛（nested SMC, NSMC）及完全自适应版本（FA-NSMC），并指出现有公式中的偏差错误。在毒性和流畅性引导任务上，NSMC 与 FA-NSMC 一致优于 best-of-n 和 bootstrap SMC。
Motivation: 已有的粒子类推理时控制方法存在明显缺陷：best-of-n 采样容易过度乐观（overoptimism），bootstrap 序贯蒙特卡洛则面临权重退化（weight degeneracy），因此需要更稳健的引导方法。
Method: 将嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛形式化到 Feynman–Kac 引导框架中，提出 NSMC 与 FA-NSMC，并识别和修正先前公式中导致最终估计有偏的错误。
Result: 在毒性和流畅性两个文本引导任务上，NSMC 和 FA-NSMC 均持续优于 best-of-n 与 bootstrap SMC。
Conclusion: 嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛能够改善离散扩散语言模型的推理时奖励引导效果；摘要未报告更广泛任务或局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ArmorOCR: Grounded Adversarial Visual Perception via Observation-Transferred Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Large multimodal models (LMMs) have demonstrated strong OCR recognition capabilities, yet remain vulnerable to adversarial visual text that is readable to humans but challenging for models to localize and recognize. Existing OCR benchmarks mainly focus on natural or document-style text, while adversarial OCR evaluations remain limited in scale, task coverage, or region-aware evaluation. In this paper, we formulate adversarial OCR as a \textbf{grounded OCR perception} task and introduce \textbf{AdvSpot}, the first benchmark for grounded adversarial OCR evaluation. AdvSpot comprises 390 images with region-level annotations, spanning 5 primary categories and 13 fine-grained adversarial OCR types. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{ArmorOCR}, a two-stage training framework for robust adversarial OCR perception. ArmorOCR first acquires missing adversarial OCR perception from privileged transformed observations through On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), and then refines grounded OCR perception through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-conditioned rewards for localization, recognition, full spotting, and visual question answering (VQA). Experiments on our AdvSpot, other adversarial OCR benchmarks, and general OCR benchmarks demonstrate that ArmorOCR consistently improves adversarial OCR perception while preserving competitive general OCR capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型多模态模型（LMM）在对抗性视觉文本上的脆弱性，将对抗性 OCR 形式化为 grounded OCR perception 任务，提出首个对抗性 OCR 基准 AdvSpot（390 张图像、区域级标注，覆盖 5 个主类别和 13 种细粒度对抗 OCR 类型），并提出两阶段训练框架 ArmorOCR。实验表明 ArmorOCR 在 AdvSpot、其他对抗 OCR 基准和通用 OCR 基准上一致提升对抗性 OCR 感知，同时保持有竞争力的通用 OCR 能力。
Motivation: 现有 LMM 虽有强 OCR 能力，但对人类可读而模型难定位和识别的对抗性视觉文本仍然脆弱；已有 OCR 基准多聚焦自然或文档风格文本，对抗性 OCR 评估在规模、任务覆盖和区域感知评估上均不足。
Method: 提出 ArmorOCR 两阶段训练框架：第一阶段通过 On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) 从特权变换观测中获取缺失的对抗性 OCR 感知；第二阶段使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 并结合任务条件奖励，优化定位、识别、完整 spotting 和视觉问答 (VQA) 等 grounded OCR 能力。
Result: 摘要报告 ArmorOCR 在 AdvSpot、其他对抗性 OCR 基准及通用 OCR 基准上均能一致提升对抗性 OCR 感知，且不牺牲通用 OCR 能力。
Conclusion: 作者主张将对抗性 OCR 视为 grounded OCR perception 问题，并以此为基础构建首个专用基准与鲁棒训练框架；未在摘要中讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SAE-Xplainers: Rule-Based Feature Interpretation for Extreme Earth Events
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of large-scale Weather and Climate (W&C) datasets offers new opportunities for modeling extreme Earth events (ExEE) and their impacts using deep learning. However, their adoption in operational settings remains limited by the lack of models' interpretability. While for conventional text and image modalities, tools such as Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have proven effective for extracting human-understandable concepts, their use for the analysis of ExEE remains challenging due to the nature of W&C data. To address this, we introduce (i) a geographic location-based modulation of the inputs of SAE to capture the local semantic meaning of environmental patterns, and (ii) an ensemble of rule-based SAE-Xplainers to interpret the resulting high-dimensional features derived from complex, multi-modal environmental predictors. We evaluate our method on three ExEE types: the prediction of fires, and the detection of tropical cyclones and atmospheric rivers. We show that SAE input modulation improves both reconstruction performance and feature utilization, and that our SAE-Xplainers enable faithful interpretation of complex climatic patterns by unfolding them into human-understandable rules that are consistent with the scientific literature, while also supporting the identification of feature absorption.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 16 Figures, Under Review. A non-archival 2-page version was accepted as an oral presentation at Climate Informatics 2026 (Extended Abstract ID 66, https://github.com/freddy0218/ClimateInformatics2026/tree/main), and a non-archival 4-page version was accepted as an oral presentation at the AICC Workshop at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对天气与气候 (Weather and Climate) 数据中深度学习模型可解释性不足的问题，提出 SAE-Xplainers：对稀疏自编码器 (Sparse Autoencoders, SAE) 的输入加入基于地理位置的调制，以捕获环境模式的局部语义，再用一组基于规则的解释器将高维多模态环境特征展开为人类可理解的规则。方法在火灾预测、热带气旋检测和大气河检测三类极端地球事件 (Extreme Earth Events, ExEE) 上验证，表明输入调制提升重建性能和特征利用率，且所得规则与科学文献一致并支持特征吸收 (feature absorption) 的识别。
Motivation: 大规模天气与气候数据集为用深度学习建模极端地球事件提供了机会，但模型缺乏可解释性阻碍了其在业务化场景中的采用；而常规文本和图像模态中有效的 SAE 概念提取方法难以直接用于天气与气候数据的特性。
Method: 提出两方面改进：其一，对 SAE 输入施加基于地理位置 (geographic location) 的调制，使环境模式的局部语义被编码；其二，构建一组基于规则 (rule-based) 的 SAE-Xplainers，对复杂多模态环境预测因子得到的高维特征进行解释。
Result: 在火灾预测、热带气旋检测和大气河检测三个 ExEE 任务上，摘要报告 SAE 输入调制同时改善了重建性能和特征利用率，且 SAE-Xplainers 能将复杂气候模式展开为与科学文献一致的人类可理解规则，并支持识别特征吸收现象。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为极端地球事件深度学习模型提供了一种可验证的透明解释路径，但未涉及除三类事件外的更广泛任务或业务化部署的细节。
Relevance: 45

papers.title: DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to predict how locomotion and arm motion jointly alter future observations and control. Existing world-action models, developed largely for fixed-base platforms, do not explicitly distinguish camera ego-motion from base and arm actions. Here we introduce DECOWAM, a whole-body world-action model that separates these factors through dedicated conditional interfaces. DECOWAM freezes an adapted FastWAM backbone and trains residual adapters, an action-equivalent future bottleneck distilled from privileged observations, adversarially separated base and arm latents, and base-velocity conditioning for video prediction. We further introduce ARMDOG, a real-robot dataset that synchronizes video, whole-body state and action, and language. On a fixed replay protocol, DECOWAM improved both future-video and action prediction over FastWAM, reducing action MSE by 21.7% with 25.95M trainable adaptation parameters. Across 79 closed-loop trials per method, it achieved the highest observed whole-body coordination and base-displacement robustness among the compared systems, while task completion remained comparable to the strongest baseline. These results show that embodiment-aware factorization can support parameter-efficient joint visual prediction and whole-body control under moving viewpoints.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Introduces DECOWAM, a decoupled whole-body world-action model for legged mobile manipulation, and the ARMDOG real-robot dataset
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DECOWAM，一种用于腿式移动操作 (legged mobile manipulation) 的解耦全身世界-动作模型。它通过专用条件接口将相机自运动与基座、手臂动作分开建模，冻结适配后的 FastWAM 主干并训练残差适配器、动作等价未来瓶颈、对抗分离的基座与手臂隐变量以及基座速度条件化视频预测。作者同时发布 ARMDOG 真实机器人数据集，同步视频、全身状态、动作和语言。在固定回放协议下，DECOWAM 相比 FastWAM 将动作 MSE 降低 21.7%，仅用 25.95M 可训练适配参数，并在闭环实验中取得最高的全身协调性和基座位移鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型主要面向固定基座平台，没有明确区分相机自我运动与基座和手臂动作；而移动操作需要预测运动与手臂动作如何共同改变未来观测和控制，这一缺失限制了参数高效的视觉预测与全身控制。
Method: DECOWAM 通过专用条件接口解耦影响未来观测的因素：冻结适配后的 FastWAM 主干，训练残差适配器；引入从特权观测蒸馏得到的动作等价未来瓶颈；用对抗方式分离基座与手臂隐变量；并对视频预测施加基座速度条件化。作者还构建 ARMDOG 数据集，将视频、全身状态、动作和语言同步起来。
Result: 在固定回放协议上，DECOWAM 的未来视频与动作预测均优于 FastWAM，动作 MSE 降低 21.7%，可训练适配参数为 25.95M。每种方法 79 次闭环试验中，它在全身协调与基座位移鲁棒性上取得最高观测值，任务完成率与最强基线相当。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，体现感知的因子分解 (embodiment-aware factorization) 能够在运动视点下支持参数高效的联合视觉预测与全身控制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Flow Matching-Based PET Image Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have shown strong potential for positron emission tomography (PET) image reconstruction. Although diffusion model-based reconstruction methods have demonstrated promising performance, they often require many reverse sampling steps with data-consistency updates incorporated into the sampling process. Flow matching offers an attractive alternative because it can directly estimate clean images from intermediate states, allowing data-consistency refinement to be separated from flow propagation. In this work, we proposed flow matching-based PET image reconstruction methods. We first established PET-FlowDPS by incorporating Poisson likelihood guidance with an expectation-maximization (EM)-based preconditioner into the FlowDPS framework. We then proposed a model-based PET reconstruction method that used a pretrained flow matching model as a prior, in which the flow-based prior, PET data refinement, and stochastic propagation were interpreted within an approximate Bayesian framework. Experimental results using [$^{\text{18}}\text{F}$]FDG brain PET datasets showed that the proposed method achieved better bias-variance trade-offs across different dose levels compared with other reference methods. These results demonstrated the potential of flow matching as a generative prior for quantitative PET image reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于流匹配 (flow matching) 的 PET 图像重建方法。作者先建立 PET-FlowDPS，将泊松似然引导与基于期望最大化 (EM) 的预条件子引入 FlowDPS 框架；随后提出以预训练流匹配模型作为先验的基于模型重建方法，在近似贝叶斯框架中解释流先验、PET 数据精炼与随机传播。基于 [18F]FDG 脑 PET 数据集的实验显示，该方法在不同剂量水平下取得更好的偏差-方差权衡。
Motivation: 扩散模型 PET 重建虽然效果不错，但常需要大量反向采样步骤，且数据一致性更新耦合在采样过程中。流匹配可以直接从中间状态估计干净图像，使数据一致性精炼与流传播分离，因此有望简化采样并改善定量重建。
Method: 提出两条技术路线：一是 PET-FlowDPS，将泊松似然引导和 EM 预条件子融入 FlowDPS 框架；二是基于模型的重建，使用预训练流匹配模型作为生成先验，并在近似贝叶斯框架下统一流先验、PET 数据精炼和随机传播。
Result: 摘要报告在 [18F]FDG 脑 PET 数据集上，所提方法在不同剂量水平下的偏差-方差权衡优于其他参照方法。
Conclusion: 摘要认为流匹配有潜力作为 PET 定量图像重建的生成先验，并指出实验评估范围限于脑 PET 数据集。

papers.title: BeyondMasks: Evaluating Causal and Physical Consistency in Video Object Removal
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative video models have significantly improved visual realism in video object removal, yet evaluation protocols still focus on masked region fidelity, treating removal as local inpainting. In real scenes, object removal is a causal intervention: eliminating an object also requires removing its induced physical effects, such as shadows, reflections, illumination changes, translucency, and dynamic traces. Existing benchmarks lack aligned clean references or remain limited to simplified synthetic settings, preventing systematic evaluation of causal consistency. We introduce BeyondMasks, a paired benchmark for causally consistent video object removal, consisting of temporally aligned synthetic and real world video pairs with clean background references. The dataset spans diverse photometric, geometric, volumetric, and dynamic interactions, and supports both mask based and instruction driven editing. We further propose CORE, a structured vision language model based evaluation protocol that jointly measures object disappearance and after effect consistency, aligning more closely with human judgments than existing metrics. Benchmarking state of the art methods reveals systematic failures in removing secondary physical effects despite high masked region fidelity, exposing a gap between visual plausibility and causal correctness. BeyondMasks reframes video object removal as causal scene consistency rather than local reconstruction and provides a unified framework for its evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BeyondMasks，一个用于因果一致视频物体移除 (video object removal) 的配对基准，包含时间对齐的合成与真实世界视频对，并带有干净背景参考。作者同时提出 CORE，一种基于视觉语言模型的结构化评估协议，联合衡量物体消失与二次物理效应（如阴影、反射、光照变化）的一致性。基准测试发现现有最先进方法在掩码区域保真度很高，但系统性地无法移除这些二次物理效应。
Motivation: 现有视频物体移除评估只关注掩码区域保真度，把移除当作局部修复；但真实场景中移除物体是因果干预，必须同时移除其引起的阴影、反射、透光、动态痕迹等物理效应。已有基准要么缺乏对齐的干净参考，要么局限于简化合成环境，无法系统评估因果一致性。
Method: 构建 BeyondMasks 配对基准，覆盖光度、几何、体积和动态交互，支持基于掩码和指令驱动 (instruction driven) 的编辑方式；并提出 CORE 评估协议，利用视觉语言模型结构化地联合度量物体消失程度与二次效果一致性。
Result: 在 BeyondMasks 上评估最先进方法发现：尽管掩码区域保真度很高，方法仍系统性失败于移除二次物理效应，说明视觉合理性与因果正确性之间存在明显差距。
Conclusion: 作者主张将视频物体移除重新定义为因果场景一致性 (causal scene consistency) 而非局部重建，并提供统一的评估框架来支持该视角。

papers.title: Structured Affinity for Unsupervised Visual Class-Incremental Memory in Deep Artificial Immune Networks
papers.abstract_en: Artificial immune networks (AINs) are naturally memory-forming systems, but conventional visual AINs often rely on flattened vector affinity that ignores spatial structure. This paper studies whether structured, gradient-free immune affinity can make Deep AINs viable as replay-free visual class-incremental representation-memory learners. Visual B-cells are formalized as structured templates, including shifted-template affinity, zero-normalized cross-correlation (ZNCC) filters, and feature-map binding profiles. A repertoire is treated both as memory and as a representation-inducing basis, while depth is obtained by passing binding-profile response maps to subsequent immune layers. The resulting Deep AIN exhibits adaptive latent coordinate reorganization: as new classes arrive, the binding-profile space evolves while retaining recoverable structure for earlier classes. Experiments on sklearn digits, MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and KMNIST show that preserving response maps is critical. Scalar binding-profile variants underperform, whereas feature-map Deep AINs learn class-discriminative visual memory without replay, label-driven immune updates, or backpropagation through the immune layers. On sklearn digits, downstream probes fitted on the learned binding profiles reach 0.939 final balanced accuracy with logistic regression and 0.902 with 1-nearest-neighbour after all ten classes are encountered, with initial-class retention of 0.978. Adaptive layer-wise scale calibration further improves the two-layer feature-map Deep AIN to 0.978 balanced accuracy. With the same calibration rule, Fashion-MNIST reaches 0.814 and KMNIST reaches 0.853. These probes are external validation tools, not components of the AIN. The results identify structured affinity, response-map preservation, adaptive latent reorganization, and layer-wise scale calibration as key mechanisms for replay-free visual immune memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何用结构化的、免梯度的免疫亲和力（immune affinity）使深度人工免疫网络（Deep AINs）成为无回放（replay-free）的视觉类增量表示记忆学习器。作者把视觉 B 细胞形式化为结构化模板，包括移位模板亲和力、零均值归一化互相关（ZNCC）滤波器和特征图绑定剖面（binding profiles），并让绑定剖面的响应图逐层传递以获得深度。在 sklearn digits、MNIST、Fashion-MNIST 和 KMNIST 上的实验显示，保留响应图是关键，特征图版 Deep AIN 无需回放、无标签驱动免疫更新且不经过免疫层反向传播即可学习类判别视觉记忆。
Motivation: 传统视觉 AIN 常依赖扁平的向量亲和力，忽视了图像的空间结构，使其难以作为有效的类增量记忆系统；作者想探究结构化亲和力能否让 AIN 在无回放条件下成为可行的视觉表示记忆学习者。
Method: 将视觉 B 细胞形式化为结构化模板，引入移位模板亲和力与 ZNCC 滤波器，把免疫库（repertoire）同时作为记忆和表示诱导基；通过将绑定剖面响应图输入后续免疫层获取深度，并提出适应性的层内尺度标定（layer-wise scale calibration）来改进表示。
Result: 在 sklearn digits 上，基于所学绑定剖面的下游探针在十类全部出现后达到 0.939 的最终平衡准确率（逻辑回归）和 0.902（1-最近邻），初始类保留率为 0.978；自适应层内尺度标定将两层特征图版 Deep AIN 提升到 0.978，同标定规则下 Fashion-MNIST 达 0.814、KMNIST 达 0.853。标量绑定剖面变体表现较差，特征图版本明显更优。
Conclusion: 作者把结构化亲和力、响应图保留、自适应潜在重组和层内尺度标定识别为无回放视觉免疫记忆的关键机制；同时强调这些下游探针只是外部验证工具，并非 AIN 的组成部分。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation for Efficient Multi-Agent Communication Topology Design
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by coordinating multiple agents, but at the cost of substantial token consumption. Recent work on automatic topology design, ARG-Designer, has reframed this problem as autoregressive graph generation. However, its training objective provides no explicit incentive for the model to generate sparse and efficient topologies. We address this limitation by introducing a Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation (RGA-Designer) inspired by Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). We train a reward model that jointly captures task correctness and structural compactness, and then fine-tune the pretrained graph generator using the reward model as feedback. Our method preserves task accuracy at the level of ARG-Designer while reducing token consumption by an average of 20.5%.
papers.comment: Full version of extended abstract accepted at ICONIP 2026 (poster)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RGA-Designer，一种面向 LLM 多智能体系统 (MAS) 通信拓扑设计的奖励引导自回归图生成方法。作者受 RLHF 启发训练一个同时捕捉任务正确性与结构紧凑性的奖励模型，并用它微调预训练图生成器。摘要报告该方法在保持 ARG-Designer 任务精度的同时，平均降低 20.5% 的 token 消耗。
Motivation: 已有工作 ARG-Designer 将自动拓扑设计建模为自回归图生成，但其训练目标没有显式激励模型生成稀疏且高效的拓扑，导致多智能体协作消耗大量 token。
Method: 引入奖励引导的自回归图生成 (RGA-Designer)：先训练一个联合建模任务正确性与结构紧凑性的奖励模型，再以该奖励模型作为反馈对预训练图生成器进行微调，使生成过程偏向更经济的拓扑。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在保持与 ARG-Designer 相当的任务准确率的同时，将 token 消耗平均降低 20.5%。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于奖励反馈的训练方式可以在不牺牲任务正确性的前提下得到更高效的多智能体通信拓扑。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HandMvNet: Real-Time 3D Hand Pose Estimation Using Multi-View Cross-Attention Fusion
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we present HandMvNet, one of the first real-time method designed to estimate 3D hand motion and shape from multi-view camera images. Unlike previous monocular approaches, which suffer from scale-depth ambiguities, our method ensures consistent and accurate absolute hand poses and shapes. This is achieved through a multi-view attention-fusion mechanism that effectively integrates features from multiple viewpoints. In contrast to previous multi-view methods, our approach eliminates the need for camera parameters as input to learn 3D geometry. HandMvNet also achieves a substantial reduction in inference time while delivering competitive results compared to the state-of-the-art methods, making it suitable for real-time applications. Evaluated on publicly available datasets, HandMvNet qualitatively and quantitatively outperforms previous methods under identical settings. Code is available at github.com/pyxploiter/handmvnet.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 20th International Joint Conference on Computer Vision, Imaging and Computer Graphics Theory and Applications - Volume 2: VISAPP (2025), pp. 555-562
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HandMvNet，一种基于多视角图像输入的实时 3D 手部姿态与形状估计方法。它通过多视角注意力融合 (multi-view attention fusion) 整合多个视角的特征，无需相机参数作为输入，从而避免单目方法中的尺度-深度歧义。摘要称其在公开数据集上与现有最先进方法相当或更优，并大幅缩短推理时间，适合实时应用。
Motivation: 单目 3D 手部姿态估计存在尺度-深度歧义，难以获得一致的绝对手部姿态与形状；而先前多视角方法通常需要相机参数作为输入。作者希望实现无需相机参数、实时且准确的多视角手部姿态估计。
Method: 提出多视角注意力融合机制，将多个视角的图像特征有效集成以学习 3D 几何，不依赖相机参数输入；整个框架面向实时推理设计，同时估计手部运动与形状。
Result: 摘要报告在公开数据集上与最先进方法在相同设置下进行定性与定量比较，HandMvNet 优于此前方法，并显著减少推理时间，达到实时性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调 HandMvNet 是首批实时多视角 3D 手部姿态估计方法之一，消除了对相机参数输入的需求并大幅降低推理时间，适合实时应用；代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Professional Tennis Styles for Humanoid Robots with Adaptive Motion Planning and Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in real-world ball sports. However, achieving professional motion styles while maintaining strong task performance remains challenging. In this work, we propose AdaPT, an Adaptive Motion Planning and Tracking framework that learns professional tennis serving and rally styles directly from broadcast videos. This hierarchical design is motivated by the key insight that the planner generates stylistic kinematic motions, while the tracker executes them with minimal interference with planning. Despite its effectiveness in simulation, a substantial sim-to-real gap emerges: tracking performance inevitably degrades on real robots, and this degradation is partially overlooked by autoregressive planning and further compounded by noisy perception. To address these issues, our adaptation mechanism improves tracking robustness by learning to track randomized execution speeds, while conditioning the planner on a learned motion-speed adapter to mitigate compounding errors. Real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 demonstrate the effectiveness of our adaptation mechanism in bridging the sim-to-real gap. We further deploy AdaPT policies on the full-size Dobot Atom humanoid robot (1.7m) and demonstrate in-the-wild serving without motion capture. Beyond these results, our real-world experiments reveal both algorithmic and engineering insights for future humanoid ball-sports systems. Videos and code are available on our \href{https://humanoidtennis.github.io/AdaPT/}{project website}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaPT（Adaptive Motion Planning and Tracking），一种从广播视频中学习职业网球发球与对拉风格的层次化框架，用于人形机器人。其核心设计是规划器生成风格化运动学动作，跟踪器以最小干扰执行；针对仿真到实物迁移中的跟踪退化与自回归规划误差累积，引入学习随机执行速度跟踪与运动速度适配器的适应机制。真实实验在 Unitree G1 与全尺寸 Dobot Atom（1.7m）上展示效果，并实现无需动作捕捉的野外发球。
Motivation: 现有人形机器人已能在真实球类运动中展现一定能力，但要在保持任务表现的同时达到职业级动作风格仍很困难；此外仿真到实物的差距会导致跟踪性能下降，并被自回归规划与噪声感知放大。
Method: 提出 AdaPT 层次化框架：规划器从广播视频学习风格化运动，跟踪器在执行时尽量不干扰规划；适应机制通过学习跟踪随机化执行速度、并用运动速度适配器调节规划输入来缓解误差累积。
Result: 真实实验显示该适应机制有效缩小 sim-to-real 差距；策略在 Unitree G1 上验证，并部署到 1.7m 的 Dobot Atom 人形机器人上，实现无需动作捕捉的野外发球。
Conclusion: 论文强调真实实验揭示了人形机器人球类系统后续的算法与工程洞察，并开源视频与代码。

papers.title: Evidence-Gated Task and Motion Planning with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Robots executing long-horizon manipulation tasks from natural-language instructions must reason about both semantic task structure and geometric feasibility. However, under partial observability, the availability of goal-relevant objects may be uncertain. In such cases, approaches that combine Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) may generate subgoals that rely on the VLM's prior knowledge without observational support, leading to execution failures or unintended outcomes. We propose Evidence Acquisition and Feasibility Gating (EAFG), a framework that acquires visual evidence through VLM-generated exploratory subgoals and TAMP-based execution. EAFG then applies a feasibility gate to decide whether to proceed with task planning, acquire further evidence, or halt. Our experiments show that, in cooking tasks with ambiguous object use, EAFG improves recipe completion by discovering task-relevant objects before planning. For instructions requiring an absent object, EAFG promotes appropriate halt decisions and reduces repeated attempts to manipulate that object.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Evidence Acquisition and Feasibility Gating (EAFG) 的框架，用于在部分可观测环境下将视觉语言模型 (VLM) 与任务和运动规划 (TAMP) 结合，处理长期操作任务中的不确定性。EAFG 通过 VLM 生成的探索性子目标获取视觉证据，并施加可行性门控来决定继续规划、获取更多证据还是停止。实验表明，在物体用途模糊的烹饪任务中，EAFG 能提前发现任务相关物体并提升食谱完成度；在需要缺失物体的指令下，能促进合理的停止决策并减少重复操作尝试。
Motivation: 在部分可观测条件下，结合 VLM 与 TAMP 的方法可能生成依赖 VLM 先验知识但缺乏观察支持的子目标，导致执行失败或意外结果。
Method: 提出 EAFG 框架，包含由 VLM 生成的探索性子目标和 TAMP 执行来获取视觉证据，并通过可行性门控决定下一步动作（继续任务规划、获取更多证据或停止）。
Result: 在烹饪任务中，EAFG 通过规划前发现任务相关物体而提升食谱完成率；对于需要缺失物体的指令，EAFG 促进适当的停止决策并减少对该物体的重复操作尝试。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在不确定性下通过显式证据获取和可行性门控可以改善 VLM 与 TAMP 结合的鲁棒性，避免脱离观测支持的规划。

papers.title: SABET-QA: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Question Answering over Temporal Knowledge Graphs (TKGQA) requires reasoning over time-sensitive facts, yet existing embedding-based methods struggle with multi-step queries due to single-pass reasoning pipelines. We propose SABET-QA, a framework that iteratively refines reasoning states across multiple hops via a bidirectional entity-temporal scoring mechanism and a slot-aware contextualization module that aligns question semantics with temporal KG embeddings. A differentiable working memory enables progressive hypothesis refinement, while auxiliary temporal boundaries serve as coarse supervision when available. Experiments on CronQuestions, Complex-CronQuestions, MultiTQ, and TimeQuestions demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, particularly on complex multi-step temporal queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SABET-QA，一个面向时序知识图谱问答 (TKGQA) 的框架，通过多跳迭代推理来代替传统嵌入方法的单次推理流程。框架使用双向实体-时序打分机制和槽感知上下文模块 (slot-aware contextualization) 对齐问题语义与时序嵌入，并借助可微工作记忆逐步细化假设；在 CronQuestions、Complex-CronQuestions、MultiTQ 和 TimeQuestions 四个基准上一致优于强基线，尤其在复杂多步时序查询上。
Motivation: 现有基于嵌入的 TKGQA 方法通常采用单次推理流水线，难以处理需要跨多步推理的时间敏感事实查询，导致在复杂多步问题上表现不佳。
Method: 提出 SABET-QA 框架，包含双向实体-时序打分机制以跨多跳细化推理状态，以及将问题语义与时序知识图谱嵌入对齐的槽感知上下文模块；可微工作记忆支持渐进式假设精炼，并可在可用时利用辅助时序边界作为粗粒度监督信号。
Result: 在 CronQuestions、Complex-CronQuestions、MultiTQ 和 TimeQuestions 上的实验显示，该方法相比强基线取得一致提升，尤其在复杂多步时序查询上改进明显；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为迭代式多跳推理结合双向时序打分能够有效改善嵌入方法在时序知识图谱问答上的表现，重点面向复杂多步时序查询场景。

papers.title: V-REX: Efficient Specialist VLM Training for Veterinary X-Rays
papers.abstract_en: While generalist VLMs are expensive to train, creating domain experts is widely assumed to require fine-tuning increasingly large foundation models. We show that, in veterinary radiology, this assumption is misguided. By rethinking the entire VLM pipeline - from text tokenisation and pre-training to grounding and inference - we demonstrate that careful engineering can yield models that outperform much larger foundation models from scratch, without relying on any other data. Our approach introduces new strategies for generative pre-training and grounding that improve training efficiency, increasing data utilisation and downstream performance. Using only a fraction of the parameters, data, and compute of contemporary generalist models, we develop the first VLM capable of generating diagnostic reports for veterinary radiographs, surpassing open foundation models on this task by significant margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 V-REX，一种面向兽医X光片的高效专业视觉语言模型（VLM）训练方法。作者重新思考整个VLM管线（从文本分词、预训练、接地 grounding 到推理），主张在兽医放射学领域，精心工程可以从零训练出超越更大基础模型的模型，且不依赖任何其他数据。他们开发出第一个能够为兽医X光片生成诊断报告的VLM，并报告其在该任务上显著超过开放基础模型。
Motivation: 训练通用VLM成本高昂，而构建领域专家通常被认为必须对越来越大的基础模型进行微调。作者认为在兽医放射学中这一假设是错误的，希望通过重新设计管线，用远小于通用模型的参数、数据和计算量实现专业模型。
Method: 针对VLM全流程进行重新设计，提出新的生成式预训练和接地（grounding）策略，以提升训练效率、数据利用率和下游性能，强调通过仔细工程而非扩大模型规模来取得收益。
Result: 摘要报告，仅用通用模型参数、数据和计算的一小部分，从零训练的模型在兽医X光片诊断报告生成任务上以显著优势超越开放基础模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为在兽医放射学中，小心设计的工程手段可以替代对大规模基础模型的依赖，并展示了首个可生成兽医X光诊断报告的VLM。
Relevance: 0
