papers.title: Orthogonal JEPA: Factorized Predictive States for Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models construct latent states that support prediction, planning, and reasoning about an underlying system. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) offer a direct way to learn such states by predicting targets in representation space instead of reconstructing every detail of the observation. Standard JEPAs, however, organize all predictable content through one target embedding and one prediction pathway. In complex systems, this monolithic state can allocate redundant capacity to dominant signals while providing weak or conflicting gradients to less dominant predictive structure. We introduce \method, a latent world-modeling framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization. Learned basis matrices analyze each target state into multiple components, and a dedicated prediction branch estimates each component from a shared context representation. Predictive regression preserves the factor magnitudes required for state synthesis, an orthogonality objective discourages repeated directions, factor-activity regularization maintains variation in projected targets, and online variance regularization discourages coordinate-wise encoder collapse. Predicted components are synthesized into a complete latent state that can be used by a readout, decoder, planner, or autoregressive rollout. The same predictive-state mechanism applies when the target is temporally future, spatially hidden, or another partial observation of the same system. Experiments on controlled vision, single-cell transcriptomics, longitudinal health records, continuous control, and molecular dynamics evaluate representation quality, forecasting, planning, and long-horizon stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于正交预测分解 (orthogonal predictive factorization) 的潜在世界模型框架，用于改进 Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) 的潜在状态学习。作者用学习到的基矩阵将目标状态分解为多个分量，并为每个分量设置独立的预测分支，配合正交性、因子活跃度与在线方差正则化来避免冗余和坍缩。预测出的分量被合成为完整潜在状态，可供 readout、解码器、规划器或自回归 rollout 使用。实验覆盖受控视觉、单细胞转录组、纵向健康记录、连续控制和分子动力学等任务，评估表示质量、预测、规划与长时程稳定性。
Motivation: 标准 JEPA 通过单一目标嵌入和单一预测通路组织所有可预测内容，在复杂系统中容易把冗余容量分配给主导信号，而对次要预测结构提供偏弱或相互冲突的梯度。
Method: 引入正交预测分解机制：学习基矩阵将目标状态解析为多个分量，每个分量由共享上下文表示上的专门预测分支估计；损失包含预测回归、正交性约束、因子活跃度正则化以及抑制逐坐标编码器坍缩的在线方差正则化，预测分量再合成完整潜在状态。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果，只说明在受控视觉、单细胞转录组、纵向健康记录、连续控制和分子动力学等实验中对表示质量、预测、规划与长时程稳定性进行了评估。
Conclusion: 该预测状态机制被表述为可统一适用于时间未来、空间隐藏或同一系统的其他部分观测目标；作者强调分解式预测可减轻标准 JEPA 中单体目标嵌入带来的容量分配问题。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Let's Scale Step by Step: Compute-Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures significantly expand model capacity without a proportional increase in computational cost. However, optimizing their hyperparameters---particularly the learning rate---at extreme scales of both model size and token budget via sweeping remains computationally prohibitive. In this paper, we propose a compute-efficient, two-step hyperparameter transfer framework that estimates optimal learning rates for training large MoE models by transferring them across scaling model widths, and subsequently extrapolating to trillion-token horizons. First, we formulate a Maximal Update Parameterization ($μ$P) adaptation for MoE architectures utilizing Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and the Muon optimizer, demonstrating that optimal learning rates transfer consistently across width-scaled models. Second, we extend this transferability along the token dimension by establishing a predictive scaling law. By applying linear regression to the optimal values derived from small proxy models on limited budgets, we successfully extrapolate the ideal learning rate to massive training horizons (e.g., 10 trillion tokens) with high fidelity ($R^2=0.95$). Consequently, this indicates that proxy training on small models is sufficient to determine the optimal learning rate for the extensive training of large-scale MoEs. We apply the proposed methodology to pretrain our foundation model (155B total, 17B active parameters) from scratch, and the stable training and evaluation results validate that optimal configurations for full-scale target models can be accurately predicted with minimal ablation costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个计算高效的两步超参数迁移框架，用于估计大规模 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 模型的最优学习率：先通过 Maximal Update Parameterization (μP) 在模型宽度缩放上迁移，再沿 token 维度用预测性缩放律外推至万亿 token 规模。作者在 MoE + Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) + Muon 优化器设置下验证了学习率跨宽度迁移性，并用线性回归在小型代理模型上外推出 10 万亿 token 训练水平的最优学习率 (R²=0.95)。该方法被用于从零预训练一个 155B 总参数/17B 激活参数的基础模型，稳定训练与评估结果支持其预测有效性。
Motivation: MoE 在不按比例增加计算量的情况下扩展模型容量，但在模型规模和 token 预算都极大时，通过 sweeping 搜索最优超参数（尤其是学习率）在计算上不可行。
Method: 提出两步超参数迁移框架：首先为使用 Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) 和 Muon 优化器的 MoE 架构设计 Maximal Update Parameterization (μP) 适配，证明最优学习率可跨宽度缩放迁移；然后沿 token 维度建立预测性缩放律，用有限预算的小型代理模型得到的最优值做线性回归，外推至大规模训练水平。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能以高保真度 (R²=0.95) 将最优学习率外推到 10 万亿 token 的训练水平；用该方法从零预训练 155B 总参数/17B 激活参数的模型时，训练稳定且评估结果验证了预测准确性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在小型模型上进行代理训练足以确定大规模 MoE 长时间训练的最优学习率，全尺寸目标模型的最优配置可以以极小的消融成本被准确预测。

papers.title: Gravity-aware partially calibrated absolute pose estimation from affine- or rotation-covariant features
papers.abstract_en: Inertial measurement units (IMUs) are now standard in most consumer devices, such as smartphones, drones, and extended reality (XR) headsets. By fusing visual and inertial data, localization systems gain significantly in speed and robustness compared to vision-only or IMU-only approaches. However, traditional pose estimation methods fail to utilize the local geometric information embedded in feature descriptors like SIFT. Recent work has proved the advantages of leveraging this information for relative and absolute pose estimation, but its application to partially calibrated absolute pose estimation remains unexplored. In this paper, we derive novel constraints for joint estimation of absolute pose and focal length, making use of a gravity vector obtained from IMU data and the feature-induced local geometry, which we use to construct two efficient solvers: UP1PfAC, that operates given a single affine correspondence and UP2PfORI, which requires two orientation-covariant features. Unlike traditional, semi-calibrated absolute pose methods requiring four point correspondences, our solvers benefit from fewer samples and lower computational cost, simplifying robust estimation in modern RANSAC-like frameworks. We evaluate the proposed solvers against the state-of-the-art on large-scale public datasets and demonstrate that our method achieves fast and accurate localization and focal length estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对部分标定绝对位姿估计问题，利用 IMU 提供的重力向量以及特征描述子中蕴含的局部几何信息，推导了联合估计绝对位姿和焦距的新约束。作者据此构建了两个高效求解器：UP1PfAC（单个仿射对应）和 UP2PfORI（两个方向协变特征）。与传统需要四个点对应的半标定绝对位姿方法相比，该方法所需样本更少、计算成本更低，并在大规模公开数据集上实现了快速且准确的定位与焦距估计。
Motivation: 传统姿态估计方法没有利用 SIFT 等特征描述子中嵌入的局部几何信息；尽管已有工作证明该信息对相对和绝对姿态估计有益，但尚未应用于部分标定的绝对位姿估计。
Method: 从 IMU 重力向量和特征诱导的局部几何出发，推导联合估计绝对位姿与焦距的新约束，并据此构造两个求解器：UP1PfAC 使用单个仿射对应，UP2PfORI 使用两个方向协变特征；它们可嵌入现代 RANSAC 式框架以简化鲁棒估计。
Result: 在与最先进方法的大规模公开数据集对比中，该方法实现了快速且准确的定位和焦距估计，并且相较于传统四点点对应半标定方法，所需样本更少、计算成本更低。
Conclusion: 该工作将特征局部几何与重力信息相结合，拓展到部分标定的绝对位姿估计，表明借助更少的对应关系即可高效完成位姿与焦距联合估计。

papers.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Hidden chain-of-thought (CoT) traces, especially those from frontier proprietary large reasoning models (LRMs), are valuable model assets. Yet whether these hidden CoTs can be directly extracted from black-box models remains largely unexplored. In this work, we systematically study whether hidden CoTs can be extracted near-verbatim from black-box LRMs through API interactions. We identify a previously overlooked reasoning replay surface between tool calls and develop EchoCoT, a multi-step attack that iteratively extracts hidden CoTs using API-returned fidelity signals. We further develop an LLM-based optimization framework that automatically searches for an effective universal injection trajectory across various datasets. We evaluate EchoCoT on three open-source and five frontier proprietary LRMs. On open-source LRMs, EchoCoT achieves up to 66.4\% near-verbatim extraction success, with the extracted trace length within 10\% of the target and at least 90\% of tokens exactly matching the target CoT. The same injection trajectory also generalizes to unseen datasets, achieving up to 80\% extraction success under the same criterion. For tested frontier proprietary LRMs, a substantial fraction of extracted CoTs closely align with provider-reported reasoning lengths and available CoT summaries. EchoCoT can also extract very long CoTs: on Gemini-2.5, it extracts 33,463 tokens from a 32,948-token target. These results establish hidden-CoT extraction as a practical security risk and highlight the need to better protect hidden CoT assets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否通过API交互从黑盒大型推理模型（LRM）中近似逐字提取隐藏思维链（hidden CoT）。作者识别出工具调用之间存在可被利用的推理回放面，提出多步攻击EchoCoT，利用API返回的保真信号迭代提取，并用LLM驱动的优化框架自动搜索通用注入轨迹。评估表明在开源和专有LRM上均能高成功率提取，揭示隐藏CoT提取是实际安全风险。
Motivation: 隐藏CoT轨迹是前沿专有推理模型的重要资产，但黑盒模型中的隐藏CoT能否被直接提取此前基本未被探索，该问题直接影响模型资产安全。
Method: 提出EchoCoT攻击，其核心是识别工具调用间的推理回放面作为攻击入口，通过多步迭代利用API返回的保真信号提取逐字CoT；同时开发基于LLM的优化框架自动搜索跨数据集有效的通用注入轨迹。
Result: 在开源LRM上最高达66.4%的近逐字提取成功率，提取轨迹长度与目标相差10%以内且至少90%token精确匹配；同一注入轨迹泛化到未见数据集时可达80%成功率。对前沿专有LRM，提取的CoT与供应商报告的推理长度及可用CoT摘要高度吻合；在Gemini-2.5上从32948 token目标提取出33463 token。
Conclusion: 摘要强调隐藏CoT提取已被证明是一种切实可行的安全风险，表明需要加强对隐藏CoT资产的保护。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What You Can't See Is What You Learn: Restricted Evidence Visibility Favors Compositional Generalization in Shared-Genome Language-Model Societies
papers.abstract_en: Multi-module systems often expose every module to the full input. We test whether restricting evidence visibility changes which solutions gradient-based training discovers. Four-cell societies share one frozen pretrained language model and one low-rank adapter, communicating only through two model-width continuous vectors in a fixed relay. On a prospectively sealed natural-language function-composition task, we train ten matched restricted/global pairs sharing initialization bytes, training order, token layout, parameters, and computation; only the attention mask differs. Restricted societies outperform their globally visible twins by at least 20 points at both depths in 9 of 10 pairs, with median paired advantages of 0.7648 and 0.6050. Cutting communication reduces every restricted society to chance, and the depth-three advantage remains 0.558 on programs whose composite function never appeared in training. Across six audited restricted societies, same-value packet transplants preserve behavior at 0.94-1.00 across all tested interfaces; destructive interventions collapse performance; and counterfactual packets redirect outputs toward the mathematically predicted answer. The sole high-performing global model also requires communication, but its same-value packets are not interchangeable across episodes. Restricted visibility is thus not necessary for composition; under this protocol it substantially increases the probability of a generalizing relay and favors a reusable, value-indexed interface. The complete preregistered battery nevertheless formally fails because restricted-arm median depth-three accuracy is 0.6988, below the 0.70 floor. An earlier qualification cohort likewise yielded 0/10 complete passes: one model met every task-performance gate, but all ten failed ordinary-language preservation, confining the system to explicitly task-gated use.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and evaluation records: https://github.com/tokenosopher/populus-evidence-partitioning ; checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/tokenosopher/populus-evidence-partitioning-checkpoints
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在多模块系统中限制证据可见性（restricted evidence visibility）如何影响基于梯度训练所发现的解。作者构造了共享冻结预训练语言模型与低秩适配器的四单元社会（four-cell society），单元仅通过两个模型宽度的连续向量在固定中继中通信，并在事前密封的自然语言函数组合任务上训练十对匹配的 restricted/global 模型（仅注意力掩码不同）。结果显示受限社会在 9/10 配对中显著优于全局可见孪生模型，中位配对优势分别为 0.7648 和 0.6050；通信中断使所有受限社会退化为随机水平，且深度三优势在从未出现在训练中的复合函数上仍为 0.558。尽管完整的预先注册测试因受限臂中位深度三准确率 0.6988 低于 0.70 门槛而正式失败，证据仍表明受限可见性并非组合能力的必要条件，但显著提高了泛化中继的概率并促成可复用、值索引的接口。
Motivation: 多模块系统通常让每个模块看到完整输入，但作者质疑这种全可见性是否会影响梯度训练发现的解。该问题对理解组合泛化（compositional generalization）的产生机制以及多智能体/模块化系统的接口设计具有重要意义。
Method: 采用四单元社会设置，所有单元共享一个冻结的预训练语言模型和一个低秩适配器，单元间仅通过两个模型宽度的连续向量在固定中继中通信。在事前密封的自然语言函数组合任务上，训练十对严格匹配的 restricted/global 模型对（共享初始化字节、训练顺序、token 布局、参数与计算，仅注意力掩码不同）。此外进行通信消融、同值包移植（same-value packet transplants）、破坏性干预与反事实包实验，以审计所发现的接口行为。
Result: 受限社会在 9/10 配对中于两个深度均至少领先全局可见孪生模型 20 点，中位配对优势为 0.7648（深度二）与 0.6050（深度三）。切断通信使所有受限社会降至随机水平；深度三优势在未见过的复合函数程序上仍为 0.558。在六个受限社会的审计中，同值包移植在 0.94-1.00 范围内保持行为，破坏性干预导致性能崩溃，反事实包将输出引向数学预期答案。唯一高表现的全局模型也需要通信，但其同值包在跨 episode 时不可互换。预先注册的完整测试正式失败，因为受限臂中位深度三准确率为 0.6988，低于 0.70 的门槛；此前的资格队列同样得到 0/10 完整通过。
Conclusion: 作者认为在此协议下，受限证据可见性并非组合能力的必要条件，但能显著提高产生泛化中继（generalizing relay）的概率，并促成可复用、值索引的接口。系统目前受限于明确任务门控的使用场景，因为即使通过了任务性能门槛的模型也未能在普通语言保持（ordinary-language preservation）上通过全部测试。

papers.title: On the Applicability of Safety Nets: A Safety-By-Design Solution for Certifying Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in safety-critical aviation systems presents significant challenges for certification and deployment. Aviation, often regarded as the safest form of transportation, relies on numerous safety-critical systems. For future safety-critical AI-based systems, EASA requires a Safety-by-Design approach, which can be achieved by using Safety Nets that combine neural network compression with lookup tables to ensure 100 % correct runtime behavior across the discretized operational design domain. Although Safety Nets have been studied, no comprehensive study of their performance characteristics and system design trade-offs has been conducted. This work presents the first systematic analysis of the trade-off between neural network and lookup table size in Safety Nets. By systematically comparing neural networks with diverse architectures, this study identifies optimal design parameters that minimize overall storage and memory requirements while maintaining certification compliance. Results demonstrate that architectures with 3 to 5 hidden layers, each with approximately 50 to 100 nodes, combined with one-hot encoding, achieve the best balance. In these configurations, neural networks accurately represent at least 97 % of the data, while compact lookup tables handle the remaining errors. The resulting Safety Nets reduce the system size by almost three orders of magnitude, fitting within the memory budget of current avionics hardware while guaranteeing 100 % correct outputs across the entire discretized input space, as required by EASA guidelines. This work provides the first-ever open-source implementation of Safety Nets for HCAS and VCAS with replicable results, demonstrating a practical pathway toward certifiable AI-based systems in aviation and establishing Safety Nets as a viable Safety-by-Design solution for safety-critical applications.
papers.journal_ref: 35th Congress of the International Councilof the Aeronautical Sciences (ICAS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对航空安全关键系统中AI认证的难题，提出并系统评估Safety Nets方法——将神经网络压缩与查找表结合，以保证在离散化操作设计域内100%的正确运行时行为。作者首次系统分析了神经网络与查找表大小之间的权衡，发现3至5个隐藏层、每层约50至100个节点并配合one-hot编码的架构最优，可将系统体积缩小近三个数量级，同时满足EASA的Safety-by-Design要求。该工作还首次开源了HCAS和VCAS的Safety Nets实现。
Motivation: 航空系统对安全认证要求极高，而基于AI的系统难以满足EASA的Safety-by-Design认证要求。虽然Safety Nets已被提出，但此前缺乏对其性能特征和系统设计权衡的系统性研究。
Method: 作者对多种不同架构的神经网络进行系统比较，分析神经网络与查找表大小之间的权衡，以最小化总体存储和内存需求并维持认证合规性。识别出的最优设计为3至5个隐藏层、每层约50至100个节点，并结合one-hot编码。
Result: 在最优配置下，神经网络能准确表示至少97%的数据，由紧凑查找表处理剩余误差。Safety Nets将系统大小减少近三个数量级，适配当前航空电子硬件的内存预算，并在整个离散化输入空间内保证100%的正确输出。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作提供了首个Safety Nets开源实现且结果可复现，展示了航空领域可认证AI系统的实际路径，并将Safety Nets确立为安全关键应用中可行的Safety-by-Design解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DecoVAE: a Lightweight Interpretable Trend-Seasonal VAE Framework for Efficient Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic time series forecasting remains challenging, largely because modeling distinct trend and seasonal dynamics requires specialized approaches. Existing methods often fail to capture the unique inner properties of these components, lack interpretability, or suffer from heavy memory and runtime overhead. To address these limitations, we propose DecoVAE, a lightweight interpretable trend-seasonal VAE framework that explicitly decomposes time series into trend and seasonal components by applying domain-specific inductive biases. The trend stream enforces structural smoothness using a differential regularizer on the latent trajectory, analogous to the Hodrick-Prescott filter. Concurrently, the seasonal stream operates in the frequency domain via a complex Gaussian VAE, natively capturing the amplitude and phase of periodic patterns. Extensive evaluations across seven real-world benchmarks show that DecoVAE consistently outperforms strong baselines. It achieves reductions of up to 14.96\% in CRPS and 23.30\% in NMAE for short-term forecasting, and up to 52.68\% and 26.51\% for long-term horizons. Crucially, DecoVAE yields these accuracy gains while remaining highly efficient, reducing model weight by up to 93\% and accelerating speed by up to 74\% compared to the second-best method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DecoVAE，一个轻量级可解释的趋势-季节性 VAE 框架，用于概率时间序列预测。方法将时间序列显式分解为趋势与季节成分：趋势流在隐轨迹上施加差分正则化以强制结构平滑性（类似 Hodrick-Prescott 滤波），季节流则用复高斯 VAE 在频域建模幅度与相位。在 7 个真实基准上，短时预测 CRPS 最多降低 14.96%、NMAE 最多降低 23.30%，长时预测分别最多降低 52.68% 和 26.51%。
Motivation: 现有概率时间序列预测方法难以同时刻画趋势与季节成分各自的内在属性，或缺乏可解释性，且常伴随较大的内存与运行时开销。
Method: 提出显式分解趋势与季节成分的 VAE 框架：趋势流通过差分正则化约束隐轨迹的平滑性，季节流采用频域复高斯 VAE 以自然捕获周期模式的幅度与相位。
Result: 在 7 个真实世界基准上一致优于强基线：短时预测 CRPS 最高降低 14.96%、NMAE 最高降低 23.30%，长时预测最高降低 52.68% 和 26.51%；与次优方法相比，模型权重最多减少 93%，速度最多提升 74%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能在大幅降低模型规模和提升速度的同时取得精度增益，并具备可解释性；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking schemes for large language model output are evaluated almost exclusively on English text using each scheme's detection threshold and a narrow set of quality measurements. Multilingual deployment exposes evaluation-design choices that are inconsequential on English but determine conclusions cross-lingually. We propose an evaluation framework with four components: detection thresholds calibrated empirically per deployment context, a threshold-independent companion measurement that distinguishes calibration failures from detection failures, three disjoint quality measurement paradigms (distributional, paired-semantic, and reference-perplexity), and a generalized-entropy decomposition of cross-language disparity over a typological family partition. Applied to six watermarking schemes, three open-weight generators, eleven languages spanning four scripts and eight typological families, and both base and instruction-tuned regimes, the framework reveals failure modes that single-language single-paradigm evaluation cannot surface. Across detection and quality, observed disparity is predominantly between-family on the typological partition, indicating that cross-lingual fairness gaps in watermarking are structural to language properties rather than idiosyncratic to particular languages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向大语言模型水印 (watermarking) 的跨语言公平性评测框架，包含按部署场景经验校准的检测阈值、与阈值无关的伴随测量、三种相互独立的文本质量测量范式（分布型、配对语义型、参考困惑度型），以及基于语言类型学家族划分的广义熵分解。作者将该框架用于六个水印方案、三个开放权重生成器、跨越四种文字和八个类型学家族的十一种语言，并覆盖基础模型与指令微调两种模式。结果表明观察到的跨语言差异主要来自类型学家族之间，说明水印的跨语言公平性差距源于语言的结构性属性而非个别语言的特异性。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型输出水印几乎只在英文文本上评测，且依赖单一检测阈值和较窄的质量测量；多语言部署会暴露这些评测设计选择，使原本在英文上无关紧要的设定决定跨语言结论。
Method: 提出四组件评测框架：按部署上下文经验校准检测阈值；引入与阈值无关的伴随测量以区分校准失败与检测失败；使用三种互不重叠的质量测量范式（分布型、配对语义型、reference-perplexity）；通过类型学家族划分上的广义熵分解来量化跨语言差异。
Result: 在六个水印方案、三个开放权重生成器、十一种语言（四种文字、八个类型学家族）以及 base 和 instruction-tuned 两种模式下，该框架揭示出单语言单范式评测无法发现的失败模式；在检测与质量两方面，观测到的差异主要来自类型学家族之间。
Conclusion: 作者认为跨语言公平性差距在水印任务中是语言属性的结构性结果，而非特定语言的偶然现象，因此需要多语言、多范式的评测设计来评估水印方案。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: End-to-end Early Classification of Time Series in Non-Stationary Environments
papers.abstract_en: Early Classification of Time Series (ECTS) requires making accurate decisions as early as possible in inherently online and evolving environments. Yet, most existing methods assume stationarity and rely on separable designs, where classification and triggering are optimized independently, an assumption that fundamentally limits their adaptability under drift. In this work, we challenge this paradigm and study ECTS under non-stationary conditions. We provide the first systematic comparison between separable and end-to-end approaches across controlled drifting scenarios. Building on Reinforcement Learning, we introduce DQeND, a unified architecture that jointly learns representation, classification, and triggering decisions, while remaining directly comparable to state-of-the-art separable baselines. Across a wide range of drifts, DQeND demonstrates strong robustness across various non-stationary scenarios, consistently outperforming separable baselines. An ablation study further highlights that jointly updating representation and decision modules is critical to these gains. Overall, our results indicate that end-to-end learning can offer improved adaptation capabilities for ECTS in dynamic environments, and motivate further investigation of alternatives to separable designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非平稳环境下的时间序列早期分类 (Early Classification of Time Series, ECTS)，指出现有方法大多假设平稳性且采用分类与触发决策分离的设计，难以适应概念漂移。作者基于强化学习提出统一架构 DQeND，联合学习表示、分类与触发决策，并在多种受控漂移场景下与可分离基线进行系统比较。摘要报告 DQeND 在非平稳场景中持续优于可分离基线，消融实验表明联合更新表示与决策模块对性能提升至关重要。
Motivation: 现有 ECTS 方法通常假设环境平稳，并将分类与触发时机分开优化，这种可分离设计在概念漂移条件下适应性受限。作者希望挑战这一范式，系统研究非平稳环境下的 ECTS。
Method: 引入基于强化学习的 DQeND 架构，统一学习表示、分类与触发决策，同时保持与现有可分离基线直接可比；论文还提供了可分离与端到端方法在受控漂移场景下的首次系统比较。
Result: 在多种非平稳漂移场景中，DQeND 持续优于可分离基线；消融实验表明，同时更新表示模块和决策模块是性能提升的关键。
Conclusion: 端到端学习能提升 ECTS 在动态环境中的适应能力，作者认为这支持进一步探索可分离设计的替代方案。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: A three-dimensional typology of agency for advanced AI systems
papers.abstract_en: Research on the agency of advanced artificial intelligence (AI) systems focuses on agency as a normative concept and on the agency of particularly agentic AI systems. While recent work also focuses on the different profiles of agentic systems, no framework exists to address the question of the type of agency instantiated by advanced AI systems, particularly when considering non-moral forms of agency. Based on established theoretical positions in philosophy, ethics, legal theory and sociology, we develop a typology of agency for frontier AI systems consisting of three dimensions: the nature of agency (moral or legal), its mode (individual or collective) and its locus (human or non-human). Combining these dimensions produces eight possible instantiations of agency, which we classify as conventional, contested or controversial. The typology separates legal from moral agency and thereby creates conceptual space for considering individual, legal, non-human agency without presupposing that advanced AI systems are moral agents. We argue that this distinction is increasingly relevant where instrumental goal pursuit complicates the attribution of AI actions to particular human actors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对前沿 AI 系统的能动性（agency）类型问题，提出一个三维类型学框架，从性质（道德或法律能动性）、模式（个体或集体）和定位（人类或非人类）三个维度刻画先进 AI 系统所体现的能动性类型。三个维度组合出八种可能的能动性实例，并被划分为 conventional、contested 或 controversial 三类。该框架明确区分法律能动性与道德能动性，从而在不预设先进 AI 是道德能动者的前提下，为个体、法律、非人类能动性留出概念空间。
Motivation: 现有关于高级 AI 能动性的研究主要把能动性当作规范性概念，聚焦于特别具能动性的 AI 系统，也关注不同能动性系统的特征，但缺少一个框架来回答先进 AI 系统究竟实例化了何种类型的能动性，尤其是非道德形式的能动性。
Method: 基于哲学、伦理学、法学和社会学中已有的理论立场，构建一个由三个维度组成的能动性类型学：能动性的性质（道德或法律）、模式（个体或集体）以及定位（人类或非人类），并据此组合出八种可能的能动性实例。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果，其核心概念性产出是将八种组合分类为 conventional、contested 或 controversial，并把法律能动性与道德能动性分离，从而在无需假定先进 AI 是道德能动者的情况下，支持个体性、法律性、非人类能动性的概念化。
Conclusion: 作者主张，在工具性目标追求使 AI 行为的归因复杂化、难以归因于特定人类行动者的情况下，区分法律与道德能动性正变得越来越重要。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有关于高级 AI 能动性的研究主要把能动性当作规范性概念，聚焦于特别具能动性的 AI 系统，也关注不同能动性系统的特征，但缺少一个框架来回答先进 AI 系统究竟实例化了何种类型的能动性，尤其是非道德形式的能动性。
summary_sections.method: 基于哲学、伦理学、法学和社会学中已有的理论立场，构建一个由三个维度组成的能动性类型学：能动性的性质（道德或法律）、模式（个体或集体）以及定位（人类或非人类），并据此组合出八种可能的能动性实例。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告实证结果，其核心概念性产出是将八种组合分类为 conventional、contested 或 controversial，并把法律能动性与道德能动性分离，从而在无需假定先进 AI 是道德能动者的情况下，支持个体性、法律性、非人类能动性的概念化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张，在工具性目标追求使 AI 行为的归因复杂化、难以归因于特定人类行动者的情况下，区分法律与道德能动性正变得越来越重要。

papers.title: An Inclusive and Lightweight Approach to Federated Continual Learning for Cultural Heritage
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence can support cultural heritage and digital humanities through large-scale retrieval and analysis of digitized collections. However, cultural heritage data are often distributed across institutions, constrained by ownership and access restrictions, and continuously evolving over time. Federated Continual Learning (FCL) is well suited to this setting, as it enables models to learn from distributed and sequential data without sharing raw collections. In this paper, we propose FedCurv-DR, a lightweight, regularisation-based FCL strategy. The method accumulates parameter-importance estimates across clients and experiences to protect learned knowledge, while updating them only at fixed intervals to minimize communication and computation overhead. We evaluate FedCurv-DR in a continual learning scenario using the WikiArt image dataset for genre classification with evolving styles, reporting performance, energy, and fairness metrics. Our results show that FedCurv- DR reduces forgetting and balances performance, fairness, and energy efficiency for sustainable AI in cultural heritage.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Humanities (IEEE-CH 2026), Venice, Italy, September 7--9, 2026. Accepted author manuscript. Copyright 2026 IEEE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedCurv-DR，一种轻量、基于正则化的联邦持续学习 (Federated Continual Learning, FCL) 策略，面向文化遗产图像分类场景。该方法跨客户端和任务阶段累积参数重要性估计以保护已学知识，并仅在固定时间间隔更新这些估计以降低通信和计算开销。作者在 WikiArt 数据集上以不断演化的画风进行流派分类持续学习实验，报告性能、能量与公平性指标。
Motivation: 文化遗产数据通常分散在多家机构，受所有权和访问限制约束，且随时间持续演化；联邦持续学习适合该场景，但如何在保护历史知识的同时控制通信与计算开销仍是问题。
Method: 提出 FedCurv-DR，一种正则化型 FCL 策略：累积跨客户端和经历 (experience) 的参数重要性估计来抑制灾难性遗忘，并通过固定间隔更新这些估计来最小化通信和计算开销。
Result: 在 WikiArt 图像数据集上的流派分类持续学习场景中，FedCurv-DR 减少了遗忘，并在性能、公平性和能耗之间取得平衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法兼顾了遗忘抑制、公平性和能量效率，为文化遗产领域的可持续 AI 提供了一种可行路径。

papers.title: From Street View Imagery to Street Quality Indicators: Vision Language Inference for the Suburban 15-minute City
papers.abstract_en: Streetscape quality has become a central concern in contemporary urban planning, particularly within the framework of the pedestrian-friendly 15-minute city, where walkability and public-space quality are increasingly recognized as key determinants of urban performance. However, assessing streetscape qualities across large suburban and peri-urban territories remains challenging due to the time and resource demands of conventional field surveys. This paper presents a planning-oriented assessment of streetscape qualities in the north-eastern periphery of Nice (France) using the latest release of SAGAI (Streetscape Analysis with Generative AI), an open-source workflow that leverages vision-language models (VLMs) for large-scale streetscape analysis from Google Street View imagery. The new release addresses limitations of the original framework through improved image acquisition, geographically consistent view generation, support for multiple VLM architectures, consensus-based inference, and an integrated analytical environment. The workflow is applied to several thousand street-level observations to evaluate qualities relevant to pedestrian-friendly urban environments: sidewalk presence, pedestrian entrance density, and vegetation. The resulting maps reveal that the desired streetscape qualities characterize only a fraction of today's suburban streetscapes, mainly in compact developments and traditional suburban faubourgs, while they are particularly lacking on residential hills. The analysis demonstrates the potential of contemporary VLMs to support urban diagnostics in extensive suburban territories where fieldwork would be prohibitively time-consuming. Beyond the case study, the paper illustrates how recent advances in vision-language models can contribute to evidence-based planning by enabling scalable, flexible, and interpretable assessments of urban public-space quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向规划的街道质量评估流程，利用开放源码工作流 SAGAI（Streetscape Analysis with Generative AI）的最新版本，结合视觉语言模型（VLM）分析法国尼斯东北郊区的 Google Street View 影像。研究评估了人行道存在性、行人入口密度和植被等与步行友好环境相关的指标，并绘制出郊区街道质量的空间分布图。结果表明理想街道质量仅出现在少数紧凑型开发区和传统郊区街区，丘陵住宅区尤其缺乏。作者认为该方法可在实地调查成本过高的广阔郊区中支持基于证据的城市规划。
Motivation: 传统实地调查方式耗时耗力，难以在广大郊区与近郊区域评估街道景观质量，而街道质量正是步行友好型15分钟城市（15-minute city）理念中的关键因素。
Method: 使用 SAGAI 最新版本，改进图像采集、生成地理一致的视角、支持多种 VLM 架构、采用基于共识的推断并集成分析环境，从 Google Street View 影像中大规模提取街道质量指标。
Result: 对数千条街道级观测的分析显示，理想街道质量仅覆盖当前郊区街道景观的一小部分，主要见于紧凑型开发与传统郊区街区，而在丘陵住宅区尤为缺乏。
Conclusion: 该案例研究说明当代视觉语言模型能够支持大规模、灵活且可解释的城市公共空间质量评估，为证据导向的规划提供可行的替代方案。

papers.title: CLaST: Context-aware Contrastive VAE for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic forecasting models are widely used for time series forecasting in domains such as energy systems, finance, medicine, and transportation. In recent years, deep generative models have shown strong results on probabilistic forecasting, yet many conventional approaches struggle to capture internal temporal dependencies, leading to latent representations with limited expressive power. To address this limitation, we propose \textit{CLaST}, a VAE framework for probabilistic multivariate time series forecasting. Unlike existing generative models, CLaST learns embeddings that preserve contextual similarity between observations through our contrastive loss function. Experiments across nine widely adopted benchmarks demonstrate that CLaST consistently surpasses strong baseline methods. In short-term forecasting tasks, our approach achieves improvements of up to $16.4\%$ in CRPS and $14.4\%$ in NMAE over the second-best method. Furthermore, in long-term prediction CLaST attains superior overall performance, exceeding the second-best method by up to $48.6\%$ and $25.1\%$ in CRPS and NMAE, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLaST，一个用于概率多元时间序列预测的 VAE 框架，核心思想是通过对比损失（contrastive loss）学习保持观测之间上下文相似性的嵌入。实验在九个广泛采用的基准上显示 CLaST 一致优于强基线：短期预测在 CRPS 和 NMAE 上相对次优方法分别最高提升 16.4% 和 14.4%，长期预测则分别最高提升 48.6% 和 25.1%。
Motivation: 现有深度生成模型在概率时间序列预测中常难以捕捉内部时间依赖，导致潜在表示（latent representation）表达能力有限，限制了预测性能。
Method: 提出 CLaST 框架，在 VAE 基础上引入对比损失函数，使模型学习到的嵌入能够保留观测之间的上下文相似性，从而增强对时间依赖的建模能力。
Result: 在九个基准数据集上，CLaST 一致超越强基线方法；短期预测中 CRPS 最高提升 16.4%、NMAE 最高提升 14.4%，长期预测中 CRPS 最高提升 48.6%、NMAE 最高提升 25.1%。
Conclusion: 作者认为保留上下文相似性的对比式潜在表示可以有效提升概率时间序列预测的精度，但摘要未涉及降水、临近预报等天气领域的专门验证。

papers.title: Systematic Evaluation of TabPFN-TS for Zero-Shot Probabilistic Heat Load Forecasting in District Heating Networks
papers.abstract_en: District heating energy hubs require reliable heat load forecasts for efficient operational scheduling. Conventional forecasting workflows train system-specific models on historical data, which can become burdensome when networks change through new consumers, retrofits, or changing operating regimes. Zero-shot time-series foundation models and in-context forecasting offer a promising alternative: they can adapt at inference time from recent observations rather than by repeated retraining. This study systematically evaluates TabPFN-TS against time-series foundation models and trained machine-learning baselines for probabilistic heat load forecasting in district heating networks. Unlike foundation models pretrained on large collections of real time series, TabPFN-TS relies on synthetic pretraining data, which avoids direct pretraining-test overlap but raises the question of whether the learned prior captures district heating dynamics. We analyze covariate choice, context length, temporal resolution, and prediction horizon on representative operating weeks, validate the selected configuration over a full year, and test transferability on a second network. The results identify hourly 24-hour forecasting with a 12-week rolling context and ambient temperature as a parsimonious high-performing configuration; longer context windows do not improve accuracy. TabPFN-TS remains close to Chronos-2 in deterministic accuracy, reaching CVRMSE values of 13.06% versus 12.48% on the main dataset, and lies within the critical-difference threshold in the daily-rank comparison. Although Chronos-2 achieves the lowest aggregate full-year error, TabPFN-TS shows better empirical calibration. Finally, the diagnostic findings motivate a Multi-Resolution Residual-Correction Forecaster that combines a low-frequency Base Forecaster with a short-horizon Residual Forecaster to improve longer-horizon planning accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估TabPFN-TS在区域供热网络零样本概率热负荷预测中的表现，并与时间序列基础模型和传统机器学习基线对比。摘要报告，采用12周滚动上下文、环境温度作为协变量的逐小时24小时预测是简约且高性能的配置；TabPFN-TS的确定性精度接近Chronos-2（CVRMSE 13.06% vs 12.48%），且经验校准更好。诊断结果还催生了一个组合低频基础预测器和短时残差预测器的多分辨率残差校正预测器。
Motivation: 传统热负荷预测依赖逐系统训练，网络因新用户、改造或运行工况变化时维护成本高；零样本时间序列基础模型和上下文内预测（in-context forecasting）可依据近期观测在推理时自适应，但TabPFN-TS基于合成预训练数据，需要验证其学到的先验能否捕捉区域供热动态。
Method: 系统评估TabPFN-TS，分析协变量选择、上下文长度、时间分辨率和预测时域对代表运行周的影响；在全年数据上验证所选配置，并在第二个网络上测试可迁移性。此外，基于诊断发现提出Multi-Resolution Residual-Correction Forecaster，组合低频Base Forecaster与短时域Residual Forecaster以改善更长规划时域的精度。
Result: 摘要报告最佳配置为12周滚动上下文加环境温度、逐小时24小时预测；更长上下文不提高精度。在主数据集上TabPFN-TS的CVRMSE为13.06%，Chronos-2为12.48%，两者在日排名比较中处于关键差阈值内；Chronos-2全年聚合误差最低，但TabPFN-TS经验校准更好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调合成预训练的基础模型可以在确定性精度上接近真实数据预训练的基础模型，且配置简约、可迁移；诊断发现被用于构建多分辨率残差校正预测器，以增强较长规划时域的预测精度。

papers.title: Contrastive Mixed Prompt Learning for Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Unseen Modality Combination
papers.abstract_en: Incomplete multimodal sentiment analysis has garnered significant attention in recent years. Existing approaches typically assume that data is missing at random or are designed specifically for certain missing patterns, ignoring the modality combination inconsistency between training and testing phases. However, in real-world scenarios, the testing phase often encounters modal combinations that were not present during the training phase, which leads to insufficient generalization capabilities and unstable performance. In this paper, we introduce the problem of Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Unseen Modality Combinations (IMSAUMC), aiming to enhance model generalization for unseen modality combinations. To address this challenge, we propose the model named $\textbf{C}$ontrastive $\textbf{M}$ixed $\textbf{P}$rompt $\textbf{L}$earning ($\textsf{CMPL}$) for IMSAUMC. It introduces a label-guided contrastive feature learning mechanism to learn robust and discriminative cross-modal representations. Additionally, we design modality-combination prompts with a soft router to facilitate better learning of various modality combinations. Furthermore, we introduce three prompt contrastive learning strategies, which enable effective learning of prompts corresponding to unseen modality combinations, thereby significantly strengthening the model's generalization capabilities in diverse testing scenarios. Extensive experiments on three widely used datasets demonstrate that $\textsf{CMPL}$ achieves more than a 5% improvement in accuracy compared to state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Unseen Modality Combinations (IMSAUMC) 问题，并为此提出 Contrastive Mixed Prompt Learning (CMPL) 模型。CMPL 结合 label-guided 对比特征学习、带 soft router 的模态组合提示 (modality-combination prompts) 以及三种提示对比学习策略，以增强模型对未见模态组合的泛化能力。摘要报告在三个广泛使用的数据集上相较现有最先进方法准确率提升超过 5%。
Motivation: 现有不完整多模态情感分析方法通常假设数据随机缺失或仅针对特定缺失模式设计，忽视了训练阶段与测试阶段之间模态组合不一致的问题。真实场景中测试阶段常出现训练阶段未出现过的模态组合，导致模型泛化不足且性能不稳定。
Method: 提出 CMPL 模型：通过 label-guided 对比特征学习机制获得鲁棒且有判别力的跨模态表示；设计带 soft router 的模态组合提示以更好地学习多种模态组合；并引入三种提示对比学习策略，使模型能够有效学习对应未见模态组合的提示。
Result: 在三个广泛使用的数据集上，CMPL 相较现有最先进方法取得超过 5% 的准确率提升。
Conclusion: 该工作将未见模态组合下的不完整多模态情感分析形式化，并表明对比混合提示学习能够显著增强模型在多样化测试场景中的泛化能力。

papers.title: Emergence of cooperation: A reputation-modulated reinforcement learning
papers.abstract_en: Reputation is widely recognized as a key mechanism for sustaining cooperation. However, most existing game-theoretic models treat reputation primarily as an external factor that modulates payoffs, interaction structures, or strategy update rules. In many social contexts, though, reputation operates primarily as information -- it shapes how individuals interpret their own experiences and assess the behavior of others. To bridge this gap, we propose a spatial prisoner's dilemma game grounded in the reinforcement learning paradigm, in which agents equipped with Q-learning integrate both individual and social information via a locally defined reputation metric to guide their decisions. Our results reveal that reputation-modulated learning significantly promotes the emergence of cooperative behavior, and we observe a discontinuous phase transition from full cooperation to full defection as the temptation increases. Cooperation spreads through the nucleation of cooperative clusters, whereas the disintegration of these clusters drives the system into an absorbing state of complete defection. Overall, this study demonstrates that reputation facilitates cooperation not only by providing direct incentives but also by reshaping the social information landscape that agents rely on for learning and adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于声誉调制的强化学习空间囚徒困境模型，将声誉视为影响个体学习与行为评估的信息而非单纯的外部激励。作者使用Q-learning智能体结合局部声誉度量整合个体与社会信息，发现声誉调制学习显著促进合作涌现，并观察到随诱惑增大出现从全合作到全背叛的不连续相变。合作通过合作簇的成核扩展，而簇的解体使系统进入完全背叛的吸收态。
Motivation: 现有博弈论模型大多将声誉视为调节收益、交互结构或策略更新规则的外部因素，而忽视其在许多社会情境中主要作为信息起作用——塑造个体对自身经验与他人行为的解读。
Method: 在空间囚徒困境中引入强化学习范式，智能体配备Q-learning，通过局部定义的声誉度量整合个体信息与社会信息来指导决策。
Result: 声誉调制的学习显著促进合作行为的涌现；随诱惑增加，系统呈现从全合作到全背叛的不连续相变，合作通过合作簇的成核传播，簇的瓦解导致完全背叛的吸收态。
Conclusion: 声誉不仅通过直接激励促进合作，还通过重塑智能体用于学习与适应的社会信息格局来促进合作。

papers.title: Manifold Drift in Flow Preference Optimization: A Root Cause of Reward Hacking
papers.abstract_en: Preference optimization is a standard alignment method for generative models, yet extending it to continuous-time dynamics remains non-trivial. In flow matching, reward-driven updates modify transport trajectories without an inherent constraint to the pretrained data manifold and can move terminal samples off the pretrained support. We formalize this failure mode as manifold drift. Theoretically, we show that optimal flow matching recovers the terminal data distribution, whereas a preference update leaves the pretrained manifold whenever its induced terminal displacement has a nonzero normal component. As a remedy, we propose ThermoDPO, a temperature-controlled objective that anchors pairwise preference optimization on preferred samples. Across temperature regimes, this objective connects rejection sampling fine-tuning and FlowDPO and controls a pointwise reconstruction-based surrogate for manifold distance. To counteract diminished signals at low temperatures, we further introduce a weighted variant, ThermoDPO-weighted. On the main toy benchmark, ThermoDPO-weighted attains a StrictScore of 0.899, compared with 0.629 for FlowDPO and 0.857 for FlowDPO+RFT. On SD3.5-M at CFG = 4.5, it improves OCR by 47.5% and the average of four metrics by 16.0%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究流匹配（flow matching）中偏好优化（preference optimization）导致生成终态偏离预训练数据流形的问题，将其形式化为流形漂移（manifold drift）。理论结果显示，最优流匹配能恢复终端数据分布，而偏好更新在诱导终端位移具有非零法向分量时会离开预训练流形。作者提出温度控制目标 ThermoDPO，将成对偏好优化锚定在偏好样本上，并引入加权变体 ThermoDPO-weighted 来应对低温下信号减弱的问题。在主玩具基准上 ThermoDPO-weighted 的 StrictScore 达到 0.899，并显著提升 SD3.5-M 上的 OCR 与平均指标。
Motivation: 偏好优化虽是生成模型的标准对齐方法，但扩展到连续时间动力学（如流匹配）时，奖励驱动更新会无约束地改变传输轨迹，使终端样本偏离预训练支撑集，引发奖励黑客（reward hacking）。现有方法缺乏对预训练数据流形的内在约束。
Method: 提出 ThermoDPO，一个带温度控制的成对偏好优化目标，将优化锚定在偏好样本上，理论上连接拒绝采样微调（rejection sampling fine-tuning）与 FlowDPO，并控制基于逐点重建的流形距离代理；针对低温下信号衰减，进一步引入加权版本 ThermoDPO-weighted。
Result: 在主要玩具基准上，ThermoDPO-weighted 取得 StrictScore 0.899，优于 FlowDPO 的 0.629 与 FlowDPO+RFT 的 0.857；在 SD3.5-M、CFG=4.5 设置下，OCR 提升 47.5%，四项指标平均提升 16.0%。
Conclusion: 论文将流形漂移识别为流程匹配偏好优化中奖励黑客的根源，并表明温度控制目标可通过锚定偏好样本来缓解该问题，同时在不同温度区间统一了两种既有方法。摘要未讨论具体局限性。

papers.title: ExPhy: A Benchmark for Explicit Physical Property Learning in Multi-Object Trajectory Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Understanding object dynamics requires not only predicting future trajectories but also examining whether a model captures the physical properties that govern motion. However, existing benchmarks rarely expose object-level physical properties as explicit evaluation targets alongside trajectory forecasting. To address this gap, we introduce \emph{ExPhy}, a multi-object trajectory forecasting benchmark containing 24,000 simulated physical scenes with explicit object-level labels for mass, friction, and restitution. ExPhy provides observed and future trajectories together with an in-distribution (ID) split and two out-of-distribution (OOD) splits over physical parameters (OOD-Parameter) and initial states (OOD-Initial) for jointly evaluating trajectory forecasting and physical property estimation. We further instantiate \textsc{PhyODE}, a physics-guided model with an explicit property interface that estimates physical properties from observed trajectories and uses them for differentiable future rollout. On the long-horizon OOD-Initial setting, \textsc{PhyODE} reduces ADE and FDE by 33.1\% and 31.0\%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline. Zero-shot evaluation on ComPhy further assesses cross-benchmark transfer. Property-level analyses reveal that accurate trajectory forecasting does not necessarily imply accurate recovery of the underlying physical properties. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Zest86/ExPhy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ExPhy，一个多物体轨迹预测基准，包含 24,000 个模拟物理场景并对每个物体提供质量、摩擦、恢复系数的显式标签；同时给出 ID 划分和两个 OOD 划分（OOD-Parameter、OOD-Initial）用于联合评估轨迹预测与物理属性估计。作者还实例化了 PhyODE，一个带显式属性接口的物理引导模型，先从观测轨迹估计物理属性，再用其进行可微的未来 rollout。在长时程 OOD-Initial 设置下，PhyODE 相对最强基线将 ADE 和 FDE 分别降低 33.1% 和 31.0%。
Motivation: 现有基准很少把物体级物理属性作为显式评估目标与轨迹预测同时考察，难以判断模型是否真正捕获控制运动的物理性质。
Method: 构建 ExPhy 基准，包含 24,000 个模拟物理场景及质量、摩擦、恢复系数标签，并提供 ID、OOD-Parameter、OOD-Initial 三种数据划分；同时提出 PhyODE，一种物理引导模型，通过显式属性接口从观测轨迹估计物理属性，并将这些属性用于可微的未来 rollout。
Result: 在长时程 OOD-Initial 设置下，PhyODE 相比最强基线将 ADE 和 FDE 分别减少 33.1% 和 31.0%；还在 ComPhy 上进行了零样本跨基准评估。属性级分析表明，准确的轨迹预测并不必然意味着对底层物理属性的准确恢复。
Conclusion: 摘要强调应将物理属性估计与轨迹预测联合评估，并指出预测性能与属性恢复之间存在差距；代码和数据已开源。

papers.title: Scale-Aware Pretraining of Time Series Foundation Models via Multi-Patch Token Alignment and Hybrid Masking
papers.abstract_en: Pretraining time series foundation models across heterogeneous datasets necessitates effective handling of varying sampling frequencies. Current methods either employ dataset-specific patch sizes and separate FFNs, leading to fragmented representations, or enforce a fixed patch size that neglects inherent temporal variations. To address this, we propose SATS, featuring a scale-aware token alignment mechanism that treats patch size as an explicit notion of scale. By incorporating a contrastive-inspired alignment regularizer, SATS aligns representation spaces across scales while preserving distinct modeling capacities. Furthermore, a hybrid masking strategy combining random and contiguous masking is introduced to capture multi-scale temporal structures. Experimental results on LSTF benchmarks demonstrate that SATS achieves a 9.2% improvement in MSE and an 8.3% gain in GIFT-Eval MASE compared to competitive baselines. Notably, SATS consistently delivers SOTA performance while achieving a 65.6% increase in model efficiency over advanced baselines, highlighting its effectiveness and scalability in time series pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向时间序列基础模型预训练的 SATS 方法，专门处理跨异构数据集时采样频率不一致的问题。SATS 将 patch 大小视为显式的尺度 (scale) 概念，通过尺度感知的 token 对齐机制和混合掩码策略，在保持各尺度建模能力的同时统一表示空间。在 LSTF 基准上的实验显示，相比强基线，SATS 将 MSE 降低 9.2%、GIFT-Eval MASE 提升 8.3%，并以 65.6% 的模型效率提升持续取得 SOTA 结果。
Motivation: 跨异构数据集预训练时间序列基础模型时，不同采样频率难以统一处理；现有方法要么为每个数据集使用专属 patch 大小和独立 FFN 导致表示碎片化，要么强制固定 patch 大小而忽略内在时间尺度变化。
Method: 提出 SATS，核心是尺度感知 token 对齐机制，将 patch 大小当作显式尺度，并引入对比学习启发的对齐正则化项 (contrastive-inspired alignment regularizer)，在跨尺度对齐表示空间的同时保留不同尺度的独立建模能力；此外采用随机掩码与连续掩码结合的混合掩码策略来捕捉多尺度时间结构。
Result: 在 LSTF 基准上，SATS 相比竞争基线实现 MSE 9.2% 的改进和 GIFT-Eval MASE 8.3% 的提升，同时相对先进基线将模型效率提升 65.6%，并且稳定取得 SOTA 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SATS 在时间序列预训练中的有效性和可扩展性：通过显式尺度对齐和混合掩码，能够在异构采样频率下统一预训练并提升下游长序列预测性能。

papers.title: Point-Based 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views under Known Illumination
papers.abstract_en: Sparse view 3D reconstruction is commonly addressed with neural implicit surfaces or dense point-based representations such as Gaussian splatting. Surface-aware splatting methods improve extracted geometry through oriented primitives and regularization, while RadiosityGS incorporates differentiable light transport through a radiosity inspired finite-element surfel formulation. We propose a differentiable point rendering method based on opacity-bearing beta surfels. An opacity explicit adjoint light transport formulation provides gradients for surfel geometry and appearance parameters, allowing physically based light transport to constrain reconstruction. Across five synthetic objects reconstructed from ten posed views, our method achieves the lowest mean symmetric Chamfer distance among the evaluated baselines and reduces mean Chamfer distance by 28.5% relative to the strongest point-based baseline while using only 267 surfels on average, approximately ~161 fewer primitives. Directional Chamfer results further show improved accuracy and competitive completion relative to related point-based methods. These results show that, in the controlled direct illumination setting, compact beta surfels combined with transport-based optimization can recover surfaces without relying on the tens to hundreds of thousands of primitives used by the evaluated baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于不透明 beta surfel 的可微点渲染方法，用于已知光照条件下的稀疏视角三维重建。作者将物理光照传输作为约束，通过显式伴随光传输公式为 surfel 几何与外观参数提供梯度。在五个人造物体的十视角重建实验中，该方法以平均约 267 个 surfel 取得最低的平均对称 Chamfer 距离。
Motivation: 稀疏视角三维重建通常依赖神经隐式曲面或稠密点基表示（如 Gaussian splatting），这些方法往往需要大量图元，而现有表面感知 splatting 方法虽能改善几何，但在利用光照传输约束重建方面仍有空间。
Method: 提出基于可微 beta surfel 的点渲染方法，采用 opacity-explicit 的伴随光传输公式（adjoint light transport formulation）来计算 surfel 几何与外观参数的梯度，从而使基于物理的光传输能够约束重建过程。
Result: 在五个合成物体、十个有姿态视角的重建实验中，该方法在评估基线中取得最低的平均对称 Chamfer 距离，相比最强的点基基线将平均 Chamfer 距离降低 28.5%，且平均仅使用约 267 个 surfel，比基线少约 161 个图元；方向性 Chamfer 结果同时显示精度提升和具有竞争力的完整度。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在受控的直接光照（direct illumination）设置下，紧凑的 beta surfel 结合基于光传输的优化可以在不依赖基线所使用的数万至数十万图元的情况下恢复表面。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Green BOA: Determining the environmental break-even point for ML-based data compression
papers.abstract_en: We summarise the outcome of two summer internship projects based at the University of Manchester, focused on the break-even point in terms of environmental sustainability for ML-based data compression algorithms. Using the example of a ML-based lossless compression algorithm, we compare estimates for the carbon-equivalent of the infrastructure needed for ML training and inference with the carbon-equivalent savings from reduced disk storage requirements, and discuss their break-even point.
papers.comment: 3 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a lightning-talk contribution at the 2nd International Workshop on Low Carbon Computing (LOCO 2026), Lancaster University, United Kingdom, 10-11 September 2026. Part of the LOCO 2026 proceedings, arXiv:LOCO2026/L05
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文总结曼彻斯特大学两个暑期实习项目的成果，围绕基于 ML 的数据压缩算法的环境可持续性盈亏平衡点展开讨论。以 ML 无损压缩算法为例，作者比较了 ML 训练与推理所需基础设施的碳当量，以及因减少磁盘存储需求而带来的碳当量节省，并探讨两者何时达到盈亏平衡。
Motivation: ML 数据压缩可以减少存储需求，但训练和推理本身也会产生碳排放；需要量化这些成本之间的平衡点，才能判断该类方案是否真正有利于环境可持续性。
Method: 以 ML 无损压缩算法为具体案例，分别估算 ML 训练和推理所需基础设施的碳当量，以及降低磁盘存储需求所能节省的碳当量，并对两者进行比较以讨论盈亏平衡点。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果，仅说明研究对碳当量进行了估算并讨论了盈亏平衡点。
Conclusion: 作者强调在评估 ML 数据压缩方案的环境收益时，必须同时计入训练与推理的基础设施碳成本，而不是只考虑存储节省。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Optimal Skill Selection for LLM Agents with Provable Bicriteria Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Loading reusable skill documents into a bounded context window is now the primary way large language model (LLM) agents acquire task-specific capabilities, which makes skill selection a first-order determinant of task performance and token cost. Yet current agents score skills independently by semantic relevance and assemble the set by top-$k$ or greedy packing, with no quality guarantee or cost awareness on the selected set. As a result, redundant or poorly chosen skills waste scarce context tokens and can even degrade performance. We give the first model of how the selected skill set shapes execution outcomes and cast skill selection as an optimization problem: choose a skill set under a hard token budget to maximize a monotone submodular benefit minus context penalty. For this problem, we develop Best Prefix Selection (BPS), a polynomial-time algorithm, and prove, to our knowledge, the first performance guarantee for skill selection: a bicriteria $(1-1/e,1)$ approximation whose benefit coefficient is optimal in polynomial time. On a contamination-controlled BigCodeBench variant, BPS outperforms all the baselines, reaching $0.73$ measured task success versus $0.20$--$0.52$ for released skill routers, text retrievers, and the executor's own selection, on $28\%$ fewer tokens than the strongest released router.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将 LLM 代理的技能选择（skill selection）形式化为带硬 token 预算的优化问题：选择技能集以最大化单调子模收益减去上下文惩罚。作者提出多项式时间算法 Best Prefix Selection (BPS)，并证明双准则 (1-1/e, 1) 近似保证。在污染受控的 BigCodeBench 变体上，BPS 达到 0.73 任务成功率，超过 0.20–0.52 的各基线，且比最强 released router 少用 28% token。
Motivation: 现有代理按语义相关性独立评分技能，再用 top-k 或贪心打包，缺乏对所选集合的质量保证与成本意识，导致冗余技能浪费上下文 token 甚至降低性能。
Method: 建立技能集如何影响执行结果的模型，将技能选择转化为在硬 token 预算下最大化单调子模收益减上下文惩罚的组合优化问题，并提出多项式时间算法 BPS 及双准则近似证明。
Result: 在 BigCodeBench 变体上，BPS 的测量任务成功率为 0.73，优于 released skill routers、text retrievers 和 executor 自身选择的 0.20–0.52；同时比最强 released router 节省 28% 的 token。
Conclusion: 该工作给出技能选择的首个可证明性能保证，证明收益系数在多项式时间内最优，并表明 BPS 在任务成功与 token 成本两方面均优于现有选择方式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: STEP: Score-Based Temporal Energy for Human Pose Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Skeleton-based Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) offers a robust, privacy-preserving solution for identifying abnormal behaviors. To model the distribution of normal static and moving poses, recent methods train Energy-Based Models (EBMs) via Denoising Score Matching (DSM). However, directly injecting noise, required for training, into raw joint coordinates creates physically impossible poses, and this structural collapse severely worsens as the temporal window expands. To address this, we introduce STEP, a simple framework that utilizes Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to project pose sequences into a compact, whitened PC-space. Learning the data density within this well-behaved PC-space ensures that the injected noise translates into physically plausible variations, which allows the model to process longer video sequences without the performance collapse of raw coordinate baselines. Additionally, to mitigate inherent pose estimation inaccuracies arising from occlusions or motion blur, we integrate a sequence-level weighting mechanism based on the estimator's confidence scores. Operating at real-time computational efficiency, our simple and lightweight framework outperforms the previous skeleton-based state-of-the-art by 12.2% (90.1% AUROC) on the challenging UBnormal dataset and achieves highly competitive results by improving on the ShanghaiTech benchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://jakubmicorek.github.io/STEP-demo | Code: https://github.com/jakubmicorek/STEP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STEP，一个基于骨架的时序视频异常检测框架。针对现有 Energy-Based Models (EBMs) 结合 Denoising Score Matching (DSM) 直接在原始关节坐标中注入噪声会产生物理上不可能的位形、且随时间窗口扩大结构崩塌加剧的问题，作者用 PCA 将姿态序列投影到紧凑的白化 PC 空间，在该空间中学习数据密度，使注入噪声对应物理上合理的变体，从而支持更长的视频序列。方法还基于姿态估计器的置信度分数做序列级加权，以缓解遮挡或运动模糊带来的估计误差。该框架轻量且达到实时效率，在 UBnormal 上超过先前骨架 SOTA 12.2%（90.1% AUROC），并在 ShanghaiTech 上取得有竞争力的改进。
Motivation: 骨架视频异常检测需要建模正常静态与动态姿态的分布，但现有 DSM 训练所需的噪声注入在原始关节坐标上会产生物理上不可能的位形，且时窗越大该结构崩塌越严重，限制了模型处理长序列的能力。
Method: 提出 STEP 框架：利用 PCA 将姿态序列投影至紧凑的白化 PC 空间，在该良性空间学习数据密度，使噪声注入转化为物理上合理的扰动；同时引入基于估计器置信度分数的序列级加权机制，抑制遮挡与运动模糊导致的姿态估计误差。
Result: 在 UBnormal 数据集上达到 90.1% AUROC，较先前的骨架 SOTA 提升 12.2%；在 ShanghaiTech 基准上也取得具有竞争力的改进，并保持实时计算效率。
Conclusion: STEP 通过改在白化 PC 空间中学习密度并结合置信度加权，避免了原始坐标噪声注入带来的物理不合理性和长序列性能崩塌，实现简单轻量且实时的高精度骨架视频异常检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReguSim: Evaluating LLM Agent Rule Grounding in Financial Compliance
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents in financial markets may cite rules yet still submit orders that violate executable constraints or misread surveillance evidence. We introduce ReguSim, a controlled financial-compliance environment, and ReguBench, a target-marked monitoring benchmark, to separate four artifacts: stated reasoning, attempted action, execution enforcement, and monitor evidence. In trader runs with DeepSeek V4 Pro and Gemini 3.5 Flash, visible rules reduce but do not eliminate rejected actions, and incentive or persona framing shifts behavior. A bridge study shows that trader rationales can mislead an independent monitor unless enforcement evidence is shown. In monitoring, simple structured baselines either match or exceed prompt-only LLMs. The results frame financial compliance evaluation as an audit of rule-grounded actions and evidence use, rather than a single compliance score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReguSim 受控金融合规环境和 ReguBench 目标标记监控基准，用于分离 LLM 代理在金融交易中的四类工件：陈述推理、尝试行动、执行强制和监控证据。在 DeepSeek V4 Pro 与 Gemini 3.5 Flash 的交易运行中，可见规则能减少但不能消除被拒绝的违规行动，且激励或人物框架会改变行为。桥接研究显示，若不展示强制证据，交易者的理由陈述会误导独立监控者；而在监控任务中，简单的结构化基线匹配或超过了仅使用提示的 LLM。作者认为金融合规评估应是对规则接地行动与证据使用的审计，而非单一合规分数。
Motivation: LLM 代理在金融市场中可能引用规则却仍提交违反可执行约束的订单，或误读监控证据；现有评估难以区分推理、行动、执行与监控这些环节，导致合规能力定位不清。
Method: 引入受控金融合规环境 ReguSim 与目标标记监控基准 ReguBench，将评估拆分为陈述推理、尝试行动、执行强制和监控证据四个工件，并设计交易者运行与桥接研究来比较不同条件下的行为和监控效果。
Result: 在 DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 Gemini 3.5 Flash 上，可见规则减少但未消除被拒行动；激励或人物框架会改变行为。桥接研究表明交易者的理由陈述可误导独立监控者，除非同时展示执行强制证据；在监控任务中，简单结构化基线达到或超过仅用提示的 LLM。
Conclusion: 摘要强调金融合规评估不应简化为单一合规分数，而应作为对规则接地行动和证据使用的审计；该框架有助于分离模型在陈述、行动、执行与监控环节的真实表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Detection with Co-Distillation Discovery and Dual Guidance Robust Training
papers.abstract_en: Recently, open-vocabulary 3D object detection (3D-OVD) has gained increasing attention for its ability to detect unseen objects in 3D scenes. Existing approaches typically adopt a two-stage pipeline that first discovers novel objects using foundation models and then trains a 3D-OVD model based on these discovered objects. Although effective, this pipeline often suffers from inaccurate localization and mismatched classification during the discovery stage, which subsequently limits the performance of the model training stage. To address these limitations, we advocate for improving both the reliability of novel object discovery and the robustness of model training, and propose an innovative framework. Specifically, for reliable discovery, our co-distillation strategy distills high-quality novel objects by applying Hungarian matching over a comprehensive score that incorporates geometric consistency, structural objectness, and semantic certainty. To enhance robust model training, we further propose a dual-guidance learning scheme, incorporating a scene-awareness-guided uncertainty regularization for the regression head and an LLM-guided hierarchical alignment for the classification head, effectively mitigating the negative effects of imprecise 3D bounding boxes and semantic ambiguity. Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScanNetV2 demonstrate that our method achieves significant performance gains over state-of-the-art approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/shangboyuan/Co-3DGT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放词汇 3D 目标检测（open-vocabulary 3D object detection, 3D-OVD）中的两阶段流程，指出发现阶段的不准确定位与分类错配会限制后续训练。作者提出基于共蒸馏（co-distillation）的可靠新类别发现策略，以及用于鲁棒训练的双重引导（dual-guidance）学习方案，并在 SUN RGB-D 与 ScanNetV2 上取得优于现有方法的显著性能提升。
Motivation: 现有两阶段 3D-OVD 方法先借助基础模型发现新对象，再训练检测模型；但发现阶段常出现定位不准确和分类错配，制约训练阶段性能。
Method: 在发现阶段，用综合评分（融合几何一致性、结构目标性、语义确定性）配合匈牙利匹配（Hungarian matching）蒸馏高质量新对象；在训练阶段，用场景感知引导的不确定性正则化处理回归头，并用 LLM 引导的层次化对齐处理分类头。
Result: 在 SUN RGB-D 与 ScanNetV2 上的大量实验表明，该方法相对最先进方法取得显著性能提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调同时提升新对象发现可靠性并增强训练鲁棒性，可降低不精确 3D 边界框与语义歧义的负面影响。代码已开源。

papers.title: PVRA: A Pointwise Key-point Voting Framework for Robotic Assembly
papers.abstract_en: Modern computer vision has enabled partial autonomy in robotic assembly manipulation. However, performing autonomous manipulation of a progressive assembly demands a more specific set of skills, in addition to perceiving the objects. Through a comparative analysis of research in the associated domains, we deduce that object-centric perception must advance towards learning assembly dependencies to predict meaningful actionable outputs for autonomous assembly manipulation. Subsequently, we present a 3D keypoint-based modular learning framework to learn assembly dependencies to infer actionable outputs given a RGB-D input of an assembly scene. We train and evaluate our trained network on an assembly pose estimation dataset and compare it against object-centric baselines with an augmented set of metrics for progressive assemblies.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for presentation at the European Conference on Robotics (ECoR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PVRA，一个基于 3D 关键点的模块化学习框架，用于机器人装配场景：给定 RGB-D 输入，模型学习装配依赖关系 (assembly dependencies) 并推断可执行的输出。作者在装配位姿估计数据集上训练和评估该网络，并与以物体为中心 (object-centric) 的基线方法进行对比，使用为渐进式装配扩展的指标集。
Motivation: 现代计算机视觉已能为机器人装配操作提供部分自主性，但渐进式装配的自主操作除了感知物体外还需要更专门的能力。通过相关领域研究的比较分析，作者认为物体为中心的感知需要向学习装配依赖关系推进，才能预测对自主装配操作有意义的可执行输出。
Method: 提出一个 3D 关键点投票 (key-point voting) 的模块化学习框架，以 RGB-D 装配场景图像为输入，通过学习装配依赖关系来推断可执行输出。该框架在装配位姿估计数据集上训练和评估，并与物体为中心的基线比较。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明在装配位姿估计数据集上进行了训练与评估，并使用针对渐进式装配扩展的指标集与物体为中心基线进行对比。
Conclusion: 本文的核心论点是物体为中心的感知必须向学习装配依赖关系演进，以支持自主渐进式装配操作；所提出的关键点投票框架在这一定位下进行了验证。

papers.title: Rethinking Patch Based Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Semantic Structured Partitioning
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series forecasting (MTSF) is a fundamental task in many real world applications. Existing patch based forecasting methods generally fall into three categories: fixed partitioning, multi-scale partitioning, and extendable partitioning. Fixed partitioning often breaks meaningful temporal boundaries, multi-scale partitioning may introduce redundant representations across scales, and extendable partitioning improves flexibility but still lacks an explicit mechanism for organizing semantic structure and modeling interactions among heterogeneous temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we propose SCPaT, a Transformer based framework built on semantic structured partitioning. SCPaT first decomposes input sequences into semantically consistent units through adaptive semantic unit generation, then constructs a dynamic semantic graph to model directed dependencies among these units and organize them into higher order semantic blocks. Based on these structured representations, an importance aware routing mechanism adaptively dispatches different semantic blocks to different experts for customized modeling. Extensive experiments on 12 real world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of SCPaT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于 patch 的多元时间序列预测 (MTSF)，提出 SCPaT，一个基于语义结构化分区的 Transformer 框架。SCPaT 先把输入序列分解成语义一致的单元，构建动态语义图刻画单元间有向依赖并组织成高阶语义块，再用重要性感知路由将不同语义块分派给不同专家。摘要报告在 12 个真实数据集上的充分实验验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有 patch 类预测方法可分为固定分区、多尺度分区和可扩展分区三类，分别存在破坏有意义时间边界、跨尺度冗余表示以及缺少显式机制来组织语义结构和建模异质时序模式交互等问题。论文旨在弥补这些局限。
Method: SCPaT 包含三步：通过自适应语义单元生成 (adaptive semantic unit generation) 将序列分解为语义一致的单元；构建动态语义图 (dynamic semantic graph) 建模单元间的有向依赖并将单元组织为高阶语义块；利用重要性感知路由 (importance aware routing) 将不同语义块自适应分派给不同专家进行定制化建模。
Result: 摘要称在 12 个真实数据集上的大量实验证明了 SCPaT 的有效性，但未给出具体性能数字或与基线的量化对比。
Conclusion: 论文认为显式的语义结构化分区、动态语义图与专家路由结合，能够改善 patch 方法对异质时序模式的建模，为 MTSF 提供新思路；摘要未提及方法局限。

papers.title: Flow Matching Meets 3D Curvilinear Structure Segmentation in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Segmentation of curvilinear anatomical structures in 3D medical images remains challenging due to complex topology, severe class imbalance, weak contrast, and large variations in structure morphology. While deep learning approaches for 3D curvilinear segmentation have been proposed, they are often tailored to specific anatomies or modalities, limiting generalization across clinical settings and leaving room for improvement. Recent generative models have shown the benefits of iterative prediction for structured segmentation tasks, yet diffusion-based methods suffer from computationally expensive sampling, hindering their use on high-resolution 3D volumes. We present 3D-CurvSegFlow, a flow matching-based model for 3D curvilinear structure segmentation. The model learns a continuous transformation from a simple source distribution to the target vascular representation, enabling progressive refinement of complex curvilinear geometries with efficient inference. We evaluate our method on Three public challenging datasets covering distinct anatomies and modalities: portal vein, cerebral vessel, and coronary arteries. Using a common architecture and training strategy across all tasks, our method outperforms general-purpose and vessel-specific approaches, with strong preservation of thin branches and vascular continuity. This work not only advances the state-of-the-art in 3D curvilinear segmentation but also opens new avenues for efficient, generalizable, and clinically applicable methods in medical image analysis.
papers.comment: International Workshop on Machine Learning in Medical Imaging (MLMI 2026) @ MICCAI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 3D-CurvSegFlow，一种基于 flow matching 的 3D 曲率结构分割模型，通过学习从简单源分布到目标血管表示的连续变换，以高效推理实现对复杂曲率几何的渐进细化。作者在门静脉、脑血管和冠状动脉三个公开数据集上采用统一架构与训练策略，声称优于通用与血管专用方法，并保留细薄分支和血管连续性。
Motivation: 3D 医学图像中曲率解剖结构分割因复杂拓扑、严重类别不平衡、弱对比度和形态差异而困难；现有方法常针对特定解剖或模态设计，泛化有限，而扩散式生成模型采样成本高，难以用于高分辨率 3D 体数据。
Method: 提出 flow matching 模型 3D-CurvSegFlow，学习从简单源分布到目标血管表示的连续变换，通过渐进式细化处理复杂曲率几何，并在所有任务上使用统一架构与训练策略以提升泛化性。
Result: 在门静脉、脑血管和冠状动脉三个公开挑战数据集上验证，该方法优于通用分割和血管专用方法，尤其在细薄分支保留和血管连续性方面表现突出；摘要未给出量化指标。
Conclusion: 该工作声称推进 3D 曲率分割的最新技术水平，并为医学图像分析中高效、可泛化且临床适用的方法开辟新途径。

papers.title: G-MARK: Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Cooperative Driving via Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving systems must operate under partial observability, where safety-critical objects may be occluded or visible only to neighboring connected vehicles. Vehicle-to-vehicle cooperation can reduce this uncertainty, but existing cooperative driving methods often compress multi-agent evidence into latent features or hidden multimodal states. As a result, they obscure which agent observed each object, whether the object is visible to the ego vehicle, and how conflicting evidence affects downstream decisions. We propose G-MARK, a grounded multi-agent reasoning framework that converts cooperative object-centric observations into explicit provenance-aware knowledge graphs (KGs). The resulting KGs preserve object hypotheses together with their source attribution, ego-versus-partner visibility, uncertainty, conflicts, spatial relations, and planning-relevant context. G-MARK then derives a shared feature representation from these KGs, enabling lightweight task heads to support object reasoning, motion prediction, control selection, and trajectory forecasting. Compared with the state-of-the-art baseline, GMARK improves occlusion reasoning accuracy by 42.2%, reduces control-selection error by 13.1%, and achieves comparable trajectory-planning accuracy with a 25.6x smaller structured communication payload. Our code is available at https://github.com/bhavyagupta98/g-mark.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the 25th IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 G-MARK，一个面向协同驾驶的 grounded 多智能体推理框架。它将协作目标中心的观测转换为显式的、带来源追踪的知识图谱 (knowledge graphs)，保留物体假设的来源归属、自车与伙伴可见性、不确定性、冲突、空间关系及规划上下文，再从这些图谱导出共享特征表示，支撑轻量级任务头完成物体推理、运动预测、控制选择和轨迹预测。对比当前最先进的基线，G-MARK 将遮挡推理准确率提升 42.2%，控制选择误差降低 13.1%，并以 25.6 倍更小的结构化通信负载获得可比的轨迹规划精度。
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统在部分可观测条件下运行，安全关键的物体可能被遮挡而仅对邻近网联车辆可见；车对车协作可以减少这种不确定性。但现有协同驾驶方法常将多智能体证据压缩为隐特征或隐藏多模态状态，掩盖了“哪个智能体观测了哪个物体”、物体是否被自车看到以及冲突证据如何影响下游决策等信息。
Method: G-MARK 将协同的目标中心观测转化为显式的、来源感知的知识图谱 (provenance-aware KGs)，这些图谱保留物体假设及其来源归属、自车与伙伴可见性、不确定性、冲突、空间关系和规划相关上下文。随后 G-MARK 从这些知识图谱中导出共享特征表示，使轻量级任务头可以支持物体推理、运动预测、控制选择和轨迹预测。
Result: 在摘要报告的对比中，与最先进基线相比，G-MARK 将遮挡推理准确率提高 42.2%，控制选择误差降低 13.1%，并以 25.6 倍更小的结构化通信负载达到可比的轨迹规划精度。
Conclusion: 作者强调将多智能体证据显式地组织为带来源归属的知识图谱，可以为下游协同驾驶任务提供更扎实的推理基础；代码已开源。摘要未讨论额外局限。

summary_sections.method: G-MARK 将协同的目标中心观测转化为显式的、来源感知的知识图谱 (provenance-aware KGs)，这些图谱保留物体假设及其来源归属、自车与伙伴可见性、不确定性、冲突、空间关系和规划相关上下文。随后 G-MARK 从这些知识图谱中导出共享特征表示，使轻量级任务头可以支持物体推理、运动预测、控制选择和轨迹预测。
summary_sections.result: 在摘要报告的对比中，与最先进基线相比，G-MARK 将遮挡推理准确率提高 42.2%，控制选择误差降低 13.1%，并以 25.6 倍更小的结构化通信负载达到可比的轨迹规划精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调将多智能体证据显式地组织为带来源归属的知识图谱，可以为下游协同驾驶任务提供更扎实的推理基础；代码已开源。摘要未讨论额外局限。

papers.title: Learning Early-to-Final Solution Consistency for MILP Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) is a fundamental problem class in operations research and combinatorial optimization, with broad applications to industrial decision-making. Owing to their NP-hardness, however, modern solvers may struggle to find high-quality solutions for challenging MILP instances within practical time limits. Recent learning-based approaches seek to accelerate MILP solving by directly predicting high-quality solutions from static instance-level features, such as variable-constraint bipartite graphs. Yet accurate solution prediction from instance features alone is difficult, and these methods largely overlook the information revealed during the solver's search process. In this paper, we find that solutions produced at the early search stage of MILP solvers, which are computationally cheap to obtain, are often structurally close to the solutions found after full-budget search. Motivated by this observation, we propose a new solver-informed paradigm that shifts the learning target from variable assignment to early-to-final consistency: for each variable, we predict whether its early-stage assignment should persist in full-budget solutions. The predicted consistency naturally guides downstream search, for instance by fixing the assignments deemed consistent. At inference time, we further ensemble consistency predictions across multiple early-stage solutions to improve robustness. Experiments across four MILP benchmarks show our method improves prediction-guided search across diverse downstream pipelines. With Gurobi, our proposed method reduces the primal gap by 56.9% on average and closes it completely on combinatorial auction instances. Besides, we transferred the Gurobi-trained model zero-shot to SCIP without adaptation, achieving a 36.4% average gap reduction across benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用求解器搜索过程信息的 MILP 加速范式。作者发现 MILP 求解器早期搜索阶段的解在结构上通常接近全预算搜索得到的最终解，因此将学习目标从直接预测变量赋值改为预测“早期赋值是否会保留到最终解”（early-to-final consistency），并用该一致性指导下游搜索（例如固定被认为一致的赋值）。实验表明，该方法在四个 MILP 基准上显著降低原始间隙（primal gap），并能零样本迁移到其他求解器。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的 MILP 加速方法主要从静态实例特征（如变量-约束二部图）直接预测高质量解，但仅凭实例特征难以准确预测，且忽略了求解器搜索过程中揭示的动态信息。作者观察到早期解与最终解在结构上接近，从而提出利用这一廉价易得的信号。
Method: 提出 solver-informed 的 early-to-final consistency 预测：对每个变量，预测其早期阶段赋值是否应在全预算解中保留。该预测可自然引导下游搜索，例如固定被认为一致的赋值；推理时还对多个早期解的预测进行集成以提升鲁棒性。
Result: 在四个 MILP 基准上，结合 Gurobi 的方法平均降低原始间隙 56.9%，并在组合拍卖（combinatorial auction）实例上完全闭合间隙；将 Gurobi 训练模型零样本迁移到 SCIP，平均间隙降低 36.4%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用求解器搜索过程中廉价易得的早期解信息可以有效提升预测引导搜索的性能，且所学一致性具有跨求解器的泛化能力。

papers.title: Designing Human-mediated AI Guidance: Ready Together for Personalized Family Emergency Preparedness
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly used across domains to provide personalized information, recommendations, and decision support. However, in some contexts, AI-generated information may not be suitable for direct delivery to the final recipient. Instead, it may need to be interpreted, adapted, and communicated by a human who understands the recipient's needs, emotional state, and situational context. Human-AI interaction research has given less attention to situations in which a more knowledgeable human acts as an intermediary between an AI system and a less experienced or less informed recipient. We introduce the human-mediated AI guidance framework and explore it through Ready Together, an AI-supported family emergency preparedness system in which parents mediate AI-generated content for their children. The system is designed to provide personalized guidance and support parents in making emergency preparedness more interactive and understandable through guided activities and family-centered learning. The system design was informed by a qualitative, design-oriented research process involving semi-structured interviews and co-design activities. Findings identified challenges in family emergency preparedness, including difficulty discussing emergencies with children, uncertainty about providing appropriate explanations, and a preference for interactive learning activities. These findings informed the design of an interactive prototype, subsequently evaluated through a pilot study and a heuristic evaluation. Participants responded positively to the personalized recommendations and practical activities. Preliminary findings suggest that human-mediated AI guidance may support context-sensitive family preparedness while preserving parents' responsibility for interpreting, adapting, and communicating AI-generated information.
papers.comment: Accepted for Italian Workshop on Artificial Intelligence for Human-Machine Interaction (AIxHMI 2026), October 6-9, 2026, Perugia, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 human-mediated AI guidance 框架，并基于家庭应急准备系统 Ready Together 进行探索：由父母作为中介，向儿童解释、调整和传达 AI 生成的个性化应急准备内容。系统设计源于半结构化访谈与共同设计活动，随后进行了试点研究和启发式评估。初步结果表明，参与者对个性化推荐和实践活动反馈积极，且该框架可能支持情境敏感的家庭应急准备。
Motivation: 人类与 AI 交互研究较少关注这样一种场景：更具知识的用户充当 AI 系统与经验较少或信息较少的最终接收者之间的中介。家庭应急准备中，家长需要向儿童传达 AI 生成信息，但往往难以讨论紧急话题、不确定如何给出恰当解释，并偏好互动式学习活动。
Method: 引入 human-mediated AI guidance 框架，通过定性、面向设计的研究流程（包括半结构化访谈和共同设计活动）识别家庭应急准备的挑战，并据此设计交互式原型；随后通过试点研究和启发式评估对原型进行评价。
Result: 摘要报告参与者对个性化推荐和实践活动反应积极；初步发现表明该框架可以支持情境敏感的家庭应急准备，同时保留家长对 AI 生成信息进行解释、调整和沟通的责任。摘要未给出量化评估数据。
Conclusion: 作者强调，由人类中介参与 AI 内容传递有助于应对家庭应急准备中接收者的情境与情感需求，但该结论仍属初步，有待更大规模验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Noise to Signal: Improving Security Log Anomaly Detection Using LLMs with Endpoint-Specific Logs
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches to anomalous behaviour log detection, such as Wazuh rely primarily on predefined detection rules, while statistical anomaly detection approaches such as OpenSearch identify deviations from previously observed behavioural patterns. Recent research has investigated LLMs for log anomaly detection because of their ability to interpret semantic and contextual information. However, LLM-based approaches can be affected by prompt construction, noisy log data, and reliance on generic datasets that may lack endpoint-specific authentication behaviours. To address these limitations, this study develops a standardised instruction-based LLM classification framework for detecting anomalous authentication behaviours, including borderline cases. A controlled cybersecurity testbed was developed to generate endpoint-specific authentication data, producing a curated dataset comprising normal, borderline, and anomalous behavioural scenarios. Three instruction-tuned LLMs, Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct, and GPT-OSS 20B, were evaluated against Wazuh rule-based detection and OpenSearch Anomaly Detection using a common ground-truth severity framework. Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct achieved the strongest overall end-to-end detection performance, with an accuracy of 89.3%, recall of 88.2%, F1-score of 91.8%, and false negative rate of 11.8%. In comparison, Wazuh achieved an accuracy of 52.0% and false negative rate of 68.6%, while OpenSearch achieved an accuracy of 49.3% and false negative rate of 74.5%. Meta Llama also detected 80% of the borderline anomalous scenarios, compared with 20% for Wazuh and 15% for OpenSearch. Qwen achieved lower overall detection performance than Meta Llama but recorded the lowest average inference latency and 100% structured-response validity. GPT-OSS demonstrated strong classification performance when valid responses were produced.
papers.comment: The paper contains 35 pages and 3 figures. The paper has not been submitted or published in any conference or journal. The authors have an aim to publish it in a journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对安全日志异常检测中现有规则与统计方法的不足，提出基于指令微调 LLM 的标准分类框架，用于检测认证行为的异常，包括边界情形。研究在受控网络安全测试床上生成端到端认证数据，并对比 Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct、Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct、GPT-OSS 20B 与 Wazuh 规则检测、OpenSearch 异常检测的表现。结果显示 Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 综合检测性能最强，准确率 89.3%，召回率 88.2%，F1 91.8%，假阴性率 11.8%，显著优于 Wazuh 和 OpenSearch。
Motivation: 现有安全日志异常检测方法（如 Wazuh 的规则检测、OpenSearch 的统计方法）依赖预定义规则或历史行为模式，难以处理语义和上下文信息；LLM 方法虽有潜力，但受提示构造、日志噪声以及缺乏端点特定认证行为数据的制约。
Method: 开发标准化的基于指令的 LLM 分类框架，并搭建受控网络安全测试床生成端点特定认证数据，构建包含正常、边界和异常行为场景的数据集；在统一 ground-truth 严重性框架下评估三个指令微调 LLM 与规则/统计方法的端到端检测性能。
Result: Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 取得最佳综合性能，准确率 89.3%、召回率 88.2%、F1 91.8%、假阴性率 11.8%，并检测出 80% 的边界异常场景；对比之下 Wazuh 准确率 52.0%、假阴性率 68.6%，OpenSearch 准确率 49.3%、假阴性率 74.5%。Qwen 检测性能较低但推理延迟最低且结构化响应有效性达 100%，GPT-OSS 在产生有效响应时分类性能较强。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合端点特定日志和指令化 LLM 分类框架能显著提升安全日志异常检测的准确性与边界场景识别能力，明显优于传统规则和统计方法。

papers.title: Towards Quantifying Benchmark Optimization in ASR Models
papers.abstract_en: Public benchmarks are important measures of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model capabilities. However, by nature of being public, there is risk of models being optimized for these benchmarks in ways that do not generalize well to real-world data. We present a methodology for quantifying benchmark optimization, focusing on cases where the audio underdetermines the reference transcript. We identify three families of behavioral probes that reveal models' capabilities of reproducing benchmark reference spans despite underdetermined audio: reference disagreement, masked-number recovery, and orthographic switching. We find that the highest-scoring open source models output verbatim reference transcript spans even when the relevant audio is contradictory, masked, or ambiguous. Using a variety of mechanistic probes, we show that models respond to narrow acoustic cues to override the faithful representation of the audio in favor of a benchmark-optimized policy. We show the benchmark-optimized behavior can be causally manipulated via low-rank linear steering or simply appending audio to the end of a segment in some cases. Overall, our results indicate that high-performing models exhibit benchmark-conditioned behaviors that can inflate benchmark performance without reflecting improved general-purpose transcription ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套量化 ASR 模型基准优化 (benchmark optimization) 的方法论，聚焦于音频不足以唯一确定参考转写 (reference transcript) 的情形。作者设计了三类行为探针，发现得分最高的开源模型会在音频矛盾、被掩蔽或含糊时仍逐字输出基准参考转写片段，并借助机制探针表明模型利用狭窄的声学线索来覆盖对音频的忠实表征。研究还显示该基准优化行为可通过低秩线性 steering 或在片段末尾拼接音频等方式被因果操纵，整体说明高表现模型存在使基准分数虚高但不反映通用转写能力提升的行为。
Motivation: 公开基准是衡量 ASR 模型能力的重要标准，但公开性本身带来模型为基准而优化的风险，这类优化未必能泛化到真实数据；尤其是音频对参考转写欠定 (underdetermined) 的情况下，基准分数可能失真。
Method: 提出一种量化基准优化的方法论，识别出三类行为探针家族：参考分歧 (reference disagreement)、掩蔽数字恢复 (masked-number recovery) 和正字法切换 (orthographic switching)；并采用多种机制探针 (mechanistic probes) 检测模型行为，还通过低秩线性 steering 或向片段末尾追加音频进行因果干预。
Result: 最高分的开源模型即使在相关音频矛盾、被掩蔽或含糊时仍会输出逐字的基准参考转写片段；机制探针显示模型依赖狭窄声学线索而非忠实表征音频，并且该行为可被低秩线性 steering 或简单追加音频因果地操纵。
Conclusion: 作者认为高表现模型展现出基准条件化 (benchmark-conditioned) 行为，这会虚增基准性能，却不代表通用转写能力的真实提升。
