papers.title: Adaptive Probabilistic Shielding by Learning MDPs for Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic shielding is a technique for safe reinforcement learning (RL). Typically, a static observer -- called the shield -- constrains the learning agent's actions to those for which acting safely remains feasible. Traditionally, the shield is computed from the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov decision process (MDP). Thus, this technique is not applicable when the MDP model is not given a priori, which, unfortunately, is the case in typical RL applications. In this paper, we study the problem of computing a shield in the setting where the transition graph of the MDP is known, but the transition probabilities are unknown. Our approach integrates probabilistic shielding with online model learning: as the RL agent explores the environment, we estimate the transition probabilities. From this estimate, we compute a shield. While the shield may be conservative initially, it adapts as the model estimate becomes more precise. Thus, the shield improves in tandem with the RL agent. This paradigm of adaptive probabilistic shielding raises a number of challenges, such as when to recompute the shield and how to balance between exploration and safety during learning. We empirically evaluate multiple variants of this paradigm across several environments.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. To be published in the proceedings of RV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究安全强化学习中的概率屏蔽（probabilistic shielding）在MDP转移概率未知时的扩展。作者提出将概率屏蔽与在线模型学习结合：RL智能体探索环境时估计转移概率，并据此计算屏蔽；屏蔽初始可能保守，但随模型估计变精确而逐步适应。论文在多个环境中对多种变体进行了经验评估。
Motivation: 传统概率屏蔽依赖底层MDP的转移概率，但在典型RL应用中MDP模型并非先验已知，导致该技术不可用。本文针对转移图已知但转移概率未知的设置，研究如何计算屏蔽。
Method: 提出自适应概率屏蔽范式：在RL探索过程中在线估计转移概率，从当前估计中计算屏蔽，并随估计精度提高而更新屏蔽。文中讨论了屏蔽重算时机以及探索与安全之间的平衡等挑战，并经验评估多种变体。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，仅在多个环境中对提出的多种变体进行了经验评估。
Conclusion: 摘要指出现有静态概率屏蔽因需要已知MDP概率而不适用于典型RL，本文通过在线学习并自适应更新屏蔽的方式应对该问题。

papers.title: Causal Reasoning with Bipartite Graphical Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: Causal Bayesian networks (CBNs) and structural causal models (SCMs) are the dominant frameworks for graphical causal reasoning, but they cannot adequately represent all real-world causal systems. In particular, systems at equilibrium---where feedback mechanisms create cyclic causal dependencies---can exhibit causal semantics that are fundamentally incompatible with these frameworks: different interventions that enforce the same variable value may have different effects, rendering the standard ``perfect intervention'' do($X = x$) ambiguous. We propose bipartite graphical causal models (BGCMs), in which the structure of a system of equations is encoded by a bipartite graph with variable and equation nodes. In this framework, a hard intervention do($f_j : X_v = ξ_v$) specifies which equation is replaced, which variable is targeted, and at what value---resolving the ambiguity of the standard notion. We demonstrate, through a detailed case study of a physical system, that this representation naturally corresponds to distinct real-world interventions. We formulate a Markov property in terms of a new graphical separation criterion (B-separation) that exploits the functional determinism inherent in the equations, and we extend it to settings with non-random inputs. We show how this gives rise to a do-calculus for reasoning about domain invariances. BGCMs strictly generalize CBNs and SCMs while retaining the ability to perform graphical causal reasoning.
papers.comment: Figure 2 was added w.r.t. to the published version at Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出因果贝叶斯网络（CBNs）和结构因果模型（SCMs）无法充分表示所有真实因果系统，尤其是处于平衡态、带反馈循环的系统，此时标准干预 do(X = x) 存在歧义。作者提出二分图因果模型（BGCMs），用变量节点和方程节点组成的二分图编码方程组结构，并通过指定被替换的方程、目标变量和取值来定义硬干预 do(f_j : X_v = ξ_v)，从而消除歧义。文章通过物理系统案例研究展示该表示与真实干预的对应关系，提出基于 B-separation 的 Markov 性质，并扩展出 do-calculus 用于推理域不变性。
Motivation: 现有主流图形因果框架（CBNs 和 SCMs）不能充分表示所有真实世界的因果系统，尤其是平衡态下反馈机制导致循环因果依赖的系统，其干预语义与标准框架不兼容，标准完美干预 do(X = x) 会变得有歧义。
Method: 提出二分图因果模型（BGCMs），以包含变量节点和方程节点的二分图编码系统方程组结构；定义硬干预 do(f_j : X_v = ξ_v)，明确指定替换哪个方程、干预哪个变量以及设定什么值；并基于方程内在的函数决定论提出新的图形分离准则 B-separation，建立 Markov 性质，推广到非随机输入情形，进而推导 do-calculus。
Result: 通过一个物理系统的详细案例研究，展示了 BGCMs 表示与不同真实世界干预的自然对应；并证明 BGCMs 严格推广了 CBNs 和 SCMs，同时保留进行图形因果推理的能力。
Conclusion: BGCMs 为处理标准框架无法兼容的平衡态反馈系统提供了更一般的图形因果推理框架，能够解决完美干预的歧义并支撑域不变性推理。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Towards Clinically Faithful Medical Image Captioning via Enhanced Vision-Language Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Medical image captioning is a technique that accelerates early-stage diagnostic workflows and enhances the interpretability of medical diagnostic AI systems. However, unlike general image captioning, clinically reliable captioning remains challenging due to grayscale-based modalities, subtle anatomical cues, specialized medical phrasing, and variations in data quality. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models, fluent outputs do not necessarily guarantee sufficient alignment with clinical concept spaces or evaluation criteria. To address this issue, we propose a framework that strengthens clinical alignment by separating and enhancing training-time alignment and inference-time alignment. We build a medical image captioning pipeline that integrates single/dual vision encoders based on BioMedCLIP and SigLIP2, a Q-Former, and a LLaMA-based decoder, and examine the contribution of auxiliary learning for UMLS concept/type prediction. At inference, we apply single-embedding-based reranking to select the best caption among candidates, while at training we introduce MedPAIR-SCST, which combines clinically relevant rewards to shift the generative distribution toward improved clinical alignment. Our experiments show that complementary visual representations with a multi-encoder design and concept-level auxiliary learning help preserve clinically meaningful information. Furthermore, inference-time reranking provides a practical way to improve semantic and clinical alignment without additional training, whereas MedPAIR-SCST goes beyond selection by directly improving the model's distribution to generate more consistent and clinically grounded captions. These findings suggest that jointly leveraging selection-based alignment and reinforcement-learning-based alignment can promote more trustworthy medical image captioning even in data-constrained settings.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Preprint submitted to IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向医学图像描述（medical image captioning）的临床可靠性问题，提出一个将训练期对齐与推理期对齐分开强化的框架。流程整合了基于 BioMedCLIP 与 SigLIP2 的单/双视觉编码器、Q-Former 以及 LLaMA 解码器，并在训练时加入 UMLS 概念/类型预测的辅助学习；推理时采用单嵌入重排序（reranking）挑选候选描述，训练时则使用结合临床相关奖励的 MedPAIR-SCST。实验表明多编码器互补视觉表示与概念级辅助学习有助于保留临床信息，推理期重排序无需额外训练即可提升语义与临床对齐，而 MedPAIR-SCST 能进一步改善生成分布。
Motivation: 与通用图像描述不同，医学图像描述面临灰度模态、细微解剖线索、专科医学措辞和数据质量波动等挑战；现有大视觉语言模型即使生成流畅文本，也不一定能与临床概念空间或评价标准充分对齐。
Method: 提出分离训练期与推理期对齐的框架：以 BioMedCLIP/SigLIP2 构建单/双视觉编码器，配合 Q-Former 与 LLaMA 解码器组成描述流程，并引入 UMLS 概念/类型预测的辅助学习；推理时用单嵌入重排序从候选中选取最佳描述，训练时用 MedPAIR-SCST 结合临床相关奖励调整生成分布。
Result: 实验显示多编码器互补视觉表示与概念级辅助学习能保留临床有意义的信息；推理期重排序在不额外训练的情况下提升语义与临床对齐；MedPAIR-SCST 则超越选择机制，直接改进模型分布以生成更一致且临床有依据的描述。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时利用基于选择的对齐与基于强化学习的对齐，可以在数据受限条件下促进更可信的医学图像描述生成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Core-KAN: Continuous Vision Kernels with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Conventional convolutional kernels are typically defined on fixed discrete grids, limiting their ability to accommodate heterogeneous local structures. Existing adaptive operators improve flexibility but often couple geometric scale variation with content-dependent filtering, while incurring high computational cost from per-location kernel generation. To decouple geometric scale adaptation from content-dependent filtering while avoiding expensive per-location kernel generation, we propose Continuous Relative-scale KAN (Core-KAN), a relative-scale-conditioned continuous convolution operator. Core-KAN maps input features into a compact latent basis space and uses a lightweight scale controller to predict local scales relative to an exponential moving average reference. A KAN-based generator represents depth-wise kernel bases as continuous coordinate functions, allowing the operator to synthesize spatial filters at arbitrary resolutions rather than being confined to a fixed lattice. Instead of synthesizing independent kernels at every location, it constructs a compact bank of scale-conditioned kernel responses and interpolates them according to the predicted local scale map. An independent mixing controller further combines the interpolated basis responses based on local content, explicitly decoupling geometric scale adaptation from content-dependent filtering. Together with lightweight pointwise projections, this design forms a low-rank dynamic convolution that scales efficiently with kernel size and integrates readily into hierarchical vision backbones. Experiments across three representative vision tasks show Core-KAN consistently outperforms strong convolutional and dynamic-kernel baselines with only marginal parameter and computational overhead, offering an efficient, general framework for continuous, scale-adaptive convolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Core-KAN，一种以相对尺度为条件的连续卷积算子，将几何尺度适应与内容相关滤波解耦。它把输入特征映射到紧凑隐空间，用轻量尺度控制器预测相对尺度，并通过 KAN 生成器将深度核基表示为连续坐标函数，从而在任意分辨率合成空间滤波器，而非固定网格。实验在三个代表性视觉任务上表明其一致优于强卷积和动态核基线，且参数和计算开销很小。
Motivation: 传统卷积核定义在固定离散网格上，难以适应异构局部结构；现有自适应算子虽提升灵活性，但常将几何尺度变化与内容相关滤波耦合，且逐位置生成卷积核带来高计算成本。
Method: Core-KAN 由尺度控制器、KAN 基生成器、混合控制器和逐点投影组成；它构建紧凑的尺度条件核响应库，依预测的局部尺度图插值，再由混合控制器按局部内容组合响应，从而显式解耦几何尺度适应与内容相关滤波，形成低秩动态卷积。
Result: 摘要报告在三个代表性视觉任务上，Core-KAN 一致超越强卷积基线与动态核基线，仅引入边际参数和计算开销，且能随卷积核大小高效扩展。

papers.title: When Saying No Makes Better Videos: Designing Dual Gatekeeping for Pedagogically Grounded AI Content Creation
papers.abstract_en: To prevent the adoption of aesthetically polished but pedagogically flawed AI content, we study a video authoring pipeline featuring two layers of structured refusal. The first layer empowers educators to iteratively reshape AI scripts based on multimedia learning theory, while the second employs automated metrics to flag violations in instructional coherence and narrative-visual synchronization. While neither layer is exhaustive, their synergy ensures that principled resistance--the act of deferring AI output until it meets rigorous standards--becomes a catalyst for higher quality. Evaluation combining a study with 23 educators across 3 topics and automated metrics across 7 topics drawn from established science and philosophy curricula shows that both layers independently improve the same instructional dimensions, suggesting that thoughtful resistance and generative AI are not opposites but partners.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 1 figure. Presented at the CHI 2026 Workshop on Understanding and Engaging Critical Resistance to AI in Education
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一个视频创作管线，通过两层结构化拒绝（structured refusal）机制防止生成美学上精致但教学上有缺陷的AI内容。第一层让教育者基于多媒体学习理论迭代重塑AI脚本，第二层用自动化指标标记教学连贯性与叙事-视觉同步方面的违规。对23名教育者、3个主题的用户研究和7个主题的自动化指标评估显示，两层都能独立改进相同的教学维度。
Motivation: AI生成内容可能外表精美但教学逻辑有问题，现有流程缺乏对教育质量的系统性把关。作者提出用两个互补的拒绝层来确保AI输出达到严格标准。
Method: 提出双门控（dual gatekeeping）视频创作管线：教育者基于多媒体学习理论对AI脚本进行人工迭代修改，同时使用自动化指标检测教学连贯性和叙事-视觉同步性问题，两层形成协同的拒绝机制。
Result: 含23名教育者、3个主题的评估以及7个主题（来自科学和哲学课程）的自动化指标显示，两层均独立改进相同的教学维度。
Conclusion: 摘要认为有原则的抵抗（deferring AI output until it meets rigorous standards）可以成为提升质量的催化剂，表明审慎的抵抗与生成式AI不是对立面而是合作伙伴；但摘要未讨论该方法在更广泛内容类型或更大规模上的局限。

papers.title: FAR-DPO: Feasibility-Aware and Robust Direct Preference Optimization for Cyclic Peptide Design
papers.abstract_en: Cyclic peptides are emerging as promising molecular scaffolds in drug discovery due to their high binding affinity and structural stability. However, extending generative models from linear to cyclic peptide design remains challenging, as cyclization sharply restricts the feasible design space through coupled geometric and biophysical constraints. Moreover, limited training data has led existing approaches to rely largely on zero-shot generation or post hoc filtering, resulting in low yields of feasible designs and limited control over multi-objective trade-offs. To address these limitations, we propose FAR-DPO (Feasibility-Aware and Robust Direct Preference Optimization), an architecture-agnostic framework that steers generative models toward structurally and biophysically feasible cyclic peptide designs, particularly for challenging targets. FAR-DPO integrates feasibility-aware preference construction with difficulty-aware group-robust optimization. Specifically, it constructs within-target preference pairs through feasibility-gated multi-objective dominance and adaptively reweights predefined difficulty groups according to their current preference losses. On the CPSea LNR benchmark, under a fixed generation budget, FAR-DPO increases overall success rate from 46.89% to 57.79% on PepGLAD and from 47.96% to 49.57% on PepFlow. These gains also extend to the hardest target quartile and are accompanied by more favorable best-per-target binding scores. Together, these results demonstrate FAR-DPO's effectiveness in improving feasibility and target-wise robustness.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, and 7 tables. Includes supplementary materials
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FAR-DPO（Feasibility-Aware and Robust Direct Preference Optimization），一个与模型架构无关的框架，用于将生成模型引导到结构和生物物理上可行的环肽设计。它通过可行性门控的多目标支配构造目标内偏好对，并用难度感知的组鲁棒优化自适应加权不同难度组。在 CPSea LNR 基准上，固定生成预算下，PepGLAD 的整体成功率从 46.89% 提升到 57.79%，PepFlow 从 47.96% 提升到 49.57%，并在最难目标四分位上也取得提升。
Motivation: 环肽作为药物发现中的分子骨架具有高结合亲和力和结构稳定性，但从线性生成模型扩展至环肽设计时，环化带来的几何与生物物理耦合约束严重压缩可行设计空间；同时训练数据有限，现有方法多依赖零样本生成或事后过滤，导致可行设计产率低且对多目标权衡的控制有限。
Method: FAR-DPO 集成两种技术：一是可行性感知偏好构建，通过可行性门控的多目标支配关系在目标内构造偏好对；二是难度感知的组鲁棒优化，根据当前偏好损失自适应重新加权预定义的难度组。
Result: 在 CPSea LNR 基准上，固定生成预算下，FAR-DPO 将 PepGLAD 的整体成功率从 46.89% 提升到 57.79%，将 PepFlow 从 47.96% 提升到 49.57%；这些提升也覆盖最难目标四分位，并伴随更优的每目标最佳结合分数。
Conclusion: 结果表明 FAR-DPO 能有效提升环肽设计的可行性和目标级鲁棒性，但摘要未讨论其在其他数据集或模型上的泛化边界。

papers.title: Answer-Level Trust Selection for Physical Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can estimate physical quantities such as duration, speed, and acceleration from visual observations, but existing benchmarks primarily assess overall model performance against annotated ground truth. In deployment, a key question is whether an individual prediction can be trusted when its ground truth is unavailable. Self-consistency alone may fail to capture important failure modes: a VLM may produce stable-but-wrong estimates or rely on textual priors rather than visual evidence. We formulate answer-level selective prediction for quantitative physical reasoning and propose Answer-Level Trust Selection (ATS), a post-hoc, model-agnostic framework for accepting or rejecting individual VLM predictions. ATS requires no fine-tuning, auxiliary verifier, or access to the model's internal logits. Instead, it aggregates eight interpretable behavioral diagnostic scores derived from repeated queries and controlled interventions into a unified trust score. We evaluate ATS in depth on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and across 20 VLM backbones, examining selective performance, diagnostic behavior, and targeted failure modes. Our results show that intervention-based diagnostics help identify stable-but-wrong and prior-tracking predictions that repeated agreement alone may miss. However, improved failure-case rejection can come at the cost of lower retention of correct predictions. ATS therefore complements model-level capability evaluation with answer-level reliability assessment for quantitative VLM predictions. Code will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLMs）在物理量（如时长、速度、加速度）估计中的单条预测可信度问题，提出 Answer-Level Trust Selection (ATS)，一个无需微调、无需要辅助验证器或模型内部 logits 的事后、模型无关框架。ATS 将来自重复查询和受控干预的八个可解释行为诊断分数聚合为一个统一信任分数，用于接受或拒绝单个 VLM 预测。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 20 个 VLM 骨干上的评估表明，基于干预的诊断能识别稳定但错误以及依赖文本先验的预测，但改进失败案例拒绝可能以降低正确预测保留率为代价。
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估 VLMs 在物理量估计上的整体性能，无法判断部署中单个预测在真值不可用时是否可信。自洽性（self-consistency）可能失效，因为模型可能产生稳定但错误的估计，或依赖文本先验而非视觉证据。
Method: 提出 ATS，一种 post-hoc、模型无关的选择性预测框架。它不需要微调、辅助验证器或内部 logits，而是聚合八个可解释行为诊断分数（来自重复查询和受控干预）为一个统一信任分数，用于接受或拒绝单个 VLM 预测。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 20 个 VLM 骨干上评估选择性能、诊断行为和目标失败模式。结果显示，基于干预的诊断能帮助识别重复一致可能遗漏的稳定但错误和先验跟踪预测，但改进失败案例拒绝可能以降低正确预测保留率为代价。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ATS 以答案级可靠性评估补充模型级能力评估，适用于定量 VLM 预测，并指出失败案例拒绝与正确预测保留之间存在权衡。代码将在发表后发布。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ADAPT: Physics-Aware Diffusion-based World Models for Adaptive Predictive Transferable HVAC Control
papers.abstract_en: Buildings account for roughly one-third of global energy consumption and CO$_2$ emissions. Optimizing indoor climate systems plays a critical role for urban climate mitigation aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals 11 and 13. However, indoor delayed thermodynamic responses and partial observability severely hinder existing methods, which are primarily limited by implicit thermal inertia, occupancy dynamic prediction, and cumulative prediction errors, especially for out-of-distribution environments. In practice, these challenges are further exacerbated by the high cost and privacy burden of dense indoor sensing, forcing operators to collect only limited data in a single operating regime while expecting controllers to generalize reliably across unseen seasons and climate regions. To address this problem, we propose ADAPT, a physics-aware conditional diffusion indoor environmental world model for HVAC control. The model predicts a short-horizon held-action thermal baseline to capture the latent thermal inertia of the buildings. The diffusion backbone utilizes the robustness of generative models, while a learnable multi-zone heat-balance regularizer constrains generated trajectories to satisfy transferable building thermodynamics without requiring known building geometry or manually calibrated thermal parameters. A credit assignment is then design for the downstream reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on SemibuildingSim and Sinergym demonstrate that ADAPT reduces HVAC energy consumption by 7.3\% and occupant discomfort by 30.2\% compared with state-of-the-art baselines under IID control. Under OOD control scenarios spanning unseen seasons and climate regions, ADAPT maintains robust performance with only marginal degradation relative to its IID performance, substantially outperforming existing methods in transfer robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADAPT，一个基于物理感知的条件扩散室内环境世界模型，用于暖通空调（HVAC）控制。模型通过预测短时程的保持动作热基线来捕捉建筑潜在热惯性，并用可学习的多区域热平衡正则项约束生成轨迹满足可迁移的建筑热力学，同时为下游强化学习设计信用分配。实验表明在 IID 控制下相比 SOTA 基线降低 7.3% 能耗和 30.2% 不适时间，在 OOD 场景下保持稳健迁移性能。
Motivation: 建筑能耗约占全球三分之一，但室内延迟热响应和部分可观测性使现有方法受限于隐式热惯性、 occupancy 动态预测和累积预测误差，尤其在分布外环境中表现不佳。高成本与隐私负担导致只能采集单运行工况的有限数据，却需泛化到未见季节和气候区域。
Method: 提出物理感知的条件扩散世界模型 ADAPT：用扩散骨干建模生成鲁棒性，预测短时程保持动作热基线以学习潜在热惯性；引入可学习多区域热平衡正则项，无需已知建筑几何或人工标定热参数即可约束轨迹；并为下游强化学习设计信用分配机制。
Result: 在 SemibuildingSim 和 Sinergym 上，ADAPT 在 IID 控制下比 SOTA 基线降低 HVAC 能耗 7.3%、 occupant 不适 30.2%；在跨未见季节和气候区域的 OOD 控制场景下，性能仅相对 IID 略有下降，迁移鲁棒性显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ADAPT 通过物理感知扩散世界模型和可迁移热力学正则项，能够在数据有限且分布外的情况下保持稳健的 HVAC 控制性能。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 ADAPT 通过物理感知扩散世界模型和可迁移热力学正则项，能够在数据有限且分布外的情况下保持稳健的 HVAC 控制性能。

papers.title: MileGPO: Milestone Inference with Local Evidence for Graph-Based Policy Optimization of Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Credit assignment is challenging in long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning, where supervision often comes only from final rewards. Existing methods refine trajectory-level signals into step-level credits through step grouping or graph-based advantage estimation, but can overlook meaningful intermediate milestones. We propose MileGPO (Milestone Inference with Local Evidence for Graph-Based Policy Optimization), which derives process-level credit from grouped on-policy rollouts through three designs. Milestone Discovery identifies candidate milestones on successful rollouts and recurring traps on failed ones. Reliability-Calibrated Shaping (RCS) weights these candidates by outcome-based confidence, strengthening reliable milestones and traps while down-weighting uncertain ones. Progress-Contrastive Calibration (PCC) further tests whether a candidate reflects local progress and whether its incoming ansition outperforms observed alternatives from the same state.MileGPO requires neither auxiliary models nor additional environment interaction. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show state-of-the-art performance and a small in-distribution to out-of-distribution gap on ALFWorld. Ablations and credit diagnostics indicate that reliability weighting, local progress, and same-state branch evidence complement milestone discovery and resolve ambiguous intermediate credit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MileGPO，一种面向长视界 LLM 智能体 (long-horizon LLM agents) 的基于图的策略优化方法，旨在从分组的有策略采样轨迹 (grouped on-policy rollouts) 中提取过程级信用 (process-level credit)。方法包含三个设计：里程碑发现 (Milestone Discovery)、可靠性校准塑形 (Reliability-Calibrated Shaping, RCS) 和进度对比校准 (Progress-Contrastive Calibration, PCC)，且不需要辅助模型或额外的环境交互。实验在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上达到最先进性能，并在 ALFWorld 上表现出较小的分布内到分布外差距。
Motivation: 长视界智能体强化学习中信用分配 (credit assignment) 困难，监督信号往往只来自最终奖励；现有方法通过步骤分组或基于图的优势估计把轨迹级信号细化为步骤级信用，但可能忽略有意义的中间里程碑。
Method: MileGPO 从成功轨迹中发现候选里程碑、从失败轨迹中发现反复出现的陷阱；RCS 按基于结果的置信度对这些候选加权，强化可靠里程碑与陷阱并降低不确定项的权重；PCC 进一步检验候选是否反映局部进度以及其入边转移是否优于同一状态下的其他观测替代。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上取得最先进性能，且在 ALFWorld 上分布内到分布外 (in-distribution to out-of-distribution) 差距较小；消融与信用诊断表明，可靠性加权、局部进度和同状态分支证据能够补充里程碑发现并解决模糊的中间信用。
Conclusion: 作者认为，不需要辅助模型或额外环境交互即可从分组的有策略轨迹中导出过程级信用，从而改善长视界智能体 RL 的信用分配。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection Using Flow Matching on Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Financial anomaly detection often relies on large unlabeled transaction logs, where anomalous samples may already be present during training. Such training-set contamination violates the clean-normal data assumption underlying many anomaly detection methods. Although flow matching has demonstrated strong performance in generative modeling, its robustness in unsupervised tabular anomaly detection remains underexplored. In this work, we study flow-matching-based anomaly detection under contaminated training data by comparing Time-Conditioned Contraction Matching (TCCM) with Forest-Flow and evaluating multiple anomaly scoring functions. Our results show that the choice of anomaly score is critical. The original single-step Decision score used by TCCM is sensitive to contamination, whereas trajectory-based Deviation and Reconstruction scores provide more stable anomaly signals. With these scores, Forest-Flow becomes competitive with, and in some cases outperforms, TCCM. These findings highlight the importance of anomaly scoring for flow-matching methods in financial anomaly detection under severe class imbalance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究流匹配 (flow matching) 方法在表格型金融异常检测中的表现，重点考察训练数据被异常样本污染时的鲁棒性。作者对比 Time-Conditioned Contraction Matching (TCCM) 与 Forest-Flow，并评估多种异常评分函数，发现评分函数的选择对结果影响很大：TCCM 原有的单步 Decision 分数对污染敏感，而基于轨迹的 Deviation 和 Reconstruction 分数更稳定，并使 Forest-Flow 达到与 TCCM 相当甚至更优的性能。
Motivation: 金融异常检测常依赖包含异常样本的大规模无标注交易日志，训练集污染破坏了传统异常检测方法对干净正常数据的假设；流匹配在此类无监督表格异常检测中的鲁棒性尚不清楚。
Method: 在受污染的训练数据设定下，系统比较 TCCM 与 Forest-Flow 两种流匹配方法，并评估包括原始 Decision、轨迹式 Deviation 和 Reconstruction 在内的多种异常评分函数。
Result: 摘要报告异常评分函数的选择是关键因素：TCCM 的原始单步 Decision 分数易受污染影响，而 Deviation 和 Reconstruction 分数提供更稳定的异常信号；使用这些分数后 Forest-Flow 与 TCCM 竞争，并在部分情况下优于 TCCM。
Conclusion: 作者强调在严重类别不平衡的金融异常检测中，异常评分设计对基于流匹配的方法至关重要。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LoRA-GA$^2$: Low Rank Adaptation with Multi-step Gradient Adaptive Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a prominent fine-tuning method for large models, achieving competitive performance with reduced memory overhead. However, a persistent performance gap remains between LoRA and full fine-tuning. Recent studies have sought to narrow this gap by employing one-step gradient approximations of pretrained weights to align LoRA updates with the principal directions or intrinsic dimensionalities of full fine-tuning updates. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to capture the full dynamics of the gradients. In this paper, we propose LoRA-GA$^2$, an effective fine-tuning algorithm that fully leverages multi-step gradient information. Specifically, we introduce a lightweight probe for multi-step gradients of pretrained weights that incurs no additional GPU memory cost and only marginal time overhead. We further employ a spectrum-aware, importance-based rank allocation and optimal initialization derived from multi-step gradients. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that LoRA-GA$^2$ consistently outperforms existing LoRA variants while preserving the efficiency advantages of vanilla LoRA. For instance, LoRA-GA$^2$ surpasses the leading baseline by an average of 0.66 points on the GLUE benchmark, and outperforms the strongest baseline by 1.03 points on GSM8K and 0.87 points on HumanEval, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoRA-GA$^2$，一种利用多步梯度信息来缩小 LoRA 与全量微调差距的低秩适应算法。作者引入轻量探针获取预训练权重的多步梯度，无额外 GPU 显存开销且时间开销很小，并基于多步梯度做频谱感知的秩分配与最优初始化。实验显示其在 GLUE、GSM8K 和 HumanEval 上持续优于现有 LoRA 变体，同时保持 vanilla LoRA 的效率优势。
Motivation: LoRA 与全量微调之间仍存在性能差距；现有方法使用一步梯度近似来对齐 LoRA 更新，但无法捕捉梯度的完整动态。
Method: 提出轻量探针用于多步梯度估计，无额外显存成本；采用基于频谱感知和重要性（spectrum-aware, importance-based）的秩分配，以及从多步梯度导出的最优初始化。
Result: 在 GLUE 上平均超过最强基线 0.66 分，在 GSM8K 上超出 1.03 分，在 HumanEval 上超出 0.87 分；同时保持 vanilla LoRA 的效率优势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调充分使用多步梯度信息可以有效提升 LoRA 微调性能，同时不牺牲内存与时间效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards general embodied intelligence: integrating large language models, knowledge bases, and reasoning capabilities to build the next generation of AI agents
papers.abstract_en: The convergence of large language models (LLMs), structured knowledge bases (KBs), and reasoning ability (RA) presents a promising trajectory toward general embodied intelligence (GEI). This paper reviews the evolution of LLM-centered intelligent systems, emphasising their integration with knowledge representation, logical reasoning, and physical embodiment. We analyse LLM architectures, pre-training methods, and inference mechanisms, along with their interaction with external knowledge sources and structured reasoning frameworks. Furthermore, we examine embodied intelligence (EI) paradigms wherein agents learn and act in physical environments. To synthesise these dimensions, we present a conceptual framework that illustrates the synergy among LLMs, KBs, RA, and embodiment, serving as a guiding model for perception, reasoning, and action rather than an implemented engineering architecture. To advance toward GEI, we identify five key challenges: efficient LLM deployment, closed-loop knowledge integration, hybrid symbolic-neural reasoning, perception-action grounding, and continual learning. This survey provides a comprehensive roadmap for developing adaptive, multimodal agents capable of operating in complex, dynamic settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，围绕大语言模型（LLM）、结构化知识库（KBs）与推理能力（RA）的融合，探讨通往通用具身智能（GEI）的路径。作者回顾了以 LLM 为核心的智能系统演化，分析其与知识表示、逻辑推理和物理具身的交互，并提出一个概念性框架说明 LLM、KB、RA 与具身之间的协同关系。该框架定位为感知、推理与行动的指导模型，而非已实现的工程架构。文中还总结了迈向 GEI 的五大挑战，包括高效 LLM 部署、闭环知识整合、混合符号-神经推理、感知-行动接地和持续学习。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 中心智能系统在知识表示、逻辑推理与实际物理环境中的行动能力彼此割裂，缺少能够统一这些维度的整体视角；作者希望通过整合 LLM、知识库与推理能力，为构建自适应、多模态的通用具身智能体提供路线图。
Method: 论文采用综述与概念框架方法：分析 LLM 的架构、预训练与推理机制，考察其与外部知识源和结构化推理框架的交互，并检视具身智能（embodied intelligence）范式；在此基础上提出一个概念性协同框架，将 LLM、KB、RA 与具身作为指导模型而非工程实现。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或基准结果；主要产出是识别出五大挑战：高效 LLM 部署、闭环知识整合、混合符号-神经推理、感知-行动接地与持续学习，并给出面向复杂动态环境的多模态智能体研究路线图。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架是感知、推理与行动的概念指导模型，而非已实施的工程架构；综述旨在为通用具身智能的后续研究提供综合路线图，同时指出仍需解决的五大开放性挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLMs as Acquisition Policies for Finite-Pool Materials Optimization: A Controlled Study
papers.abstract_en: Discovering materials with desirable properties often requires searching large candidate spaces while experimental or computational evaluations remain costly. Active learning addresses this challenge by using previous observations to select which candidate to evaluate next, typically through probabilistic surrogate models. We investigate whether open-weight large language models (LLMs) can serve as standalone acquisition policies in this setting. We evaluate five LLMs across four retrospective finite-pool materials optimization tasks under different candidate-presentation strategies and compare them with random selection and conventional Gaussian-process methods. LLM policies generally reach the global optimum in fewer iterations than random selection, indicating that they provide a useful acquisition signal without task-specific training. Their performance relative to Gaussian-process methods is mixed: conventional acquisition performs better on most tasks, while LLMs match or outperform it in some settings. Performance varies substantially across tasks, models, initializations, and candidate presentations, with no LLM approach performing best across all tasks. Overall, open-weight LLMs show potential as acquisition policies for finite-pool materials search, although their reliability remains sensitive to the task and to how candidates and scientific context are presented.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开放权重大语言模型（LLM）能否作为有限候选池材料优化中的独立采集策略（acquisition policy）。作者在四个回顾性有限池材料优化任务上评估五个 LLM，并与随机选择和高斯过程方法比较。摘要显示 LLM 策略一般比随机选择更快达到全局最优，但相对高斯过程方法的表现好坏参半，且性能在不同任务、模型、初始化和候选呈现方式下波动较大。
Motivation: 材料发现需要在大规模候选空间中搜索，而实验或计算评估成本高昂。主动学习通常依赖概率代理模型来选择下一个评估候选；本文想探究开放权重 LLM 能否无需任务特定训练就直接充当采集策略。
Method: 将五个开放权重 LLM 作为独立的采集策略，在四个回顾性有限池材料优化任务中测试不同的候选呈现策略，并与随机选择和高斯过程方法基线进行对比。
Result: LLM 策略一般比随机选择用更少迭代达到全局最优，表明其无需任务特定训练即可提供有用的采集信号；但相对高斯过程方法表现混合，多数任务上传统采集方法更好，某些设置下 LLM 能匹配或超越。
Conclusion: 开放权重 LLM 在有限池材料搜索中有潜力作为采集策略，但其可靠性对任务类型以及候选和科学背景的呈现方式敏感；没有任何一种 LLM 方法在所有任务上表现最佳。

summary_sections.motivation: 材料发现需要在大规模候选空间中搜索，而实验或计算评估成本高昂。主动学习通常依赖概率代理模型来选择下一个评估候选；本文想探究开放权重 LLM 能否无需任务特定训练就直接充当采集策略。
summary_sections.method: 将五个开放权重 LLM 作为独立的采集策略，在四个回顾性有限池材料优化任务中测试不同的候选呈现策略，并与随机选择和高斯过程方法基线进行对比。
summary_sections.result: LLM 策略一般比随机选择用更少迭代达到全局最优，表明其无需任务特定训练即可提供有用的采集信号；但相对高斯过程方法表现混合，多数任务上传统采集方法更好，某些设置下 LLM 能匹配或超越。
summary_sections.conclusion: 开放权重 LLM 在有限池材料搜索中有潜力作为采集策略，但其可靠性对任务类型以及候选和科学背景的呈现方式敏感；没有任何一种 LLM 方法在所有任务上表现最佳。

papers.title: TT-net: Quantum Inspired Tensor Network Denoising in Conditional GANs
papers.abstract_en: Developed as a workhorse for classical simulations of quantum algorithms and quantum many-body systems, Tensor Network methods have entered the scientific mainstream in quantum physics. Among various types of tensor networks, Tensor Trains (commonly know as Matrix Product States in the quantum computing community) have already found applications in machine learning. These methods often rely on a powerful linear algebra tool called the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Several conditional GAN architectures for image denoising incorporate SVD as a single-cut decomposition step applied to generator feature maps. In this work we introduce TT-Net, which replaces the per-channel SVD denoising block with a two-cut tensor-train decomposition capable of accessing cross-channel information directly, a capability absent from contemporary alternatives. In a controlled comparison differing only in this decomposition mechanism, TT-Net outperforms SVD-Net on PSNR and SSIM across all three noise types tested (Gaussian, motion blur, and salt-and-pepper), supporting the hypothesis that cross-channel access improves denoising quality. Training-dynamics analysis further shows that TT-Net's adversarial loss term consistently saturates to a stagnant state across all three noise types, more so than SVD-Net's, while reconstruction quality continues to improve regardless, raising an open question about the adversarial component's contribution that this work identifies but does not resolve. Furthermore, for Gaussian noise our method outperforms both the EigenGAN and the state of the art Pix2pix method which does not assume any linear algebra decompositions and does not retain any linear algebra information. Our manuscript shows how quantum inspired tools can be used as practical real world feature filters for deep learning applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TT-Net 条件 GAN 图像去噪架构，用双切张量训练 (tensor-train) 分解替换现有 SVD-Net 中的逐通道 SVD 去噪块，从而直接访问跨通道信息。在仅改变分解机制的受控对比中，TT-Net 在 Gaussian、motion blur 与 salt-and-pepper 三类噪声上的 PSNR 和 SSIM 均优于 SVD-Net；Gaussian 噪声下还超过 EigenGAN 和 Pix2pix。训练动力学分析显示其对抗损失项趋于停滞，但重建质量仍持续改善，作者认为这引出对抗组件贡献的开放问题。
Motivation: 现有条件 GAN 去噪架构把 SVD 作为生成器特征图的单一切割 (single-cut) 分解步骤，只能逐通道处理，无法利用跨通道信息。作者希望用量子物理中经典张量网络模拟的工具，为深度学习特征过滤提供更实用的方案。
Method: 提出 TT-Net，用两切割张量训练分解 (two-cut tensor-train decomposition) 替换 SVD-Net 的逐通道 SVD 去噪块，使分解能够直接访问跨通道信息；将张量网络方法作为条件 GAN 生成器内部的去噪模块。
Result: 在只改变分解机制的受控对比中，TT-Net 在 Gaussian、motion blur 和 salt-and-pepper 三类噪声上均优于 SVD-Net 的 PSNR 与 SSIM；Gaussian 噪声下还优于 EigenGAN 和声明为 state of the art 的 Pix2pix。训练动力学显示 TT-Net 的对抗损失项在三种噪声下都持续饱和到停滞状态，而重建质量继续提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为跨通道访问能力是去噪质量提升的关键假设得到支持；同时提出对抗损失项饱和但重建仍改进这一开放问题，本文识别但未解决；展示了量子启发的工具可作为深度学习应用中的实际特征过滤器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MOSAIC: Modality-agnostic Spectral Alignment for Federated Image-level Weakly Supervised Tumor Segmentation under Client-specific Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Trustworthy multimodal fusion in clinical settings requires handling incomplete and heterogeneous modality subsets across institutions, where privacy constraints prohibit centralized data sharing. Federated learning (FL) mitigates data-sharing constraints but suffers from client-specific missing modalities, where institutions possess incomplete multimodal subsets, degrading fusion quality and segmentation performance. While FL and weak supervision have been studied separately, their joint use with image-level labels under heterogeneous missing modalities remains unaddressed. We propose \textbf{MOSAIC}, the first modality-agnostic federated framework for weakly supervised binary tumor segmentation under client-specific missing modalities. We introduce a client-specific modality-alignment module that fuses available channels into a shared latent space without prior knowledge of modality identity, a spectral prototype alignment loss that reconciles cross-client distribution shift using compact non-invertible frequency-domain statistics, and a dedicated federated refinement network that denoises the resulting CAM pseudo-labels into accurate masks, breaking the accuracy ceiling of weak supervision. Experiments on three multi-institutional brain tumor benchmarks (FeTS2022, BraTS-MEN, and BraTS-SSA) demonstrate significant improvements over all image, box, and point-supervised baselines, approaching fully supervised accuracy using only image-level labels and reaching 0.84 Dice on FeTS2022. Dynamic new client addition enables previously unseen institutions to join an already-trained federation within 0.01-0.04 Dice without retraining. Code is available at https://github.com/Tarun2201/MOSAIC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOSAIC，首个针对客户端特定缺失模态场景的模态无关联邦学习框架，用于图像级弱监督二值肿瘤分割。方法通过客户端特定模态对齐模块将可用通道融合到共享潜空间，引入频谱原型对齐损失缓解跨客户端分布偏移，并用联邦细化网络将 CAM 伪标签去噪为精确掩码。在 FeTS2022、BraTS-MEN 和 BraTS-SSA 三个脑肿瘤基准上，仅用图像级标签即接近全监督精度，FeTS2022 上 Dice 达 0.84。
Motivation: 临床多模态融合需要处理机构间不完整且异构的模态子集，而联邦学习虽缓解数据共享约束，却受客户端特定缺失模态影响，导致融合质量与分割性能下降。弱监督与联邦学习在异构缺失模态下的联合使用此前尚未被解决。
Method: 提出模态无关的联邦框架 MOSAIC，包含三个核心组件：无需模态身份先验的客户端特定模态对齐模块，将可用通道融合进共享潜空间；基于紧凑不可逆频域统计量的频谱原型对齐损失，用于调和跨客户端分布偏移；以及专门的联邦细化网络，将 CAM 伪标签去噪为准确掩码。
Result: 在三个多机构脑肿瘤基准（FeTS2022、BraTS-MEN、BraTS-SSA）上的实验显示，该方法显著优于所有图像、框和点监督基线，仅用图像级标签即接近全监督精度，并在 FeTS2022 上达到 0.84 Dice。动态添加新客户端时，未经重训练的已训练联邦可在 0.01–0.04 Dice 范围内接纳新机构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MOSAIC 通过模态无关对齐、频谱原型损失和联邦细化网络打破了弱监督的精度上限，并支持动态新客户端加入。代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning piecewise-smooth dynamical systems
papers.abstract_en: Discovering dynamical systems from trajectory data is a central problem in applied mathematics and engineering. Whilst recent advances in machine learning have led to strong progress in data-driven system identification, much less attention has been given to systems with discontinuous dynamics. These systems are nevertheless highly relevant in applications, including climate dynamics and mechanical systems with friction. In this work, we consider the problem of identifying piecewise-smooth dynamical systems directly from trajectory data. Compared with the smooth setting, this requires recovering the governing equations and detecting the switching hyperplanes that separate different dynamical regimes and characterising their behaviour, such as sliding motion. We present a modular framework for discovering such systems by first estimating switching hyperplanes from data and then learning smooth dynamics within each region using geometry-constrained neural networks. The geometry-learning phase is studied from a statistical perspective, analysing the identifiability of the discontinuities and the robustness of the procedure. We also introduce a novel neural network architecture with a prescribed discontinuity set, and provide a theoretical analysis of its approximation properties. The approach is tested on low-dimensional benchmark problems, including dry-friction oscillators and the PP04 climate model for the ice ages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个从轨迹数据辨识分段光滑动力系统（piecewise-smooth dynamical systems）的模块化框架：先从数据中估计切换超平面（switching hyperplanes），再在各区域内用几何约束神经网络（geometry-constrained neural networks）学习光滑动力学；同时引入具有预设不连续集的新型神经网络架构，并对其逼近性质给出理论分析。方法在低维基准问题（干摩擦振子、PP04 冰期气候模型）上做了测试。
Motivation: 数据驱动的系统辨识大多针对光滑动力系统，对不连续动力学的关注较少；而这类系统在气候动力学、含摩擦机械系统等应用中非常重要，现有方法难以同时恢复控制方程、检测不同动力学区域之间的切换超平面并刻画滑动运动（sliding motion）。
Method: 采用模块化框架，第一步从轨迹数据估计切换超平面，第二步在每个光滑区域内用几何约束神经网络学习局部动力学；从统计角度分析几何学习阶段中不连续点的可辨识性（identifiability）和过程鲁棒性，并提出一种具有预设不连续集的神经网络架构及其逼近性质的理论分析。
Result: 摘要报告方法在低维基准问题上进行了测试，包括干摩擦振荡器和 PP04 冰期气候模型；摘要未给出具体定量数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调辨识分段光滑系统比光滑情形更复杂，需要同时恢复控制方程、检测切换超平面并描述滑动运动等行为；本文框架为此提供了一种模块化且带有理论分析的途径，但目前仅在低维问题上验证。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Coupled Optimal Transport with Landmark Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Existing optimal transport (OT) models primarily seek an OT map or plan between distributions by minimizing a prescribed transport cost or distortion. However, minimizing transport cost or distortion alone may fail to identify a geometrically meaningful transformation between the two distributions. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a novel coupled OT framework that leverages a small number of annotated landmarks to guide the recovery of an underlying deformation governing the distribution transformation. The coupled OT framework integrates the optimization of the transport plan and the deformation field into a unified model, where the landmark-guided deformation field and the cost-driven transport plan are coupled through a mutual-consistency constraint. As a result, the deformation is jointly determined by the annotated landmarks and cost-driven distribution matching. The proposed framework provides a principled connection between landmark-based registration and transport-based distribution matching, enabling the recovery of transport maps from sparse geometric supervision. We establish the well-definedness of the proposed model in a general variational setting and develop a finite-element-based numerical algorithm for computation whose convergence properties are systematically analyzed. The practical effectiveness of the proposed approach is verified in shape matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种带地标约束的耦合最优传输（coupled optimal transport, OT）框架，将传输计划与形变场联合优化，并通过互一致性约束把地标引导的形变场与代价驱动的传输计划耦合起来，从而从少量标注地标中恢复分布间有几何意义的变换。作者在一般变分框架下证明模型适定性，发展基于有限元的数值算法并分析收敛性，在形状匹配任务上验证有效性。
Motivation: 现有 OT 模型主要通过最小化指定传输代价或失真来寻找分布间的映射，但单纯最小化代价可能无法得到几何上有意义的变换；该工作利用少量标注地标来引导底层形变的恢复，弥补这一局限。
Method: 提出一个统一的耦合 OT 模型，将地标引导的形变场与代价驱动的传输计划通过互一致性约束结合起来；在变分框架下建立模型的良定义性，并设计基于有限元（finite element）的数值算法，系统分析其收敛性质。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值指标，仅报告该方法在形状匹配任务中验证了实际有效性，能够从稀疏几何监督中恢复传输映射。
Conclusion: 该框架建立了基于地标的配准（landmark-based registration）与基于传输的分布匹配之间的原则性联系，可从稀疏几何监督恢复传输映射；摘要未提及除形状匹配之外的适用范围。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架建立了基于地标的配准（landmark-based registration）与基于传输的分布匹配之间的原则性联系，可从稀疏几何监督恢复传输映射；摘要未提及除形状匹配之外的适用范围。

papers.title: An Irreducible Quantum Advantage in Aligning World Models with Reality
papers.abstract_en: World models provide digital simulacra of the true world, allowing agents to be trained and tested before costly real-world deployment. At each time step, they receive an action and generate an observation and reward matching the statistics of the true world. In complex environments where present outcomes depend on events far in the past, this requires memory. One might expect that, by increasing memory, we can always build a model accurately enough to align the optimal agent policies of the real and virtual worlds. We show that this is false for classical world models, even when the true world itself is classical. We construct true worlds for which every finite classical model fails along the same possible trajectory: it either loses the ability to distinguish actions when the true world clearly prefers one, or repeatedly assigns the highest expected reward to suboptimal actions. Its expected-reward estimates also retain a nonvanishing average error. In contrast, each such true world admits a quantum world model using a single qutrit that reproduces it exactly: its reward estimates and preferred actions always match those of the true world, ensuring that the optimal policies of the real and virtual worlds remain perfectly aligned.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究世界模型（world model）在模拟真实环境时所需的记忆资源，并证明一个反直觉结论：即使真实世界本身是经典系统，任何有限记忆的经典世界模型都可能在某个轨迹上失效，无法保证虚拟环境中的最优策略与真实环境对齐。作者构造了具体反例，并展示每个此类真实世界都可以被一个基于单 qutrit 的量子世界模型精确复现，使奖励估计与最优策略完全一致。
Motivation: 在复杂环境中，当前结果可能依赖很久以前的事件，因此世界模型需要记忆；直觉上增加记忆总能构建足够精确的模型，使真实与虚拟世界的最优策略对齐。论文针对这一直觉，考察有限记忆经典模型的不可克服缺陷。
Method: 论文不提出单一算法，而是通过构造一类特殊真实世界，系统性地论证每个有限经典世界模型都存在同样类型的失败轨迹，并构造出对应单 qutrit 量子世界模型来精确复现这些真实世界。
Result: 摘要报告：对构造的真实世界，每个有限经典模型要么无法区分真实世界明显偏向的两种动作，要么反复把最高期望奖励赋予次优动作，且其期望奖励估计保持非零的平均误差；而单 qutrit 量子模型在奖励估计和偏好动作上都与真实世界完全一致，从而保证最优策略对齐。
Conclusion: 作者指出经典世界模型即使增大记忆也无法保证与真实世界策略对齐，而量子世界模型在该问题上有不可约的（irreducible）优势，为量子增强的智能体训练提供了理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distilling Aggregate Mobility Statistics into a Language Model Policy for Post-Event Crowd Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian simulators need a behaviour rule for every agent, but privacy usually limits the data for setting one to aggregate statistics, namely zone-level device counts and origin-to-destination (OD) flows, with no individual trajectories. Such aggregates under-determine individual behaviour, because many different sets of decisions reproduce the same counts. We fine-tune a language model crowd agent so that the simulated population matches the observed destination composition, the fraction of the departing crowd heading to each point of interest. We read this target from the OD flow and reweight the model's own destination distribution onto it by iterative proportional fitting. Because fine-tuning inflates the dominant destination class, we fit the low-rank adapter to trajectories resampled to a corrected training composition that reaches the target after this inflation. On mobile network counts from two baseball games the fine-tuned agent runs without inference-time correction, cutting the destination-share error by 25%, while the grid correlation remains similar across policies.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a short paper at ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对隐私限制下只有聚合移动统计（区域设备计数与 OD 流）而没有个体轨迹的人群仿真问题，提出将这类聚合统计蒸馏到语言模型智能体策略中。作者用迭代比例拟合 (iterative proportional fitting) 把模型的目的地分布重加权到从 OD 流读出的目标目的地构成，并通过对修正训练构成重采样的轨迹拟合低秩适配器。在两次棒球比赛的移动网络计数上，微调后的智能体无需推理时修正即可运行，目的地份额误差降低 25%，网格相关性基本不变。
Motivation: 行人仿真需要为每个智能体设定行为规则，但隐私通常只允许使用区域级设备计数和 OD 流等聚合统计，缺乏个体轨迹；而聚合统计无法唯一决定个体行为，因为多组不同决策可复现同样的计数。
Method: 微调一个语言模型人群智能体，使仿真人群匹配从 OD 流读取的目标目的地构成；通过迭代比例拟合将模型自身的目的地分布重加权到该目标。由于微调会放大占主导的目的地类别，作者对按修正后的训练构成重采样的轨迹拟合低秩适配器 (low-rank adapter)，使微调后的分布恰好达到目标。
Result: 在来自两场棒球比赛的移动网络计数数据上，微调后的智能体无需推理时校正即可运行，目的地份额误差降低 25%，而网格相关性在不同策略间保持相近。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，仅基于聚合移动统计也可以把目标目的地构成蒸馏进语言模型智能体策略，从而在赛后人群仿真中省去推理时修正。

papers.title: CoToGrasp: Contact-Topology-Conditioned Dexterous Grasp Synthesis via Canonical Workspace Learning
papers.abstract_en: Current dexterous grasp planners primarily optimize for physical stability, focusing on whether an object can be grasped rather than how it should be grasped to support downstream functional tasks. However, conditioning grasp synthesis on specific human grasp taxonomies typically requires prohibitively expensive, object-annotated datasets. To address these limitations, we propose CoToGrasp, a novel generative framework that synthesizes diverse, stable grasps strictly conditioned on specific contact topologies. To bypass the data collection bottleneck, CoToGrasp is trained entirely in an object-agnostic manner. We introduce a feature-based canonical workspace that projects local object features into a unified gripper-centric domain, effectively decoupling the semantic functional intent from the arbitrary object geometry. By learning the intrinsic contact manifold of the gripper within this workspace, our model achieves zero-shot generalization to unseen objects at inference. Extensive evaluations on the large-scale DexGraspNet dataset demonstrate that CoToGrasp achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing taxonomy-guided planners. Finally, we demonstrate the physical viability and kinematic feasibility of our synthesized contact topologies on a physical robot platform. Code is available on our project website https://cea-list.github.io/cotograspweb/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoToGrasp，一个以指定接触拓扑 (contact topology) 为条件生成多样化且稳定灵巧抓取的生成式框架。模型完全以物体无关 (object-agnostic) 方式训练，利用基于特征的规范工作空间 (canonical workspace) 将局部物体特征投影到统一的灵巧手中心域，从而将语义功能意图与任意物体几何解耦。在 DexGraspNet 上达到最优性能，并在物理机器人平台上验证了生成接触拓扑的可执行性。
Motivation: 现有灵巧抓取规划器主要优化物理稳定性，关注物体能否被抓取，而不关心如何抓取以支持下游功能任务；而基于人类抓取分类法 (taxonomy) 的条件合成通常需要昂贵且带物体标注的数据集。
Method: 提出生成式框架 CoToGrasp，引入特征化规范工作空间，将局部物体特征投影到统一的手抓取器中心域，学习该空间内抓取器的固有接触流形，从而把语义功能意图与具体物体几何解耦，并以物体无关方式训练以实现零样本泛化。
Result: 在大规模 DexGraspNet 数据集上的评估表明，CoToGrasp 优于现有分类法引导的规划器，达到最先进性能；并在物理机器人平台上验证了合成接触拓扑的物理可行性和运动学可行性。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过规范工作空间学习抓取器接触流形，可以在无物体标注数据的前提下实现严格按接触拓扑条件的多样稳定抓取合成，并对未见物体零样本泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AsymFeX: A Symmetry-Driven Framework for Ischemic Stroke Segmentation Across Imaging Modalities and Stroke Stages
papers.abstract_en: Fast and accurate segmentation of Acute Ischemic Stroke (AIS) lesions is essential for stroke prognosis and treatment planning. Non-contrast CT (NCCT), the first-line imaging modality for diagnosing ischemic infarcts, exhibits subtle infarct contrast, making manual delineation slow and labor-intensive. Motivated by this, and by the clinical practice of comparing brain hemispheres to localize infarcts, we propose a two-stage, nnU-Net-compatible 3D segmentation method. The first stage corrects head tilt to align each scan to its true anatomical mid-sagittal plane; the second applies a novel Asymmetric Feature Extraction (AsymFeX) module, comparing each voxel to its true contralateral counterpart within a local 3 x 3 x 3 neighborhood via cross-hemispheric attention, feature disparity estimation, and dual-scale gating to capture both large and small infarcts. On AISD, our method achieves 0.6796 Dice, 23.53 mm HD95, and 7.69 mL AVD, significantly outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods, with clinically relevant volumetric analysis at the 70 mL thrombolysis-eligibility threshold. Proof-of-concept evaluation on ATLAS v2.1 and ISLES'24 demonstrates that the same symmetry-driven design generalizes across imaging modalities and stroke time points without architectural changes, further supported by an uncertainty analysis assessing reliability under clinical deployment. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/biomedia-lab/AIS-detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种对称性驱动的两阶段3D分割框架 AsymFeX，用于急性缺血性卒中 (AIS) 病灶分割。第一阶段校正头部倾斜以对齐真实解剖中矢状面；第二阶段采用新颖的 Asymmetric Feature Extraction 模块，通过跨半球注意力、特征差异估计和双尺度门控在局部 3x3x3 邻域内比较每个体素与其对侧对应体素。在 AISD 数据集上达到 0.6796 Dice、23.53 mm HD95、7.69 mL AVD，并优于现有最先进方法；在 ATLAS v2.1 和 ISLES'24 上的概念验证表明无需架构修改即可跨成像模态和卒中时间点泛化。
Motivation: 非对比CT (NCCT) 是诊断缺血性梗死的一线影像模态，但病灶对比度低，手动勾画缓慢且费力。临床实践中常通过比较大脑半球来定位梗死灶，本文受此启发，希望实现快速准确的 AIS 病灶自动分割以支持预后和治疗规划。
Method: 提出两阶段、nnU-Net 兼容的 3D 分割方法。第一阶段校正头部倾斜，将每个扫描对齐到真实解剖中矢状面；第二阶段应用新颖的 AsymFeX 模块，在局部 3x3x3 邻域内通过跨半球注意力 (cross-hemispheric attention)、特征差异估计 (feature disparity estimation) 和双尺度门控 (dual-scale gating) 将每个体素与其对侧对应体素进行比较，以同时捕捉大和小梗死灶。
Result: 在 AISD 数据集上达到 0.6796 Dice、23.53 mm HD95 和 7.69 mL AVD，显著优于现有最先进方法；并在 70 mL 溶栓资格阈值下提供临床相关的体积分析。在 ATLAS v2.1 和 ISLES'24 上的概念验证显示同一对称性驱动设计无需架构修改即可跨成像模态和卒中时间点泛化，不确定性分析进一步评估了临床部署下的可靠性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该对称性驱动的分割设计能够跨不同成像模态和卒中阶段泛化，且不确定性分析有助于评估临床部署可靠性；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: skchange: Fast and Flexible Algorithms for Changepoint Detection
papers.abstract_en: Skchange is an open-source Python library for detecting structural changes in time series. It implements modern change detection algorithms within a unified and extensible framework. The algorithms are modular and composable, and they include changepoint search methods based on both cost minimisation and statistical tests. Key features include the detection of anomalous segments in addition to changepoints; theoretically well-founded fast and approximate search methods; theoretically well-founded algorithms for high-dimensional data, covering settings where either few or many features change simultaneously; utilities for automatic and data-driven penalty calibration, which balances false alarms against missed detections; and a large collection of built-in costs and statistical tests. The design follows established scikit-learn conventions to streamline both user and contributor experience, and Numba is used extensively to achieve high computational performance. Source code and documentation are available at https://github.com/NorskRegnesentral/skchange.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 skchange，一个用于时间序列结构变化检测的开源 Python 库。该库在一个统一可扩展的框架中实现现代变化检测算法，包含基于代价最小化和统计检验的搜索方法，支持异常段检测、高维数据、惩罚校准以及大量内置代价函数和统计检验，并遵循 scikit-learn 约定、使用 Numba 提升性能。
Motivation: 时间序列变化点检测缺乏一个统一、模块化且高性能的开源实现，现有工具在可扩展性、高维数据支持和惩罚校准方面存在不足。
Method: 该库提供模块化可组合的算法，包括基于代价最小化和统计检验的变化点搜索方法，支持 fast 和 approximate 搜索、高维数据（少特征或多特征同时变化）、自动数据驱动惩罚校准，并内置丰富的代价函数和统计检验。
Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值，但强调通过 Numba 实现高计算性能，并提供了完整的源代码和文档。
Conclusion: skchange 作为一个遵循 scikit-learn 约定的开源库，旨在简化用户和贡献者体验，适用于多种变化检测场景。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Far from the Crowd: Scalable Self-Supervised Learning via Geographic Isolation
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised pretraining on remote sensing imagery typically treats all samples as equally informative, despite large variability in geographic and visual structure. We propose a curriculum learning strategy for self-supervised Earth observation that ranks samples by geographic isolation, a label-free proxy derived entirely from geolocation metadata already present in geospatial datasets, requiring no image decoding, no model feedback, and no manual annotation. Unlike visual complexity proxies, it scales as O(D log D) with dataset size D and is well-defined for both contrastive and reconstructive objectives. We integrate the proposed measure into MoCoV2 and MAE pretraining and evaluate across three downstream tasks from CopernicusBench (BigEarthNet, DFC-2020, LCZ). Our curriculum reaches baseline final-epoch performance using as few as 20% of the training budget (MAE) and at most 40% (MoCo) of the training budget, and improves final downstream performance by up to +5 mAP on BigEarthNet, with gains of 1-5 points across benchmarks, matching visual-complexity curricula while reducing pre-computation cost by more than 140x (4 s vs. 568 s on SSL4EO). A CKA and effective-rank analysis further reveals that curriculum-trained encoders develop higher-dimensional, more uniformly utilized embedding spaces throughout training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于遥感影像自监督预训练的课程学习策略，以地理隔离度 (geographic isolation) 作为无标签难度指标，该指标仅由地理空间数据中已有的地理位置元数据计算，无需图像解码、模型反馈或人工标注。作者将该排序策略集成到 MoCoV2 和 MAE 预训练中，并在 CopernicusBench 的三个下游任务上评估，结果显示用 20%（MAE）或 40%（MoCo）的训练预算即可达到基线最终 epoch 的性能，且 BigEarthNet 上最终下游性能最高提升 +5 mAP。该方法在匹配基于视觉复杂度的课程效果的同时，将预计算成本降低超过 140 倍。
Motivation: 遥感影像的自监督预训练通常将所有样本视为同等信息量，忽略了地理和视觉结构上的巨大差异；而现有的视觉复杂度代理指标计算成本高、难以大规模扩展，因此需要一种完全由地理元数据导出的可扩展无标签排序方式。
Method: 提出按地理隔离度对样本排序的课程学习策略：该代理指标完全来自地理位置元数据，复杂度为 O(D log D)，不依赖图像内容、模型反馈或人工标注，并同时适用于对比学习 (contrastive) 和重构式 (reconstructive) 自监督目标；作者将其整合进 MoCoV2 和 MAE 的预训练流程。
Result: 在 CopernicusBench 的 BigEarthNet、DFC-2020 和 LCZ 三个下游任务上，课程策略以 20%（MAE）至 40%（MoCo）的训练预算达到基线最终 epoch 性能，最终下游性能提升 1-5 个百分点，BigEarthNet 上最高为 +5 mAP；预计算成本从 SSL4EO 上的 568 秒降至 4 秒（约 140 倍），且 CKA 与有效秩 (effective rank) 分析表明课程训练得到的编码器在整个训练过程中形成更高维、更均匀利用的嵌入空间。
Conclusion: 摘要强调地理隔离度是一种与视觉复杂度课程效果相当但成本极低的无标签课程信号，适用于大规模自监督地球观测预训练；其分析显示该策略改变了编码器嵌入空间的利用方式。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Finite-Horizon Input-Output Dynamics of Minibatch Perturbations in AdamW
papers.abstract_en: A minibatch can influence training beyond the update at which it is observed because AdamW stores past gradient information in its optimizer states. We study this delayed effect through paired trajectories that differ only in one gradient update and share the same subsequent training sequence. We formulate AdamW as a finite-horizon input--state--output (ISO) system whose state contains the model parameters and first- and second-moment estimates. Linearizing the joint dynamics yields a signed response operator that maps a localized gradient perturbation to its future loss effects, revealing how optimizer memory shapes their magnitude, timing, and sign. We further derive an exact multistep error decomposition and establish first-order finite-horizon accuracy under local smoothness and controlled activation switching. Experiments validate the response mechanism and optimizer-state effects, while repeated-future analyses reveal substantial prospective structure in delayed influence that can be partially recovered from ISO approximations. Code is available at https://github.com/Kanyooo/Loss_ISO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AdamW 中小批量梯度扰动对后续训练轨迹的延迟影响。作者将 AdamW 建模为有限时域输入-状态-输出 (ISO) 系统，其中状态包含模型参数和一阶、二阶矩估计；通过线性化联合动力学得到符号响应算子 (signed response operator)，刻画局部梯度扰动对未来损失的幅值、时延和符号影响。实验验证了响应机制与优化器状态效应，并表明延迟影响中存在可被 ISO 近似部分恢复的前瞻结构。
Motivation: 由于 AdamW 在优化器状态中存储历史梯度信息，单个小批量不仅影响其当前更新，还会影响后续训练过程。现有分析大多只关注单步更新，缺乏对这类延迟效应的系统刻画。
Method: 将 AdamW 视为有限时域 ISO 系统，使用仅相差一次梯度更新的配对轨迹，并固定后续训练序列；通过对联合动力学线性化得到响应算子，推导精确的多步误差分解，并在局部光滑和受控激活切换条件下建立一阶有限时域准确性。
Result: 实验验证了响应机制和优化器状态效应；重复未来分析 (repeated-future analyses) 显示延迟影响存在可观的预测性结构，可部分从 ISO 近似中恢复。
Conclusion: 摘要指出优化器记忆 (optimizer memory) 决定梯度扰动未来影响的幅值、时序与符号，且 ISO 近似能部分捕捉延迟影响的预测结构。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay
papers.abstract_en: Audited against causal ground truth from executed replay in a single-agent tool environment (ALFWorld), none of the step-level credit signals used to train LLM agents -- LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence -- identifies which steps causally matter better than chance. Existing evaluations grade these signals against annotated step *correctness*; we audit them against step *contribution* -- what re-sampling the policy's own alternatives at each decision point and rolling forward actually changes about the outcome -- and the two come apart. The ground truth itself is structured: causal contribution is sparse (30.5% of decision points where ground truth is defined carry measurable effect), and measurability is model-dependent -- the fraction of points with no policy-supported counterfactual differs by a factor of two (13.1% vs. 26.8%) between two similar-scale policies. The failure mode is identifiable: implicit credit echoes the policy's fluency (median rank correlation +0.75, replicating at +0.70 in a second family under a corrected instrument), while conditioning on the outcome adds no causal information (partial correlation -0.004, Qwen). A confidence-only router recovers pivotal steps at chance level, but cuts judge cost by 13.1% per turn (14.0% per trajectory). In a seven-arm pre-registered training experiment, no arm reliably outperforms the untrained policy, and the checkpoints' apparent instrument signature is fully explained by training dose -- sparser credit retains fewer examples, an order-of-magnitude spread in optimizer steps -- not credit content. Comparisons of credit rules must therefore match effective sample size, or they measure dose, not credit.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 7 figures. Pre-registered; frozen analysis plans and prompts included in the appendices. Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在单一智能体工具环境 ALFWorld 中，以执行回放 (executed replay) 产生的因果真值来审计 LLM 智能体训练中使用的步骤级信用分配信号。结果显示，LLM-judge 分数、以结果为条件的 logprob 比率以及策略自身置信度，都无法以优于随机水平的准确率识别真正因果关键步骤。因果贡献的真值本身是稀疏且依赖模型的，且隐式信用与策略流畅度高度相关。
Motivation: 现有评测把步骤级信用信号与标注的步骤正确性 (correctness) 比较，而不是与其对结果的因果贡献 (contribution) 比较；本文指出两者并不一致，因此需要直接审计这些信号能否识别真正影响结果的步骤。
Method: 在单智能体工具环境 ALFWorld 中对每个决策点重新采样策略自身的备选动作并向前滚动，以结果变化定义因果贡献真值；据此审计 LLM-judge 分数、结果条件 logprob 比率和策略置信度三类信号，并开展预注册的七臂训练实验和置信度路由器实验。
Result: 三类信号识别因果关键步骤均不优于随机水平；因果贡献稀疏（30.5% 的决策点有可测效应），可测性依赖模型（两个规模相近策略的无对应反事实比例分别为 13.1% 与 26.8%）；隐式信用与策略流畅度的中位秩相关为 +0.75（第二族策略复现 +0.70），而结果条件化不增加因果信息（Qwen 上偏相关 -0.004）；仅靠置信度的路由器恢复关键步骤处于随机水平，但每回合节省 13.1% 的 judge 成本（每条轨迹 14.0%）；训练实验中无任何臂稳定超越未训练策略，且表观信号特征完全可由训练剂量（优化步数）解释。
Conclusion: 比较不同信用分配规则时必须匹配有效样本量，否则测到的是训练剂量而非信用内容本身。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Multifingered grasping is a crucial robotic skill, but current deep-learning grasp planners often struggle to generalize to new objects because they are trained on limited, object-specific datasets. We introduce a fundamentally different approach, grounded in the observation that the gripper and the object share identical surface geometry at their mutual contact points. We propose GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation, a novel deep generative model that learns a compact latent representation of a specific gripper's contact surface distribution, enabling the efficient sampling of valid grasp configurations without relying on object-specific training data. We show that by introducing object features only at inference time, our model can effectively retrieve admissible contact areas that are compatible with the gripper's capabilities. We validate our approach through extensive experiments on established grasp protocols in both simulated and real-world scenarios, demonstrating its effectiveness with different grippers from the literature. Our method delivers state-of-the-art results on the objects from the MultiDex dataset, achieving an average success rate of 86.93%. It offers significantly faster processing when generating numerous grasps, while matching the performance of leading approaches specifically trained on this dataset. Unlike these methods, our approach does not rely on object-specific training data, highlighting the advantages of object-agnostic learning. It effectively addresses the generalization challenges faced by traditional data-driven grasp planners. Code and videos are available on our project website https://cea-list.github.io/goagweb/ .
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GOAG，一个生成式且与物体无关 (object-agnostic) 的灵巧手抓取规划器。核心观察是抓取器与物体在其相互接触点上具有相同的表面几何，因此模型仅学习抓取器接触表面的紧凑潜在分布，并在推理时才引入物体特征来采样可行抓取配置。在 MultiDex 数据集上平均成功率达 86.93%，且无需物体特定的训练数据即可匹配在该数据集上专门训练的最先进方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有多指抓取深度学习方法通常依赖有限且物体特定的数据集，难以泛化到新物体；本文希望突破这一泛化瓶颈，避免使用物体特定训练数据。
Method: 提出一种深度生成模型，学习特定抓取器接触表面分布的紧凑潜在表征；训练时不使用物体特定数据，仅在推理阶段引入物体特征来检索与抓取器能力兼容的可行接触区域，从而高效采样有效抓取构型。
Result: 在仿真和真实场景的既有抓取协议上进行了广泛验证，并在 MultiDex 物体上获得平均 86.93% 的成功率；在生成大量抓取时处理速度显著更快，同时性能与专门在该数据集上训练的主流方法相当。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法的物体无关学习有效应对了传统数据驱动抓取规划器的泛化挑战，代码和视频已公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 GOAG，一个生成式且与物体无关 (object-agnostic) 的灵巧手抓取规划器。核心观察是抓取器与物体在其相互接触点上具有相同的表面几何，因此模型仅学习抓取器接触表面的紧凑潜在分布，并在推理时才引入物体特征来采样可行抓取配置。在 MultiDex 数据集上平均成功率达 86.93%，且无需物体特定的训练数据即可匹配在该数据集上专门训练的最先进方法的性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有多指抓取深度学习方法通常依赖有限且物体特定的数据集，难以泛化到新物体；本文希望突破这一泛化瓶颈，避免使用物体特定训练数据。

papers.title: GenMatch: An End-to-End Generative Matching Framework for Micro-View Order-Dispatching in Ride-Hailing
papers.abstract_en: Micro-View Order-Dispatching assigns available drivers to passenger orders within each dispatch batch and is critical to the service quality and operational efficiency of ride-hailing platforms. Mainstream industrial solutions follow a multi-stage paradigm of model prediction, value calculation, and dispatch matching. Although dispatch quality is determined by the final batch-level assignment, these stages optimize different intermediate objectives. This cross-stage objective inconsistency means that improving a single stage does not necessarily improve the overall dispatch result. We therefore formulate Micro-View Order-Dispatching as a generative matching problem and propose GenMatch, an end-to-end Generative Matching framework and the first such framework deployed in a real-world production environment. Applying generative modeling to this problem introduces three challenges. First, each dispatch batch forms a dynamic sparse bipartite graph, requiring efficient structured batch-level encoding. Second, replacing the hand-crafted value function requires learning unified business utility from heterogeneous feedback. Third, directly generating an assignment requires tracking the evolving matching state because each selected order-driver pair changes the remaining feasible candidates. GenMatch addresses these challenges with a Context-Aware Bipartite Encoder, a Business-Aware Utility Learner, and a State-Aware Pointer Decoder. Extensive offline evaluations and online A/B tests in five cities across DiDi's international ride-hailing markets show consistent improvements over competitive baselines, confirming the effectiveness and practicality of GenMatch for industrial order-dispatching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenMatch，一个端到端的生成式匹配框架，用于网约车平台中的微视角订单派单（Micro-View Order-Dispatching），旨在解决多阶段流水线中模型预测、价值计算与派单匹配目标不一致的问题。GenMatch 由上下文感知二分图编码器（Context-Aware Bipartite Encoder）、业务感知效用学习器（Business-Aware Utility Learner）和状态感知指针解码器（State-Aware Pointer Decoder）组成，并已在滴滴国际业务五个城市进行离线评估与在线 A/B 测试。
Motivation: 主流工业方案采用模型预测、价值计算和派单匹配的多阶段范式，各阶段优化不同的中间目标，导致单阶段改进不一定会提升最终批级派单结果。作者将微视角订单派单重新表述为生成式匹配问题，以端到端方式优化最终分配。
Method: 提出了 GenMatch 框架：用上下文感知二分图编码器处理每个派单批次形成的动态稀疏二分图；用业务感知效用学习器从异构反馈中学习统一的业务效用以替代手工设计的价值函数；用状态感知指针解码器跟踪匹配状态，因为每个已选订单-司机对会改变剩余可行候选集合。
Result: 离线评估与在线 A/B 测试覆盖滴滴国际出行市场的五个城市，结果显示 GenMatch 相对于竞争基线取得一致改进，并且是首个部署于真实生产环境的此类框架。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 GenMatch 对工业订单派单具有有效性和实用性，强调端到端生成式匹配能够改善整体派单质量。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Truncate Bad, Upweight Good: BoN-Style Distillation via Rank-Based Classification
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time selection methods, such as Best-of-N, improve generation by sampling a pool of candidates and selecting the top-ranked completion according to a reward model. Distillation seeks to amortize this procedure into a single policy by replacing raw rewards with in-pool ranks and learning a policy that upweights higher-ranked completions. However, existing rank-based policies typically use smooth full-support reweighting, so low-ranked completions receive less mass but remain in the target support. Although a sharper reweighting reduces lower-tail mass, it also increases reliance on brittle ranking at the top made by a single reward model. We propose TUP: a Truncate-bad, Upweight-good Policy that removes low-ranked completions from the support and reweights only the retained upper tail with a tunable sharpness. TUP admits a closed-form, prompt-independent normalization and can be trained fully offline via binary cross-entropy, using shifted-truncated win-rates as soft labels and distilled-to-reference log-likelihood ratios as logits. Theoretically, under certain assumptions, we show that for any unknown oracle reward, the best monotone rank-reweighting can be matched by a lower-tail truncation rule, providing formal support for removing the lower tail rather than merely downweighting it. Empirically, we show that TUP is competitive with strong offline alignment baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TUP（Truncate-bad, Upweight-good Policy），一种基于排序的蒸馏方法，用于将 Best-of-N 推理时选择过程摊销到单一策略中。TUP 将低排名完成从支持集中截断，仅对保留的上尾部分按可调锐度重新加权，并通过二元交叉熵完全离线训练，使用 shifted-truncated win-rates 作为软标签、distilled-to-reference log-likelihood ratios 作为 logits。理论上证明在特定假设下，任何未知 oracle reward 的最优单调排序重加权都可被下尾截断规则匹配；实验表明 TUP 与强离线对齐基线相当。
Motivation: 现有基于排序的策略通常使用光滑的全支持重加权，低排名完成虽然被降权但仍保留在目标支持集中；更尖锐的重加权虽能减少下尾质量，却会加剧对单一奖励模型在顶部脆弱排序的依赖。
Method: 提出 TUP：将低排名完成从支持集中截断，只对保留的上尾部分进行具有可调锐度的重加权。该方法具有闭式的、与提示无关的归一化，并可通过二元交叉熵完全离线训练，其中 soft labels 采用 shifted-truncated win-rates，logits 采用 distilled-to-reference log-likelihood ratios。
Result: 理论上证明，在特定假设下，任意未知 oracle reward 的最优单调排序重加权都能被下尾截断规则匹配，为移除下尾而非仅降权提供了形式化支持；经验上，TUP 与强离线对齐基线表现相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调下尾截断优于单纯降权在排序蒸馏中的理论正当性，并提供了一种简单的离线训练框架；但未报告具体数值或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gallileo-4D: Frozen Backbone Ensemble for Dynamic 4D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We describe our entry to the PhysAI Dynamic 4D Reconstruction Challenge, which placed third of 27 teams at 0.58356 APD on the final leaderboard, without a single gradient update. This was not the plan: of thirteen fine-tuning configurations of a pre-trained 4D backbone, twelve degraded the challenge score, and eleven of those twelve improved local validation at the same time. We trace this inversion to the structure of the benchmark: only 25% of the evaluation set belongs to the data variant released for training, so updates that fit the available data damage the pre-trained features the remaining 75% relies on. Our system therefore freezes the backbone and spends its budget at inference time, fusing three decoding configurations -- temporal stride-3, horizontal-flip test-time augmentation, and dense stride-1 -- under a convex weighting. The ensemble recovers +0.041 APD over the frozen baseline, more than any training run achieved, at zero training cost.
papers.comment: Technical report for the PhysAI Dynamic 4D Reconstruction Challenge at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Physical AI. Third of 27 teams. 14 pages, 10 figures. Code: https://github.com/odaxai/Gallileo-4D Weights: https://huggingface.co/OdaxAI/gallileo-4d-weights
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Gallileo-4D 在 ECCV 2026 PhysAI Dynamic 4D Reconstruction Challenge 中的参赛方案，最终以 0.58356 APD 位列 27 支队伍中的第三名，且全程未做任何梯度更新。作者冻结预训练 4D backbone，把计算预算花在推理期，通过凸权重融合三种解码配置（temporal stride-3、水平翻转测试时增强、dense stride-1）得到集成模型，相比冻结基线提升 +0.041 APD，超过任意一次训练微调的效果。
Motivation: 作者发现预训练 4D backbone 的微调在挑战分数上出现反直觉退化：13 个微调配置中 12 个降低挑战分数，但其中 11 个同时改善本地验证。原因是评估集只有 25% 属于训练发布的数据变体，其余 75% 依赖预训练特征，拟合可用数据的更新会破坏这些特征。
Method: 系统冻结预训练 4D backbone，不进行梯度更新，在推理阶段融合三种解码配置：temporal stride-3、水平翻转测试时增强 (horizontal-flip test-time augmentation) 和 dense stride-1，并使用凸权重做集成。
Result: 该集成方案在最终榜单上取得 0.58356 APD，排名第三（共 27 队），相对冻结基线提升 +0.041 APD，超过所有训练微调配置带来的收益，且训练成本为零。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在训练与评估数据变体不匹配时，推理期集成比微调更有效；同时指出本地验证与挑战基准存在显著背离，微调改善本地验证并不能转化为更高的挑战分数。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Question-Guided Evidence Acquisition for Multimodal Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal LLMs can see a document, but they often can't read it reliably. Small text, tables, visual cues, and topological elements still trip them up under direct visual inference, even when the page is already sitting in the model's context. Most document-VQA systems treat perception as fixed: they encode the page once, ask the question, and answer from whatever the model happened to extract in that single fast pass. We think document VQA needs slower, more deliberate perception: rather than answering from one fixed encoding, the model should spend a bit of extra compute at inference time working out what to look at next, and only then answer. We build this into \textbf{Q-Guide}, a small agent that reads a question, works out what evidence it is still missing, and calls targeted tool(s) to recover it---reading text where text is needed, zooming in where detail is needed, or grounding a region where position matters. On DocVQA2026 and Manga109, Q-Guide outperforms both direct prompting and recent multi-agent document systems ($65.0\%$ vs.\ $40.0\%$ on DocVQA2026, $32.4\%$ vs.\ $24.4\%$ on Manga109), and the improvement holds across three Claude backbones (Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, and Opus 4.5). We find that accuracy scales with the perception budget---most of the gain appears within two to three deliberate rounds---and that the gain comes from directing perception to the right place, not from complex control logic: adding planners, routers, or multiple collaborating agents does not help.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Q-Guide，一个基于问题引导的证据获取智能体，用于多模态文档视觉问答。Q-Guide 先读取问题并判断缺失的证据，再调用定向工具（如读取文本、放大细节、区域定位）来补充感知，而不是像传统系统那样仅对页面做一次固定编码后直接回答。摘要报告其在 DocVQA2026 和 Manga109 上显著优于直接提示和近期多智能体文档系统，并指出收益主要来自将感知引导到正确位置，而非复杂的控制逻辑。
Motivation: 多模态大模型能“看到”文档，但直接视觉推断下仍难以可靠读取小字号文本、表格、视觉线索和拓扑元素。现有文档 VQA 系统将感知视为固定过程，只编码页面一次后直接回答，导致模型容易遗漏所需证据；作者认为文档 VQA 需要更慢、更审慎的感知。
Method: 构建 Q-Guide 小型智能体：读取问题后推理还缺少哪些证据，并调用定向工具来获取这些证据——需要文本时读取文字、需要细节时放大、需要位置信息时对区域进行 grounding，然后再作答。
Result: 在 DocVQA2026 上 Q-Guide 达 65.0%，对比直接提示为 40.0%；在 Manga109 上为 32.4% 对比 24.4%，且该提升在 Claude Opus 4.6、Sonnet 4.6 和 Opus 4.5 三个骨干模型上均成立。提升幅度随感知预算（perception budget）增加而增长，大部分增益在两到三轮内出现；增加 planner、router 或多个协作智能体并无帮助。
Conclusion: 作者认为文档 VQA 应将额外推理计算投入“下一步看哪里”的定向感知，而非复杂的控制逻辑；精确引导感知方向是性能提升的关键。

papers.title: Learning to Beat: Phenotype-Guided Latent Flow with Regional Motion Priors for Biventricular Motion Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Full-cycle biventricular geometry is essential for characterizing cardiac function. However, dense and temporally consistent 3D+t biventricular meshes are not routinely available, whereas end-diastolic (ED) anatomy can often be obtained reliably. We therefore investigate full-cycle biventricular motion synthesis from a single ED mesh. This task is challenging because cardiac deformation is spatially heterogeneous and phenotype dependent, while conventional global generative models often obscure localized motion patterns. In this study, we propose a region-specific and phenotype-adaptive framework that integrates motion-informed functional parcellation with conditional latent flow. A functional partition learned from reconstructed motion organizes the ventricular surface into regions with coherent dynamics and enables topology-aware regional feature exchange. A phenotype-conditioned rectified-flow model subsequently maps the ED anatomy to full-cycle motion latents through fine-grained conditioning and prototype-routed motion adapters. An optional control branch further incorporates available motion descriptors for controllable synthesis. Experiments on ACDC, M\&Ms, and M\&Ms-2 demonstrate consistent improvements in geometric accuracy and functional fidelity. Under ED-only synthesis, our method achieves biventricular ASSD, HD95, and vRMSE of \(1.49\pm0.34\)~mm, \(3.77\pm1.06\)~mm, and \(3.31\pm1.03\)~mm, respectively, outperforming all competing methods. Complementary functional and robustness evaluations further demonstrate that the synthesized sequences preserve physiologically plausible ventricular dynamics and generalize across cohorts and disease phenotypes. The code will be released publicly upon acceptance of the manuscript for publication.

TL;DR: 本文研究从单个舒张末期 (ED) 心室网格合成全周期双心室运动的任务，提出一个区域特定且表型自适应的框架，将运动信息的功能分区与条件潜流 (conditional latent flow) 结合。方法在 ACDC、M&Ms 和 M&Ms-2 上对比现有方法取得一致的几何精度与功能保真度提升，并验证了合成序列的生理合理性与跨队列泛化能力。
Motivation: 全周期双心室几何对表征心脏功能很重要，但稠密且时间一致的 3D+t 双心室网格难以常规获取，而 ED 解剖结构通常可以可靠获得。心脏形变在空间上异质且依赖表型，传统全局生成模型容易掩盖局部运动模式，因此需要区域特定且表型自适应的运动合成方法。
Method: 提出一个区域特定、表型自适应的框架：先从重建运动中学习功能分区，将心室表面划分为具有一致动力学的区域并支持拓扑感知的区域特征交换；随后用表型条件的修正流模型 (rectified-flow) 将 ED 解剖映射到全周期运动潜变量，通过细粒度条件与原型路由的运动适配器 (prototype-routed motion adapters) 实现；另设可选控制分支以纳入已有的运动描述符进行可控合成。
Result: 在 ACDC、M&Ms 与 M&Ms-2 上，方法在几何准确度和功能保真度上均一致提升。仅用 ED 合成时，双心室 ASSD、HD95 和 vRMSE 分别达到 1.49±0.34 mm、3.77±1.06 mm 和 3.31±1.03 mm，优于所有对比方法；功能与鲁棒性评估表明合成序列保持生理上合理的室壁动力学，并能泛化到不同队列和疾病表型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能在仅有 ED 解剖的条件下生成生理合理且跨队列泛化的全周期双心室运动序列，并有可选的运动描述符控制分支；代码将在论文接收后公开。

papers.title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attack against Large Vision-Language Models via Subtitle Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding and reasoning. Despite extensive studies on text- and image-based jailbreaks, video jailbreaks against LVLMs remain largely unexplored. Existing video jailbreak methods mainly manipulate textual content embedded in videos, while overlooking how such information is organized over time. Our analysis reveals that jailbreak effectiveness depends not only on the semantics of textual information but also on its temporal presentation, including duration and timing-slot allocation. Motivated by this finding, we use subtitles, which are common in real-world videos and allow semantic content to be presented under precise temporal control without appearing visually intrusive, as a natural attack medium. Based on this insight, we propose TempJail, a black-box video-based jailbreak framework that constructs query-aligned dialogue-style subtitle sequences and optimizes their temporal scheduling to exploit temporal vulnerabilities in LVLMs and elicit responses that satisfy the harmful intent of the source query. Extensive experiments on four representative LVLMs and two datasets demonstrate that TempJail achieves the highest attack success rate across all evaluated model--dataset settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by 53 and 18 percentage points in dataset-averaged ASR on GPT-5 and Gemini 3.5-Flash, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的视频越狱攻击，发现越狱有效性不仅取决于视频中文本信息的语义，还取决于其时间呈现方式（持续时长和时隙分配）。作者提出 TempJail，一个黑盒视频越狱框架，利用字幕作为攻击载体，构造与查询对齐的对话式字幕序列并优化其时间调度。实验在四个代表性 LVLM 和两个数据集上取得最高攻击成功率，在 GPT-5 和 Gemini 3.5-Flash 上分别比最强基线高出 53 和 18 个百分点（数据集平均 ASR）。
Motivation: 文本和图像越狱已被广泛研究，但针对 LVLM 的视频越狱仍较少探索；现有视频越狱方法主要操纵视频中嵌入的文本内容，而忽略了此类信息在时间上的组织方式。作者的分析表明，越狱效果同时取决于文本语义词义及其时间呈现，因此需要利用这一时间维度。
Method: 提出 TempJail，一个黑盒视频越狱框架，以现实视频中常见且不具视觉侵入性的字幕为攻击媒介；该方法构造与源查询对齐的对话式字幕序列，并优化其时间调度以利用 LVLM 的时间漏洞，从而诱导模型产出满足有害意图的响应。
Result: 在四个代表性 LVLM 和两个数据集上的大量实验表明，TempJail 在所有模型-数据集组合中取得最高攻击成功率，在数据集平均 ASR 上分别超过最强基线 GPT-5 达 53 个百分点、Gemini 3.5-Flash 达 18 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调时间调度是视频越狱攻击中此前被忽视的关键维度，并将字幕调度作为可行的黑盒攻击手段。该工作的范围集中于基于视频字幕的时间漏洞挖掘，未涉及其他模态或防御层面的验证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: RecPFN: Prior-Fitted Networks for In-Context-Based Recommendations
papers.abstract_en: We introduce RecPFN, a prior-fitted network that brings in-context learning to sequential recommendation. RecPFN is pretrained entirely on synthetic clickstream environments sampled from a broad structural causal prior, enabling it to amortize Bayesian-style inference from a small support set. At inference, a lightweight decoder-only transformer conditions on a handful of domain sequences and produces next-item predictions for queries in a single forward pass, without any weight updates. Across eight public benchmarks, RecPFN achives state-of-the-art zero-shot performance while remaining strongly competitive with supervised methods in low-compute and low-data regimes. It is deployment-efficient and robust to domain shift, outperforming strong zero-shot baselines that rely on large real-interaction corpora. RecPFN provides a practical path toward generalizable, data-efficient recommenders and opens avenues for richer priors, longer-context ICL, and multimodal extensions. Code for training and evaluation is publicly available at https://github.com/SAP-samples/tabular-ai-recpfn/.
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval, pp. 1731-1742. 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RecPFN，一种 prior-fitted network，将上下文学习 (in-context learning) 引入序列推荐。模型完全在从广泛结构因果先验中采样的合成点击流环境上预训练，从而能够从少量支持集 (support set) 上摊销贝叶斯式推断。推理时，一个轻量级 decoder-only Transformer 以少量域序列为条件，在单次前向传播中产生下一项预测，无需任何权重更新。在八个公开基准上取得最先进的零样本表现，并在低计算、低数据场景下与监督方法保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有序列推荐器通常依赖大规模真实交互语料并需要重新训练，泛化性和数据效率受限；本文旨在借助上下文学习提供一条通用且数据高效的推荐路径。
Method: 提出先验拟合网络 RecPFN：在由结构因果先验生成的合成点击流环境上预训练，使模型学习从少量示例中推断；推理阶段用 decoder-only Transformer 以若干域序列为条件，对查询项进行单次前向的下一项预测，不更新权重。
Result: 在八个公开基准上，RecPFN 达到零样本最优性能，在低计算和低数据场景下与监督方法相当；对域偏移具有鲁棒性，并超过依赖大规模真实交互语料的强零样本基线。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该方法为通用、数据高效的推荐系统提供了可行路径，并指出未来方向包括更丰富的先验、更长上下文的 ICL 以及多模态扩展。

papers.title: SafeBranch: Branch-Pair Safety Alignment for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-model-based embodied agents can complete instructed tasks but often violate safety constraints in the process, a problem recently framed as interactive safety. Training such agents to act safely is difficult, since safety and task success are distinct objectives, and safety arises only at a small number of safety-critical steps within a trajectory. Standard supervision is insufficient: imitating safe trajectories teaches behavior without explaining why it is safe, and contrasting arbitrary safe and unsafe trajectories mixes the safety signal with unrelated differences. We propose SafeBranch, a framework that aligns an embodied actor on safety through branch pairs constructed from the actor's own unsafe rollouts via environment rollback. SafeBranch rolls each unsafe rollout back to the safety-critical step that caused the violation, queries the actor for a safe alternative, and pairs the original action with the alternative so that the two branches differ only at that step. The trained actor acts safely at deployment with no critic in the loop. On IS-Bench, SafetyALFRED, and out-of-distribution variants with unseen tasks and objects, it handles safety reliably without sacrificing task success, achieving roughly ten times more safe successes than the untrained baseline on the unseen-object variant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言模型驱动的具身智能体在完成任务时违反安全约束的问题，提出 SafeBranch 框架。该框架利用环境回滚 (environment rollback) 从智能体自身的不安全轨迹中构造分支对：将轨迹回滚到导致违规的安全关键步骤，让智能体生成一个安全替代动作，使两个分支仅在那一小步上不同，从而用分支对进行安全对齐。部署时不需要任何评论器 (critic) 参与，训练后的智能体在保持任务成功率的同时可靠地保证安全。
Motivation: 具身智能体的安全与任务成功是两个不同的优化目标，且安全约束只出现在一条轨迹中的少量安全关键步骤上，因此标准监督不足以训练安全行为：直接模仿安全轨迹不解释其安全原因，而对比任意的安全与不安全轨迹会把安全信号与无关差异混在一起。
Method: SafeBranch 从智能体自身的不安全 rollout 出发，通过环境回滚定位并回退到引发违规的安全关键步骤，再向智能体查询一个安全替代动作，将原动作与替代动作配对，构造出仅在关键步骤不同的两条分支，并以此对齐具身 actor。
Result: 在 IS-Bench、SafetyALFRED 以及包含未见任务和未见物体的分布外 (out-of-distribution) 变体上，SafeBranch 在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下可靠地处理安全约束；在未见物体变体上，其安全成功次数约为未训练基线的十倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，只改变安全关键步骤的分支对可以让安全信号与任务信号解耦，训练后的智能体部署时无需评论器在环即可保持安全行为。
Relevance: 0
