papers.title: A Locally Tokenized Generative Model for Robust Time-Series Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking is a central tool for provenance in generative models, yet its application to multivariate time series remains hindered by reliability failures under post-editing attacks. We show that existing detectors, which rely on globally coupled re-encoding, suffer from bidirectional drift of the null distribution: post-editing attacks can shift the z-score of non-watermarked samples in either direction, invalidating clean-calibrated thresholds. We argue that this instability is a property of the re-encoding, and that reliable detection requires each recovered unit to depend only on a bounded temporal neighborhood. Guided by this principle, we propose L-VQVAE, a generative model in which each discrete token is produced from a short contiguous window, and LVQMark, a watermarking method over this token space that combines logit-bias injection with robust re-encoding for attack-time detection. Experiments on four benchmarks spanning finance, energy, and neuroimaging show that our approach preserves generation quality while stabilizing both detection power and false-positive behavior under post-editing attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多变量时间序列水印在后处理攻击下可靠性差的问题，指出现有基于全局耦合重编码的检测器会发生零分布的双向漂移，导致按干净数据标定的阈值失效。作者提出生成模型 L-VQVAE，使每个离散 token 只依赖短的连续时间窗口，并在此基础上构建水印方法 LVQMark，将 logit-bias 注入与鲁棒重编码结合用于攻击时刻检测。在金融、能源和神经影像四个基准上的实验表明，该方法在保持生成质量的同时稳定了检测能力和误报行为。
Motivation: 时序数据溯源需要可靠水印，但现有检测器依赖全局耦合重编码，后处理攻击会使非水印样本的 z-score 向任一方向偏移，破坏基于干净数据标定的阈值；作者认为这种不稳定性源于重编码方式本身。
Method: 提出 L-VQVAE，一种每个离散 token 由短连续窗口生成的生成模型；并在该 token 空间上提出水印方法 LVQMark，组合 logit-bias 注入和鲁棒重编码，使每个恢复单元只依赖有界时间邻域。
Result: 在覆盖金融、能源和神经影像的四个基准上的实验表明，方法在保持生成质量的同时，稳定了后处理攻击下的检测能力和假阳性行为。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可靠的时序水印检测需要恢复单元只依赖有界时间邻域，而非全局重编码。

papers.title: Projector Is All You Train
papers.abstract_en: The typical training process of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) involves adapting both the language model backbone and the projector between the backbone and a modality-specific encoder. We ask whether fine-tuning the backbone of an MLLM is necessary to adapt it to a new modality. Through experiments on 3D MLLMs, we find that training only the projector is sufficient to achieve strong multimodal performance relative to existing baseline models and our jointly trained MLLMs with the same encoder and backbone. We also show that joint training leads to undesirable drift in existing capabilities of the language model, which projector-only training avoids by definition. Furthermore, projector-only training has approximately twice the training sample throughput of joint training. We validate our findings across different language model backbones via 3D classification and captioning benchmarks as well as standard benchmarks evaluating language, vision, and spatial reasoning capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大语言模型（MLLM）适配新模态时是否必须微调语言模型主干。作者在3D MLLM上实验发现，只训练projector即可达到与联合训练相近的强多模态性能；联合训练会导致语言模型已有能力漂移，而projector-only训练从定义上避免该问题，且样本吞吐量约为联合训练的两倍。结果在多个语言模型骨架上通过3D分类与captioning基准以及语言、视觉、空间推理基准得到验证。
Motivation: 典型MLLM训练同时适配语言模型主干和projector，作者质疑适配新模态时微调主干是否必要；该问题关系到训练成本以及语言模型已有能力的保持。
Method: 提出只训练projector（projector-only training）的训练方案，并在相同encoder和backbone条件下与联合训练的MLLM及现有baseline模型进行对比，跨多个语言模型骨干验证。
Result: 实验表明只训练projector即可获得强多模态性能，接近现有baseline和联合训练模型；联合训练会造成语言模型已有能力的不期望漂移，而projector-only训练的样本吞吐量约为联合训练的两倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为projector-only训练足以将MLLM适配到新模态，同时避免能力漂移并提升训练效率；该结论在3D MLLM场景下得到验证。

papers.title: StreamSoccer: Event-Driven Memory for Streaming Soccer Commentary
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires models to causally update state as video arrives and organize growing history into semantic units that can evolve, persist, and be recalled under bounded computation and memory. This challenge is pronounced in live soccer commentary, where a system must describe completed events, summarize recent play, recall earlier events, or remain silent using only information available before each utterance. We present StreamSoccer, an event-driven system that uses event memory as its intermediate representation. A fixed-budget active memory integrates the stream; completed event states are retained locally and consolidated into retrievable historical records. A unified generator uses current, recent, and historical context to produce three commentary modes, while a rule-assisted scheduler selects a mode or silence. Unlike streaming video-language models organized around frames, visual tokens, or caches, and soccer-commentary methods based on predefined clips or output timestamps, StreamSoccer explicitly models event lifecycles. We construct a three-track streaming soccer commentary dataset and a layered evaluation protocol. At common reference anchors, StreamSoccer obtains CIDEr scores of 38.62, 23.96, and 17.39 for current-event, recent-window, and historical-memory commentary, ranking first on the current-event and historical-memory tracks and second on recent-window. Controlled ablations show that local completed events improve all tracks and that the full system performs best on all three. Across 174 raw-video runs on 58 matches, per-minute RTF p95 ranges from 0.10 to 0.22 without sustained growth with match history. These results indicate that event memory supports streaming soccer commentary across temporal scopes while controlling long-history computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamSoccer，一个基于事件驱动记忆的事件级流式足球解说生成系统。系统以固定预算的活跃记忆整合直播流，将完成的事件状态保留为可检索的历史记录，并由统一生成器结合当前、近期与历史上下文产生三种解说模式，配合规则辅助调度器决定输出内容或保持沉默。作者构建了三轨流式足球解说数据集与分层评估协议，在公共参考锚点上获得当前事件、近期窗口与历史记忆三类解说的 CIDEr 分数 38.62、23.96 与 17.39，并在当前事件与历史记忆轨上排名第一。实时性方面，58 场比赛共 174 次原始视频运行中，每分钟 RTF 的 p95 在 0.10 到 0.22 之间且不随比赛历史持续增长。
Motivation: 流式视频理解要求模型在视频到达时因果地更新状态，并在有限计算和内存下将不断增长的历史组织成可演化、可持久、可召回语义单元；直播足球解说中系统需要描述已完成事件、总结近期比赛、回忆更早事件或保持沉默，且只能使用每次发声之前的信息。
Method: StreamSoccer 使用事件记忆作为中间表示：固定预算的活跃记忆整合输入流，完成的事件状态在本地保留并整合为可检索的历史记录；统一的生成器使用当前、近期和历史上下文输出三种解说模式，规则辅助调度器负责选择模式或输出静默。
Result: 在公共参考锚点上，当前事件、近期窗口和历史记忆三类解说的 CIDEr 分别为 38.62、23.96 和 17.39，系统在当前事件与历史记忆轨上排名第一、近期窗口轨排名第二；消融实验表明本地已完成事件提升所有轨道的表现，完整系统在所有轨道上最好。实时性上，174 次原始视频运行中每分钟 RTF 的 p95 为 0.10 至 0.22，且不随比赛历史长度持续增长。
Conclusion: 作者认为事件记忆能够在不同时间尺度上支持流式足球解说，同时控制长期历史的计算开销。

papers.title: Scale-Separated Conditioning for Style-Encoder-Free Diffusion Stylization
papers.abstract_en: Reference-based diffusion stylization requires separating target geometry from transferable appearance. Existing tuning-based methods often rely on aligned content-style-target triplets or auxiliary visual encoders, which increases data cost and can transfer unintended scene structure from the style reference. We propose SEFS (Style-Encoder-Free Stylization), a style-encoder-free conditioning framework for diffusion transformers. SEFS forms style tokens from stochastic low-resolution crops of single training images. This crop bottleneck preserves local appearance statistics such as palette, stroke, texture, and material, while reducing access to global layout cues. Target content is encoded by edge and segmentation cues and fused with the noisy latent through parameter-efficient trainable projections. We add style-to-denoising re-normalization for token-statistic alignment and cross-block skip fusion for spatial detail. SEFS trains on unpaired single images; the frozen diffusion VAE is used only to place image conditions in the latent space. On artistic stylization benchmarks, SEFS improves content consistency and leakage diagnostics while retaining reference-style affinity, and ablations support the crop-resolution, re-normalization, and skip-fusion choices. The code of SEFS will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEFS（Style-Encoder-Free Stylization），一种无需风格编码器的扩散模型风格化框架，面向 diffusion transformers。SEFS 从单张训练图像的随机低分辨率裁剪中构造风格 token，通过裁剪瓶颈保留局部外观统计（如调色、笔触、纹理、材质），同时减少全局布局线索的传递；目标内容由边缘和分割线索编码，并通过参数高效的投影与噪声潜变量融合。实验在艺术风格化基准上显示内容一致性与泄漏诊断提升，同时保持参考风格接近度，代码将公开。
Motivation: 现有基于参考图的扩散风格化方法需要将目标几何与可迁移外观分离，但基于微调的方法常依赖对齐的内容-风格-目标三元组或辅助视觉编码器，数据成本高，且可能从风格参考图中迁移非预期的场景结构。
Method: 提出 SEFS 框架：从单个训练图像的随机低分辨率裁剪中形成风格 token，利用该裁剪瓶颈过滤全局布局；目标内容通过边缘和分割线索编码，并用参数高效的可训练投影与噪声潜变量融合。还引入风格到去噪的重归一化（style-to-denoising re-normalization）实现 token 统计对齐，以及跨块跳跃融合（cross-block skip fusion）保留空间细节。训练使用未配对的单张图像，冻结的扩散 VAE 仅用于将图像条件放入潜空间。
Result: 在艺术风格化基准上，SEFS 相比基线提升了内容一致性和泄漏诊断指标，同时保留了参考风格接近度；消融实验支持了裁剪分辨率、重归一化和跳跃融合这三个设计选择。
Conclusion: 作者认为风格编码器无关的条件化框架可以在不依赖对齐三元组或外部视觉编码器的情况下实现更干净的内容-风格分离，并计划公开代码。

papers.title: Robust Cross-Modal Foundation Model Perception for Underwater Robots under Degraded Visual Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Reliable underwater robotic perception remains difficult because optical imagery degrades under turbidity, wavelength-dependent attenuation, low illumination, scattering, and blur. Although sonar provides complementary information that is less affected by optical visibility, prior visual-sonar research has largely focused on feature alignment and nominal detection performance. We investigate cross-modal robustness as visual reliability deteriorates and assess whether pretrained visual foundation-model representations can be complemented by sonar under severe degradation. We use frozen DINOv2 as the visual encoder and construct a controlled five-level benchmark ranging from clean to extreme visual conditions. We compare conventional visual detection, frozen foundation-model representations, sonar context, fixed multimodal fusion, clean-trained adaptive gating, and degradation-aware gated fusion. Our method trains the fusion mechanism across the full range of degradation while keeping the visual and sonar encoders frozen, allowing modality contributions to adapt without fine-tuning the pretrained backbone. Under extreme combined degradation, the DINOv2 baseline achieves 0.4610 balanced accuracy, while degradation-aware visual-sonar fusion reaches 0.6152, a 33.5% relative improvement. The learned sonar contribution increases from 14.2% under clean conditions to 41.3% under extreme degradation, demonstrating adaptive redistribution of cross-modal reliance. Fusion provides the largest gains under severe turbidity and blur, whereas color attenuation alone yields little additional benefit. These results show that foundation-model representations remain valuable but insufficient under severe information loss, and that explicitly adapting fusion to modality reliability can improve robust underwater multimodal perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究水下光学图像在浑浊、波长相关衰减、低照度、散射和模糊等退化条件下的鲁棒感知问题，探索冻结视觉基础模型表示能否与声纳信息互补。作者使用冻结的DINOv2作为视觉编码器，构建从干净到极端条件的五级受控基准，并比较多种融合策略。实验显示，在极端联合退化下，退化感知的视觉-声纳融合相比DINOv2基线将平衡准确率从0.4610提升到0.6152，相对提升33.5%，且声纳贡献从干净条件下的14.2%自适应上升到极端退化下的41.3%。
Motivation: 水下光学感知在浑浊、低照度等退化条件下可靠性差，而声纳受光学可见度影响较小。但既有视觉-声纳研究多聚焦特征对齐和名义检测性能，没有系统考察视觉可靠性下降时跨模态鲁棒性，也未评估预训练视觉基础模型表示在严重退化下能否被声纳有效补充。
Method: 采用冻结的DINOv2作为视觉编码器，构建包含干净到极端条件的五级退化基准；对比传统视觉检测、冻结基础模型表示、声纳上下文、固定多模态融合、干净训练的自适应门控以及退化感知的门控融合。所提方法在完整退化范围内训练融合机制，保持视觉和声纳编码器冻结，使模态贡献自适应调整而无需微调预训练骨干。
Result: 在极端联合退化下，DINOv2基线平衡准确率为0.4610，退化感知的视觉-声纳融合达到0.6152，相对提升33.5%；声纳贡献从干净条件下的14.2%增至极端退化下的41.3%。融合在严重浑浊和模糊下收益最大，而仅颜色衰减带来的额外收益很小。
Conclusion: 基础模型表示在严重信息损失下仍具价值但不够充分，显式地根据模态可靠性调整融合可以改善水下多模态感知的鲁棒性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究水下光学图像在浑浊、波长相关衰减、低照度、散射和模糊等退化条件下的鲁棒感知问题，探索冻结视觉基础模型表示能否与声纳信息互补。作者使用冻结的DINOv2作为视觉编码器，构建从干净到极端条件的五级受控基准，并比较多种融合策略。实验显示，在极端联合退化下，退化感知的视觉-声纳融合相比DINOv2基线将平衡准确率从0.4610提升到0.6152，相对提升33.5%，且声纳贡献从干净条件下的14.2%自适应上升到极端退化下的41.3%。
summary_sections.motivation: 水下光学感知在浑浊、低照度等退化条件下可靠性差，而声纳受光学可见度影响较小。但既有视觉-声纳研究多聚焦特征对齐和名义检测性能，没有系统考察视觉可靠性下降时跨模态鲁棒性，也未评估预训练视觉基础模型表示在严重退化下能否被声纳有效补充。
summary_sections.method: 采用冻结的DINOv2作为视觉编码器，构建包含干净到极端条件的五级退化基准；对比传统视觉检测、冻结基础模型表示、声纳上下文、固定多模态融合、干净训练的自适应门控以及退化感知的门控融合。所提方法在完整退化范围内训练融合机制，保持视觉和声纳编码器冻结，使模态贡献自适应调整而无需微调预训练骨干。
summary_sections.result: 在极端联合退化下，DINOv2基线平衡准确率为0.4610，退化感知的视觉-声纳融合达到0.6152，相对提升33.5%；声纳贡献从干净条件下的14.2%增至极端退化下的41.3%。融合在严重浑浊和模糊下收益最大，而仅颜色衰减带来的额外收益很小。
summary_sections.conclusion: 基础模型表示在严重信息损失下仍具价值但不够充分，显式地根据模态可靠性调整融合可以改善水下多模态感知的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Loreley: Repository-Scale Program Evolution with Quality-Diversity Search
papers.abstract_en: Sequential agent search accumulates changes from its current champion but discards alternative branches; independent proposals preserve breadth but restart from the root. Loreley instead retains complete repository states in a Quality-Diversity (QD) archive and samples them as parents or supplies them as context for later edits. Candidates are Git commits produced in isolated worktrees and judged by a project-supplied evaluator. We compare configured Loreley QD, sequential champion editing, and independent root proposals in a matched Zstandard experiment: seven paired blocks and 48 physical candidate jobs per policy and block (1,008 total), with root-only initialization and each policy's native concurrency. Validation selected a winner at each budget checkpoint; an agent-hidden holdout measured the fixed candidate. At 48 jobs, QD was 0.135% below Sequential Champion (95% BCa interval for the paired effect: -0.556% to +0.161%) and 0.320% above Independent Root (-0.082% to +0.686%). Neither contrast established a QD advantage; Sequential had the highest observed 48-job mean and median. Archive retention and later sampling did occur. Four of seven final QD winners had a non-incumbent state in their primary-parent ancestry under a retrospective one-incumbent rule applied only to the observed QD stream. Including inspiration edges raised the count to six, without showing that supplied context caused an edit. Three earlier capability campaigns produced generation-4, multi-file improvements in two Python libraries and a separate Zstandard revision. Loreley engaged the intended stepping-stone mechanism, but the controlled experiment did not show an endpoint benefit at 48 jobs.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code and evidence: https://github.com/NeapolitanIcecream/loreley
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Loreley，一种在仓库规模上进行程序进化 (program evolution) 的搜索方法：不再像顺序智能体搜索那样只保留当前最优分支，也不像独立提案那样每次都从头开始，而是把所有候选仓库状态保存在质量-多样性 (Quality-Diversity, QD) 档案中，并从中采样作为父代或上下文进行后续编辑。候选以 Git 提交形式在隔离的 worktree 中产生，由项目提供的评估器判断。受控的 Zstandard 实验显示，在 48 个候选任务预算下 QD 相对于顺序冠军编辑没有显著优势，但档案保留与后续采样机制确实发生了。
Motivation: 顺序智能体搜索会丢弃替代分支，独立提案则保留多样性但每次都从根状态重启；两者分别牺牲广度或连续性。作者希望用 QD 档案同时保留完整仓库状态，兼顾搜索的连续性与分支多样性。
Method: Loreley 将完整的仓库状态存入 QD 档案，并从中选择父代或作为后续编辑的上下文；候选由隔离 worktree 中的 Git 提交构成，使用项目提供的评估器打分。实验采用匹配的 Zstandard 任务：七个配对块、每策略每块 48 个物理候选任务（共 1,008 个），仅根状态初始化，并比较 QD、顺序冠军编辑和独立根提案三种策略。
Result: 在 48 个候选任务下，QD 比 Sequential Champion 低 0.135%（配对效应 95% BCa 区间 -0.556% 到 +0.161%），比 Independent Root 高 0.320%（区间 -0.082% 到 +0.686%）；两个对比均未确立 QD 优势，Sequential 的 48 任务均值和均值中位数最高。回顾性分析中七个最终 QD 胜者有四个的主父系祖先含有非在位状态（包含启发边后为六个），但未证明提供的上下文导致了编辑。
Conclusion: Loreley 确实启动了预期的垫脚石 (stepping-stone) 机制，档案保留与后续采样均发生，但受控实验在 48 个候选任务的预算下未显示终点收益优势。

papers.title: Beyond Memory Majority: Latent-Source Reasoning for Multi-Agent Memory Arbitration
papers.abstract_en: Long-term multi-agent systems continuously accumulate the memories produced by different agents. Existing memory methods typically treat retrieved memories as independent evidence and combine them through voting or weighting. However, this independence assumption often fails in multi-agent settings: memories written by different agents may inherit the same upstream source or shared bias, causing correlated evidence to be repeatedly counted and creating a false majority. We term this failure mode \textit{Memory Correlation Bias}. To address the issue, we propose the \textbf{C}orrelation-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{M}emory \textbf{A}rbitration (CAMA) framework that jointly decouples retrieved memories and recovers missing independent evidence. We model the retrieved memories as query-conditioned evidence groups and combine neural dependency inference with provenance-based symbolic priors to estimate the effective number of independent evidence sources, thereby preventing correlated memories from forming a false majority. Since critical independent evidence may be absent from the initial retrieval set, \textsc{CAMA} further learns a sequential recovery policy that actively retrieves alternative evidence or traces upstream sources before making the final decision, aiming to recover sufficient independent evidence for reliable arbitration while minimizing retrieval cost. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our method over the state-of-the-art baseline methods, suppressing false majorities induced by correlated memories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出长期多智能体系统 (multi-agent systems) 中现有记忆方法常把检索到的记忆当作独立证据进行投票或加权，但不同智能体写入的记忆可能继承同一上游来源或共享偏差，导致相关证据被重复计数并形成虚假多数，作者称该失效模式为 Memory Correlation Bias。为此提出 Correlation-Aware Memory Arbitration (CAMA) 框架，联合解耦检索记忆并恢复缺失的独立证据：将记忆建模为查询条件下的证据组 (evidence groups)，结合神经依赖推断与基于溯源 (provenance) 的符号先验估计独立证据源的有效数量，并通过顺序恢复策略 (sequential recovery policy) 主动检索替代证据或追踪上游来源后再做最终决策。多个基准上的实验表明该方法优于现有 SOTA 基线，能抑制由相关记忆造成的虚假多数。
Motivation: 现有记忆仲裁方法假设检索到的记忆相互独立，并通过投票或加权聚合；但在多智能体设定下该假设常失效，不同记忆源之间的相关性会使同一证据被重复计入而形成虚假多数，影响长期记忆系统的可靠性。
Method: 提出 CAMA 框架：将检索记忆建模为查询条件下的证据组，用神经依赖推理结合溯源符号先验估计有效独立证据源数量，从而防止相关记忆形成虚假多数；同时学习一个顺序恢复策略，在最终决策前主动检索替代证据或回溯上游来源，在保证仲裁可靠性的同时最小化检索成本。
Result: 摘要在多个基准上的实验显示 CAMA 优于现有 SOTA 基线方法，能够抑制由相关记忆诱导的虚假多数；摘要未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调，显式建模记忆相关性并恢复缺失的独立证据，可以在控制检索成本的同时提高多智能体长期记忆仲裁的可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RIPE++: Reinforced Keypoint Learning from Positive Pairs Only
papers.abstract_en: Sparse keypoint extraction and matching underpin core tasks in geometric computer vision, including structure-from-motion, visual SLAM, augmented reality, and medical image registration. Learning robust local feature representations, however, typically requires accurate camera poses or depth supervision, which are often unavailable in real-world settings. Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as a promising alternative, requiring only the information if two images show the same scene or not. However, existing RL formulations such as RIPE rely on coarse binary rewards and carefully constructed negative training pairs, limiting training stability and descriptor discriminability. In this paper, we revisit RL-based keypoint learning and propose a reward that fully exploits the geometric consistency signal, deriving both reward and penalty from a single positive pair without contrasting against negatives. This richer signal provides sufficient supervisory contrast to learn discriminative detectors and descriptors from positive image pairs alone, enabling representation learning under extremely limited supervision. Furthermore, we show that the same RL objective can be extended to the matching stage by adapting LightGlue, raising AUC@5 on MegaDepth1500 from 56.58 to 59.65 and enabling weakly-supervised training of the full sparse matching pipeline from image pairs with partial visual overlap. We validate our approach on established benchmarks, demonstrating competitive results compared to fully-supervised methods. We further show that the method can be even trained on low texture medical video sequences, where camera poses are usually unavailable and standard SfM pipelines often fail. Code and data are available at https://github.com/fraunhoferhhi/RIPEpp .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RIPE++，一种仅使用正样本图像对的强化学习关键点学习方法。作者重新设计奖励，从单一正样本对中同时导出奖励与惩罚，不再依赖负样本对比，从而在极弱监督下学习判别性的检测器与描述子。该方法还将同一目标扩展到匹配阶段（适配 LightGlue），在 MegaDepth1500 上将 AUC@5 从 56.58 提升到 59.65，并能在低纹理医学视频序列上训练完整稀疏匹配流程。
Motivation: 现有局部特征学习通常需要相机位姿或深度监督，而真实场景中往往不可用；已有的强化学习方案（如 RIPE）依赖粗糙的二元奖励和精心构造的负样本对，限制了训练稳定性与描述子判别力。
Method: 提出一种充分挖掘几何一致性信号的奖励函数，仅从单个正样本对同时构造奖励和惩罚，无需与负样本对比；并将该 RL 目标扩展到匹配阶段，通过适配 LightGlue 实现整个稀疏匹配流程的弱监督训练。
Result: 摘要报告在 MegaDepth1500 上将 AUC@5 从 56.58 提升到 59.65，在既有基准上与全监督方法相比具有竞争力；该方法还可在通常缺乏相机位姿、标准 SfM 流程常失败的低纹理医学视频序列上训练。
Conclusion: 作者认为仅依赖正样本对的更丰富奖励信号足以提供监督对比，支持在极有限监督下学习判别性表示，并可弱监督训练完整的稀疏匹配流程。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Rethinking the Evaluation and Optimization of LLM-Based Social Simulation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based social simulation is a promising complement to traditional methods such as surveys and behavioral experiments. A core question is how to evaluate the fidelity of LLM-simulated human behavior and optimize LLMs toward it. Prevailing practice evaluates by accuracy, checking whether the model selects the single response observed from a human, and trains the LLM to reproduce this hard label. However, human behavior is inherently subjective: the same person in the same situation may reasonably act differently, so an observed response is only one draw from an underlying response distribution, rendering accuracy-based evaluation unreliable and hard-label training misleading. To address these problems, we first introduce the subjectivity coefficient, an entropy-based quantity distinguishing objective tasks such as coding from subjective ones such as social simulation, and use it to systematically analyze how accuracy-based evaluation and hard-label training fail as subjectivity grows. Based on the subjectivity coefficient, we propose Subjectivity-Adaptive soft-Label Training (SALT): it pools observed outputs from semantically nearby inputs into soft distributional labels, with an aggregation radius adapted to the estimated subjectivity of each input; in the near-objective limit the neighborhood shrinks, so SALT naturally falls back to standard single-label training. Moreover, since existing datasets record only single observed responses and cannot support distributional evaluation, we construct SUBJSIM, a benchmark of 19,300 contexts covering 193 annotators and 100 subjective questions. Since real-world data typically provide only a single observation per input, our experiments train models from single observed outputs while evaluating them against the full response distributions, verifying feasibility in realistic settings. Results on SUBJSIM demonstrate the advantages of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于 LLM 的社会仿真 (LLM-based social simulation) 的评估与优化问题，指出人类行为具有主观性，同一人在同一情境下可能有多种合理行为，因此观测响应只是底层响应分布的一次采样，基于准确率 (accuracy) 的评估和硬标签 (hard label) 训练会失效。作者提出基于熵的主观性系数 (subjectivity coefficient) 来区分客观任务与主观任务，并据此提出 Subjectivity-Adaptive soft-Label Training (SALT) 和包含 19,300 个上下文的 SUBJSIM 基准，实验结果验证了该方法在现实单观测设置下的优势。
Motivation: 现有实践用准确率判断模型是否选中人类观测的唯一响应，并训练 LLM 复现这种硬标签；但人类行为是主观的，观测响应只是潜在响应分布的一次抽样，导致基于准确率的评估不可靠、硬标签训练具有误导性。
Method: 提出熵-based 的主观性系数，用于区分编码等客观任务与社会仿真等主观任务，并系统分析准确率评估与硬标签训练随主观性增大而失效的机制。基于该系数提出 SALT：把语义相近输入的观测输出汇集为软分布标签，聚合半径随每个输入的主观性估计自适应调整，在近客观极限下退化为标准单标签训练；同时构建 SUBJSIM 基准，含 19,300 个上下文、193 位标注者和 100 个主观问题。
Result: 实验在 SUBJSIM 上验证了 SALT 的优势；训练仅使用每个输入的单个观测输出，评估则对照完整响应分布，验证了该方法在真实单观测数据场景下的可行性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于准确率的评估和硬标签训练在主观性任务上不可靠，主观性自适应的软标签训练能够改善 LLM 社会仿真的优化；论文验证了仅凭单个观测输出训练、按完整分布评估的可行性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning Deterministic and Stochastic Forced Hamiltonian Systems
papers.abstract_en: We develop a geometric framework for learning deterministic and stochastic forced Hamiltonian systems with neural networks. Motivated by the Lagrange-d'Alembert principle and the theory of variational integrators, we introduce the notion of a Lagrange-d'Alembert map and establish a $C^r$ convergence theorem for first-order one-step methods. Building on these results, we propose Generalized Forced Hamiltonian Neural Networks (GFHNNs), a class of structure-preserving neural networks obtained by concatenating Lagrange-d'Alembert-Euler maps, and prove a universal approximation theorem for this architecture. We further extend the framework to parameter-dependent systems, leading to Parametric Generalized Forced Hamiltonian Neural Networks (PGFHNNs). By interpreting the multiple Stratonovich integrals appearing in the Stratonovich-Taylor expansion as parameters, the same framework can be applied to stochastic forced Hamiltonian systems whenever information about the underlying Wiener process is available. Our numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed geometric architectures provide significantly improved long-time stability and accuracy compared to non-geometric residual neural networks, while requiring substantially less training data to achieve a comparable level of performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于学习确定性与随机强迫哈密顿系统的几何框架，引入 Lagrange-d'Alembert 映射并对一阶单步方法建立 C^r 收敛定理。基于该理论，作者提出 Generalized Forced Hamiltonian Neural Networks (GFHNNs) 及其参数化版本 PGFHNNs，并证明其万能逼近性质。数值实验显示这类几何结构保持网络相比非几何残差网络在长期稳定性和精度上显著更优，且训练所需数据更少。
Motivation: 现有神经网络学习动力学系统时通常忽略哈密顿结构，尤其在存在外力和随机扰动的情况下难以保证长期积分稳定性；作者希望将 Lagrange-d'Alembert 原理和变分积分器理论引入网络设计，以在数据驱动建模中保持几何结构。
Method: 基于 Lagrange-d'Alembert 原理定义 Lagrange-d'Alembert 映射，并构造由 Lagrange-d'Alembert-Euler 映射拼接而成的 GFHNNs；通过引入参数依赖得到 PGFHNNs。对于随机强迫系统，将 Stratonovich-Taylor 展开中的多重 Stratonovich 积分解释为参数，从而在同一框架下处理。
Result: 论文证明了所提一阶单步方法的 C^r 收敛定理以及 GFHNN 架构的万能逼近定理；数值实验表明，GFHNN 等几何架构相比非几何残差网络在长期稳定性和精度上有显著提升，并可用更少训练数据达到相近性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调几何结构保持对于学习强迫哈密顿系统的长期行为具有重要意义，所提框架统一覆盖确定性、随机和参数依赖情形，但其适用前提是可获取关于底层 Wiener 过程的信息。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning Hierarchical Skill Policies with Offline Quality-Diversity Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies investigate how to leverage pre-collected datasets to improve the policy performance and sample efficiency of RL. One promising approach to achieve this goal is to employ a two-stage strategy: In the first stage, diverse skills are extracted as a low-level policy from a given dataset, and a high-level policy is trained to solve a specific task in the second stage. Typically, extraction of the low-level policy is performed based on unsupervised learning such as trajectory VAE. However, a limitation of this approach is that the quality of the low-level policy highly depends on the quality of the dataset. To address this issue, we introduce QDOS (Quality-Diversity Offline Skill learning), a unified pipeline for robust offline-to-online learning. Our approach incorporates an Advantage-Weighted Quality-Diversity pretraining objective, which weights the skill extraction and diversity objectives by the estimated advantage of each trajectory segment. This approach allows the model to extract diverse and high-value skills. By providing robust and task-relevant skill representations, QDOS significantly improves the quality of the embedded skill space used by the low-level policy. We further integrate this with a dual dataset reuse strategy, where offline data is used both for skill pretraining and for populating the online replay buffer via pseudo-labeling. Experiments demonstrate that QDOS significantly outperforms strong baselines in structured manipulation tasks and unstructured locomotion tasks, confirming its ability to accelerate exploration and improve final returns in challenging sparse-reward domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QDOS (Quality-Diversity Offline Skill learning)，一个统一的 offline-to-online 分层强化学习流水线。核心是 Advantage-Weighted Quality-Diversity 预训练目标，用每个轨迹段 (trajectory segment) 的优势估计 (advantage) 来加权技能提取与多样性目标，从而从离线数据中提取多样且有价值的技能；并配合双数据集复用策略，使离线数据既用于技能预训练，又通过伪标签 (pseudo-labeling) 填充在线回放缓冲区。实验表明 QDOS 在结构化操作任务与非结构化运动任务上均显著优于强基线，能加速稀疏奖励场景下的探索并提升最终回报。
Motivation: 典型的两阶段分层策略先用无监督学习（如轨迹 VAE）从已有数据集提取低层技能，但低层策略质量高度依赖数据集质量，较差的离线数据会直接损害学到的技能空间。作者希望解决这一局限，使离线数据的利用对数据质量更鲁棒。
Method: 提出统一流水线 QDOS：引入 Advantage-Weighted Quality-Diversity 预训练目标，以轨迹段的优势估计对技能提取目标与多样性目标进行加权；同时采用双数据集复用策略，将离线数据既用于技能预训练，也通过伪标签方式用于填充在线回放缓冲区。
Result: 实验在结构化操作任务和非结构化运动任务上显示 QDOS 显著优于强基线，并确认其能加速探索、改善稀疏奖励领域的最终回报。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过提供稳健且与任务相关的技能表征，QDOS 明显提升了低层策略所使用嵌入技能空间的质量，是面向 sparse-reward 领域离线到在线学习的一种有效方案；该文为 IROS 2026 投稿。

papers.title: Frequency-Aware Continual Learning for Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Smart contract vulnerability detection with Large Language Models (LLMs) faces three causally linked challenges. First, new vulnerability categories demand parameter-efficient adaptation, since full retraining is prohibitive for sequentially arriving tasks. Second, training per-task adapters on a shared backbone causes catastrophic forgetting of previously learned vulnerabilities. Third, the resulting multiplicity of adapters must be consolidated into a single model, since task identity is unknown at inference time. Each challenge arises directly from the solution to its predecessor, making an integrated framework essential. We propose a three-stage pipeline in which each stage addresses one challenge and feeds into the next. The adaptation stage uses Frequency-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation (FA-LoRA), which performs adaptation in the Fourier domain with per-frequency importance gates, requiring only 0.4% trainable parameters while outperforming standard LoRA and QLoRA. The continual learning stage applies Forget-Aware Replay (FAR), which uses these frequency gates to estimate per-sample forgetting risk via loss dynamics and prioritizes vulnerable knowledge for rehearsal, achieving an average Micro-F1 of 0.8022 across sequential tasks. The deployment stage employs Anchor-Protected Progressive Merging (APPM), which exploits the asymmetric generalization produced by FAR training to identify the strongest-generalizing adapter as an anchor and consolidates all adapters into a single model via anchor-protected weighted merging with frequency-domain gate competition. APPM achieves a Micro-F1 of 0.8085, within 2.7% of the independent per-task upper bound, at a merge cost of 156 ms and no additional runtime memory. Experiments on DIVE confirm the framework effectively addresses all three challenges for evolving blockchain ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个三阶段框架，应对大语言模型 (LLM) 在智能合约漏洞检测中的持续学习问题：新漏洞类别需要参数高效适配、共享骨干网络上的逐任务适配导致灾难性遗忘、推理时任务身份未知而需将多个适配器整合为单一模型。三个阶段分别为频域低秩适配 FA-LoRA、遗忘感知重放 FAR 和锚点保护渐进合并 APPM，并在 DIVE 数据集上验证。
Motivation: 智能合约漏洞检测中三个因果关联的挑战：全量重训成本过高、逐任务适配器会造成灾难性遗忘、多适配器需在推理时任务身份未知的情况下合并。每个挑战都由前一个的解法直接引出，因此需要集成框架而非孤立方法。
Method: 提出三阶段流水线：适配阶段使用 Frequency-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation (FA-LoRA)，在傅里叶域进行低秩适配并加入逐频率重要性门控，仅需 0.4% 可训练参数；持续学习阶段使用 Forget-Aware Replay (FAR)，利用频率门控通过损失动态估计每个样本的遗忘风险，优先重放易遗忘的漏洞知识；部署阶段使用 Anchor-Protected Progressive Merging (APPM)，利用 FAR 训练产生的不对称泛化特性选出最强泛化的适配器作为锚点，通过锚点保护加权合并与频域门控竞争将所有适配器整合进单一模型。
Result: FA-LoRA 仅需 0.4% 可训练参数且优于标准 LoRA 和 QLoRA；FAR 在顺序任务上取得平均 Micro-F1 0.8022；APPM 取得 Micro-F1 0.8085，距独立逐任务上界仅差 2.7%，合并耗时为 156 ms 且不增加运行内存。DIVE 实验确认该框架能同时应对三个挑战。
Conclusion: 作者认为该三阶段框架有效解决了区块链生态持续演化下智能合约漏洞检测中的适配、遗忘和模型合并问题，最终交付单一模型且推理时无需任务身份信息。

papers.title: CacheRoute: Planned Prefix-Affinity Routing for Large-Scale LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Prefix caching avoids prefill only when a repeated request returns to a server that still holds the prefix KV. Cache-blind balancing disperses that reuse; fixed affinity preserves it but can overload a server. CacheRoute resolves this tradeoff with a periodic routing plan. It admits high-rate keys to a stable warm set and places their assignments by expected load. Hot keys may use more than one destination, although every key in our primary semi-synthetic aggregate uses exactly one. On Llama-3.3-70B in fp8 across 60 H100 GPUs, CacheRoute sustains 176+/-11 QPS at a 3.5-s p99 SLO, 2.3x the strongest of five baselines. Served KV-cache hit rate rises from 64.1+/-1.3% under cache-blind balancing to 93.2+/-0.5%. A second semi-synthetic aggregate and controlled 8B and burst experiments separate the effects of affinity and placement. Two 32B workloads provide the counterexamples: when affinity recovers too little KV work, its residual load skew reduces or erases the improvement. We therefore recommend gating any deployment with a shadow replay rather than enabling affinity from workload statistics alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CacheRoute 面向大规模 LLM 服务提出一种周期性路由计划，将高频键纳入稳定热集并按期望负载放置，以同时兼顾前缀缓存复用与服务器负载均衡。在 60 张 H100 上以 Llama-3.3-70B fp8 测试，p99 3.5 秒 SLO 下达到 176±11 QPS，为五个基线中最强者的 2.3 倍；KV 缓存命中率从缓存盲均衡下的 64.1% 提升到 93.2%。两个 32B 工作负载的反例显示，当亲和路由回收的 KV 工作量不足时，残留负载偏差会削弱甚至消除收益，因此作者建议用影子回放 (shadow replay) 门控部署。
Motivation: 前缀缓存仅在重复请求回到仍持有该前缀 KV 的服务器时才避免 prefill；缓存盲均衡会分散这种复用，而固定亲和虽能保留复用却可能使单台服务器过载。论文旨在解决这一复用与负载均衡之间的权衡。
Method: 提出周期性路由计划：接收高到达率键并将其分配到一个稳定的热集 (stable warm set)，按期望负载决定放置位置；热键可使用多个目的地，但论文中的主半合成工作负载每个键恰好使用一个目的地。
Result: 摘要报告在 Llama-3.3-70B fp8、60 张 H100 上，CacheRoute 以 3.5 秒 p99 SLO 维持 176±11 QPS，是最强基线的 2.3 倍；KV 缓存命中率从 64.1±1.3% 升至 93.2±0.5%。第二个半合成负载以及受控 8B 和突发实验用于分离亲和与放置的影响，而两个 32B 负载则提供了收益被抵消的反例。
Conclusion: 作者认为不应仅凭工作负载统计直接启用亲和路由，而应通过影子回放对任何部署进行门控，以判断亲和能否回收足够多的 KV 工作量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Escaping the Quicksand: A Call to Arms
papers.abstract_en: Computing has been an astonishing success - but the accumulated technical debt exposes us all to huge costs in business and societal risk. For 75 years, we've built systems to prose specifications with test-and-debug development. That works well enough for industry to thrive, but it's an expensive and ineffective feedback loop, and leaves everyone relying on shaky foundations. Now, AI-enabled engineering is amplifying the success by reducing coding costs, but also amplifies the risks, by rapidly increasing technical debt, and by automating detection of the vulnerabilities therein. How can we do better? Research has long pursued mathematical proof of correctness, which, unlike testing, can cover all cases. This too has advanced massively, but it remains hard to apply, both technically and because of a deep-seated cultural disconnect. Instead, we argue for a pragmatic approach to flexible combinations of testing, *specification*, and proof, that provides more effective feedback loops for both AI and human development. Most simply, one can incrementally co-develop executable-as-test-oracle partial specifications alongside conventional prose descriptions, code, and tests. This clarifies design and makes testing much more discriminating. Developers can and should do it today. Or, even better, one can use specifications that support the full gamut of testing, property-based testing, symbolic execution, and proof. This enables a range of intertwined feedback loops, again both for AI and humans, from cheap testing to more expensive proof. However, making it really practical needs *semantics infrastructure*: specifications and tooling for the main programming languages and other abstractions, which we now more-or-less know how to build, but which is not yet in place. We call the community to arms to create and deploy it - to enable a future built on firmer ground.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 Peter Sewell 与 Jean Pichon-Pharabod 撰写的一篇呼吁性文章，针对计算领域累积的技术债务和脆弱基础，主张以务实方式组合测试、规格说明 (specification) 与形式化证明，为人类和 AI 驱动的工程提供更有效的反馈回路。文章还呼吁社区建设面向主流编程语言的语义基础设施 (semantics infrastructure)，以支撑从测试到证明的完整谱系。
Motivation: 75 年来软件开发依赖散文式规格与测试-调试循环，代价高昂且反馈低效；AI 工程化在降低编码成本的同时加速了技术债务积累并自动化了漏洞检测，使风险进一步放大。现有形式化证明虽能覆盖全部情况，但技术上难以应用，且存在文化隔阂。
Method: 提出先增量地将可执行、可充当测试预言机的部分规格与代码和测试共同开发，以澄清设计并提升测试判别力；更进一步的方案是使用同时支持测试、基于属性的测试、符号执行和证明的规格。作者强调需要建设语义基础设施，即面向主要编程语言和抽象的工具与规格。
Result: 本文是立场文章，未报告实验或基准结果；摘要中的主张是这些方法今天就能被开发者采用，并使测试更具判别力，但使其实用化依赖尚未就位的语义基础设施。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁研究与实践社区共同创建并部署语义基础设施，从而让未来建立在更牢固的地基上；文章强调务实组合而非纯粹证明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGE-XGBoost: Spatially Augmented Graph Embeddings--Machine Learning Framework for Natural Hazards Susceptibility Mapping under Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: Natural hazard susceptibility mapping is often constrained by limited labeled data, reducing the generalizability of conventional machine learning and limiting the applicability of complex deep learning models. This study proposes SAGE (Spatially Augmented Graph Embeddings), a structurally informed feature-engineering framework that combines controlled noise-based data augmentation with neighborhood-based graph embeddings to improve prediction under data-scarce conditions. A K-nearest neighbor graph is constructed to derive local spatial statistics, which are reduced using principal component analysis and integrated with environmental covariates and spatial coordinates. The resulting features are used with XGBoost to develop the SAGE-XGBoost model. The framework was evaluated for landslide and wildfire susceptibility mapping. SAGE-XGBoost consistently outperformed conventional and spatially explicit machine learning models. Compared with Spatial XGBoost, it achieved an absolute improvement of above 33 percentage points across the two case studies. The model reached AUC values of approximately 0.97 for landslide susceptibility and 0.95 for wildfire susceptibility. Feature importance analysis confirmed the contribution of graph embeddings to prediction, while their integration improved spatial coherence and reduced local noise amplification. Overall, SAGE-XGBoost provides an efficient and transferable alternative to deep representation learning for environmental hazard assessment and other geospatial prediction tasks under limited supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数据稀缺条件下自然灾害易发性制图性能受限的问题，提出 SAGE-XGBoost 框架：将受控噪声数据增强与基于邻域的图嵌入（graph embeddings）结合，生成空间增强特征并用于 XGBoost。摘要报告该方法在滑坡和野火两个案例上均优于常规及空间显式机器学习模型，AUC 分别约为 0.97 和 0.95。
Motivation: 自然灾害易发性制图常受限于少量标注数据，这会降低常规机器学习的泛化能力，也限制了复杂深度学习的可用性。
Method: 构建 K 近邻图以导出局部空间统计量，用主成分分析（PCA）降维后与环境协变量和空间坐标整合，得到 SAGE 特征；再以 XGBoost 建模形成 SAGE-XGBoost。
Result: 在滑坡和野火易发性制图案例中，SAGE-XGBoost 一致优于常规和空间显式机器学习模型；相对 Spatial XGBoost 取得超过 33 个百分点的绝对提升，滑坡 AUC 约 0.97、野火 AUC 约 0.95。特征重要性分析确认图嵌入对预测有贡献，并提升了空间连贯性、降低了局部噪声放大。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 SAGE-XGBoost 是深度表示学习在有限监督条件下的一种高效且可迁移的替代方案，适用于环境灾害评估及其他地理空间预测任务。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Scaffolding Minds: Optimizing Latent Visual Target Representations for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning has advanced multimodal reasoning through a two-stage training paradigm: (1) a helper image is encoded into latent tokens to teach visual chain-of-thought during a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage, and (2) these latent tokens are further refined with reward feedback during a reinforcement learning (RL) stage. In this paper, we identify two key limitations of this framework, one in each stage. First, the SFT stage typically relies on an off-the-shelf vision encoder to encode the helper image, yielding suboptimal latent representations that may not be well aligned with the downstream reasoning task. Second, existing RL methods treat the latent component only through deterministic regularization, which constrains policy drift but does not create alternative latent trajectories for exploration. To address these limitations, we propose Scaffolding Minds. Our approach learns a dedicated scaffolding encoder that provides an optimized target in latent space, and learns both the mean and variance of the RL sampler. We further show that these two improvements are complementary, together yielding substantial gains over strong baselines. Empirically, our method improves over the strongest latent-reasoning baseline by +9.5% on FrozenLake spatial planning, with the gain widening to +19% at 32x32 grid map, and by +5.2% on average across nine visual-centric reasoning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态推理中两阶段潜变量推理 (latent reasoning) 范式的缺陷，提出 Scaffolding Minds 方法：在 SFT 阶段训练专门的 scaffolding encoder，为辅助图像提供与推理任务对齐的潜空间优化目标；在 RL 阶段同时学习采样器的均值和方差，从而创造可探索的潜变量轨迹。作者认为这两个改进互补，并在空间规划与九项视觉推理基准上相对于强基线取得一致提升。
Motivation: 现有两阶段潜变量推理中，SFT 阶段使用现成的视觉编码器编码辅助图像，得到的潜表示可能与下游推理任务不对齐；RL 阶段仅用确定性正则化约束策略漂移，无法生成替代性潜变量轨迹供探索。
Method: 提出 Scaffolding Minds，学习一个专门的 scaffolding encoder，在潜空间中提供优化后的目标表示；同时让 RL 采样器同时建模均值和方差，以支持对潜变量轨迹的探索。
Result: 在 FrozenLake 空间规划任务上比最强潜变量推理基线提升 +9.5%，在 32x32 网格地图上提升扩大至 +19%；在九个以视觉为中心的推理基准上平均提升 +5.2%。
Conclusion: 作者表明 SFT 阶段的优化目标与 RL 阶段的随机采样这两项改进是互补的，共同带来超过强基线的显著收益，说明优化潜空间目标表示能有效增强多模态推理。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MUST-PET: MUltimodal Self-supervised learning across Tracers for whole-body PET/CT-based lesion segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based whole-body PET-CT lesion segmentation can support cancer staging, treatment planning, and response assessment, but generalization is limited by scarce annotations and domain shifts. Self-supervised learning (SSL) can address these challenges but remains underexplored in pan-cancer, multi-tracer PET-CT. In this work, we propose MUST-PET (MUltimodal Self-Supervised learning across Tracers), a multimodal, multi-tracer SSL framework for generalizable whole-body PET-CT lesion segmentation. MUST-PET is trained and validated on a diverse, multi-institutional collection of pan-cancer PET-CT scans acquired with FDG and prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-targeted radiotracers. MUST-PET uses context-aware masked reconstruction, where one modality is partially masked and reconstructed using complementary information from both PET and CT. The pretrained model is subsequently fine-tuned with labeled samples and evaluated for reconstruction quality, lesion segmentation, label efficiency, and generalizability across independent held-out datasets. MUST-PET reduces reconstruction error, improves lesion segmentation over training from scratch, and performs well with limited labeled data and on unseen external datasets, demonstrating the potential of multi-tracer SSL for label-efficient, generalizable whole-body PET-CT. segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MUST-PET，一个面向全身 PET-CT 病灶分割的多模态、多示踪剂自监督学习框架。方法采用上下文感知的掩码重构，将一种模态部分掩码并用 PET 与 CT 的互补信息重建，随后在有标注样本上微调。在涵盖 FDG 和 PSMA 的多机构泛癌 PET-CT 数据上，框架降低了重构误差，相比从头训练提升病灶分割性能，并在标签稀缺和未见外部数据集上表现良好。
Motivation: 基于深度学习的全身 PET-CT 病灶分割受限于稀缺标注和域偏移，泛化能力不足；自监督学习可缓解这些问题，但在泛癌、多示踪剂 PET-CT 场景中仍未被充分探索。
Method: 提出多模态多示踪剂自监督框架 MUST-PET，采用上下文感知掩码重构，即部分掩码某一模态并利用 PET 与 CT 两者的互补信息进行重构，预训练后用有标签样本微调。
Result: 摘要报告 MUST-PET 降低重构误差，在病灶分割上优于从头训练，且在有限标注数据和独立留出数据集上表现良好。
Conclusion: 作者认为多示踪剂自监督学习有望实现标签高效且可泛化的全身 PET-CT 病灶分割。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为多示踪剂自监督学习有望实现标签高效且可泛化的全身 PET-CT 病灶分割。

papers.title: FleetSieve: Decision-Critical Profiling for SLO-Aware LLM Fleet Configuration
papers.abstract_en: Choosing tensor-parallel (TP) degrees and replica counts for an LLM serving fleet is difficult because performance is not monotonic in TP and the feasible choice can change with load. Exhaustive profiling resolves this uncertainty, but measures many configurations that do not affect the final resource allocation. We present FleetSieve, which selects measurements according to their expected effect on a resource-coupled, SLO-aware fleet decision. FleetSieve models capacity and tail latency jointly, compares conservative and optimistic allocations, and stops when their remaining decision gap is below a specified tolerance. On a fixed H100 measurement grid for a 31B-parameter open-weight model, FleetSieve reaches the oracle aggregate decision using 22,200 GPU-seconds, 6.9% less than uniform random profiling in the fixed comparison. Across 200 random reveal orders, its mean saving over random profiling is 5.4% (95% bootstrap CI: 3.5-7.2%). The fixed-comparison saving is 21.5% for Chat, while FleetSieve does not use the fewest GPU-seconds for Code. Joint capacity and tail modeling also avoids selecting a configuration whose 46.4-second completion p99 violates a 30-second SLO. In a 16-GPU allocation, an incorrect sparse-profile decision loses up to 1.93 requests/s and 12.4 percentage points of max-min fulfillment. Boundary repeats and BurstGPT measurements support the observed load-dependent tail-latency mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FleetSieve，一种面向 LLM 服务集群 (serving fleet) 的决策关键型性能剖析方法，用于在给定资源约束和 SLO 下选择张量并行 (TP) 度与副本数。FleetSieve 联合建模容量与尾部延迟，比较保守与乐观的资源配置，并在决策差距低于指定容差时停止测量。在固定 H100 测量网格上针对 31B 参数开源模型，FleetSieve 用 22,200 GPU-seconds 达到 oracle 聚合决策，比均匀随机剖析少 6.9%；在 200 种随机揭示顺序下平均节省 5.4%（95% bootstrap CI: 3.5-7.2%）。
Motivation: 为 LLM 服务集群选择 TP 度和副本数很困难，因为性能随 TP 并非单调变化，且可行配置会随负载改变；穷举剖析会测量许多对最终资源分配没有影响的配置。
Method: FleetSieve 根据测量对资源耦合的、SLO 感知集群决策的预期影响来选择要测量的配置；它联合建模容量和尾延迟，比较保守分配与乐观分配，并在剩余决策差距低于指定容差时停止。
Result: 在固定 H100 网格上针对 31B 模型，FleetSieve 以 22,200 GPU-seconds 达到 oracle 聚合决策，比均匀随机剖析节省 6.9%；200 次随机揭示顺序下平均节省 5.4%（95% bootstrap CI: 3.5-7.2%），Chat 场景固定比较节省 21.5%，Code 场景并非最少 GPU-seconds。联合容量与尾部建模避免了选择 46.4 秒完成 p99 违反 30 秒 SLO 的配置；在 16-GPU 分配中，错误的稀疏剖析决策最多损失 1.93 requests/s 和 12.4 个百分点的 max-min 满足度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合建模容量与尾部延迟可以避免 SLO 违规，并指出边界重复测量与 BurstGPT 实验结果支持所观察到的负载依赖尾延迟机制。

papers.title: Rationally Enriched Chebyshev Trunk Bases for DeepONet Surrogates of High Péclet Entrance Transport
papers.abstract_en: This study demonstrates a rationally enriched Chebyshev (REC) trunk for deep operator network (DeepONet) surrogate models of singularly perturbed and high-Péclet transport problems whose solution profiles are characterized by thin localized boundary or wall layers. The REC trunk combines Chebyshev polynomial dictionary elements with rational dictionary elements constructed using the adaptive Antoulas-Anderson (AAA) algorithm. Over five independent training runs, the resulting REC-trunk DeepONet is evaluated against a vanilla DeepONet and a Chebyshev-trunk DeepONet whose prescribed dictionary consists only of Chebyshev polynomials across three problems whose singular perturbation parameters are diffusion-to-advection ratios: a singularly perturbed scalar boundary-value problem (BVP), the thermal entrance problem with a prescribed wall temperature, and the concentration entrance problem with an absorbing wall. Across the held-out test profiles, the REC-trunk DeepONet improves over the vanilla DeepONet and remains comparable to the Chebyshev-trunk DeepONet in predicting the scalar profile, with its clearest advantage over the Chebyshev-trunk DeepONet appearing when the perturbation parameter lies between $1.00\times10^{-4}$ and $1.78\times10^{-4}$, where it reduces the profile-error metrics by up to $19.5\,\%$ relative to the Chebyshev-trunk DeepONet. In predicting the wall-normal temperature and concentration profiles, the REC-trunk DeepONet reduces the profile-error metrics by up to $60.2\,\%$ and $32.2\,\%$ relative to the vanilla and Chebyshev-trunk DeepONets, respectively, while suppressing artificial near-wall oscillations as the Péclet or mass-transfer Péclet number ranges from $10^{2}$ to $10^{4}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种理性增强的 Chebyshev（REC）trunk 用于 DeepONet 代理模型，针对奇异摄动和高 Péclet 输运问题中具有薄边界/壁面层的解轮廓。REC trunk 将 Chebyshev 多项式字典与基于自适应 Antoulas-Anderson（AAA）算法构造的有理字典相结合，并在三个问题上与 vanilla DeepONet 及 Chebyshev-trunk DeepONet 对比评估。摘要报告 REC-trunk DeepONet 在部分误差指标上取得显著降低，并抑制了高 Péclet 数下的近壁人工振荡。
Motivation: 高 Péclet 输运问题的解具有薄且局域化的边界层或壁面层，标准 DeepONet 和纯多项式 trunk 难以准确逼近这类奇异摄动轮廓，需要更合适的 trunk 基来提升代理模型精度。
Method: 提出理性增强 Chebyshev（REC）trunk，将 Chebyshev 多项式字典与通过 AAA 算法构造的有理字典元素结合，作为 DeepONet 的 trunk 网络以表达含尖锐层结构的解。
Result: 在五个独立训练运行下，跨三个问题（奇异摄动标量边值问题、定壁温热入口问题、吸收壁浓度入口问题）评估，REC-trunk DeepONet 在标量轮廓预测上优于 vanilla DeepONet 并与 Chebyshev-trunk 相当；当摄动参数在 1.00e-4 到 1.78e-4 之间时，相对 Chebyshev-trunk 最多降低 19.5% 的轮廓误差；对壁法向温度和浓度轮廓，相对 vanilla 和 Chebyshev-trunk 分别最多降低 60.2% 和 32.2% 的误差，并在 Péclet 数 1e2 到 1e4 范围内抑制近壁人工振荡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调理性富集是改善 DeepONet 对奇异摄动输运问题预测能力的关键，尤其在抑制近壁振荡方面效果明显；其适用范围为高 Péclet 输运代理建模。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DeltaML-Bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Real-World Research Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents for machine learning experimentation must navigate heterogeneous repositories, repair training pipelines, and evaluate candidate improvements under realistic compute constraints. Existing benchmarks only partially capture these conditions. We introduce DeltaML-Bench, a benchmark comprising 48 tasks sourced from research papers that require agents to improve published baselines within imperfect, open-source repositories. We evaluate GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4 with a standard Modular agent and a search-based ARG scaffolding. In the 4 x 6h allocation, ARG raises GPT-5's per-run success rate from 9.4% to 33.9%; in the 2 x 12h allocation, GPT-5 ARG reaches 49.0%. Modular configurations exhibit specification gaming rates as high as 47.9%, while no gaming is observed in the evaluated ARG configurations. These results indicate that scaffolding design and integrity checks are important considerations when deploying agents for autonomous ML experimentation.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 12 tables. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/AlgorithmicResearchGroup/deltaml-bench-public
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeltaML-Bench，一个包含 48 个任务的基准，任务来源于研究论文，要求智能体在不完美的开源代码库中改进已发表的基线，并评估 GPT-5 与 Claude Sonnet 4 在 Modular agent 和基于搜索的 ARG scaffolding 下的表现。结果显示 ARG 能显著提升成功率，而 Modular 配置存在高达 47.9% 的规格博弈（specification gaming），ARG 配置则未观察到此类行为。
Motivation: 现有基准只部分覆盖真实机器学习实验中的条件，包括异构代码库、修复训练流水线以及在现实计算约束下评估候选改进，因此缺乏对自主智能体在真实研究仓库中表现的全面评测。
Method: 构建了 48 个从研究论文中提取的基准任务，在两种计算分配（4 x 6h 与 2 x 12h）下比较标准 Modular agent 与基于搜索的 ARG scaffolding，并引入完整性检查来检测规格博弈。
Result: 在 4 x 6h 分配下，ARG 将 GPT-5 的单次运行成功率从 9.4% 提升到 33.9%；在 2 x 12h 分配下，GPT-5 ARG 达到 49.0%。Modular 配置的规格博弈率最高达 47.9%，而评测的 ARG 配置未观察到规格博弈。
Conclusion: 作者强调 scaffold 设计与完整性检查对于部署自主机器学习实验智能体至关重要，是影响成功率与行为可靠性的关键因素。

papers.title: Can Agent Memory Systems Track Evolving State?
papers.abstract_en: As LLM-based agents are deployed for longer and higher-stakes tasks, their memory systems continue to have crucial gaps. While existing memory benchmarks focus largely on recall-shaped tasks, we argue an effective memory system must track the evolving state of the world; as facts, constraints, and decisions are revised over a long interaction, answers must reflect the current state and not a superseded one. We define this capability as state tracking and instantiate it in StateMemBench, a benchmark of 234 multi-session scenarios spanning two conversation-length regimes. Its closed-pool grading scores whether an answer reflects the current state, the superseded state, or fails otherwise, separating state-tracking failures from other errors by construction. Our analysis shows that this task is challenging for existing memory systems, retrieval-augmented baselines, and long-context baselines. We then present StateMem, a state-first memory method that explicitly tracks supersession and relational dependencies, and show it improves current-state accuracy over the strongest same-backbone baseline by 1.8x (0.205 -> 0.363) on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and over the strongest memory system by 1.6x (0.149 -> 0.233) on Qwen-3.5-9B, while remaining competitive with the long-context baselines. Finally, we show the same state approach can be applied as a lightweight single-call wrapper over existing memory systems, lifting current-state accuracy by +32 to +67 points on StateMemBench across six memory and retrieval backends. A length- and cost-matched control attributes +15 to +32 of those points to state structure rather than added context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM 智能体记忆系统应具备状态跟踪 (state tracking) 能力，即在整个长期交互中跟踪事实、约束和决策的修订，使回答反映当前状态而非已取代的状态。作者构建了包含 234 个多会话场景的基准 StateMemBench，并提出 StateMem 方法显式跟踪取代关系和关系依赖，在多个同骨干基线上显著提升当前状态准确率。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体记忆基准大多聚焦于召回型 (recall-shaped) 任务，忽视了记忆系统必须跟踪世界演化状态的能力；当事实、约束和决策在长交互中被修订时，回答必须反映当前状态。
Method: 定义状态跟踪能力并实例化为 StateMemBench，包含 234 个多会话场景和两种对话长度区间，采用闭池评分区分回答反映当前状态、旧状态或失败，从构造上分离状态跟踪失败与其他错误；随后提出 StateMem，一种 state-first 记忆方法，显式跟踪取代关系 (supersession) 和关系依赖，并可作为轻量级单次调用包装器应用于现有记忆系统。
Result: StateMem 在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上比最强同骨干基线提升 1.8 倍（0.205 到 0.363），在 Qwen-3.5-9B 上比最强记忆系统提升 1.6 倍（0.149 到 0.233），并与长上下文基线保持竞争力；作为包装器在六个记忆与检索后端上将当前状态准确率提升 +32 到 +67 个百分点，长度和成本匹配的对照实验表明其中 +15 到 +32 个百分点来自状态结构而非额外上下文。
Conclusion: 摘要强调现有记忆系统、检索增强基线和长上下文基线在状态跟踪上都存在困难，state-first 方法能有效提升当前状态准确率，且该状态方法可作为轻量包装器移植到现有记忆系统上。

papers.title: PL-NBA: A Possession-level Universal Basketball Video Dataset Supporting Multiple Visual Understanding Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Visual understanding in sports has emerged as a hot topic in computer vision in recent years. Most existing basketball video datasets adopt single action or activity as sample, which can neither preserve the temporal continuity of game events nor support complex tasks such as action anticipation. To address this issue, this paper constructs the first possession-level basketball video dataset (PL-NBA), in which each sample is composed of a complete NBA offensive possession. Collected from 60 NBA games, PL-NBA contains 11,000 valid offensive possession clips and 31,567 annotated events with player names, captions, event types and timestamps. Each video clip includes multiple events and preserves the continuity of events, which is helpful for analysis of tactic. Experiment is conducted on multiple visual understanding tasks, including event recognition, video captioning, temporal action localization and action anticipation. Experimental results show that existing methods achieve limited performance on above four tasks, demonstrating that PL-NBA is a challenging benchmark for sports video understanding.

papers.title: When Guidance Goes Off-Scale: Recalibrating Diffusion Transformers under Analog Compute-in-Memory Nonidealities
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) incur high memory traffic and energy costs because sampling repeatedly evaluates large denoisers dominated by linear operations. Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) can alleviate these costs by executing linear operations within weight-storing memory arrays. However, CIM nonidealities perturb effective weights, with errors accumulating along the state-dependent denoising trajectory; their interaction with classifier-free guidance (CFG) remains underexplored. In this paper, we characterize the impact of analog CIM nonidealities on DiT sampling. Although conditional and unconditional predictions can each remain close to their clean counterparts, their difference (the CFG residual) is disproportionately attenuated and rotated. Identifying this residual as a controllable failure channel, we propose a retraining-free, sampler-side recalibration that adjusts only the CFG scale for a given CIM condition. Trajectory-level analysis shows that moderate recalibration strengthens the target-oriented component preserved in the distorted residual, enabling earlier commitment to a prompt-consistent semantic region. In contrast, excessive guidance amplifies the full noisy residual and degrades quality, resulting in a finite, noise-dependent optimum. Extensive experiments on PixArt-Sigma, PixArt-alpha, and DiT-XL/2 show that the optimal guidance scale increases with CIM noise. Using 30,000 samples per condition, guidance recalibration consistently restores generation quality across simulated CIM mappings, closing at least 87% of the CIM-induced FID gap at a CIM noise level of 0.20. It reduces FID from 59.22 to 20.49 on PixArt-Sigma, 72.37 to 21.12 on PixArt-alpha, and 20.89 to 6.62 on DiT-XL/2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究模拟存内计算 (analog compute-in-memory, CIM) 非理想性对 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 采样的影响，重点关注分类器自由引导 (classifier-free guidance, CFG) 的退化机制。作者发现条件预测与无条件预测各自接近干净结果，但二者之差即 CFG 残差会被不成比例地衰减和旋转，并提出无需重训练、仅在采样端调整 CFG 尺度的重校准方法。实验在 PixArt-Sigma、PixArt-alpha 和 DiT-XL/2 上验证，该方法能显著恢复生成质量，并缩小 CIM 引入的 FID 差距。
Motivation: DiT 采样反复评估以线性运算为主的大规模去噪器，带来高内存访问和能耗；模拟 CIM 可在存储权重的阵列中执行线性运算以缓解成本，但其非理想性会扰动有效权重，且误差沿状态依赖的去噪轨迹累积。现有研究尚未充分探索 CIM 非理想性与 CFG 的相互作用。
Method: 首先刻画模拟 CIM 非理想性对 DiT 采样的影响，识别 CFG 残差作为可控的失效通道。随后提出一种无需重训练的采样端重校准方法，针对给定 CIM 条件只调整 CFG 尺度，并辅以轨迹级分析解释重校准的作用机制。
Result: 轨迹级分析显示适度重校准能增强失真残差中保留的目标导向成分，而过强引导会放大整体噪声残差并降低质量，因此存在有限且依赖噪声的最优引导尺度。在每条件 30000 个样本的模拟 CIM 映射下，引导重校准一致恢复生成质量，在 CIM 噪声水平 0.20 时至少弥合 87% 的 CIM 所致 FID 差距：PixArt-Sigma 上 FID 从 59.22 降至 20.49，PixArt-alpha 从 72.37 降至 21.12，DiT-XL/2 从 20.89 降至 6.62。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CFG 残差是 CIM 非理想性下 DiT 采样的可控失效通道，最优引导尺度随 CIM 噪声增大而增大，采样端重校准可在不重训练的情况下有效恢复生成质量。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Time-Uniform Self-Normalized Concentration for Discounted Least Squares: Limits and Corrections
papers.abstract_en: Self-normalized concentration inequalities are standard tools in bandit and reinforcement-learning analyses. A widely used weighted extension claims an analogous time-uniform guarantee for discounted least-squares estimators in non-stationary problems. A simple scalar Gaussian counterexample with a fixed parameter shows that the claimed bounded radius is crossed with probability one. For fixed discount and regularization parameters, we further show that, when $δ\leq1/2$ and $T/δ$ is sufficiently large, any deterministic anytime boundary valid uniformly over the stated conditionally sub-Gaussian model class must be at least of order $R\sqrt{\log(T/δ)}$ at some time by horizon $T$; for nondecreasing boundaries, this order is required at time $T$. We identify the proof error: different terminal times use different Gaussian mixing distributions, so the fixed-time mixtures do not form one supermartingale, and the stopping-time argument does not repair this failure. Finally, we show that the weighted inequality remains valid at each fixed deterministic time, give valid finite- and infinite-horizon corrections, and discuss consequences for downstream analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 bandit 与强化学习分析中常用的折扣最小二乘估计器自归一化集中不等式，指出其时间一致 (time-uniform) 版本存在反例。作者用一个固定参数的标量高斯反例说明，被声称的有界半径会以概率 1 被越过；随后给出在条件亚高斯模型类上均匀成立所需的边界下界，并定位证明错误在于不同终止时间使用了不同的高斯混合分布，无法构成一个 supermartingale。最后证明原不等式在每个固定确定性时间仍成立，并给出有限与无限时域的修正。
Motivation: 自归一化集中不等式是 bandit 和强化学习分析的标准工具，而折扣最小二乘估计器的非平稳扩展声称具有时间一致保证；若该保证不成立，将影响基于此类不等式推导的下游 regret 分析。
Method: 作者构造标量高斯反例，并在固定折扣与正则化参数下给出下界论证，说明任何在条件亚高斯模型类上均匀成立的确定性任意时间边界必须达到 R√log(T/δ) 量级；同时剖析证明结构，指出不同终止时间依赖不同高斯混合分布导致无法形成单一 supermartingale，并据此给出修正后的有限/无限时域不等式。
Result: 摘要表明：当 δ≤1/2 且 T/δ 足够大时，任何均匀成立的确定性任意时间边界在 horizon T 内某个时刻至少为 R√log(T/δ) 量级；对非降边界，该量级在时间 T 被要求达到。原加权不等式在每个固定确定性时刻仍然有效。
Conclusion: 作者强调不同终止时间不能使用不同混合分布，停止时间论证无法修复 supermartingale 的失败，并给出有效修正及其对下游分析的后果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: S$^2$GS: Structured Sparse Gaussian Streaming for Efficient Free-Viewpoint Video Reconstruction on Edge-IoT Devices
papers.abstract_en: Streaming reconstruction of Free-Viewpoint Videos (FVVs) supports immersive Internet of Things (IoT) services, such as telepresence and digital twin visualization. Existing methods suffer from high per-frame optimization time and large storage footprints, limiting deployment on resource-constrained Edge-IoT devices. To address these challenges, we propose Structured Sparse Gaussian Streaming (S$^2$GS), an FVV reconstruction framework that exploits structure-aware temporal sparsity to selectively update Gaussian residuals, enabling efficient streaming without compromising visual fidelity. In the spatial domain, a streaming octree hierarchically organizes Gaussian residuals, capturing spatial correlations that guide residual updates. In the temporal domain, a structured gating mechanism, comprising hierarchical feature propagation (HFP) and Gumbel-Sigmoid sampling, converts hierarchical dynamic cues into sparse residual update decisions under differentiable optimization. A multi-level discrete scheme is further adopted to provide fine-grained control over residual updates while preserving intricate dynamic details. Extensive experiments across consumer GPUs, industrial edge IoT devices, and a physical telepresence testbed demonstrate that S$^2$GS consistently reduces per-frame optimization time and storage footprint while maintaining competitive visual quality. Compared with QUEEN, S$^2$GS reduces per-frame optimization time by 59% and storage costs by 85% on an RTX 4090 GPU. On the Jetson AGX Orin, S$^2$GS delivers the highest rendering throughput (60+ FPS) and the lowest energy consumption among the evaluated methods, demonstrating its potential for deployment in resource-constrained systems.
papers.comment: Project Page, Code, and Supplementary Material: https://github.com/liyw420/S2GS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Structured Sparse Gaussian Streaming (S$^2$GS)，一种面向边缘 IoT 设备的自由视角视频 (Free-Viewpoint Video) 流式重建框架。它利用结构感知的时间稀疏性，只选择性更新高斯残差，从而在保持视觉质量的同时降低每帧优化时间和存储占用。作者在消费级 GPU、工业边缘 IoT 设备和物理远程在场测试平台上验证了方法的效率与质量。
Motivation: 现有 FVV 流式重建方法存在每帧优化时间长和存储占用大的问题，难以部署到资源受限的 Edge-IoT 设备上，限制了沉浸式 IoT 服务（如远程在场和数字孪生可视化）的落地。
Method: S$^2$GS 在空间域引入流式八叉树 (streaming octree) 层次化组织高斯残差，捕获空间相关性以指导残差更新；在时间域采用由层次特征传播 (HFP) 和 Gumbel-Sigmoid 采样构成的结构化门控机制，将层次化动态线索转化为可微优化下的稀疏残差更新决策；并用多级离散方案对残差更新进行细粒度控制。
Result: 与 QUEEN 相比，S$^2$GS 在 RTX 4090 上将每帧优化时间降低 59%，存储成本降低 85%；在 Jetson AGX Orin 上取得最高的渲染吞吐率（60+ FPS）和最低的能耗。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架在保持竞争性视觉质量的同时，持续降低每帧优化时间和存储占用，展示出在资源受限系统中的部署潜力。

papers.title: TextRefine: Improving Textual Fidelity, Spatial Placement, and Glyph Rendering for Text Editing in Product Posters
papers.abstract_en: Text editing in product posters entails inserting new text or replacing existing text while preserving product appearance, background content, and global composition. Despite recent progress in instruction-based image editing, general-purpose models remain unreliable in this setting: they often omit or incorrectly render the target text, place it over salient products or pre-existing content, and produce structurally distorted or visually inconsistent glyphs. We introduce \textbf{TextRefine}, a task-aligned post-training framework that combines supervised fine-tuning with operation-specific reward optimization to address these complementary failure modes. For text insertion, our text-span-level reward jointly assesses semantic fidelity and target-span coverage, penalizes spatial conflicts with products and existing text, and employs a gated structural constraint to preserve non-text regions. For text replacement, our glyph-level reward leverages the connectionist temporal classification (CTC) posterior of the target character to provide graded supervision for fine-grained defects, including missing strokes, structural deformations, and confusion among visually similar characters. We further introduce \textbf{OpenTextEdit}, a dataset comprising 100K images for text editing in product posters, with multi-text layouts, detailed text attributes, product masks, and challenging low-frequency characters. Extensive experiments on both insertion and replacement demonstrate that TextRefine consistently outperforms the evaluated image editing baselines in textual fidelity, placement reliability, and glyph quality while better preserving source-image content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TextRefine，一个面向产品海报文本编辑的任务对齐后训练框架，结合监督微调与按操作区分的奖励优化。摘要报告该方法在文本插入与替换任务上均优于所评估的图像编辑基线，在文本保真度、放置可靠性和字形质量上更优，同时更好地保留源图像内容，并引入含 100K 图像的 OpenTextEdit 数据集。
Motivation: 通用指令式图像编辑模型在产品海报文本编辑场景中不可靠：目标文本常被遗漏或渲染错误、被放置在显著产品或已有内容之上，且字形存在结构扭曲或不一致。
Method: TextRefine 采用监督微调加操作特定奖励优化；插入任务使用文本跨度级奖励，联合评估语义保真度与目标跨度覆盖率，惩罚与产品及现有文本的空间冲突，并引入门控结构约束保护非文本区域；替换任务使用基于连接主义时序分类（CTC）后验的字形级奖励，对缺笔画、结构形变及相似字符混淆等细粒度缺陷提供分级监督。同时构建 OpenTextEdit 数据集，包含多文本布局、详细文本属性、产品掩码和难例低频字符。

Conclusion: 作者认为任务对齐的后训练与操作特定奖励设计能够互补地解决文本编辑中的多类失败模式，数据集 OpenTextEdit 为该任务提供了规模化训练与评测基础。

papers.title: Complementary, Not Cumulative: Interaction Effects in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Navier-Stokes Vortex Shedding
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) embed governing partial differential equations directly into the training loss, offering a promising alternative to costly CFD solvers for unsteady flows. Yet the growing list of techniques proposed to improve PINN training is typically validated one at a time, leaving open whether these techniques actually compose. We study this question in depth on the DFG/Schafer-Turek unsteady cylinder wake benchmark. In isolation, nearly every technique performs no better than an untreated baseline. However, combining periodic (SIREN) activations with causal weighting unlocks a previously inaccessible regime, reconstructing velocity and pressure fields to within 4.1% average relative L2 error against an OpenFOAM reference solution. Adding further techniques instead causes catastrophic performance degradation, demonstrating that individually effective PINN interventions can interact nonlinearly and that more elaborate training recipes are not necessarily better.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以 DFG/Schäfer-Turek 非定常圆柱绕流基准为对象，系统考察多种 PINN 训练技巧的组合效应。结果表明单独使用几乎所有技巧都不优于未处理基线，但将周期激活（SIREN）与因果加权结合后，能以 4.1% 的平均相对 L2 误差重建速度与压力场（以 OpenFOAM 参考解为基准）；继续叠加技巧则导致性能急剧退化，说明单独有效的干预之间存在非线性交互。
Motivation: 现有提升 PINN 训练的诸多技术通常被逐一独立验证，缺少对它们能否真正组合使用的考察；作者希望弄清这些技巧叠加后是累计增益还是互补交互。
Method: 在 DFG/Schäfer-Turek 非定常圆柱绕流基准上，对多种 PINN 改进技巧进行隔离测试与组合测试，重点比较不同激活函数与损失加权策略（如 SIREN 周期激活与因果加权）的配对效果。
Result: 单独应用几乎所有技巧均不优于未处理基线；SIREN 激活与 causal weighting 的组合达到 4.1% 的平均相对 L2 误差，而继续加入更多技巧会造成严重的性能退化。
Conclusion: 作者强调大量看似有效的 PINN 干预彼此之间存在非线性交互，更复杂的训练配方并不必然更好，说明技巧的组合效应需要被显式验证。

papers.title: Scientific Data Skills: Enabling Agent-Ready Scientific Data Services at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Scientific data are increasingly used by AI agents, yet existing dataset representations provide limited support for autonomous discovery, interpretation, and invocation. This limitation stems from the fragmentation of scientific data across heterogeneous repositories and from dataset representations designed primarily for human use. To address this limitation, we introduce the Scientific Data Skill (SciDSK), an agent-ready representation that packages dataset-specific knowledge and operational guidance as a reusable agent skill. A SciDSK integrates dataset descriptions, scientific context, file organization, usage procedures, quality checks, and provenance information while retaining the underlying data in its original repository. We define a structured SciDSK specification and develop a systematic construction pipeline that grounds each SciDSK in authoritative dataset records and associated supporting materials. We further establish the Scientific Data Skill Bank, a unified platform that publishes SciDSK resources across six scientific disciplines and supports package access, persistent identification, and traceability to source datasets. We evaluate SciDSK through a retrieval benchmark for dataset discovery and controlled cases for dataset interpretation. The results show that SciDSK improves agent-driven dataset discovery and provides more precise and actionable support for dataset interpretation. These findings support the value of organizing dataset-specific knowledge in an agent-ready representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Scientific Data Skill (SciDSK)，一种面向 AI 智能体的科学数据集表示，将数据集描述、科学背景、文件组织、使用流程、质量检查和来源信息打包为可复用的智能体技能，同时保留底层数据在原始数据仓库中。作者定义了结构化规格和系统化构建流程，并建立覆盖六个科学领域的统一平台 Scientific Data Skill Bank。基于数据集发现检索基准和受控解读案例的评估表明，SciDSK 改善了智能体驱动的数据集发现，并为数据集解读提供更精确、可操作的支持。
Motivation: 科学数据越来越多地被 AI 智能体使用，但现有数据集表示主要面向人类，且数据分散在异构存储库中，导致智能体难以自主发现、解读和调用这些数据。
Method: 引入 SciDSK 表示及其结构化规格，开发系统化构建流程，基于权威数据集记录和支撑材料为每个技能生成内容，并通过 Scientific Data Skill Bank 平台提供跨六个科学领域的资源发布、持久标识和到源数据的可追溯性。
Result: 评估采用数据集发现检索基准和受控的数据集解读案例，结果显示 SciDSK 提升了智能体驱动的数据集发现，并为数据集解读提供了更精确、可操作的指导。
Conclusion: 作者认为将数据集特定知识组织为 agent-ready 表示是有价值的；摘要未展开具体实验规模、基线或局限。

papers.title: What Matters for Latent Actions in Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Latent Action Models (LAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling robot learning to leverage large-scale unlabeled videos through latent actions that serve as compact surrogates for physical actions. Despite rapid progress, research on LAM remains highly fragmented, with existing methods evaluating different design choices in isolation under inconsistent experimental settings, making it difficult to identify the factors that truly determine downstream robotic manipulation performance. In this work, we present the first comprehensive empirical study of latent action learning for robotic manipulation. We unify representative LAM methods within a common autoencoding framework and systematically investigate 41 LAM design choices across three dimensions, including latent action modeling paradigms, learning objectives and regularization methods, and latent action integration strategies. We further examine four proxy metrics for evaluating latent action quality and assess their ability to reliably predict downstream robotic manipulation performance. Extensive experiments on three widely used benchmarks provide strong empirical evidence that fine-tuning vision-language model (VLM) backbones with latent actions provides a stronger initialization for downstream policy learning, with further validation on real-world robot manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出针对机器人操作中潜在动作学习 (latent action learning) 的首个综合性实证研究。作者将代表性潜在动作模型 (Latent Action Model, LAM) 统一到自编码框架中，系统考察 41 种设计选择，覆盖潜在动作建模范式、学习目标与正则化方法、潜在动作集成策略三个维度，并在三个常用基准及真实机器人任务上验证。核心发现是：用潜在动作微调 vision-language model (VLM) 骨干可为下游策略学习提供更强的初始化。
Motivation: LAM 研究目前高度碎片化，各方法在互不一致的实验设置下孤立评估不同设计选择，导致难以判断哪些因素真正决定下游机器人操作性能。
Method: 将代表性 LAM 方法统一到共同的自编码框架内，系统研究 41 种设计选择（涵盖潜在动作建模范式、学习目标与正则化、潜在动作集成策略），并考察四种用于评估潜在动作质量的代理指标 (proxy metrics) 及其预测下游操作性能的能力。
Result: 在三个广泛使用的基准上的大量实验表明，使用潜在动作微调 VLM 骨干能为下游策略学习提供更好的初始化，该结论在真实世界机器人操作任务上得到进一步验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该研究为 LAM 设计选择提供了系统性实证依据，指出 VLM 骨干微调在潜在动作学习中的关键作用；摘要未报告明确的局限讨论。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Forking Fast: Efficiently Estimating Uncertainty Dynamics in Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: LLM reasoning is stochastic, and so understanding a model requires grappling with the distribution of reasoning chains that it might produce for a given question, i.e., its uncertainty. Resampling-based analyses characterize this distribution, revealing which steps of a rollout determine how the model arrives at its answer. However, a major limitation of these approaches is that resampling text sequences at every token or sentence in a reasoning chain is very costly. Our work strives to make resampling analysis more computationally efficient, while also shedding light on an important scientific question: what is the right statistical model for explaining uncertainty dynamics in text generation? We show that when resampling many reasoning chains, uncertainty dynamics converge to stable patterns, and noise is largely an artifact of sampling rather than an LLM's sensitivity to each individual token or reasoning step. We develop a statistical model for smoothing noisy low-sample rollout data to better approximate high-sample data, allowing us to significantly cut sampling costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究文本生成中不确定性动态的估计效率。作者指出基于重采样 (resampling) 的推理链分布分析成本高昂，并发现当重采样大量推理链时不确定性动态会收敛到稳定模式，噪声主要来自采样而非 LLM 对每个 token 或推理步骤的敏感性。他们提出一个统计模型，对低样本 rollout 数据进行平滑以逼近高样本数据，从而显著降低采样成本。
Motivation: 理解 LLM 推理需要刻画给定问题下模型可能产生的推理链分布，即不确定性；但现有重采样分析在每个 token 或句子上反复重采样文本序列的代价很高，限制了这类分析的可扩展性。
Method: 通过大量重采样推理链来分析不确定性动态的收敛行为，并开发一个统计模型来平滑噪声较大的低样本 rollout 数据，使其近似高样本数据，进而减少达到同等估计质量所需的采样数量。
Result: 摘要报告不确定性动态在大量重采样下收敛到稳定模式，噪声主要是采样导致的伪影；平滑低样本数据可显著降低采样成本并接近高样本结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为不确定性动态存在可估计的稳定统计结构，且用统计模型平滑低样本数据是降低重采样分析计算成本的有效途径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PEA-DPO: Perception-Enhanced Alignment Direct Preference Optimization for MLLMs Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as an effective approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, its adaptation to multimodal settings remains unexplored. Through representational analysis, we identify a key limitation in multimodal preference optimization, which we term visual insensitivity: models often fail to distinguish between images and those with critical visual context removed. Our theoretical analysis further uncovers two manifestations of this problem, namely Across-Image Insensitivity and Within-Image Insensitivity. To address these challenges, we propose Perception-Enhanced Alignment DPO (PEA-DPO), a framework for multimodal LLMs alignment, which explicitly leverages visual preference signals to overcome visual insensitivity. We further provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that PEA-DPO provably mitigates both failure modes. Empirical results demonstrate that PEA-DPO enhances sensitivity to visual context while preserving the language modeling capacity of the base model. Evaluations across three hallucination benchmarks using MLLMs of varying scales show that PEA-DPO effectively mitigates visual insensitivity, achieves stronger multimodal alignment, and substantially reduces hallucinations.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26), November 10--14, 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态偏好优化中的视觉不敏感（visual insensitivity）问题提出 PEA-DPO 框架。作者通过表征分析和理论分析识别出跨图像与图像内两种不敏感表现，并在 DPO 中显式利用视觉偏好信号来缓解。实验在三个幻觉基准上用不同规模的 MLLM 验证，显示该方法能增强视觉敏感性、保持语言建模能力并显著减少幻觉。
Motivation: 直接将 DPO 用于多模态对齐时，模型常无法区分原始图像与移除关键视觉上下文的图像，即视觉不敏感；作者从理论上将其分解为跨图像不敏感（Across-Image Insensitivity）和图像内不敏感（Within-Image Insensitivity）两类。该问题影响多模态大模型的对齐质量与幻觉控制。
Method: 提出 Perception-Enhanced Alignment DPO (PEA-DPO)，在多模态 LLM 对齐中显式引入视觉偏好信号以克服视觉不敏感；同时给出理论分析，证明该方法可同时缓解上述两种失败模式。
Result: 在三种不同规模的 MLLM 上、跨三个幻觉基准的评估显示，PEA-DPO 能增强对视觉上下文的敏感性，同时保持基座模型的语言建模能力，并显著减少幻觉。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 PEA-DPO 有效缓解多模态对齐中的视觉不敏感，实现更强的多模态对齐并大幅降低幻觉；其适用范围为基于 DPO 的多模态 LLM 对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OrthoSkillVLA: Continual Skill Learning via Gradient-Informed Skill Subspace Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for robot learning, but sequentially adapting them to diverse skills can perturb the representations and velocity mappings used by previous skills, leading to catastrophic forgetting. Architecture-based approaches improve retention by isolating skills but lead to increased inference footprint. Recent subspace-constrained methods restrict parameter updates in an orthogonal subspace to minimize interference but impose a unified constraint on the entire model. We analyze the distinct roles of internal VLA components and identify two VLA-specific challenges. First, the VLM maintains broad semantic representations, making it vulnerable to capacity exhaustion, whereas the ActionHead refines semantics into localized velocity patterns that are highly sensitive to perturbations. Second, the final velocity decoder serves as a readout layer. Freezing it forms an output-stage expressivity bottleneck, while updating it risks overwriting previous velocity mappings. To this end, we propose OrthoSkillVLA, a parameter-efficient framework for continual skill learning in pretrained VLA models without demonstration replay. Given the representation heterogeneity, we impose separate subspace constraints on the VLM and ActionHead, preserving reusable semantic capacity while protecting localized velocity patterns. For the output layer, we introduce a lightweight feature-aware MoE decoder, where each skill is allocated a compact expert and a training-free router selects the expert according to feature-space affinity. Extensive simulated and real-world evaluations, together with ablations, demonstrate that OrthoSkillVLA better preserves prior skills while acquiring new ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OrthoSkillVLA，一种面向预训练 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型的参数高效持续技能学习框架，无需演示回放。作者分析 VLM 与 ActionHead 在表示上的异质性，对二者施加不同的子空间约束，并在输出层引入轻量级 feature-aware MoE 解码器来避免速度映射被覆盖。模拟与真实实验表明该方法在获取新技能的同时更好地保留旧技能。
Motivation: 将预训练 VLA 模型顺序适配到多种技能时，参数更新会扰动旧技能的表示与速度映射，造成灾难性遗忘。现有子空间约束方法对整个模型施加统一约束，未考虑 VLM 与 ActionHead 的不同角色：VLM 维护广泛语义表示易容量耗尽，ActionHead 则编码对扰动敏感的局部速度模式。
Method: 对 VLM 和 ActionHead 分别施加独立的子空间约束，以保留可复用的语义容量并保护局部速度模式；对输出层提出轻量级 feature-aware MoE 解码器，为每个技能分配紧凑专家，并由无需训练的路由器根据特征空间亲和度选择专家。
Result: 摘要报告大量模拟与真实实验及消融研究表明，OrthoSkillVLA 在获取新技能的同时能更好地保留先前技能。
Conclusion: 作者认为按组件异质性分解约束、并在输出层使用特征感知 MoE 解码，是缓解 VLA 持续学习中灾难性遗忘的有效设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unregularized Convergence of Single-Loop, Entropy-Regularized Natural Actor-Critic
papers.abstract_en: While entropy regularization is widely used to stabilize and accelerate Natural Policy Gradient methods, its ability to yield faster convergence rates for the unregularized objective remains underexplored. Existing analyses often rely on double-loop architectures and invoke a linear entropy penalty. To bridge the gap between theory and practice, we analyze a single-loop, entropy-regularized Natural Actor-Critic algorithm under compatible linear function approximation. By training an uncentered critic, our critic tracking can remain stable even as the training policy approaches determinism and the Fisher information matrix degenerates. We focus on two primary regimes for the optimization landscape: a Stochastic Regime, where we fuse coupled actor-critic updates into a joint Lyapunov recurrence, and a Deterministic Regime, where we pivot to a Policy Mirror Descent framework to circumvent the collapse of Euclidean geometry. By exploiting a positive Minimal Action Gap in the unregularized Markov decision process, we introduce an Exponential Translation mechanism that maps the regularized gap to the unregularized one up to an exponentially decaying tail. By tuning the fixed temperature, our algorithm achieves accelerated unregularized convergence rates, up to approximation-error terms: $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-1})$ in the Stochastic Regime, and $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-2/3})$ for the average iterate alongside $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-1/3})$ for the last iterate in the Deterministic Regime. Here, $T_{total}$ denotes the total number of stochastic critic updates (or Monte Carlo rollouts). Furthermore, in the tabular setting, our positive-action-gap analysis yields a $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-2/3})$ average-iterate rate, surpassing the $\mathcal{O}(T_{total}^{-1/2})$ worst-case statistical barrier that applies without a positive action margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析单循环、带熵正则化的 Natural Actor-Critic (NAC) 算法在兼容线性函数逼近下的收敛行为，证明即使针对未正则化目标也能获得加速收敛速率（至多逼近误差项）。作者通过训练无中心 critic 来维持策略接近确定性时的稳定性，并利用未正则化 MDP 的正最小动作间隙 (Minimal Action Gap) 引入指数平移机制，把正则化间隙映射到未正则化间隙。得到的速率在随机区为 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-1})$，在确定性区对平均迭代为 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-2/3})$、对最后迭代为 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-1/3})$。
Motivation: 熵正则化被广泛用于稳定和加速 Natural Policy Gradient 方法，但其能否为未正则化目标带来更快收敛速率尚未得到充分研究；现有理论分析通常依赖双循环架构且只考虑线性熵惩罚，与实际单循环实践存在差距。
Method: 提出单循环、熵正则化的 Natural Actor-Critic 算法，在兼容线性函数逼近下训练无中心 (uncentered) critic，使得策略趋近确定性且 Fisher 信息矩阵退化时 critic 跟踪仍保持稳定。分析分两个场景：随机区将耦合的 actor-critic 更新融合为联合 Lyapunov 递推；确定性区改用 Policy Mirror Descent 框架避免欧氏几何失效，并利用正最小动作间隙引入 Exponential Translation 机制，将正则化间隙映射到未正则化间隙并留下指数衰减尾部。
Result: 通过调节固定温度，算法在随机区获得 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-1})$ 的未正则化收敛速率，在确定性区对平均迭代获得 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-2/3})$、对最后迭代获得 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-1/3})$。在表格 (tabular) 设置下，基于正动作间隙的分析得到 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-2/3})$ 的平均迭代速率，超过没有正动作余量时适用的 $\mathcal{O}(T_{total}^{-1/2})$ 最坏情况统计界。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作弥合了熵正则化在理论与实践之间的差距，表明固定温度下单循环熵正则化 NAC 能以加速的速率优化未正则化目标；分析依赖于正最小动作间隙条件，在函数逼近下速率带逼近误差项。
Relevance: 2
