papers.title: Kähler landscapes for complex neural network descents and guarantees including a search and destroy of the Calabi-Yau manifold
papers.abstract_en: We study landscapes for complex-parameterized networks. Our approach is motivated with an information-theoretic manifold perspective of the parameter and via classical optimization guarantees although of complex geometric variety such as through Dolbeault asymptotics. The descent path admits a Kähler information metric under a cross-entropy via the Wirtinger Hessian on the log-likelihood potential. We restrict attention to a descent update rule with natural gradient descent via a differentiated loss scaled by the inverse metric, so the descent path remains in the holomorphic tangent bundle. We emphasize Calabi-Yau information manifolds which profane theoretical guarantees via an ill-curvature-conditioned landscape. Under a Calabi-Yau metric, specifically in a non-compact setting with a global potential so defined geometrically rather than invoking the topological requirements of the Calabi conjecture, a wedged nowhere-vanishing holomorphic form is the top exterior product of the Kähler form up to constants, yielding a constant determinant condition. Under a fixed determinant, a metric almost low rank up to an eigenvalue tolerance implies a blow-up effect. Moreover, it has been discovered that negative curvature subverts the loss landscape, specifically sectional curvature, so we expand on this and draw interconnections to negative-definite Ricci curvature. Our arguments primarily exist in a geometric analytic modality, although we establish roots in deep learning theory such as through asymptotics at initialization and connections through failure modes of neural network guarantees under vanishing and negative Ricci curvature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从几何分析角度研究复参数化神经网络的损失景观。作者通过 Wirtinger Hessian 在 log-likelihood 势上构造 Kähler 信息度量，并以自然梯度下降作为下降更新规则，使路径保持在全纯切丛中；随后重点分析 Calabi-Yau 信息流形上病态曲率条件对理论保证的影响。摘要还讨论了固定行列式条件下近似低秩度量导致的 blow-up 效应，以及负截面曲率、负定 Ricci 曲率对损失景观的破坏作用。
Motivation: 论文旨在理解复参数化网络优化路径的几何结构，并用信息论流形视角为经典优化保证提供理论解释；特别关注 Calabi-Yau 信息流形上 ill-curvature-conditioned 景观如何削弱或破坏理论保证。
Method: 利用 Wirtinger Hessian 对 log-likelihood 势定义 Kähler 信息度量，采用自然梯度下降（以逆度量缩放损失）保持下降路径位于全纯切丛；在非紧致且具有全局势的 Calabi-Yau 度量设定下，通过无处消失的全纯形式与 Kähler 形式的外积关系得到常数行列式条件，并分析固定行列式下近似低秩度量的后果。
Result: 摘要报告：在固定行列式条件下，度量若在特征值容差内近似低秩，会产生 blow-up 效应；负截面曲率会破坏损失景观，且与负定 Ricci 曲率存在联系；此外在初始化渐近层面，消失或负的 Ricci 曲率对应神经网络理论保证的失效模式。
Conclusion: 论文主要以几何分析模态展开论证，同时在深度学习理论层面建立联系，包括初始化渐近行为和负曲率下的失败模式；其适用范围围绕复参数化网络与 Kähler/Calabi-Yau 几何设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VGI-BENCH: Probing Visual Intelligence in Video Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies suggest that video generation models can exhibit certain forms of zero-shot visual reasoning through generated frames. Yet reliable evaluation remains challenging: benchmarks should adopt inputs aligned with the visual priors of current video models, require valid evolving processes rather than only plausible final states, and calibrate task difficulty to remain challenging yet partly feasible. To this end, we introduce VGI-bench, containing 27 tasks and 810 instances, organized by a two-level taxonomy of task domains and skill tags for fine-grained evaluation of visual reasoning capabilities of video generation models. Our evaluations show that current generative systems can solve a subset of visually grounded reasoning tasks, but remain far from reliable, with even the strongest model, Seedance~2.0, achieving only 51.0% under our evaluation criteria. Our analysis further explore the output failure modes, input condition sensitivity, performance transfer boundary from synthetic fine-tuning, and internal denoising perspective revealing limited self-correction, where later steps mainly refine early hypotheses rather than correct reasoning errors. We hope VGI-bench will help stimulate the development of next-generation video generation models. We will release our code and data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出 VGI-bench，一个包含 27 个任务和 810 个实例的基准，用于评估视频生成模型的视觉推理能力，并按任务领域和技能标签的两级分类法进行细粒度评测。评测显示当前生成系统只能解决部分视觉推理任务，最强模型 Seedance 2.0 也仅达到 51.0% 的得分；分析进一步揭示了失败模式、输入条件敏感性、合成微调迁移边界以及去噪过程中的有限自我纠正能力。
Motivation: 现有研究表明视频生成模型可通过生成帧展现某种形式的零样本视觉推理，但可靠的评估仍具挑战性。基准需要采用与当前视频模型视觉先验一致的输入，要求有效的演化过程而非仅合理的最终状态，并校准任务难度以保持挑战性且部分可行。
Method: 构建 VGI-bench，包含 27 个任务和 810 个实例，采用任务领域和技能标签的两级分类法，对视频生成模型的视觉推理能力进行细粒度评估；同时分析输出失败模式、输入条件敏感性、合成微调的性能迁移边界，并从内部去噪视角考察自我纠正能力。
Result: 在 VGI-bench 上，当前生成系统只能解决一部分视觉推理任务，尚不可靠；最强模型 Seedance 2.0 在评估标准下也仅达到 51.0%。去噪后期步骤主要细化早期假设而非纠正推理错误，自我纠正能力有限。
Conclusion: 作者希望 VGI-bench 能激发下一代视频生成模型的发展，并计划发布代码和数据以支持后续研究。

papers.title: Mix&Fix-Net: A Dual-Stage Trajectory Prediction Model for AIS and Vision-Derived Vessel Data
papers.abstract_en: Vessel trajectory prediction is critical for maritime safety and accident prevention. While most existing trajectory prediction models rely on Automatic Identification System (AIS) data due to its precision and availability, small vessels mostly operate without AIS, resulting in a significant monitoring gap. To address this, we propose Mix&Fix-Net, a dual-stage mixer-based trajectory prediction model designed to handle vessel trajectory time-series data derived from both AIS and (non-AIS) vision data. Our architecture integrates a Primary Trajectory Predictor with a Residual Trajectory Adjuster, enabling more refined trajectory prediction. Additionally, we introduce a new video-based dataset derived from webcam streams, from which vessel trajectories are extracted to represent non-AIS data. Extensive evaluations on both AIS and non-AIS datasets across six metrics (mean squared error, mean absolute error, symmetric mean absolute percentage error, final displacement error, Frechet distance, and average Euclidean distance) demonstrate that Mix&Fix-Net consistently outperforms existing baselines across most metrics and datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mix&Fix-Net，一个双阶段 mixer 架构的船舶轨迹预测模型，用于同时处理来自 AIS 数据和从网络摄像头视频提取的非 AIS 视觉轨迹数据。模型集成主轨迹预测器（Primary Trajectory Predictor）与残差轨迹调整器（Residual Trajectory Adjuster），并引入一个新的基于视频的轨迹数据集。在 AIS 与非 AIS 数据集上的六个评估指标中，模型在大多数指标上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有轨迹预测模型主要依赖 AIS 数据，但小型船只大多不配备 AIS，导致监控空白。作者希望利用视觉派生数据补充非 AIS 船只的轨迹预测能力。
Method: 提出 Mix&Fix-Net，采用双阶段设计：第一阶段是主轨迹预测器，第二阶段是残差轨迹调整器，整体基于 mixer 架构。同时构建了从网络摄像头流中提取的船只轨迹视频数据集，用于表示非 AIS 数据。
Result: 在 AIS 和非 AIS 数据集上，使用六个指标（MSE、MAE、SMAPE、final displacement error、Frechet distance、average Euclidean distance）进行评估，Mix&Fix-Net 在大多数指标和数据集上持续优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调双阶段 mixer 预测架构能够同时处理 AIS 与视觉派生的轨迹数据，并有效弥补小型非 AIS 船只的监控差距。

papers.title: Enforcing LLM Safety through DMD-based Classification of Prompt-Response Embedding Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes applications, yet their tendency to generate toxic, harmful, or policy-violating content poses significant risks. Detecting these unsafe outputs efficiently in a black-box manner remains an open challenge. In this paper, we extend a recently proposed dynamical systems framework designed for hallucination detection to LLM safety classification. By projecting both prompts and responses into high-dimensional embedding spaces and fitting separate Koopman-based predictive models for safe and unsafe regimes, we classify new outputs using a new differential residual score that compares prediction errors of the safe and unsafe regimes. A key contribution is the incorporation of the prompt and response embedding dynamics, yielding fitted Koopman operators that capture crucial interaction patterns. We evaluate our black-box method across three safety benchmarks using three embedding models. Our results show that incorporating prompt embeddings yields consistent improvements, particularly for interaction-dependent violations when paired with causal decoders (e.g., in Llama-3), while response-only violations benefit more from dense semantic embedding representations. These findings opens the door for using dynamical systems to analyze AI systems rather than the dominant paradigm of using AI to model dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将原本用于幻觉检测 (hallucination detection) 的动力学系统框架扩展到黑盒 LLM 安全分类：将 prompt 与 response 映射到高维嵌入空间，分别为安全与不安全状态拟合基于 Koopman 的预测模型，并用一个新的差分残差分数 (differential residual score) 对新输出分类。作者在三个安全基准、三个嵌入模型上评估，发现加入 prompt 嵌入可带来一致改进，尤其当与因果解码器 (如 Llama-3) 配合时对交互依赖型违规有效；仅依赖 response 的违规则更受益于稠密语义嵌入。摘要以此提出可用动力学系统分析 AI 系统，而非仅用 AI 建模动力学系统。
Motivation: LLM 在高风险场景中部署日益增多，但生成有毒、有害或违反策略内容的倾向带来显著风险，且黑盒场景下高效检测不安全输出仍是开放挑战。
Method: 该工作把用于幻觉检测的动力学系统框架扩展至安全分类：将 prompt 与 response 投影到高维嵌入空间，分别拟合安全与不安全状态下的 Koopman 预测模型，并提出比较两种状态预测误差的新差分残差分数。关键创新在于同时纳入 prompt 与 response 的嵌入动力学，使拟合的 Koopman 算子能捕捉两者的交互模式。
Result: 在三个安全基准与三种嵌入模型上的实验显示，纳入 prompt 嵌入带来一致的性能提升；对交互依赖型违规，与因果解码器 (Llama-3) 配合时改进尤其明显，而仅响应层面的违规更受益于稠密语义嵌入表示。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果开启了用动力学系统分析 AI 系统的方向，与当前用 AI 建模动力学系统的主流范式形成对照；方法本身为黑盒嵌入级安全分类。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Two-Stage Time-Aware Transformer for Short-Horizon AECOPD Risk Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD) can worsen rapidly, making timely prediction a clinical priority. Most existing machine learning approaches rely on episodically collected clinical variables, introducing delays that limit their practical utility in home monitoring settings. Home ventilators offer a lower-latency alternative, producing a near-continuous record of respiratory status during daily use. However existing ventilator-based approaches either compress the waveform into handcrafted features or focus primarily on binary risk classification, leaving the timing of an impending event unresolved. In this paper, we present a two-stage framework that operates directly on raw pressure and flow waveforms from the most recent seven days of home ventilator use. The first-stage classification model identifies patients at high risk of a severe exacerbation. The second-stage regression model then estimates how many days remain before the event occurs. Our experimental results demonstrate that the two-stage model outperforms traditional baseline models on both risk classification and time-to-event estimation, with our selected Stage 1 classifier achieving F1 = 0.91 and our Stage 2 regression model achieving RMSE = 1.00 days and R^2 = 0.76, giving clinicians both an early warning and actionable lead time before a severe exacerbation occurs.
papers.comment: 7 pages. Accepted for publication in IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Letters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段时间感知 Transformer 框架，直接使用家用呼吸机最近七天记录的原始压力和流量波形，对慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重（AECOPD）进行短时程风险预测。第一阶段分类模型识别严重急性加重的高风险患者，第二阶段回归模型估计事件发生前剩余天数；摘要报告所选 Stage 1 分类器 F1=0.91，Stage 2 回归模型 RMSE=1.00 天、R^2=0.76。
Motivation: AECOPD 可能快速恶化，而现有机器学习方法多依赖周期性采集的临床变量，引入延迟，难以用于家庭监测场景；已有的呼吸机波形方法要么压缩为手工特征，要么只做二分类风险识别，没有解决事件发生时机的问题。
Method: 提出两阶段框架，直接对最近七天家庭呼吸机原始压力和流量波形建模：第一阶段分类模型判断患者是否处于严重急性加重高风险，第二阶段回归模型估计距离事件发生的剩余天数。
Result: 实验显示两阶段模型在风险分类和时间到事件估计上均优于传统基线，其中所选 Stage 1 分类器达到 F1=0.91，Stage 2 回归模型达到 RMSE=1.00 天、R^2=0.76。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为临床提供早期预警和可操作的提前时间，使医生能在严重急性加重发生前获得风险提示与时间估计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DraftFM: A FoundationModel for Day-Zero Drafting in Magic: The Gathering
papers.abstract_en: Drafting a new Magic: The Gathering expansion begins before any pick from it has been observed: the complete card list is public, but the draft logs that supervised pick models train on do not yet exist. We study this day-zero regime directly. DraftFM is a discrete-choice policy that scores exactly the cards available in the current pack, conditioned on the drafted pool and the state of the draft. Every card enters as a frozen 775-dimensional function of its public card record, structured features and a fixed text embedding, with no card identities, set identities, or usage statistics anywhere in the model, so an unseen card is scored by the same machinery as a familiar one. A 1.6-million-parameter network fitted on 149 million human picks from 29 expansions predicts held-out picks in three expansions withheld in their entirety, reaching 50.8%, 60.4%, and 56.7% top-1 agreement, where uniform chance at the opening pick is about 7%. Refitted on all 32 observed expansions, the same architecture produced a card ranking for the then-unreleased set The Hobbit, sealed with its complete cryptographic provenance and published roughly 36 hours before the set became draftable on MTG Arena. The sealed ranking agrees with six independent expert reviewers roughly as much as those reviewers agree with one another. Evaluation against realized outcomes is committed to a follow-on note, whatever it shows.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Sealed pre-registered forecast published ~36h before release; scoring note to follow. Also on SSRN (7257098). Code: https://github.com/brianward92/mtga Sealed forecast: https://github.com/brianward92/draftfm (tag draftfm-v1.0) Weights: https://huggingface.co/brianward92/draftfm Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/brianward92/draftfm-frozen-eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DraftFM，一个面向万智牌（Magic: The Gathering）新系列“第零天”（day-zero）选牌场景的离散选择策略（discrete-choice policy）。模型只使用每张牌的公开卡面记录、结构化特征和固定文本嵌入作为冻结的 775 维输入，不包含卡牌身份、系列身份或使用统计，因此能对未见过的新牌打分。在 1.49 亿个人类选牌样本上训练的 160 万参数网络，对三个完全保留的系列达到 50.8%、60.4% 和 56.7% 的 top-1 一致率；重新拟合后生成的《霍比特人》系列卡牌排名与六位专家评审的一致性大致与专家之间的一致性相当。
Motivation: 新系列发布时，完整卡牌列表已经公开，但基于监督选牌日志训练的模型所需的草稿数据尚不存在，形成“第零天”冷启动问题。现有方法依赖已观测选牌或卡牌使用统计，无法直接应对这一尚无任何选牌记录的时间窗口。
Method: 提出一个离散选择策略，对当前卡包中实际可用的卡牌打分，条件为已选卡池和草稿状态。每张卡牌通过冻结的 775 维函数表示（含公共卡牌记录、结构化特征和固定文本嵌入），模型不学习任何卡牌身份或系列身份，从而用同一套机制处理熟悉与未见过的新卡。
Result: 在 29 个系列上训练的 160 万参数网络，对三个完全留出的系列分别达到 50.8%、60.4% 和 56.7% 的 top-1 预测一致率，而开局选牌的随机基线约为 7%。在全部 32 个系列上重新拟合后，该架构为尚未发布的《霍比特人》系列生成了带完整加密来源证明的卡牌排名，发布时间比该系列在 MTG Arena 可草稿约早 36 小时；该排名与六位独立专家评审的一致程度大致等于专家彼此之间的一致程度。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，不依赖身份信息和使用统计的离散选择模型可以在第零天产生与人类专家相当的新卡牌排名，弥合新系列发布到草稿数据积累之间的空白。针对实际对局结果的评估已承诺在后续说明中公布，无论结果如何。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 DraftFM，一个面向万智牌（Magic: The Gathering）新系列“第零天”（day-zero）选牌场景的离散选择策略（discrete-choice policy）。模型只使用每张牌的公开卡面记录、结构化特征和固定文本嵌入作为冻结的 775 维输入，不包含卡牌身份、系列身份或使用统计，因此能对未见过的新牌打分。在 1.49 亿个人类选牌样本上训练的 160 万参数网络，对三个完全保留的系列达到 50.8%、60.4% 和 56.7% 的 top-1 一致率；重新拟合后生成的《霍比特人》系列卡牌排名与六位专家评审的一致性大致与专家之间的一致性相当。
summary_sections.motivation: 新系列发布时，完整卡牌列表已经公开，但基于监督选牌日志训练的模型所需的草稿数据尚不存在，形成“第零天”冷启动问题。现有方法依赖已观测选牌或卡牌使用统计，无法直接应对这一尚无任何选牌记录的时间窗口。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个离散选择策略，对当前卡包中实际可用的卡牌打分，条件为已选卡池和草稿状态。每张卡牌通过冻结的 775 维函数表示（含公共卡牌记录、结构化特征和固定文本嵌入），模型不学习任何卡牌身份或系列身份，从而用同一套机制处理熟悉与未见过的新卡。
summary_sections.result: 在 29 个系列上训练的 160 万参数网络，对三个完全留出的系列分别达到 50.8%、60.4% 和 56.7% 的 top-1 预测一致率，而开局选牌的随机基线约为 7%。在全部 32 个系列上重新拟合后，该架构为尚未发布的《霍比特人》系列生成了带完整加密来源证明的卡牌排名，发布时间比该系列在 MTG Arena 可草稿约早 36 小时；该排名与六位独立专家评审的一致程度大致等于专家彼此之间的一致程度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，不依赖身份信息和使用统计的离散选择模型可以在第零天产生与人类专家相当的新卡牌排名，弥合新系列发布到草稿数据积累之间的空白。针对实际对局结果的评估已承诺在后续说明中公布，无论结果如何。

papers.title: Block3D: Efficient Text-to-3D Generation via Block-Wise Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: While text-to-3D generation has advanced rapidly, achieving high geometric fidelity at low inference cost remains challenging. Existing text-to-3D methods either decode discrete shape tokens autoregressively or iteratively refine global 3D representations with diffusion or flow models. However, autoregressive decoding is sequential and cannot revise errors, whereas diffusion and flow-matching models repeatedly process the full representation, making high-quality generation increasingly expensive. In this paper, we propose Block3D, a block-wise diffusion framework that partitions the discrete shape-token sequence into contiguous blocks, generates the blocks autoregressively, and jointly denoises all tokens within the current block. To alleviate error accumulation, we introduce confidence-guided intra-block correction, which revises low-confidence tokens before each block is finalized. On a held-out set from TRELLIS-500K, Block3D reduces mean end-to-end generation time from 25.71 seconds to 4.99 seconds, achieving a $5.15\times$ speedup over the fine-tuned autoregressive baseline without sacrificing geometric fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Block3D，一种分块扩散（block-wise diffusion）框架，用于文本到3D生成。该方法将离散形状 token 序列划分为连续块，以自回归方式逐块生成，并对当前块内的所有 token 联合去噪；同时引入置信度引导的块内校正（confidence-guided intra-block correction）来缓解错误累积。在 TRELLIS-500K 的留出集上，Block3D 将平均端到端生成时间从 25.71 秒降至 4.99 秒，相对微调的自回归基线实现 5.15 倍加速，且不牺牲几何保真度。
Motivation: 现有文本到3D方法要么用自回归方式顺序解码离散形状 token、无法修正已产生的错误，要么用扩散或流匹配模型反复处理完整表示，导致高质量生成的推理成本高昂。作者旨在同时降低推理成本并保持几何保真度。
Method: 提出 Block3D：将离散形状 token 序列切分为连续块，按块自回归生成，并在当前块内联合去噪所有 token；每块最终确定前，用置信度引导的块内校正修正低置信度 token，以减少自回归过程的误差累积。
Result: 在 TRELLIS-500K 的留出集上，Block3D 将平均端到端生成时间从 25.71 秒缩短至 4.99 秒，较微调的自回归基线获得 5.15 倍加速，且未牺牲几何保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将块级自回归生成与扩散去噪结合，并加入置信度引导的校正，可以在维持几何质量的同时显著降低文本到3D生成的推理成本。

papers.title: Stream4D: 4D-Consistency for Streaming Autoregressive Diffusion Video Models
papers.abstract_en: Streaming autoregressive diffusion models enable real-time, long-horizon video generation, but their training objectives optimize local frame prediction rather than the geometry and dynamics of a coherent world: long rollouts accumulate geometric drift and degrade into static or unnatural motion. Recent bidirectional approaches address this problem using rewards signals built upon 3D Gaussian-Splatting reconstruction. However, a single rigid 3d reconstruction cannot model a dynamic scene, so this critic penalizes genuine object motion as reconstruction error and is maximized by freezing the video. This shortcut is especially detrimental in the AR setting, where each chunk can propagate an already-static configuration. In this work, we propose Stream4D, which replaces the static critic with a feed-forward 4D reconstruction reward that explicitly models scene dynamics, allowing coherent motion to receive high consistency rewards. To further guide motion magnitude and quality, we add a motion prior that rewards natural scene-flow magnitude while penalizing jitter and non-rigid artifacts. Our final recipe combines these two terms with a lightweight perceptual anchor. Across various autoregressive video backbones and various generation horizons, Stream4D improves 4D reconstruction quality, preserves motion more effectively, and achieves higher human-aligned preference. Project page: https://banyuanhao.github.io/Stream4D/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stream4D，针对流式自回归扩散视频模型在长程生成中出现几何漂移并退化为静态或不自然运动的问题，用前馈 4D 重建奖励取代静态 3D 重建 critic 来显式建模场景动态，并加入运动先验与轻量感知锚点。摘要称在多种自回归视频骨干和不同生成时长下，该方法提升了 4D 重建质量、更有效地保持运动，并获得更高的人类对齐偏好。
Motivation: 流式自回归扩散模型的训练目标只优化局部帧预测，难以保证长 rollout 下世界的几何与动态一致性。已有的双向方法用基于 3D Gaussian-Splatting 重建的奖励作为 critic，但单一刚性的 3D 重建无法建模动态场景，会把真实物体运动当作重建误差，导致模型通过冻结视频来最大化奖励，该捷径在自回归设置中尤为有害。
Method: Stream4D 用前馈 4D 重建奖励显式建模场景动态，使连贯运动能够获得高一致性奖励；同时加入运动先验，奖励自然的 scene-flow 幅度并惩罚抖动和非刚性伪影；最终的训练配方将这两项与轻量感知锚点 (lightweight perceptual anchor) 结合。
Result: 摘要报告在多种自回归视频骨干和不同生成时长的设置下，Stream4D 改进了 4D 重建质量，更有效地保持运动，并取得更高的人类对齐偏好。
Conclusion: 作者强调用动态 4D 重建奖励替代静态 critic 可以避免冻结视频的捷径，从而改善长程自回归视频生成中的几何一致性和运动质量。

papers.title: Where Grounding Accuracy Lives on the IoU Curve: Label-Free Inference-Time Boundary Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Vision--language models can identify the correct referent while returning an imprecise bounding box. We study whether a frozen direct-answer model can use its own prediction to allocate one additional localized observation without accessing target annotations at inference. Label-free precision refinement (LFPR) routes predicted-small regions to a higher-resolution pass, re-grounds the expression inside a context crop, admits a candidate only under fixed geometric guards, and returns a fixed coordinate-wise midpoint. We report results across three evidence tiers. On 31,921 retrospective Ref-L4 expressions, LFPR raises mAcc$_{0.5:0.95}$ from 72.947\% to 76.013\% (Acc@0.5 88.531\%$\to$89.725\%, Acc@0.9 55.788\%$\to$61.142\%). A frozen transfer to 30,969 RefCOCO/RefCOCO+/RefCOCOg expressions improves every dataset at Acc@0.5, mAcc, and mean IoU (pooled mAcc $+0.645$, Acc@0.5 $+0.817$), while Acc@0.9 is unchanged overall: routing alone gains $+1.162$ points there, but crop, guards, and fusion give back $-1.192$, offsetting rather than showing no strict-IoU effect. A prospective, image-disjoint Flickr30K Entities evaluation improves every endpoint (mAcc $+0.973$, Acc@0.9 $+1.022$), more strongly under a single-box variant (mAcc $+2.575$, Acc@0.9 $+3.689$). The same operator applied to two released grounding specialists improves every endpoint (Acc@0.9 $+1.569$/$+6.716$ for EGM-4B/8B) at roughly twice the latency, composing with specialist training rather than replacing it. A genuine unguarded control (guard removed from the same candidates) underperforms the incumbent on every metric, showing the guard is load-bearing. Together, these results show that referent selection and boundary precision are partially separable, with different components moving opposing regions of the IoU curve -- behavior a single threshold cannot reveal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言模型在指代正确的目标时返回的边界框不精确的问题，提出无标签推理时边界细化方法 LFPR（Label-Free precision refinement）。该方法让冻结的 direct-answer 模型利用自身预测，对小区域进行高分辨率二次定位、在上下文裁剪（context crop）中重新接地表达式，并在固定几何守卫下接受候选框，最后返回坐标方向中点。作者在三层证据上报告结果，指出指代选择与边界精度可部分分离，不同组件移动 IoU 曲线的不同区段。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型常能识别正确指代对象却给出不精确的边界框；作者希望在不访问目标标注的情况下，仅用模型自身预测在推理时分配一次额外的局部观察来细化边界。
Method: 提出 LFPR 流程：将预测出的较小区域路由到更高分辨率通道，在上下文裁剪中重新接地表达式，仅在固定几何守卫（geometric guards）下接受候选，并返回固定坐标方向中点。整个过程基于冻结的 direct-answer 模型，无需标签。
Result: 在 31,921 条 Ref-L4 表达上，mAcc0.5:0.95 从 72.947% 提高到 76.013%（Acc@0.5 88.531%→89.725%，Acc@0.9 55.788%→61.142%）。冻结迁移到 30,969 条 RefCOCO/RefCOCO+/RefCOCOg 表达在 Acc@0.5、mAcc 和 mean IoU 上均有提升（合并 mAcc +0.645，Acc@0.5 +0.817），但 Acc@0.9 总体不变：路由单独贡献 +1.162，而裁剪、守卫与融合回吐 -1.192。图像不重叠的 Flickr30K Entities 前瞻评估改善所有端点（mAcc +0.973，Acc@0.9 +1.022），单框变体更强（mAcc +2.575，Acc@0.9 +3.689）。应用于 EGM-4B/8B 两个已发布 grounding 专家时，所有端点均提升（Acc@0.9 +1.569/+6.716），代价约为两倍延迟。移除守卫的无保护对照在所有指标上劣于原方法，说明守卫是关键组件。
Conclusion: 作者认为指代选择与边界精度是部分可分离的能力，不同组件推动 IoU 曲线的相反区段，单一阈值无法揭示这种效应；LFPR 与专家模型训练可叠加而非替代。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Composition-Driven Phase Evolution in Sm-Doped BiFeO3 via Latent-Field Reconstruction of Atomically Resolved STEM Data
papers.abstract_en: Functionalities of ferroelectric materials are governed by the spatial organization and coupling of polarization, strain, lattice rotation, and structural order accessible via atomically resolved scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) images. Quantitative interpretation of atomic-resolution STEM data has conventionally relied on locating atomic columns and converting their fitted coordinates into local structural descriptors. Here, we develop a field-based approach in which atomic-resolution images are represented by spatially varying latent Bragg fields, whose amplitudes and phases provide continuous maps of crystalline order, lattice displacement, strain, rotation, and mode-specific residual structure. The observed atomically resolved images are decoded from the latent fields. We apply this framework to image series of Sm-substituted BiFeO3 spanning 0-20% Sm and crossing the composition-driven boundary between the R3c ferroelectric phase and the orthorhombic, nonpolar Pnma phase. Conventional atom-resolved parameterization is used as an independent validation, showing that reconstructed Bragg amplitude tracks local atomic-column intensity and that field-derived shear reproduces unit-cell angular distortions obtained from atom fitting. The combined analysis reveals a systematic evolution from extended ferroelectric domains at low Sm concentration, through the appearance and growth of localized regions with period-doubled Pnma order at intermediate compositions, to a connected Pnma-dominated state at high Sm content. The period-doubled order is accompanied by enhanced shear and lattice rotation and by progressive reorganization of the ferroelectric domain structure. These results establish latent-field reconstruction as a physically interpretable complement to atom finding and provide a unified framework for resolving composition-driven phase evolution in ferroic materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于场的原子分辨率STEM图像分析方法，用空间变化的潜在布拉格场（latent Bragg fields）表示晶格有序度、位移、应变、旋转与模态残余结构，并通过解码这些潜在场重建观测图像。作者将该框架应用于0–20% Sm掺杂BiFeO3的图像序列，跨过R3c铁电相与正交非极性Pnma相之间的成分驱动相界，并用传统原子柱拟合做独立验证。结果显示潜在场重构能够物理可解释地揭示从低Sm下扩展铁电畴，到中Sm下周期倍增Pnma局域区域出现并长大，再到高Sm下连通Pnma为主状态的系统演变。
Motivation: 传统原子分辨率STEM定量解释依赖定位原子柱并把拟合坐标转为局部结构描述符，缺乏连续场的统一视角；本文旨在发展一种无需显式原子定位的场基方法，以刻画铁电材料中极化、应变、晶格旋转与结构有序的耦合演化。
Method: 将原子分辨图像表示为一组空间变化的潜在Bragg场，其振幅和相位分别提供晶序、晶格位移、应变和旋转等连续映射，并从中解码观测图像；同时用常规原子分辨参数化作为独立验证，比较重建Bragg振幅与原子柱强度、场导出剪切与原子拟合得到的晶胞角畸变。
Result: 在Sm掺杂BiFeO3中，重建的Bragg振幅能追踪局部原子柱强度，场导出的剪切可复现原子拟合的晶胞角度畸变；联合分析展示了铁电畴随Sm含量增加的逐步重组、周期加倍Pnma有序区域的产生与增长，以及高Sm时连通的Pnma主导状态，且周期加倍有序伴随增强的剪切与晶格旋转。

papers.title: Continuous Adversarial MeanFlow Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Training fast generators on new domains with limited data remains challenging for two reasons. First, adapting a pretrained diffusion or flow model to a new domain leaves its costly multi-step sampling unaddressed, and existing acceleration methods are tied to the source parameterization--$ε$, $x$, $v$, or $u$--leaving heterogeneous pretrained models with no common acceleration target. Second, while adversarial refinement is proven effective for few-step quality, it is formulated only for instantaneous-velocity flows, not for the finite-interval average velocities that MeanFlow (MF) models predict. We address both problems. We propose MeanFlow-Transfer, which maps heterogeneous source outputs into a shared velocity representation, uses it to initialize an MF generator from the source weights, and optimizes an MF objective on the target domain. This unifies adaptation and acceleration in a single training loop across a broad range of pretrained models. We then introduce Continuous Adversarial MeanFlow, a post-training stage that extends continuous adversarial flow models from instantaneous velocities to MF's finite-interval average velocities. CAMF contrasts changes in a learned potential between real and predicted interval endpoints, recovering fine detail that MF regression averages away, and reduces to the instantaneous criterion in the vanishing-interval limit. Adapting four ImageNet-based source models--DiT ($ε$), SiT ($v$), JiT ($x$), iMF ($u$)--to five target domains, MF-T with CAMF matches or exceeds the fine-tuned teacher in FID and FDD at up to $125\times$ fewer Neural Function Evaluations (NFEs), while CAMF improves MF-T's few-step FID by $29\%$ on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MeanFlow-Transfer (MF-T)，将异构源参数化（ε、x、v、u）的预训练扩散/流模型统一映射到共享速度表示，并初始化 MF 生成器在目标域上优化，从而在一个训练循环内同时完成新域适配与少步加速。随后引入 Continuous Adversarial MeanFlow (CAMF) 后训练阶段，把连续对抗流从瞬时速度扩展到 MF 的有限区间平均速度。在四个 ImageNet 源模型到五个目标域的迁移中，MF-T 联合 CAMF 在最多 125× 更少 NFE 下匹配或超过微调教师，CAMF 平均提升 MF-T 少步 FID 29%。
Motivation: 将预训练扩散或流模型适配到新域时仍需要昂贵的多步采样，且现有加速方法依赖 ε、x、v 或 u 的特定参数化，异构模型缺乏统一的加速目标；同时对抗精炼仅针对瞬时速度流，无法直接用于预测有限区间平均速度的 MeanFlow 模型。
Method: 提出 MeanFlow-Transfer：将异构源模型的输出映射到共享速度表示，用源权重初始化 MF 生成器，并在目标域优化 MF 目标函数，统一适配与加速。再提出 Continuous Adversarial MeanFlow (CAMF) 后训练阶段，将连续对抗流从瞬时速度推广到 MF 的有限区间平均速度：通过对比学习势函数在真实与预测区间端点之间的变化来恢复 MF 回归平均掉的细节，并在区间趋于零时退化为瞬时对抗准则。
Result: 将 DiT (ε)、SiT (v)、JiT (x)、iMF (u) 四个 ImageNet 源模型适配到五个目标域时，MF-T 配合 CAMF 在最多 125× 更少神经函数评估 (NFE) 下匹配或超过微调教师的 FID 与 FDD，且 CAMF 平均将 MF-T 的少步 FID 改善 29%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为异构预训练模型提供统一的适配与加速框架，并通过连续对抗训练恢复回归平均化的细节；CAMF 在消失区间极限下还原为瞬时对抗流准则。论文处于审稿状态。

papers.title: CVSD-Reg: Cross-Modal Visual Semantic Prior Distillation for Robust LiDAR Registration
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based global point cloud registration has achieved remarkable progress, yet its reliance on geometric representations makes existing methods sensitive to variations in point density, scan pattern, viewpoint, and sensor characteristics. We propose CVSD-Reg, a robust global LiDAR registration framework that distills visual semantic priors from a vision foundation model into LiDAR representations. In Stage 1, a Point Transformer V3 student learns from a frozen DINOv2 teacher through contrastive distillation and spherical-manifold alignment, which preserves the hyperspherical geometry of the teacher embedding space. Self-supervised InfoNCE consistency and soft $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ invariance further encourage viewpoint-robust descriptors. In Stage 2, the distilled representation is adapted to registration through correspondence learning, density-aware point-dropout augmentation, and end-to-end pose optimization. With a single checkpoint, CVSD-Reg generalizes to both single-sensor and zero-shot cross-sensor scenarios without sensor-specific adaptation and remains entirely camera-free at inference. On KITTI, nuScenes, and HeLiPR, CVSD-Reg achieves strict success rate (SR@0.5\,m/$1^\circ$) of 97.7$\%$, 99.0$\%$, and 99.3$\%$, respectively, including 97.3$\%$ on sparse 16-beam Velodyne scans. It outperforms state-of-the-art geometric registration methods by up to 44.0 percentage points without requiring camera inputs or post-hoc ICP refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CVSD-Reg，一种跨模态视觉语义先验蒸馏的鲁棒全局 LiDAR 配准框架。方法通过两阶段训练将视觉基础模型 DINOv2 的语义先验蒸馏到 Point Transformer V3 的 LiDAR 表示中，先进行对比蒸馏与球面流形对齐，再通过对应学习、密度感知点丢弃增强和端到端位姿优化完成配准适配。在 KITTI、nuScenes 和 HeLiPR 上分别取得 97.7%、99.0% 和 99.3% 的严格成功率（SR@0.5m/1°），在稀疏 16 波束 Velodyne 扫描上为 97.3%，无需相机输入或 ICP 后处理。
Motivation: 基于学习的全局点云配准依赖几何表示，对点密度、扫描模式、视角和传感器特性变化敏感；现有方法在跨传感器或稀疏场景下鲁棒性不足。
Method: 两阶段蒸馏框架：阶段一以冻结的 DINOv2 为教师、Point Transformer V3 为学生，通过对比蒸馏和球面流形对齐保留教师嵌入空间的超球面几何，并利用自监督 InfoNCE 一致性与软 SE(3) 不变性增强视角鲁棒性；阶段二通过对应学习、密度感知点丢弃增强和端到端位姿优化将蒸馏表示适配到配准任务。
Result: 单检查点即可泛化到单传感器和零样本跨传感器场景：KITTI、nuScenes、HeLiPR 的 SR@0.5m/1° 分别为 97.7%、99.0%、99.3%，稀疏 16 波束扫描上为 97.3%；相比最先进几何配准方法最高提升 44.0 个百分点，且不需要相机输入或 ICP 后处理。
Conclusion: 摘要表明视觉语义先验蒸馏能显著提升 LiDAR 全局配准在稀疏与跨传感器场景下的鲁棒性，且推理时完全无需相机，保持纯 LiDAR 工作流。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Retrieved Context to Runtime Control: Adaptive Compression for Edge-based RAG
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language-model responses by grounding generation in external passages, which comes with overhead: retrieved context lengthens the prompt, increasing prefill work, KV-cache footprint, memory traffic, latency, and energy. Context compression offers a natural remedy by pruning retrieved text before generation. However, state-of-the-art context-compression methods are typically used with a fixed compression budget, or with the rate selected offline and then applied at inference time. This static view ignores both workload variation and the live state of the edge device. On an edge SoC, compression is not free: the compressor itself runs on the same SoC and consumes latency and energy that can offset any generation savings. This paper proposes a vision for telemetry-informed adaptive compression in edge RAG, grounded in experimental evidence. We characterize the compression tradeoff on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor using Llama and Qwen generators, Natural Questions and HotpotQA datasets, and LLMLingua-2 compression. Our measurements show that generation dominates the RAG budget for larger models, reaching roughly 90% of per-query latency and 91% of GPU energy for 7B-8B generators. Exploring the impact of the compression rate reveals an adaptive operating region: mild compression can miss energy opportunities, and overly aggressive compression can hurt inference quality. Intermediate compression can reduce GPU energy by up to 53.2%, and SoC energy by up to 48.2%, with negligible quality loss. We argue for runtime policies that dynamically manage compression, guided by workload features and edge telemetry.
papers.comment: Accepted to appear in the Proceedings of the ACM AI Leadership Summit 2026. Zlatan Feric and Amir Taherin contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向边缘 RAG 的遥测感知自适应压缩 (telemetry-informed adaptive compression) 的研究愿景，并给出实验证据。作者在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor 上使用 Llama 与 Qwen 生成器、Natural Questions 与 HotpotQA 数据集以及 LLMLingua-2 压缩方法，刻画压缩率与延迟、能耗和质量之间的权衡。测量显示对 7B-8B 生成器，生成阶段约占单次查询延迟的 90% 和 GPU 能耗的 91%；中等压缩率可在几乎不损失质量的情况下将 GPU 能耗降低最多 53.2%、SoC 能耗降低最多 48.2%。
Motivation: 现有上下文压缩方法通常使用固定压缩预算或在离线选定压缩率后在推理时应用，忽视了工作负载变化和边缘设备的实时状态。在边缘 SoC 上压缩本身也消耗延迟和能量，可能抵消生成阶段的节省，因此需要动态、遥测感知的压缩策略。
Method: 论文首先在真实边缘 SoC 上系统刻画 RAG 中压缩率、延迟、能耗与生成质量之间的权衡，然后提出一种由工作负载特征和边缘遥测引导、在运行时动态管理压缩率的自适应压缩愿景；摘要未给出具体算法实现。
Result: 实验表明大模型的生成阶段主导 RAG 预算，约占每查询延迟的 90% 和 GPU 能耗的 91%；压缩率存在自适应工作区间，轻度压缩会错过节能机会，过度压缩则损害推理质量，而中等压缩率可将 GPU 能耗降低 53.2%、SoC 能耗降低 48.2%，且质量损失可忽略。
Conclusion: 作者主张采用运行时策略，依据工作负载特征与边缘设备遥测动态调整压缩率，而不是使用静态压缩预算；该结论基于单一 SoC 平台和特定模型/数据集组合的实验证据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Machines Speak: A Unified Generative Framework for Integrating Machine-Native Symbols into Pretrained Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world AI systems represent entities, behaviors, and structured information using discrete machine-native symbols rather than natural language. While these representations are compact and preserve task-relevant structure, they lie outside the linguistic token space of pretrained large language models (LLMs), creating a fundamental divide between language modeling and structured prediction. We introduce UniLang, a unified generative framework that bridges this divide by extending pretrained LLMs to treat machine-native symbols as first-class generative units alongside natural-language tokens. UniLang expands the LLM's vocabulary and embedding space with grounded machine-native representations, enabling textual and symbolic tokens to be jointly modeled and generated under a single autoregressive objective. This unified interface allows pretrained LLMs to directly operate on machine-native representations without requiring them to be verbalized as natural language or relying on task-specific architectures. We evaluate UniLang on two structurally distinct tasks, sequential recommendation and legal precedent prediction, spanning different domains and types of structured prediction. Across both tasks, UniLang consistently outperforms strong baselines, demonstrating a path toward extending pretrained LLMs beyond language and using them as a common generative modeling backbone for heterogeneous machine-native representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniLang，一个统一的生成式框架，通过扩展预训练大语言模型（LLM）的词汇表和嵌入空间，使机器原生符号（machine-native symbols）能与自然语言 token 在单一自回归目标下联合建模和生成。作者在序列推荐和法律先例预测两个结构不同的任务上评估，称 UniLang 稳定优于强基线，展现将预训练 LLM 用作异构机器原生表示通用生成骨干的路径。
Motivation: 现实 AI 系统常用离散机器原生符号而非自然语言表示实体与结构化信息，但这些表示位于预训练 LLM 的语言 token 空间之外，造成语言建模与结构化预测之间的根本隔阂。
Method: UniLang 扩展预训练 LLM 的词汇表和嵌入空间，加入有 grounded 的机器原生表示，使文本 token 与符号 token 能在单一自回归目标下被联合建模和生成，无需将符号转述为自然语言，也无需任务专属架构。
Result: 在序列推荐与法律先例预测两个任务上，UniLang 一致优于强基线，覆盖不同领域与结构化预测类型。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这项工作展示了将预训练 LLM 扩展到语言之外的路径，使其成为异构机器原生表示的通用生成建模骨干。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automated Summarization of Financial News Using Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation: An Early Empirical Study (Fall 2023)
papers.abstract_en: Stock market analysts and investors face a daily challenge: too much financial news, too little time. Manually reading and synthesizing hundreds of company-specific articles is impractical, yet missing key information can directly affect investment decisions. This project, conducted at George Washington University in Fall 2023, explores whether Large Language Models can automate this process reliably. We built a pipeline that pulls news articles from the News API, company background from Wikipedia, and stock price data from Yahoo Finance for ten major companies (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA, JPM, NVDA, WMT, DIS). Because LLMs cannot directly process numerical tables, we developed a simple but effective template that converts stock data into natural language narratives. We then tested two summarization approaches (Summarize Chains and Retrieval-Augmented Generation with FAISS) across three open-source models (Falcon-7B-Instruct, DistilBART-CNN-12-6, BART-Large-XSum) for news, and GPT (text-davinci-003) for stock summaries. Falcon-7B with Summarize Chains gave the best results, covering all news events accurately and coherently. RAG, while promising in theory, caused severe repetition in Falcon and hallucinated facts in BART-Large when k was large. Both LLM-based approaches outperformed a simple Lead-3 baseline on ROUGE-1. We also built a Streamlit dashboard for interactive stock visualization. The work was done in Fall 2023, before RAG-based financial tools became widespread, and the failure modes we document, particularly hallucination under RAG in smaller models, remain relevant today.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Research conducted Fall 2023 at George Washington University; manuscript prepared for public release in 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是2023年秋季在乔治华盛顿大学完成的早期实证研究，探索用大语言模型与检索增强生成（RAG）自动化总结金融新闻。作者构建了从 News API、Wikipedia 和 Yahoo Finance 获取新闻、公司背景和股价数据的流水线，将股价数字表格转换为自然语言模板，并比较 Summarize Chains 与基于 FAISS 的 RAG 在 Falcon-7B-Instruct、DistilBART-CNN-12-6、BART-Large-XSum 及 GPT text-davinci-003 上的效果。结果显示 Falcon-7B 配合 Summarize Chains 表现最佳，两种 LLM 方法均优于 Lead-3 基线；RAG 在大 k 值下导致 Falcon 严重重复和 BART-Large 产生幻觉。
Motivation: 股票分析师和投资者每天面临海量金融新闻而时间有限，人工阅读和综合数百篇公司相关文章不切实际，漏掉关键信息可能直接影响投资决策。该工作旨在检验大语言模型能否可靠地自动化这一过程。
Method: 搭建流水线：用 News API 拉取新闻、Wikipedia 获取公司背景、Yahoo Finance 获取股价数据；针对 LLM 不能直接处理数值表格的问题，设计简单模板把股票数据转成自然语言叙述。测试 Summarize Chains 与基于 FAISS 的 RAG 两种摘要方法在三个开源模型上进行新闻摘要，并用 GPT（text-davinci-003）做股票摘要；还构建了基于 Streamlit 的交互式股票可视化仪表盘。
Result: Falcon-7B 配合 Summarize Chains 组合效果最佳，能准确、连贯地覆盖所有新闻事件；RAG 在 k 值较大时导致 Falcon 出现严重重复、BART-Large 产生幻觉；两种 LLM 方法在 ROUGE-1 上均优于简单 Lead-3 基线。
Conclusion: 该研究于2023年秋季完成，早于 RAG 金融工具的普及，作者指出其记录的小模型在 RAG 下出现幻觉等失败模式至今仍有参考价值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LF-GICP: Parameter-Free Degeneracy-Aware LiDAR Odometry via a Voxel-Normal Localizability Field
papers.abstract_en: Scan-to-map LiDAR odometry drifts unboundedly along the unobservable axes of geometrically degenerate environments like tunnels and corridors, and existing degeneracy handling requires environment-specific parameter tuning. This paper presents a parameter-free approach. We show that in voxelized GICP the Gauss--Newton (GN) Hessian masks translational degeneracy, because covariance regularization keeps the translation block artificially well-conditioned. We bypass this with a regularization-free voxel-normal localizability field and two of its statistics: a normalized fraction $f_0$ detecting directional anisotropy, and an absolute per-voxel mass $λ_0$ distinguishing information absence (tunnels) from dilution (dense open scenes). A temporal-median gate combines both to trigger Fisher-information correspondence weighting. Calibrated once by fixed rules on two short sequences and then frozen, LF-GICP achieves the lowest KITTI relative translation error ($0.865\%$) under an identical evaluation protocol against re-run baselines, outperforms them on GEODE tunnels and MulRan, leads the HeLiPR mean, and generalizes across four sensor types without re-tuning. We further demonstrate empirically that straight, uniform tunnels remain unobservable along their axis for LiDAR-only registration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LF-GICP，一种参数无关的退化感知 LiDAR 里程计方法。作者指出在体素化 GICP 中协方差正则化会使 GN Hessian 的平移块人为良态，从而掩盖平移退化，因此改用无正则化的体素法线局部可定位性场 (voxel-normal localizability field)。通过两个统计量（归一化分数 f0 与绝对体素质量 λ0）区分方向各向异性和信息缺失/稀释，并用时间中值门控触发基于 Fisher 信息的对应加权。在固定规则校准后不再调整参数，实验显示其 KITTI 相对平移误差为 0.865%，并在 GEODE、MulRan、HeLiPR 及四种传感器类型上泛化良好。
Motivation: 扫描到地图的 LiDAR 里程计在隧道、走廊等几何退化环境中会沿不可观测轴无界漂移，而现有退化处理方法依赖环境特定参数调优，缺乏无需调参的通用方案。
Method: 提出正则化自由的体素法线局部可定位性场，并利用两个统计量：归一化分数 f0 检测方向各向异性，绝对体素质量 λ0 区分信息缺失（隧道）与信息稀释（密集开阔场景）；二者通过时间中值门控联合触发 Fisher 信息对应加权。校准仅在两条短序列上用固定规则完成一次，之后参数冻结。
Result: 在相同评估协议下，LF-GICP 取得 KITTI 最低相对平移误差 0.865%，优于重新运行的基线；在 GEODE 隧道和 MulRan 上超过基线，在 HeLiPR 均值上领先，并且无需重新调参即可泛化到四种传感器类型。此外，实验表明直线均匀隧道沿其轴向对 LiDAR-only 配准仍不可观测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调无正则化的局部可定位性场与基于 Fisher 信息的加权可以有效处理几何退化环境，且参数固定后具有跨传感器泛化能力；同时给出直线均匀隧道沿轴不可观测的经验结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In Two Minds about Lifelong Learning: Exploring Hemispheric Redundancy and Specialisation in Neural Models
papers.abstract_en: Persistent intelligent systems require the ability to learn continually, but current machine learning approaches face significant challenges in this area compared to biological learning systems. Machine learning algorithms typically trade off retention of previously learned information and adaptation to new or changing data patterns. When continual learning capabilities are absent, algorithms must undergo retraining using the entire data set, an approach that becomes impractical when original training data are unavailable due to storage constraints, financial or computational costs, or privacy restrictions. However, biological animals can learn continually, without experiencing catastrophic forgetting. This paper attempts to build a high-level framework for how animals learn and preserve knowledge by modelling neural components and states that are known to be related to memory consolidation. We focus on three concepts: experience replay, REM sleep, and bilaterality. We propose 4MAS (4 Module Awake/Sleep), a novel macroarchitecture demonstrating how machine learning models might benefit from asymmetric hemispheres, each with their own long- and short-term memory mechanisms, and how a period of sleep between incremental learning tasks might benefit memory consolidation. Finally, we present results showing that our architecture achieves competitive results on the Split-MNIST, Split-Fashion-MNIST and Split-CIFAR-100 datasets, with 98.3%, 84.9%, and 29.29% accuracy respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受生物启发的持续学习宏观架构 4MAS（4 Module Awake/Sleep），利用不对称半球、各自的长短期记忆机制，并在增量学习任务之间插入睡眠期以促进记忆巩固。摘要报告该方法在 Split-MNIST、Split-Fashion-MNIST 和 Split-CIFAR-100 上分别达到 98.3%、84.9% 和 29.29% 的准确率。
Motivation: 机器学习持续学习需要在保留旧知识与适应新数据之间权衡；缺乏持续学习能力时须用全量数据重训，而原始数据常因存储、计算成本或隐私限制而不可得。生物系统却能持续学习而不发生灾难性遗忘，因此作者希望借鉴生物记忆巩固机制构建高层框架。
Method: 论文聚焦经验回放（experience replay）、REM 睡眠和双侧性（bilaterality）三个概念，提出 4MAS 宏观架构：模型包含两个不对称半球，各自拥有长期与短期记忆机制，并在连续增量学习任务之间加入睡眠阶段用于记忆巩固。
Result: 摘要报告该架构在 Split-MNIST、Split-Fashion-MNIST 和 Split-CIFAR-100 上分别达到 98.3%、84.9% 和 29.29% 的准确率，并称其结果具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为，带有不对称半球和睡眠期的架构可以展示机器学习模型如何从类似生物的记忆巩固中受益；摘要未给出超出上述基准的泛化性结论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Symposium: Trust via Auditable Records for Communities of AI Scientist Agents
papers.abstract_en: Symposium is a formal framework and practical implementation to record the operation of AI agents deployed by small scientific research communities. Symposium provides long-term, immutable histories of agent-driven research activity, leaving auditable trails of analyses, hypotheses, data, and scientific discourse. This shared record of published artifacts enables agents to build on prior work and preserves the evidence researchers and agents need to make purpose-dependent trust assessments. Symposium captures scientific argument, including structured claims, fine-grained evidence citations, assumptions, and explicit declarations of what material may and may not be used as evidence. Symposium differs from AI co-scientist agents or integrated AI research environments; it is a framework that separates a scientific community's durable history from the agents and other systems that operate on that history. It assumes that a community will use diverse AI systems in a rapidly evolving environment. A working implementation of the publication infrastructure, agent prompt components, and documentation are provided to enable users to rapidly set up and run their own Symposium community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Symposium，一个形式化框架与实用实现，用于记录小型科学研究社区中 AI 代理的运行历史。它为代理驱动的研究活动提供长期不可变的历史，包含分析、假设、数据和科学讨论的可审计痕迹，并捕获结构化主张、细粒度证据引用、假设以及证据使用声明。论文强调该框架将社区的持久历史与操作这些历史的代理分离，并提供了可运行的发布基础设施、代理提示组件和文档。
Motivation: AI 科学家代理在快速演化的环境中被社区使用，但缺乏一种与其运行系统解耦的持久、可审计历史，使得代理难以在前人工作基础上继续研究，研究者也难以做出依赖目的的信任评估。
Method: Symposium 作为一个独立于具体代理系统的框架，提供长期不可变的代理驱动研究活动记录，结构化保存科学论证（含主张、证据引用、假设）并明确声明哪些材料可作为证据；同时提供可部署的发布基础设施和代理提示组件。
Result: 论文提供了一套可运行的实现，包括发布基础设施、代理提示组件和文档，使社区能够快速搭建并运行自己的 Symposium 社区。
Conclusion: Symposium 的定位是记录框架而非 AI 共同科学家代理或集成式 AI 研究环境，其价值在于让社区在快速变化的 AI 生态中保留独立、可审计的科研历史，并支持基于证据的信任评估。

summary_sections.motivation: AI 科学家代理在快速演化的环境中被社区使用，但缺乏一种与其运行系统解耦的持久、可审计历史，使得代理难以在前人工作基础上继续研究，研究者也难以做出依赖目的的信任评估。
summary_sections.method: Symposium 作为一个独立于具体代理系统的框架，提供长期不可变的代理驱动研究活动记录，结构化保存科学论证（含主张、证据引用、假设）并明确声明哪些材料可作为证据；同时提供可部署的发布基础设施和代理提示组件。
summary_sections.result: 论文提供了一套可运行的实现，包括发布基础设施、代理提示组件和文档，使社区能够快速搭建并运行自己的 Symposium 社区。
summary_sections.conclusion: Symposium 的定位是记录框架而非 AI 共同科学家代理或集成式 AI 研究环境，其价值在于让社区在快速变化的 AI 生态中保留独立、可审计的科研历史，并支持基于证据的信任评估。

papers.title: Graph Surgery and the Do-Operator: A Precise Correspondence for Acyclic Structural Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: The $\operatorname{do}$-operator is described graphically by deleting arrows into its targets and functionally by replacing their mechanisms with constants. To call these operations equivalent is not yet a mathematical statement: one returns a graph and remembers only the targets, whereas the other returns mechanisms and also remembers the imposed values. We make a dependency-level comparison precise for deterministic acyclic structural causal models with finitely many endogenous variables. If $\operatorname{Graph}(F)$ extracts the dependencies of a mechanism family $F$, our main theorem is $\operatorname{Graph}(F^ι)=\operatorname{Surg}(\operatorname{Graph}(F),T_ι)$. Thus replacing target mechanisms removes exactly the dependencies removed by graph surgery. For a model $M=(G,F)$ whose graph may contain unused arrows, we characterize when the same equality holds with $G$ in place of $\operatorname{Graph}(F)$; it holds for every intervention exactly when $G$ records the dependencies of $F$ exactly. We then define the intervened model, characterize its run, show how sequential interventions combine, and prove that an outcome depends only on interventions at its actual dependency ancestors. All principal results are machine-checked in an accompanying Lean 4 development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对确定性无环结构因果模型中 do 算子的两种描述——图层面删除箭头（图手术）与函数层面用常数替换机制——给出了依赖级别上的精确数学对应。主定理表明 Graph(F^ι)=Surg(Graph(F),T_ι)，即替换目标机制恰好移除图手术所移除的依赖。作者还刻画了当模型图包含未使用箭头时等式成立的条件，并证明干预结果只依赖于实际依赖祖先，所有主要结果均在 Lean 4 中机器验证。
Motivation: 现有文献把 do 算子的图描述（删除箭头）与函数描述（用常数替换机制）称为等价，但这不是严格的数学陈述：前者只返回图和目标，后者返回机制并保留施加值。本文旨在为这种等价提供一个依赖级别的精确表述。
Method: 针对含有限内生变量的确定性无环结构因果模型，定义 Graph(F) 提取机制族 F 的依赖关系，给出主定理 Graph(F^ι)=Surg(Graph(F),T_ι)；并考虑图可能包含未用箭头的模型，刻画相同等式对任意干预成立的条件。还定义了干预模型，表征其运行，说明顺序干预的组合方式，并证明结果只取决于实际依赖祖先。
Result: 摘要报告主定理正式建立了图手术与 do 算子函数替换在依赖层面的精确对应；当图 G 准确记录 F 的依赖时，对每个干预等式都成立。干预结果只依赖实际依赖祖先这一性质也被证明，且全部主要结论已在 Lean 4 开发中机器验证。
Conclusion: 论文将该对应关系及其成立条件限定在确定性无环结构因果模型上，并通过 Lean 4 机器验证保证主要定理的可靠性。

papers.title: Agents unlock new capabilities through Switching LoRA Adapters as a Tool (SLAaaT)
papers.abstract_en: Post-training can unlock new capabilities and improve performance on specialized tasks, but sometimes at the cost of catastrophic forgetting in other domains. This poses a problem in long agent trajectories that compose different capabilities. We reject this tradeoff by giving an agent a tool to switch between specialized LoRA adapters mid-trace. To test its effectiveness, we compose two synthetic coding tasks that are logically simple but require specialization. We find that this allows the model to solve problems it previously could not, that the model is able to switch autonomously (and find a new strategy that beats our human heuristic baseline on one task), and that this incurs an up to an 18x reduction in capability tax compared to an agent using only one specialized adapter. Our approach also substantially outperforms spawning subagents in both task capabilities (solving 4 of our hardest tasks versus none) and token usage (46.1x fewer tokens in some scenarios).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SLAaaT，让智能体在长轨迹执行中通过一个工具在多个专门的 LoRA 适配器之间动态切换，以规避微调带来的灾难性遗忘 (catastrophic forgetting) 与特定任务能力之间的权衡。作者在两个合成编码任务上验证，发现该机制能让模型解决原本无法解决的问题、自主切换适配器并在一个任务上超越人工启发式基线，相比单一专门适配器最多降低 18 倍的能力税 (capability tax)，同时在任务达成和 token 开销上大幅胜过子智能体 (subagents) 方案。
Motivation: 后训练可以在专门任务上提升性能，但可能在其他领域造成灾难性遗忘；而在需要组合多种能力的长智能体轨迹中，这种权衡尤为有害。
Method: 不将多种能力塞进同一个模型，而是给智能体提供一个工具，使其能在轨迹中途切换专门的 LoRA 适配器，并在合成编码任务上测试这种切换能否自由组合不同能力。
Result: 在合成编码任务上，该方法解决了模型此前无法解决的问题；模型能够自主切换适配器，并在一个任务上找到优于人工启发式基线的策略；与只用单一专门适配器的智能体相比，能力税最多降低 18 倍；与子智能体方案相比，解决了 4 个最难任务（后者为 0 个），且某些场景下 token 使用减少 46.1 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过切换 LoRA 适配器可以拒绝‘专门化必然带来遗忘’的权衡，让长轨迹智能体组合多种能力，并在任务解决率与 token 效率上显著优于子智能体。

papers.title: Automating Learner Assessment: Benchmarking Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for EEG-Based Familiarity Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Objective assessment of learning remains a fundamental challenge in education. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a direct, non-invasive window into the neural correlates of knowledge acquisition, including cognitive familiarity. This study benchmarks fifteen machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for EEG-based familiarity prediction across two cognitive domains: faces (factual knowledge) and mathematical equations (conceptual knowledge). Using continuous EEG data from 23 participants, we extract spectral features (Power Spectral Density) across six frequency bands. We show that while standard stratified cross-validation yields artificially high classification performance (up to 0.9853 F1-score using CNN) due to temporal leakage across neighboring epochs, a rigorous trial-independent validation (Group K-Fold) drops the peak performance to 0.6038 F1-score (using CNN), which is still statistically significant above the 25% chance level. This highlights the critical necessity of trial-independent evaluation to avoid overestimating model generalizability. Furthermore, feature importance and SHAP analysis reveal that temporal and frontal Gamma and Beta oscillations are the most critical biomarkers for familiarity. This work establishes a realistic benchmark for EEG-based cognitive monitoring in educational technologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对基于EEG的熟悉度预测进行了基准测试，比较15个机器学习与深度学习模型在面孔（事实知识）和数学方程（概念知识）两个认知领域上的表现。使用23名参与者的连续EEG数据，提取六个频段的功率谱密度（Power Spectral Density）特征。结果显示标准分层交叉验证因相邻epoch间的时间泄漏而虚高（CNN最高F1达0.9853），而基于trial独立的Group K-Fold验证将峰值性能降至0.6038 F1，但仍显著高于25%随机水平。SHAP与特征重要性分析表明颞叶和额叶的Gamma与Beta振荡是关键生物标志物。
Motivation: 教育中学习的客观评估仍是基本挑战，EEG能直接非侵入地反映知识获取的神经关联（认知熟悉度），但现有研究缺乏严谨且避免时间泄漏的基准，容易高估模型泛化能力。
Method: 在两个认知领域上系统对比15种机器学习与深度学习模型，使用连续EEG提取六频段PSD特征；分别采用标准分层交叉验证和trial-independent的Group K-Fold验证，并通过特征重要性和SHAP分析识别关键神经生物标志物。
Result: 标准分层交叉验证下CNN达到0.9853 F1，但在Group K-Fold下峰值降至0.6038 F1（CNN），仍显著高于25%随机水平；颞叶和额叶的Gamma与Beta振荡被识别为最重要的熟悉度生物标志物。
Conclusion: 作者强调必须使用trial-independent评估以避免时间泄漏导致的对模型泛化能力的高估，并认为该工作为教育技术中的EEG认知监测建立了现实基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PosterText: Towards Unified Visual Text Generation and Editing for E-commerce Poster
papers.abstract_en: Automated e-commerce poster design requires both high-quality poster generation and flexible editing of existing designs. However, most existing methods either target end-to-end poster generation or follow multi-stage design pipelines, with limited capability for flexible and precise editing of existing posters. To enable unified generation and editing of e-commerce posters, we introduce Text Patch Generation and Editing, a unified task formulation that treats text patches as atomic units and covers four operations: poster generation, patch addition, patch deletion, and patch modification, with optional reference-guided style control. Based on this, we propose PosterText, a unified model trained with a four-stage curriculum, including text rendering pretraining, instruction-following training, reinforcement learning for preference alignment, and spatial guidance self-distillation for execution refinement. We further construct a large-scale dataset with patch-level annotations and a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PosterText achieves competitive performance against existing generation and editing approaches, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PosterText，一个面向电商海报的统一视觉文本生成与编辑模型。作者将任务形式化为 Text Patch Generation and Editing，以文本块为原子单元，涵盖海报生成、文本块添加、删除和修改四种操作，并支持可选的参考图风格控制。模型采用四阶段课程训练，包括文本渲染预训练、指令跟随训练、用于偏好对齐的强化学习以及用于执行精化的空间引导自蒸馏。作者还构建了带补丁级标注的大规模数据集和 benchmark，实验表明该方法在生成与编辑任务上达到有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有自动电商海报设计方法要么做端到端生成，要么走多阶段设计管线，普遍缺乏对已有海报进行灵活、精确编辑的能力，难以同时满足高质量生成与灵活编辑的需求。
Method: 提出统一的 Text Patch Generation and Editing 任务形式，将文本块视为原子单元并覆盖生成、添加、删除、修改四种操作；基于此训练统一模型 PosterText，采用文本渲染预训练、指令跟随训练、强化学习偏好对齐和空间引导自蒸馏组成四阶段课程。
Result: 摘要报告 PosterText 在生成与编辑任务上均取得与现有方法相当的有竞争力性能，验证了该统一框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调以文本块为原子单元的统一任务定义和四阶段课程训练能够同时支撑海报生成与灵活编辑，但未报告具体数值或编辑精度细节。

papers.title: Ask to Be Sure: Informative Interactions for Confident Multi-Turn LLM Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled their use as conversational recommender systems (CRS), demonstrating strong recommendation accuracy and natural dialogue. However, guiding multi-turn interactions to elicit user preferences effectively remains challenging. Existing approaches either use separate reinforcement learning agents with templated interactions or optimize for interactivity judged by another LLM, without measuring how much useful information is actually gained. We propose a new approach that quantifies the effectiveness of each interaction by the reduction in the assistant's uncertainty, measured via entropy over recommendations. We apply this entropy reduction as a reward---without relying on ground-truth recommendations, which are often unavailable in real-world scenarios---to fine-tune the LLM, enabling strategic interaction generation. Empirical results with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO) on the INSPIRED and ReDial datasets show that our method improves both recommendation quality and conversational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向多轮 LLM 对话推荐的新方法，用推荐熵的减少量来量化每次交互带来的信息增益，并将其作为奖励信号微调 LLM，从而生成更有策略性的交互。该方法不依赖 ground-truth 推荐，在 INSPIRED 和 ReDial 数据集上结合 SFT 与 DPO 训练，摘要报告推荐质量和对话效率均得到提升。
Motivation: 现有方法要么使用模板化交互的独立强化学习智能体，要么用另一个 LLM 来评判交互性，但都没有直接度量交互实际获取了多少有用信息。真实场景中 ground-truth 推荐往往不可用，因此需要一个不依赖它的信号来引导多轮偏好 elicitation。
Method: 以推荐概率分布熵的减少作为每次交互有效性的量化指标，并将该熵减少作为奖励用于微调 LLM，使其学会生成信息量更大的交互。实验采用 supervised fine-tuning (SFT) 和 direct preference optimization (DPO) 两种训练方式。
Result: 在 INSPIRED 和 ReDial 数据集上的实验显示，该方法同时提升了推荐质量和对话效率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于熵减少的奖励可以在不依赖 ground-truth 推荐的情况下改进多轮 LLM 推荐的交互策略，并兼顾准确性与对话收敛速度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Is Shallow Enough? Adaptive Split Federated Learning with Client-Specific Sufficiency Estimation
papers.abstract_en: \textit{Split Federated Learning} (SFL) enables distributed model training by splitting networks between the server and clients. However, under client heterogeneity, the conventional static split strategy may be suboptimal because clients can differ in data distributions, adaptation dynamics, and representation learning progress, making a single split point insufficient to accommodate client-specific training states. In this paper, we propose \textsc{FedSGA}, a \textbf{S}ufficiency-\textbf{G}uided \textbf{A}daptive split \textbf{Fed}erated learning framework that addresses this question through client-specific shallow sufficiency estimation. First, we introduce a client-specific adaptation channel based on private prompt tokens, which tracks local adaptation dynamics separately from the shared backbone and provides a lightweight signal for detecting whether client adaptation remains active. To further avoid repeated online probing over multiple candidate depths, we design a shallow sufficiency estimator that combines cross-client semantic alignment, temporal interface stability, and prompt-state variation to estimate whether the shallowest split is already sufficient. Finally, we introduce a split-compatible interface harmonization module that projects activations from different split depths into a shared semantic space, improving the comparability of heterogeneous client interfaces before server-side prediction. Extensive experiments on multiple heterogeneous benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of \textsc{FedSGA} in improving model performance compared with state-of-the-art methods while reducing unnecessary client-side computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedSGA，一个基于充分性引导的自适应切分联邦学习 (Split Federated Learning, SFL) 框架，针对客户端异构下静态切分点次优的问题。方法通过客户端特定适配通道、浅层充分性估计器以及切分兼容接口对齐模块，动态判断最浅切分是否已经足够。实验在多个异构基准上表明相比现有方法能提升模型性能，同时减少不必要的客户端计算。
Motivation: 传统 SFL 采用静态切分策略，但客户端在数据分布、适配动态和表示学习进度上各不相同，单一 split point 难以适配所有客户端的训练状态，因而在客户端异构场景下可能次优。
Method: FedSGA 首先引入基于私有 prompt tokens 的客户端特定适配通道，将本地适配动态与共享主干分离，作为检测客户端适配是否仍在进行的轻量信号。其次设计浅层充分性估计器，结合跨客户端语义对齐、时间接口稳定性和 prompt 状态变化，估计最浅切分是否已足够，从而避免对多个候选深度反复在线探测。最后加入切分兼容接口对齐模块，将不同切分深度的激活投影到共享语义空间，增强异构客户端接口在服务端预测前的可比性。
Result: 摘要在多个异构联邦学习基准上的实验表明，FedSGA 相比现有最先进方法能提升模型性能，同时降低不必要的客户端计算开销。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过客户端特定的浅层充分性估计，可以在异构联邦场景中实现自适应切分，在保持模型性能的同时减少客户端侧计算负担。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LongRCA Bench: Diagnosing Responsible Roles and Root Causes in Long-Horizon Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: When a long-horizon agent execution fails, outcome-level evaluation reveals the unsuccessful result but not where the decisive error entered the trajectory. Developers must then inspect the full execution to identify the responsible role and localize the earliest decisive root-cause step. Existing failure-attribution benchmarks largely focus on shorter traces, leaving diagnosis across hundreds of recorded steps underexplored. We introduce LongRCA Bench, comprising 1,140 failed trajectories across five domains without injected errors. It provides independently scored human labels for the responsible role and earliest decisive root-cause step. The median trajectory contains 145 steps, and the strongest baseline reaches only 13.2% exact root-step accuracy. We further present Root-Cause Trajectory Attribution (RCTA), a training-free method that retrieves candidate error steps from segment summaries and traces them to available earlier handoff instructions. Using the same backbone, benchmark instances, and scoring protocol, RCTA reaches 51.1% responsible-role accuracy and 24.1% exact root-step accuracy. These results highlight the need to evaluate responsible-role attribution and exact root-step localization as separate targets in long-trajectory failure diagnosis.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Yunfei Zhang and Boyu Feng contributed equally. Changhua Pei is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LongRCA Bench，一个面向长周期智能体执行失败诊断的基准，包含五个领域共 1,140 条无注入错误的失败轨迹，并为责任角色 (responsible role) 和最早决定性根因步骤 (root-cause step) 提供独立评分的人工标注。基准中轨迹中位步数为 145 步，最强基线仅达到 13.2% 的精确根因步骤准确率。作者还提出无需训练的 RCTA 方法，在该基准上达到 51.1% 的责任角色准确率和 24.1% 的精确根因步骤准确率。
Motivation: 现有失败归因基准多集中于较短轨迹，缺乏对数百步长轨迹中责任角色与最早决定性根因步骤的诊断研究，而这类诊断对开发者定位错误源头至关重要。
Method: 构建 LongRCA Bench 基准，包含五个领域、1,140 条失败轨迹和独立评分的人工标签；提出 Root-Cause Trajectory Attribution (RCTA)，一种无需训练的方法，从片段摘要中检索候选错误步骤并回溯到更早的手令指令 (handoff instructions)。
Result: 最强基线在精确根因步骤上仅达 13.2% 准确率；RCTA 使用相同骨干、基准实例和评分协议，达到 51.1% 责任角色准确率和 24.1% 精确根因步骤准确率。
Conclusion: 结果表明应将责任角色归因与精确根因步骤定位作为长轨迹失败诊断中的两个独立评估目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Andy: A Mathematical Agent for Rigorous Proof and Autonomous Research
papers.abstract_en: Andy is an autonomous mathematical research agent that turns a mathematical problem into a traceable proof. It solves or verifies a submitted problem, formulates a literature-grounded new problem through a research-value gate, and carries it through proof construction and final verification. It organizes proof steps in an executable DAG, verifies each step independently and binds the result to a certificate, retains verified work whose interfaces remain unchanged during local repair, and records the full path from problem formulation to final proof. The system separates proof generation from correctness evaluation and can acquire, retain, retrieve, and reuse knowledge from existing results. Starting from a self-triggered impulsive consensus result, Andy formulates a global exponential leader-follower synchronization problem for delayed heterogeneous networks with switching communication topologies. The proposed hybrid control combines self-triggered impulses with execution delay and continuous feedback over a recovery window. After each delayed impulse, the feedback cancels the delayed error channel until the pre-impulse history leaves the active delay interval. Sufficient conditions for global exponential synchronization are established, Zeno behavior is excluded for both timing sequences, and a numerical example illustrates the result.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, and 3 algorithms. Research logs, reports, and simulation code are available at https://github.com/mowaiwaim/Andy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Andy，一个自主数学研究代理，将输入的数学问题转化为可追踪证明，并能通过研究价值门控提出有文献依据的新问题，再完成证明构造与最终验证。系统用可执行 DAG 组织证明步骤，对每步独立验证并绑定证书，局部修复时保留接口未变的已验证工作，从而把证明生成与正确性评估分离。作为应用演示，Andy 从自触发脉冲一致性结果出发，针对带切换通信拓扑的时滞异构网络提出全局指数 leader-follower 同步问题，并给出混合控制方案。
Motivation: 数学研究的自动化面临证明生成与正确性评估耦合、已验证知识难以保留和复用、以及从问题形式化到最终证明的完整路径难以追踪等挑战。该工作通过设计一个端到端的自主代理来解决这些问题。
Method: 系统将证明步骤组织为可执行 DAG，每一步独立验证并绑定证书；在局部修复时保留接口未变的已验证工作，并记录从问题提出到最终证明的完整路径。针对同步问题，作者提出将自触发脉冲与执行延迟结合、并在恢复窗口内加入连续反馈的混合控制，以在每次延迟脉冲后抵消延迟误差通道。
Result: 摘要报告建立了带切换通信拓扑的时滞异构网络全局指数同步的充分条件，排除两种时序序列下的 Zeno 行为，并用数值算例验证了结果。
Conclusion: 论文强调分离证明生成与正确性评估、通过可执行 DAG 和证书机制保证证明可追踪性，并演示了从现有自触发脉冲一致性结果到新同步控制问题的完整自主研究路径；摘要未明确说明系统局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LODESTAR: Robust Entropy-Based Answer Selection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Question Answering -- Directing Frozen-LLM Entropy with a Reinforcement-Learned Prompt Polarizer under Misleading Passages
papers.abstract_en: Predictive-distribution entropy is a strong answer-selection rule in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for question answering: across five QA benchmarks, selecting the answer a frozen respondent LLM produces with the lowest answer-token entropy lifts mean $F_1$ from 0.4769 to 0.5148 over the retriever's top-ranked passage, without gold answers. Yet this rule, which prior entropy-based selectors adopt, fails: a misleading passage makes the respondent confidently wrong, driving entropy down where the uncertainty signal looks most trustworthy. The failure comes from the passage the respondent reads, and the context it is read in is an input we can intervene on. We introduce LODESTAR: to our knowledge the first method to score a text intervention by the uncertainty it induces in a third-party frozen respondent, compared within one question. LODESTAR uses reinforcement learning (GRPO) to train, once and offline, a polarizer -- a short fixed natural-language string inserted into the respondent's prompt and never into its weights, directing entropy so that entropy-based answer selection stays robust to misleading passages; training labels are built from gold answers and two LLM judges, and inference reads neither. With every competing selector under the same frozen respondent and candidate pools on 5,008 questions, LODESTAR attains the highest mean $F_1$ of any inference-ready selector (0.5339), the highest macro exact match (0.4136), and the highest GPT-4o judge score of the frozen-respondent configurations judged (0.6435); its three-seed mean wins all 70 $F_1$ cells against fourteen published configurations and is paired-significant on $F_1$ against every one. The gain holds in-domain on NQ-Open and out-of-domain over SQuAD, TriviaQA, EntityQuestions and WebQuestions. Ablating the polarizer shows it is what makes the respondent read a misleading passage less often (26.0% vs 30.3%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对检索增强生成 (RAG) 问答中基于预测分布熵 (predictive-distribution entropy) 的答案选择规则提出改进。作者指出该规则在误导性段落 (misleading passages) 下会失效，因为冻结的 respondent LLM 会自信地给出错误答案从而压低熵。为此提出 LODESTAR，用强化学习 (GRPO) 离线训练一个 polarizer——一段插入 prompt 的固定自然语言字符串，不修改模型权重——来引导熵，使基于熵的答案选择对误导性段落保持鲁棒；推理时不需要 gold answers 或 LLM judges。在 5,008 个问题上，LODESTAR 取得所有可推理选择器中最高平均 F1 (0.5339)、最高 macro EM (0.4136) 和最高 GPT-4o judge 分数 (0.6435)。
Motivation: 现有基于熵的答案选择规则在面对误导性段落时会失效：虚假检索内容使 respondent 模型自信且错误，熵信号在看似最可信的地方反而不可靠。作者认为问题出在 respondent 读取的上下文，而上下文是可以在输入端干预的，因此提出对该输入干预本身进行评分。
Method: LODESTAR 据作者所知是第一个通过第三方冻结 respondent 在同一个问题内所诱导的不确定性来给文本干预 (text intervention) 打分的方法。它使用 GRPO 离线训练一个 polarizer，即一段短小的、插入 respondent prompt 的固定自然语言字符串，用于引导熵使答案选择保持鲁棒；训练标签由 gold answers 和两个 LLM judges 构造，推理时不读取这些信息。
Result: 在 5,008 个问题上，LODESTAR 取得最高平均 F1 (0.5339)、最高 macro exact match (0.4136) 以及被评分的冻结 respondent 配置中最高的 GPT-4o judge 分数 (0.6435)；三种子均值在 70 个 F1 cell 上全部胜过十四个已有配置，且 F1 上对每个配置均达到配对显著性。增益在域内 NQ-Open 与域外 SQuAD、TriviaQA、EntityQuestions、WebQuestions 上均保持。消融显示 polarizer 使 respondent 读取误导性段落的频率从 30.3% 降至 26.0%。

papers.title: A Model-Internal Protocol for Assessing Multimodal Models as Integrated Systems
papers.abstract_en: As Large Vision-Language Models increasingly aim to integrate visual generation and understanding within a single parameter space, evaluating such structural unification in a cohesive manner remains a critical challenge. Current evaluation protocols predominantly treat generative and discriminative capabilities as separate tasks, leaving a gap in system-level evaluation for unified multimodal models (UMMs). In this work, we propose Self-Generative-Understanding (SGU), a novel, annotation-free evaluation framework that probes the integrated capabilities of unified models through a semantic closed-loop challenge. Without requiring new annotations, SGU leverages the dual understanding-and-generation abilities of UMMs by asking them to first perceive an image and produce a textual description, subsequently reconstruct a visual context based on that description, and finally perform reasoning over the self-generated output. This pipeline provides a zero-cost testbed that yields an integrated performance score specifically tailored for evaluating UMMs as unified systems. Extensive experiments show that even high-performing UMMs often struggle to reason over their own generated contexts, revealing limitations that are not captured by separate evaluations of understanding or generation alone. Our work provides a complementary holistic evaluation framework and offers a foundation for benchmarking the development of next-generation unified multimodal models.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 8 figures, 12 tables. Title updated; author contribution and corresponding-author notes added. Hao Zhang and Jiaxin Qi contributed equally; Jianqiang Huang is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对统一多模态模型（UMMs）的系统级评估框架 Self-Generative-Understanding (SGU)，通过让模型先感知图像并生成文本描述、再基于描述重建视觉上下文、最后对自生成输出进行推理，形成语义闭环测试。该框架无需额外标注，输出一个综合性能分数，用于评估将视觉生成与理解集成在同一参数空间中的模型。实验表明，即使是高性能的 UMMs 也常难以对自身生成的上下文进行推理，暴露了单独评估理解或生成能力时未发现的局限。
Motivation: 现有评估协议大多将生成能力与判别能力作为独立任务分别测试，缺少对统一多模态模型（UMMs）进行系统级、整体性评估的方法，因此无法捕捉结构统一带来的集成能力缺陷。
Method: 提出 SGU 框架，利用 UMMs 自身的理解与生成双重能力构建无需人工标注的语义闭环：先感知图像并输出文本描述，再依据描述重建视觉上下文，最后对自生成输出进行推理，据此计算集成性能分数。
Result: 大量实验显示，即使高性能的 UMMs 也常在推理自身生成内容时表现困难，这些局限在单独的理解或生成评估中无法被观察到。
Conclusion: 本文提供一个互补的整体性评估框架，为下一代统一多模态模型的基准测试奠定基础；摘要未提及该方法在具体数据集上的量化指标或与其他评估协议的详细对比。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Compositional Localization and Placement Assessment of Catheters and Tubes in Chest X-Rays
papers.abstract_en: Assessing catheter and tube placement on chest X-rays is safety-critical yet tedious and error-prone. Current deep learning methods either classify placement globally -- losing track of which device is where -- or segment all devices into a single mask, making per-device assessment impossible when catheters overlap. We introduce UCompCXR, a compositional framework that detects local catheter fragments, associates them into device instances via graph-based clustering, fuses per-fragment tip predictions through precision-weighted Gaussian estimation, and classifies placement per device. On the RANZCR CLiP dataset (30,083 images, 5-fold patient-level CV with bootstrap CIs), UCompCXR detects 26% more devices than a strong multi-task baseline sharing the same MobileNetV3 backbone, with 75% fewer false positives and well-calibrated tip uncertainty (95% coverage = 0.948). The aggregate tip error rises -- but only because the model finds devices the baseline misses entirely, especially nasogastric tubes. On matched devices, catastrophic localization failures drop substantially. At 2.27M parameters in a single forward pass, the model is deployable on resource-constrained clinical hardware.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 8 figures Included declaration for paper is under consideration at Pattern Recognition Letters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UCompCXR，一个用于胸片（chest X-ray）中导管和管路置放评估的复合式（compositional）框架：先检测局部导管片段，再通过基于图的聚类（graph-based clustering）将其关联成设备实例，用精度加权高斯估计（precision-weighted Gaussian estimation）融合各片段的尖端预测，并逐设备分类置放状态。在 RANZCR CLiP 数据集（30,083 张图像，5 折患者级交叉验证及 bootstrap 置信区间）上，UCompCXR 比共享 MobileNetV3 主干的强多任务基线多检出 26% 的设备，假阳性减少 75%，尖端不确定性校准良好（95% 覆盖率 = 0.948）。
Motivation: 导管和管路置放评估是安全关键且繁琐易错的任务；现有深度学习方法要么全局分类而丢失设备位置信息，要么把所有设备分割成单一掩码，导致设备重叠时无法逐设备评估。
Method: UCompCXR 采用组合式流程：检测局部导管片段，通过图聚类将片段关联为设备实例，对每个片段的尖端预测做精度加权高斯融合，并逐设备进行置放分类；模型以单次前向传播约 2.27M 参数运行。
Result: 在 RANZCR CLiP 数据集上，UCompCXR 比同骨干的强多任务基线多检测出 26% 的设备，假阳性降低 75%，尖端不确定性校准良好（95% 覆盖率 = 0.948）。总体尖端误差上升，原因在于模型检出了基线完全遗漏的设备（尤其是鼻胃管）；在匹配设备上，灾难性定位失败大幅减少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调逐设备评估与良好校准的不确定性，并指出该模型可在资源受限的临床硬件上部署；总体尖端误差的上升被归因于检出了基线遗漏的设备而非性能退化。

papers.title: SparSTAR: Sparse Attention for SpaceTime AutoRegressive Video Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: InfinityStar extends visual autoregressive generation to video through a sequence of image and clip pyramids. Its changing scale and cross-clip context, however, leave late-scale attention costly and make sparse patterns reused from diffusion or image VAR models unreliable. We introduce SparSTAR, a training-free block-sparse attention method tailored to this setting. At each expensive scale and attention head, SparSTAR scores contiguous key blocks from the current query and key activations, retains required conditioning context, and executes the selected blocks through a forward-only sparse path. We analyze cross-scale consistency within a clip, pattern persistence across clip boundaries, and quality degradation as reuse spans increasingly distant scales. Across these analyses, important key blocks shift, showing that recomputing block selection at each target scale is more reliable than reusing a transferred mask. On 720p text-to-video and image-to-video generation, SparSTAR preserves every token and refinement scale while providing about a 1.6x end-to-end speedup and maintaining VBench and paired-output reconstruction fidelity close to dense InfinityStar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SparSTAR，一种面向 InfinityStar 视频自回归生成框架的无训练块稀疏注意力方法。InfinityStar 通过图像与 clip 金字塔序列进行生成，但尺度变化和跨 clip 上下文使后期尺度注意力成本高昂，且从扩散或图像 VAR 模型复用的稀疏模式不可靠。SparSTAR 在昂贵的尺度和注意力头上对连续键块评分、保留条件上下文，并通过仅前向稀疏路径执行选中块。在 720p 文本到视频和图像到视频生成上，它以约 1.6 倍端到端加速保留全部 token 与细化尺度，VBench 和配对重建保真度接近密集 InfinityStar。
Motivation: InfinityStar 将视觉自回归生成扩展到视频时，随尺度变化和跨 clip 上下文出现的高成本注意力缺乏合适的稀疏方案，而直接复用扩散或图像 VAR 模型的稀疏模式不可靠。
Method: 提出无训练的块稀疏注意力方法 SparSTAR：在每个昂贵尺度和注意力头上对当前查询和键激活的连续键块进行评分，保留所需条件上下文，并通过仅前向稀疏路径执行选中块。作者还分析了 clip 内跨尺度一致性、clip 边界模式持久性以及跨远距离尺度复用的质量退化，发现重要键块会移动，因此每个目标尺度重新计算块选择比复用转移掩码更可靠。
Result: 在 720p 文本到视频和图像到视频生成任务上，SparSTAR 保持所有 token 和细化尺度，实现约 1.6 倍端到端加速，同时维持接近密集 InfinityStar 的 VBench 和配对输出重建保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在目标尺度重新计算块选择比复用转移掩码更可靠，且该方法是训练-free 的，可直接应用于现有生成流程。

papers.title: GENCO - A Unified Neural Solver Embedded in a Development Framework for Steady-State Grid Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are transforming business workflows and boosting productivity, yet they remain largely absent from engineering domains such as power system analysis, where strict physical consistency must be enforced. We present GENCO (GEometric Neural Corrective Optimizer), a unified neural solver for steady-state transmission grid analysis that handles power flow (PF), optimal power flow (OPF), and state estimation (SE) within a single architecture and shared grid representation. To support advances in neural power system solvers, we introduce the open-source GridFM Development Framework, which standardizes synthetic data generation and training in a low-code environment. We also release large-scale datasets with millions of PF and OPF scenarios across diverse grid topologies to support reproducible benchmarking. We evaluate GENCO on the PFDelta and OPFData benchmarks against state-of-the-art neural solvers and classical solvers, including Newton-Raphson and IPOPT, as well as on real-world Hydro-Québec SCADA data. For large-scale PF, GENCO recovers the full AC operating state, including voltage magnitudes and reactive power that DC-PF cannot provide, while matching DC-PF-level active power-balance residuals. It achieves up to 30x speedups over Newton-Raphson at only 2x the runtime of DC-PF. For OPF, it achieves up to 85x speedups over IPOPT while improving feasibility, optimality, and runtime over DC-OPF. For SE, GENCO is more robust than classical weighted least squares to noisy measurements and grid parameter errors, and always returns a high-quality estimate even when weighted least squares fails to converge. Together, the unified architecture and development framework provide a new approach to large-scale steady-state grid analysis, lowering the barrier to entry for power system engineers and marking a step toward Grid Foundation Models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GENCO (GEometric Neural Corrective Optimizer)，一个统一的神经求解器，用于稳态输电电网分析，在单一架构和共享电网表示中同时处理潮流 (PF)、最优潮流 (OPF) 和状态估计 (SE)。作者同时发布开源 GridFM Development Framework，以低代码环境标准化合成数据生成与训练，并公开包含数百万 PF 和 OPF 场景的大规模多拓扑数据集。在 PFDelta、OPFData 基准和真实 Hydro-Québec SCADA 数据上的评估显示，GENCO 在大规模 PF 上可达 Newton-Raphson 的 30 倍加速（运行时仅为 DC-PF 的 2 倍），在 OPF 上可达 IPOPT 的 85 倍加速，且 SE 对噪声测量和参数误差比加权最小二乘更鲁棒。
Motivation: 基础模型 (foundation models) 已改变业务流程并提升生产力，但在电力系统分析等工程领域仍然基本缺席，而这类领域必须强制执行严格的物理一致性。作者旨在为大规模稳态电网分析提供统一的神经求解器，并降低该领域工程师的入门门槛。
Method: 提出统一架构 GENCO，在单一架构和共享电网表示下处理 PF、OPF 与 SE 三类任务；配套发布开源 GridFM Development Framework，用于低代码环境下的合成数据生成和标准化训练；并发布大规模多拓扑 PF/OPF 场景数据集以支持可复现的基准测试。

papers.title: Verifiably grounded machine interpretation of lunar geology
papers.abstract_en: Planetary geology relies on historical, interpretive reasoning to reconstruct past events from diverse observations. Here, we investigate how far this interpretive workflow can be automated by a multimodal vision-language model. Focusing on the stratigraphy of lunar basaltic mare volcanism, we train a model to generate verifiably grounded geologic interpretations directly from co-registered topographic, spectral, and geologic maps. We demonstrate that while the system successfully balances established geological priors with local visual evidence to accurately describe stratigraphy and terrain, numeric age dating derived solely from vision defaults to memorized priors. Integrating an open-book retrieval mechanism resolves this, enabling the model to faithfully cite published chronologies. Our findings delineate the necessary architecture for automated geologic inference: site evidence must be visually interpreted from local data, while quantitative historical context must be retrieved from the scientific record.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态视觉-语言模型能在多大程度上自动化行星地质学中的解释性推理流程，并以月球玄武岩月海火山活动的地层学为切入点。作者训练模型直接从配准的地形图、光谱图与地质图中生成可验证的地质解释，并引入开放检索 (open-book retrieval) 机制使模型能够引用已发表的年代学数据。摘要指出，纯视觉输入下的数值年龄定年会退化为记忆先验，而结合检索机制后模型可忠实引用已有年代序列，从而勾勒出自动化地质推断所需的架构。
Motivation: 行星地质学依赖历史性、解释性的推理，从多种观测重建过去事件，而现有自动化方法难以保证解释的可验证性和对已有科学记录的忠实引用。
Method: 提出一个基于多模态视觉-语言模型的系统，输入为共配准的地形、光谱和地质图，直接生成可验证的地质解释；此外集成开放检索机制，从科学文献中检索并引用已发表的地质年代信息。
Result: 系统能够平衡既有地质先验与局部视觉证据，准确描述地层学和地形；但仅凭视觉进行数值年龄定年时会退化为记忆先验，加入开放检索后该问题得到解决。
Conclusion: 作者认为自动化地质推断的必要架构是：场地证据必须从局部数据中视觉解释，而定量历史背景应从科学记录中检索获取。

papers.title: SportsGrounder: Proposal-Aided Interleaved Grounding for Dense Sports Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Sports video analysis is crucial for athletic analytics and broadcasting enhancement. Dense sports video reasoning, however, demands a fine-grained understanding of numerous small-scale, highly interactive, and visually homogeneous entities (e.g., players sharing identical uniforms, the ball) across long temporal contexts. Current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) inherently struggle with such dense visual complexities. Due to the lack of fine-grained visual details, these models often over-rely on textual priors to guess answers, especially when distinguishing visually similar actions and players. To address this, we propose SportsGrounder, a framework that leverages an open-vocabulary visual expert to aid interleaved grounding specifically for dense sports video reasoning. To achieve precise spatial localization, we extract domain-guided object proposals and introduce an Interleaved Grounding Fusion (IGF) mechanism. The IGF frame-by-frame integrates explicit bounding box coordinates and implicit visual semantics with global grid features. This design preserves strict temporal alignment and prevents sequence length explosion. Furthermore, we design an Action-Aware Supervision (AAS) module that directly regularizes the model's hidden states, forcing the network to learn accurate motion representations rather than relying on language bias. Optimized with Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO) to better distinguish deceptive distractors, our extensive experiments on newly curated dense sports VQA datasets (derived from SoccerNet and FineSports) demonstrate that SportsGrounder significantly improves fine-grained reasoning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SportsGrounder，一个面向密集体育视频推理的框架，利用开放词表视觉专家（open-vocabulary visual expert）进行交错式 grounding。该方法通过领域引导的目标提议提取、Interleaved Grounding Fusion (IGF) 逐帧融合边界框坐标与隐式视觉语义，并设计 Action-Aware Supervision (AAS) 直接约束模型隐状态以避免语言偏置，配合 Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO) 优化。在由 SoccerNet 和 FineSports 派生出的密集体育 VQA 数据集上，摘要报告该方法显著提升细粒度推理能力并达到 state-of-the-art 准确率。
Motivation: 当前大型多模态模型（LMMs）在密集体育视频推理中难以处理大量小尺度、高度交互且视觉上同质的目标（如穿着相同球衣的球员和球），因缺乏细粒度视觉细节而过度依赖文本先验猜测答案，尤其在区分视觉相似动作和球员时表现不佳。
Method: 提出 SportsGrounder 框架：先提取领域引导的目标提议（domain-guided object proposals），再通过 IGF 机制逐帧将显式边界框坐标和隐式视觉语义与全局网格特征（global grid features）融合，以保持严格时间对齐并避免序列长度爆炸；另设 AAS 模块直接正则化模型隐状态以学习准确动作表征，并使用 MPO 来更好区分具有欺骗性的干扰项。
Result: 在新构建的密集体育 VQA 数据集（源自 SoccerNet 和 FineSports）上的大量实验表明，SportsGrounder 显著改善细粒度推理，并取得 state-of-the-art 准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将显式的提议级 grounding 与动作感知监督结合，能够减少 LMMs 对语言偏置的依赖，从而提升密集体育视频推理能力；实验范围限于 SoccerNet 与 FineSports 派生的数据集。
Relevance: 0
