papers.title: WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN
papers.abstract_en: Recent vision-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into vision-language-action (VLA) policies that map egocentric observations and language instructions directly to navigation actions. Although semantically capable, such action-centric training does not explicitly model how the agent's visual observations should evolve under its predicted motion. Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, yet existing WAMs for continuous VLN do not condition joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware representations inferred from the observed history. We present WNM-3D, a generative World Navigation Model with 3D scene conditioning for continuous VLN. To consolidate past observations into persistent scene context, a frozen feed-forward geometry encoder extracts geometry-aware representations from the monocular egocentric RGB history, and a trainable 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter converts them into a fixed-length prefix in the token space of the world-action Diffusion Transformer. Through block-causal attention, this prefix conditions every future video-action block, providing a shared geometric context for both future-view and action generation. We train WNM-3D through supervised world-action fine-tuning on A*-generated demonstrations, DAgger-style adaptation on policy-visited states, and Counterfactual DanceGRPO refinement for closed-loop execution. Experiments on GN-Bench show that WNM-3D outperforms strong VLM-based navigation policies and its 2D-conditioned counterpart in closed-loop navigation. Stage-wise ablations further show that DAgger-SFT provides the larger success-rate gain, while Counterfactual DanceGRPO subsequently improves both navigation success and path efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WNM-3D 是一种用于连续视觉语言导航（VLN）的生成式世界导航模型，通过 3D 场景条件化来联合预测未来视图和动作。它使用冻结的几何编码器从单目 RGB 历史中提取几何感知表示，经可训练的 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter 转换为固定长度前缀，并通过块因果注意力条件化世界动作 Diffusion Transformer 的每个未来视频-动作块。模型经监督微调、DAgger 式适应和 Counterfactual DanceGRPO 三个阶段训练，在 GN-Bench 闭环导航上超过强 VLM 策略及 2D 条件版本。
Motivation: 现有 VLN 系统把预训练视觉语言模型适配为视觉-语言-动作策略，直接由观测和指令映射动作，但没有显式建模观测在预测运动下应如何演变。已有的生成式世界动作模型（WAM）在连续 VLN 中未对观测历史中推断出的几何感知表示进行条件化。
Method: 提出 WNM-3D：冻结的前馈几何编码器从单目无关的 egocentric RGB 历史提取几何感知表示，可训练的 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter 将其转换为世界动作 Diffusion Transformer 令牌空间中的固定长度前缀；通过块因果注意力，该前缀为联合未来视图与动作生成提供共享几何上下文。训练采用监督式世界动作微调、DAgger 式策略访问状态适应，以及 Counterfactual DanceGRPO 闭环执行细化。
Result: 在 GN-Bench 上，WNM-3D 在闭环导航中优于强 VLM 导航策略及其 2D 条件版本。逐阶段消融显示 DAgger-SFT 带来更大的成功率提升，而 Counterfactual DanceGRPO 进一步同时改善导航成功率和路径效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将几何感知的 3D 场景表示纳入世界动作模型的条件生成，对闭环 VLN 中的未来视图与动作联合预测是有益的，并展示了分阶段训练策略的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why AI Detection Fails for Academic Integrity
papers.abstract_en: Institutions use commercial AI detectors for academic integrity, yet detectors cannot distinguish AI editing from full LLM drafts and may treat both as misconduct. In a controlled study of published English abstracts (four domains; 2013 to 2015 vs. 2023 to 2025), we quantify this policy failure under proxy human/AI labels at tau=0.50. Light "refine abstract only" edits, a proxy for guideline-compliant AI assistance, are flagged at 38 to 80%. Unmodified 2023 to 2025 originals are flagged at 9 to 15%, with non-STEM rates far above STEM (p<0.001); elevated scores track long-token and Academic Word List density, not authorship intent alone. After Undetectable AI humanization, evasion is near-total: fewer than 4% of AI-labeled rewrites remain flagged (post-humanization detection rate <4%; FNR >96%). Honest AI-editing results in a higher sanction risk than humanizer-assisted evasion. Therefore, detector scores should not serve as standalone misconduct evidence.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM AI Leadership Summit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究商业 AI 检测器在学术诚信审查中的政策失败。基于四个领域、2013-2015 与 2023-2025 两个时段的已发表英文摘要，在代理性人类/AI 标签（tau=0.50）下，作者量化了检测器对合规性 AI 编辑与完整 LLM 草稿的误判：轻微的 "refine abstract only" 编辑被标记为 AI 生成的比例为 38-80%，而未修改的 2023-2025 年原始摘要也有 9-15% 被标记，非 STEM 领域远高于 STEM（p<0.001）。经过 Undetectable AI 人性化改写后，AI 标记重写的检测率低于 4%（FNR 大于 96%）。
Motivation: 高校使用商业 AI 检测器维护学术诚信，但检测器无法区分 AI 编辑与完整 LLM 草稿，可能将两者都视为不当行为，从而造成错误处罚的政策风险。
Method: 作者采用受控研究设计，以已发表英文摘要为样本，覆盖四个领域并对比两个时段的数据，在代理标签（tau=0.50）下比较三类文本的检测结果：未修改原始摘要、轻度 "refine abstract only" 编辑，以及经 Undetectable AI 人性化的改写稿。

papers.title: Evaluating Investment Logic in Large Language Models: A Real-World Benchmark Towards Personalzied Financial Agents
papers.abstract_en: Investment competence is inherently personalized: the same market evidence can justify different actions for investors with different goals, horizons, portfolios, and risk boundaries. Yet financial LLMs are evaluated either by static question answering or by terminal profit and loss. The former omits agency; the latter cannot reveal whether a profitable action was grounded, profile-consistent, or merely lucky. We ask whether the community is using the wrong ruler for consequential agents. We introduce \textsc{InvestLogicBench}, a process-native benchmark containing 201,247 documented decisions from 151 real-world investors. Each episode instantiates a \textbf{P$\rightarrow$E$\rightarrow$R$\rightarrow$D$\rightarrow$O} trace: investor \textit{Profile}, observable market \textit{Events}, investment \textit{Reasoning}, executable \textit{Decision}, and delayed \textit{Outcome}. The release includes profile construction, point-in-time event binding, structured logic, horizons, outcomes, and post-mortems, and supports comprehension, profile-conditioned generation, and end-to-end replay. Across four leading LLMs, logical plausibility remains near 4/5 while event grounding is only 0.8--2.8/5; return and process quality also disagree. These results expose polished but weakly grounded reasoning that outcome-only evaluation hides. We further argue that P$\rightarrow$E$\rightarrow$R$\rightarrow$D$\rightarrow$O should be a data-system interface, requiring versioned profiles, temporal provenance, inspectable retrieval, decision ledgers, and replayable outcomes. Finance is our stress test for a broader class of personalized, consequential agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InvestLogicBench，一个过程原生的投资逻辑基准，包含 151 位真实投资者的 201,247 条决策记录，每条实例构成 P→E→R→D→O（Profile→Events→Reasoning→Decision→Outcome）轨迹。对四个主流 LLM 的评测显示，逻辑合理性接近 4/5，而事件接地性仅有 0.8–2.8/5，且收益与过程质量不一致，说明模型推理看似合理但缺乏充分的市场证据支撑。作者进一步主张把 P→E→R→D→O 作为数据系统接口，并以此作为更广泛个性化、后果性智能体的测试场景。
Motivation: 现有金融 LLM 评估要么依赖静态问答、忽略投资者的主体能动性，要么只看最终盈亏，无法判断盈利行为是否有依据、是否符合投资者画像或只是运气；社区需要一把过程导向的尺子。
Method: 构建 InvestLogicBench，收集并整理 151 位真实投资者的 201,247 条决策，为每个实例构造投资者 Profile、市场 Events、投资 Reasoning、可执行 Decision 与延迟 Outcome 的完整轨迹，支持理解、画像条件生成和端到端回放评估。
Result: 在四个领先 LLM 上，逻辑合理性得分接近 4/5，而事件接地性仅 0.8–2.8/5；收益指标与过程质量指标相互不一致，暴露了结果导向评估所掩盖的弱接地推理。
Conclusion: 作者认为 P→E→R→D→O 应作为数据系统接口，需要版本化画像、时间点事件绑定、可检查检索、决策账本与可回放结果；金融是这类个性化、后果性智能体评测的压测场景。

papers.title: Provably Efficient Self-Calibrating Quantum Fault Tolerance
papers.abstract_en: Quantum error correction protects logical information only when every physical operation remains below the fault-tolerance threshold, a condition that must be maintained continuously rather than only at the initial calibration. In practice, however, analog control parameters inevitably drift because of environmental fluctuations. As future fault-tolerant quantum computations are expected to run for days or even months, interrupting computation for repeated recalibration becomes fundamentally impractical. A promising alternative is to integrate calibration directly into computation by repurposing syndrome measurements as a calibration signal (Sivak et al, Nature 2026), but whether such self-calibration can be achieved with provable efficiency remains an open question. Here we establish a theoretical framework for such self-calibrating quantum fault tolerance. We prove that, for a broad class of control-induced errors, the detection rate defines a locally strongly convex surrogate objective for analog calibration with high probability. This geometric property enables a simple and efficient online optimization algorithm using only syndrome measurements collected during normal error correction. We prove convergence to an $\varepsilon$ detection rate within $O(1/\varepsilon^2)$ epochs for time-independent drifts and also establish guarantees for time-dependent drifts. We further show that the convergence rate is independent of the code distance for quantum low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes. Pulse-level simulations of neutral-atom arrays and large-scale circuit-level Clifford simulations confirm these theoretical predictions. Our results establish self-calibrating fault tolerance as a provably efficient paradigm in which the same syndrome measurements simultaneously protect logical information and stabilize the underlying hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为量子自校准容错建立理论框架，证明在较广一类控制诱导误差下，检测率以高概率定义局部强凸的模拟校准替代目标。作者提出仅利用纠错过程中常规采集的综合征测量 (syndrome measurement) 的简单在线优化算法，证明对时间无关漂移可在 O(1/ε²) 个 epoch 内收敛到 ε 检测率，并给出时间依赖漂移的保证；同时证明收敛速率与量子 LDPC 码的码距无关。中性原子阵列的脉冲级模拟与大规模电路级 Clifford 模拟验证了理论预测。
Motivation: 量子纠错要求所有物理操作持续低于容错阈值，而模拟控制参数会因环境波动发生漂移；未来容错计算需运行数天至数月，反复中断重校准不切实际。将校准集成到计算中（如复用综合征测量）虽有前景，但能否以可证明的效率实现尚是开放问题。
Method: 作者建立自校准量子容错的理论框架：对一类控制诱导误差，证明检测率定义局部强凸的模拟校准替代目标；利用该几何性质，设计只需在正常纠错过程中收集综合征测量的简单高效在线优化算法，并分别分析时间无关与时间依赖漂移下的收敛性。
Result: 摘要证明对时间无关漂移，算法在 O(1/ε²) 个 epoch 内收敛到 ε 检测率；对时间依赖漂移也给出保证。收敛速率与量子 LDPC 码的码距无关。中性原子阵列的脉冲级模拟和大型电路级 Clifford 模拟均验证了理论预测。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该工作将自校准容错确立为一种可证明高效的范式：同一组综合征测量既能保护逻辑信息，又能稳定底层硬件。

papers.title: YOLOv14: Adaptive Real-Time Object Detection for Diverse Imaging Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Real-time object detectors achieve remarkable accuracy under controlled conditions, yet degrade sharply on non-ideal inputs-fisheye distortion, game-rendered content, aerial views, and 360°panoramas. We present YOLOv14, a unified adaptive detection framework that addresses these variations through four complementary mechanisms, formalized under a novel Adaptive Routing and Modulation (ARM) paradigm. Unlike conventional unsupervised domain adaptation, our approach employs Target-Prior Guided Source-Domain Augmentation(TP-SDA), using only 50 unlabeled target images offline to estimate style statistics, while adversarial alignment serves as a lightweight regularizer rather than the primary adaptation driver. Together, these components enable YOLOv14 to achieve 49.1 mAP on COCO val2017 at 2.91 ms (T4 GPU), with substantial gains of +4.1 (fisheye), +6.6 (panorama), +6.4 (drone), and +26.1 (gamestylized) mAP over YOLOv12s. Crucially, we validate generalization on real-world game screenshots (GTA-V, Unity), achieving +14.2 mAP, confirming practical transferability beyond synthetic benchmarks. Code and models are released at https://github.com/zhangcbb/yolov14.

TL;DR: 本文提出 YOLOv14，一个针对鱼眼畸变、游戏渲染内容、航拍视角和 360° 全景等非理想成像条件的统一自适应实时目标检测框架。其核心是 Adaptive Routing and Modulation (ARM) 范式，包含四种互补机制，其中 Target-Prior Guided Source-Domain Augmentation (TP-SDA) 仅用 50 张无标注目标图像离线估计风格统计，对抗对齐仅作为轻量正则项。摘要报告在 COCO val2017 上达到 49.1 mAP、2.91 ms (T4 GPU)，并在鱼眼、全景、无人机和游戏风格化数据上较 YOLOv12s 有显著提升。作者在 arXiv 评论中表示论文还需更科学地评估和修改。
Motivation: 现有实时检测器在受控条件下精度良好，但在鱼眼畸变、游戏渲染内容、航拍视角和 360° 全景等非理想输入上性能急剧下降，需要一种统一的适应性检测方案来应对这些输入变化。
Method: 提出 YOLOv14，在 ARM 范式下通过四种互补机制实现自适应检测；采用 TP-SDA，仅使用 50 张无标注目标图像离线估计风格统计进行源域增强，并将对抗对齐 (adversarial alignment) 作为轻量正则项而非主要适配手段。
Result: 摘要报告在 COCO val2017 上达到 49.1 mAP、2.91 ms (T4 GPU)；与 YOLOv12s 相比，在鱼眼、全景、无人机和游戏风格化数据上分别提升 +4.1、+6.6、+6.4 和 +26.1 mAP，并在 GTA-V、Unity 等真实游戏截图上取得 +14.2 mAP 的泛化提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在合成基准之外的真实世界游戏截图上验证了实用性，并开放代码与模型；作者同时注明论文仍需更科学地评估和修订。

papers.title: MinerU.Chem: A High-Precision System for Optical Chemical Structure and Reaction Recognition
papers.abstract_en: In organic chemistry papers and patents, molecular structures, reaction schemes, and experimental conditions are often presented as molecular structure depictions, reaction diagrams, and complex tables or figures. Such information is difficult for general-purpose document parsing systems to directly convert into machine-readable data. This limits data production for organic chemistry knowledge base construction and for AI for Chemistry tasks such as reaction prediction, retrosynthesis, condition recommendation, molecular property prediction, and drug molecule design. This report introduces MinerU-Chem, a document parsing system for organic chemistry literature integrated into the MinerU online platform. Built on top of MinerU's general document parsing pipeline, MinerU-Chem adds five chemistry-specific modules: chemistry relevance filtering, molecular structure detection, molecule identifier extraction, molecular structure recognition, and reaction scheme parsing. Together, these modules convert organic-chemistry-related image regions in documents into a Molecule Summary List and a Reaction Summary List. For molecular structure recognition, MinerU-Chem uses CARBON (Complex Atomic Representation and Bonding Object Notation) as its core representation. CARBON enables recognition results to preserve both the visual layout of the original image and complex chemical semantics, while supporting the export of standard downstream formats such as MolFile and SMILES. On the SMILES-evaluable subset of MolRecBench-Wild (N=2,392), MinerU-Chem's molecular structure recognition module achieves a SMILES exact-match accuracy of 93.02%, outperforming the best evaluated comparison system, GPT-5.6-Sol (74.87%), by 18.15 percentage points. The system has been integrated into the MinerU online platform and is available at https://mineru.net/OpenSourceTools/Extractor .
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 有机化学论文和专利中的分子结构、反应式及实验条件常以结构图、反应图和复杂表格呈现，通用文档解析系统难以直接将其转换为机器可读数据，制约了有机化学知识库构建以及反应预测、逆合成、条件推荐、分子性质预测和药物分子设计等 AI for Chemistry 任务的数据生产。

papers.title: FinVerse: Financial Time-Series Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: As time-series foundation models have emerged, the need for benchmarks that can evaluate their forecasting ability in meaningful ways has become increasingly important. Existing time-series forecasting benchmarks provide useful standardized comparisons, but they often evaluate heterogeneous series with uniform error-based metrics. Strong performance under such metrics does not necessarily imply that a model's forecasts will support the best real-world decisions across domains. For example, in stock forecasting, correctly predicting whether a price will rise or fall can be more directly relevant to realized returns than minimizing point-wise forecast error alone. To this end, we introduce FinVerse, a finance-domain time-series forecasting benchmark that takes a first step toward more realistic evaluation. The released FinVerse data artifact contains 116,897 financial time series with 171.1M observations, of which 60,232 series with 17.4M observations are selected as evaluated targets based on their economic relevance to financial decisions. Unlike generic forecasting benchmarks that primarily emphasize uniform point-forecast or probabilistic accuracy, FinVerse defines 11 metric families comprising 78 evaluation metrics and assigns the most appropriate evaluation metrics to each individual time series based on its underlying economic meaning. Our analysis of 43 public time-series forecasting foundation models shows that strong performance under generic forecasting criteria does not necessarily translate into useful financial forecasts. This finding highlights the need for domain-aware benchmarks that evaluate models under objectives closer to real-world decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinVerse，一个面向金融领域的时间序列预测基准，旨在弥补现有基准用统一误差指标评估异质序列、与真实决策目标脱节的问题。数据集包含 116,897 条金融时间序列、共 171.1M 观测值，其中 60,232 条序列（17.4M 观测值）按经济相关性被选为评估目标。FinVerse 定义了 11 个指标族、共 78 个评估指标，并根据每条序列的经济含义分配最合适的指标；对 43 个公开时间序列预测基础模型的分析表明，通用预测指标上的强表现并不必然转化为有用的金融预测。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测基准常用统一误差指标评估异质序列，导致强指标表现不一定支持真实决策；例如股票预测中正确判断涨跌比最小化逐点预测误差更直接相关于实际收益。因此需要领域感知的、更贴近真实决策目标的评估方式。
Method: 构建金融领域时间序列基准 FinVerse，发布包含 116,897 条序列与 171.1M 观测值的数据集，并基于经济相关性筛选出 60,232 条评估目标序列；同时定义 11 个指标族共计 78 个评估指标，依据每条序列潜在的经济含义为其指派最合适的指标。
Result: 对 43 个公开时间序列预测基础模型的分析显示，在通用预测标准下表现强的模型，其预测并不一定产生有用的金融预测结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要领域感知的基准，以更接近真实决策的目标来评估模型；这指向现有通用基准在金融等决策场景中的评估局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Multimodal Fusion Detection through Spatial Mask and Channel Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Deep multimodal fusion for object detection has demonstrated good performance through mining modal characteristics. However, existing feature-level fusion methods mainly weigh between two modalities and unify them in a unified representation space. This can lead to overfitting or over-specialization of the statistical properties of a single modality within a dual-backbone architecture. This paper proposes an Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling framework for robust improvement of cross-modality object detection. Based on a shared channel spatial attention mechanism, we first introduce the semantic mask exchange to actively mix the boundaries of the modalities during the training phase, forcing the backbone network to learn generalized features without relying on fixed modal labels. Then we propose a learnable channel competition to sample and aggregate features in a channel-wise and learnable way. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that the proposed method is effective and yields competitive results among existing state-of-the-art approaches. The source code is provided in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于跨模态目标检测的深度多模态融合框架，称为Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling。该方法基于共享通道空间注意力机制，引入语义掩码交换（semantic mask exchange）与可学习通道竞争（learnable channel competition），在多个数据集上取得与现有最先进方法竞争的结果。
Motivation: 现有特征级融合方法主要是在两种模态之间加权并将其统一到同一表示空间，这容易在双骨干架构中导致对单一模态统计特性的过拟合或过专门化，从而影响跨模态目标检测的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling框架：首先利用共享通道空间注意力机制，在训练阶段通过语义掩码交换主动混合模态边界，迫使骨干网络学习不依赖固定模态标签的广义特征；随后提出可学习通道竞争机制，以通道级、可学习的方式对特征进行采样与聚合。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明该方法有效，并在现有最先进方法中取得有竞争力的结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调主动混合模态边界与可学习通道竞争可以提升跨模态目标检测的鲁棒性，并指出源代码可在补充材料中获得。

papers.title: LLM Capability Limits: Static Emergence and Dynamic Boundary Control
papers.abstract_en: Test-time emergence in LLM systems has a deployment boundary: additional computation can realize decisions already supported by the deployed information--execution structure, while evidence, tools, memory, and executable semantics can change the class inherited by later computation. We formalize this boundary through inherited structural capability $\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{J}}$ and resource-indexed finite realization $\mathcal{F}_s(\mathcal{J},M)$. At a common budget, Theorem 1 gives an exact decision representation: a successor improves every bounded-loss task exactly when its closed convex finite envelope retains the predecessor's. Terminal capability can therefore expand while same-budget capability strictly reverses. The same object yields finite-slice recovery and a workload-tail information radius for open-ended evaluation. Dynamically, Bellman value prices the successor capability class together with the finite policies it preserves. Nested realization makes every fixed extra resource increment vanish at saturation, allowing persistent positive successor value to dominate that increment. The resulting theory turns emergence into a boundary, compatibility, measurement, and control problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个关于 LLM 系统测试时涌现 (test-time emergence) 的理论框架，形式化了部署边界：额外计算只能实现在既有信息-执行结构下已支持的决定，而证据、工具、记忆与可执行语义可以改变后续计算继承的类别。作者用继承结构能力 D_J 和资源索引有限实现 F_s(J,M) 刻画该边界，并把涌现转化为边界、兼容性、度量与控制问题。
Motivation: LLM 在测试时增加计算并不总是能提升能力，存在一个部署边界；现有讨论缺乏对该边界的形式化刻画，而证据、工具、记忆和可执行语义的变化又会改变后续计算继承的能力类别。
Method: 引入继承结构能力 D_J 与资源索引有限实现 F_s(J,M)，通过闭凸有限包络 (closed convex finite envelope) 给出决策表示，并结合 Bellman 价值与嵌套实现 (nested realization) 分析能力类别扩展与资源增量饱和现象。
Result: 定理 1 给出精确刻画：在公共预算下，后继模型恰好当它的闭凸有限包络保留前驱模型的包络时，才在每个有界损失任务上取得改进；终端能力可以扩展，而同预算能力可能严格反转。该方法还支持有限切片恢复和面向开放式评估的工作量信息半径。
Conclusion: 本文把涌现问题重新表述为边界、兼容性、测量和控制问题，指出固定额外资源增量在饱和后趋于消失，而持续的正后继价值可以主导该增量。

papers.title: A Neurosymbolic Approach for Explainable Early Diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease
papers.abstract_en: Identifying reliable Alzheimer's disease (AD) markers typically requires manual, labor-intensive transcription and expert analysis, limiting its scale. We introduce an automated pipeline that extracts qualitative knowledge about potential AD progression indicators directly from audio recordings of verbal fluency tests. Our method uses pretrained foundation models to process raw audio and extract clinically relevant variables to construct a Bayesian Network (BN); this BN is used to reason about the AD progression markers and infer their qualitative relationships. Our system successfully recovers known clinical knowledge and identifies novel relationships between linguistic markers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号方法，用于可解释的早期阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断。系统从言语流畅性测试的音频记录中自动提取临床相关变量，构建贝叶斯网络（Bayesian Network）来推理 AD 进展标志物及其定性关系。摘要称该方法能恢复已知临床知识并识别新的语言学标志物关系。
Motivation: 现有 AD 标志物识别通常依赖耗时的人工转录和专家分析，难以规模化。作者希望自动化该流程，直接从音频中提取知识。
Method: 使用预训练基础模型（pretrained foundation models）处理原始音频并提取临床相关变量，构建贝叶斯网络对 AD 进展标志物进行推理，形成一种神经符号（neurosymbolic）管道。
Result: 系统成功恢复已知的临床知识，并识别出语言学标志物之间新的定性关系。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该自动化管道能直接从音频中提取定性知识，为可解释的早期 AD 诊断提供支持；论文主题与天气预测领域无关。

papers.title: DASH-OPD: Discrepancy-Aware Switching with Hysteresis for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains student models on their own rollouts to reduce exposure bias. However, in multi-turn agent scenarios, early student errors can lead a trajectory away from the teacher's familiar domain. Existing curriculum learning methods regulate how much teacher support is used according to training progress, but cannot determine when it is needed. In light of this, we propose DASH-OPD, Discrepancy-Aware Switching with Hysteresis for OPD, the first agentic OPD method that can switch executors adaptively and bidirectionally. On each turn, DASH-OPD calculates a mean log-probability ratio between the two executors over action tokens as their discrepancy. Student-to-teacher ratios on student turns form drift signals, while teacher-to-student ratios on teacher turns form recovery signals. These signals are normalized and accumulated over multiple turns into drift and recovery evidence. DASH-OPD switches executors when the evidence exceeds its corresponding switching threshold. This multi-turn accumulation makes the switching hysteretic, preventing high-frequency switches caused by transient fluctuations. Across WebShop, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld at two student-model scales, DASH-OPD outperforms five baselines in all 14 task-performance comparisons while yielding the shortest trajectories in nine of ten turn-count comparisons, offering the strongest overall performance-efficiency trade-off. This paper is a work in progress. Code, training logs, and model checkpoints will be released later.

TL;DR: 本文提出 DASH-OPD，一种面向在线策略蒸馏 (on-policy distillation) 的智能体方法，能在学生与教师执行器之间自适应且双向地切换。方法通过计算动作 token 上的平均对数概率比作为差异信号，并在多轮上累积为漂移证据与恢复证据，当证据超过阈值时才切换执行器，从而形成滞回 (hysteresis) 机制以避免高频抖动。在 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 两个学生模型规模下，DASH-OPD 在全部 14 项任务性能对比中优于五个基线，并在十个轮数对比中的九个取得最短轨迹。
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏让学生模型在自己的 rollout 上训练以缓解曝光偏差 (exposure bias)，但在多轮智能体场景中，早期学生错误会使轨迹偏离教师熟悉的状态分布；现有课程学习方法只能按训练进度调节教师支持量，无法判断具体何时需要教师介入。
Method: DASH-OPD 在每一轮计算两个执行器在动作 token 上的平均对数概率比作为差异度；学生轮上的学生/教师比形成漂移信号，教师轮上的教师/学生比形成恢复信号。这些信号被归一化并跨多轮累积为漂移证据和恢复证据，当证据超过对应切换阈值时切换执行器；多轮累积使切换具有滞回性，抑制瞬时波动导致的高频切换。
Result: 在 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上、两种学生模型规模下，DASH-OPD 在全部 14 项任务性能对比中胜过五个基线，并在十个轮数对比中的九个取得最短轨迹，展现出最强的性能-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 作者称该论文为进行中工作 (work in progress)，代码、训练日志和模型检查点将在之后发布。

papers.title: Learning Asymptotics with Convergence-Rate Guarantees using Linear Least Squares
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new research area that is called Asymptotics Learning Theory (ALT) and combines optimization with asymptotic analysis. In particular, ALT provides a unified approach for computing unknown constants/parameters in proven asymptotic expansions using optimization theory. In this paper, we focus on a general asymptotic form which includes a broad class of asymptotics. Furthermore, we study two powerful numerical methods, namely, sliding Linear Least Squares (sLLSQ) and sliding Tikhonov Linear Least Squares (sT-LLSQ). For these techniques we rigorously prove asymptotic estimates that lead to sufficient conditions for convergence (to the correct values of unknown parameters) and convergence-rate guarantees. Despite their strengths, both methods have also limitations, e.g., slow convergence---or even, counterintuitively, divergence---in some cases. Moreover, we present fundamental applications in analytic combinatorics, a beautiful field of mathematics that deals with asymptotic enumeration of discrete structures using complex analysis. The proposed techniques complement existing approaches, such as the ratio method and its variants. Numerical examples also verify the theoretical results. Finally, we discuss interesting research directions in ALT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个新研究方向 Asymptotics Learning Theory (ALT)，将优化理论与渐近分析结合，用于在已知渐近展开中计算未知常数/参数。作者聚焦于一类包含广泛渐近形式的一般形式，研究滑动线性最小二乘 (sLLSQ) 和滑动 Tikhonov 线性最小二乘 (sT-LLSQ) 两种数值方法，给出收敛性与收敛速率保证的充分条件。数值例子验证了理论结果，并讨论了在解析组合学 (analytic combinatorics) 中的应用。
Motivation: 渐近展开中常含有未知常数或参数，现有方法如比率法 (ratio method) 及其变体存在局限；本文旨在用优化理论统一计算这些参数，并提供严格收敛保证。
Method: 提出 Asymptotics Learning Theory (ALT) 框架，采用滑动线性最小二乘 (sLLSQ) 和滑动 Tikhonov 线性最小二乘 (sT-LLSQ) 两种数值方法，通过严格的渐近估计推导收敛到正确参数的充分条件以及收敛速率保证。
Result: 摘要报告对两种方法证明了渐近估计、收敛性与收敛速率保证，并给出数值例子验证理论；同时指出两种方法在某些情形下存在慢收敛甚至发散的局限。
Conclusion: 作者强调该技术补充了比率法及其变体等现有方法，在解析组合学中有基础应用，并展望了 ALT 中的若干研究方向。

papers.title: Distributional Determinantal Point Process for Repulsive Clustering of Distributions
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the distributional determinantal point process (dDPP) as a novel repulsive point process whose atoms are probability distributions rather than points in a real space. The dDPP is constructed via an L-ensemble with a sliced Wasserstein (SW) kernel between distributions. We show its validity as a well-defined point process. In the discrete setting, we derive concentration results for plug-in estimators of the L-ensemble, the correlation kernel, and their determinants given i.i.d. samples from the distributional atoms. Leveraging this framework, we propose a distribution-valued random partition model by way of a repulsive generalized Bayesian mixture model. The model places a dDPP prior over the atoms of the mixing measure and defines a generalized likelihood based on SW distance. To summarize posterior inference, we develop a decision-theoretic approach to report a point estimate of the mixing measure as a Bayes rule under a hierarchical optimal transport utility function. The latter is a natural choice given that the mixing measure is itself a distribution over distributions. We use the proposed framework for inference with single-cell gene expression data and human epilepsy data, producing interpretable and well-separated clusters that reflect meaningful structure in the data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分布性行列式点过程 (distributional determinantal point process, dDPP)，其原子是概率分布而非实空间中的点，借助分布之间的 sliced Wasserstein (SW) 核构造 L-ensemble，并证明其作为点过程的合法性。在离散情形下，作者给出交换 i.i.d. 样本时 L-ensemble、相关核及其行列式的 plug-in 估计量的集中结果。基于该框架，作者提出带斥力先验的广义贝叶斯混合模型，并用单细胞基因表达数据和人脑癫痫数据分析展示可解释、分离良好的聚类。
Motivation: 传统排斥点过程定义在实空间上，而许多聚类问题中的基本对象是概率分布。论文针对这一空缺，希望构造一个原子为分布的排斥点过程，并借此建立起能得到清晰分离聚类的分布值混合模型。
Method: 通过以 sliced Wasserstein (SW) 距离为核的 L-ensemble 定义 dDPP，并论证其有效性；在离散设定下推导 plug-in 估计量的集中结果。随后提出分布值随机划分模型：对混合测度的原子放置 dDPP 先验，并基于 SW 距离定义广义似然；后验推断采用决策论方法，在分层最优传输 (hierarchical optimal transport) 效用函数下给出混合测度的点估计作为 Bayes 规则。
Result: 摘要报告了 L-ensemble 与相关核估计量的集中结果，并在单细胞基因表达数据和人脑癫痫数据上得到可解释且分离良好的聚类，反映数据中有意义的结构。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 dDPP 为分布空间的排斥聚类提供了一个有效的先验框架，并将该分布值聚类方法成功应用于生物医学数据；论文篇幅为 61 页、含 15 幅图。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Drift-Adaptive ICU Intervention Prediction: Freezing the Physiological Encoder for Auditable Model Updating
papers.abstract_en: Clinical decision support degrades as treatment protocols evolve, but the obstacle to updating a deployed model is governance as much as accuracy: once retraining touches every parameter, no one can say afterwards where the update acted. We propose a two-stream architecture separating physiological (LSTM) from treatment (MLP) representations. On a dual distributional/accuracy trigger, updates are confined to the treatment stream and fusion head, leaving the physiological encoder bitwise identical to the source model. Audit logs record which treatment features the update relied on, and evidence retrieval couples per-instance PubMed queries to the frozen encoder. We evaluate on 84,792 MIMIC-IV stays split by three-year era. The constraint proved close to free: selective adaptation cost nothing in aggregate discrimination against unconstrained full adaptation (mean AUROC 0.9316 vs. 0.9249; ahead on vasopressor, marginally behind on intubation) while being six-fold more stable across adaptation seeds. Run sequentially over four era transitions, the detector located the 2020 boundary rather than assuming it, firing once and on the distributional leg alone. Confining updates to named architectural blocks therefore costs little discrimination and bounds each update's scope by construction rather than by inference after the fact. Attribution-conditioned retrieval, by contrast, tracked the source model's without reproducing it: a guarantee over weights is not a guarantee over attributions, and this design makes the former structural while leaving the latter observable.
papers.comment: v2: narrower scope. The v1 cross-model XGBoost comparison, is not carried forward: it used a fixed threshold across differently calibrated models. Claims are now restricted to within-architecture comparisons (selective vs. full adaptation); retrieval results are exploratory. Title updated. 12 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/empresst/ClinicalRag. Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对临床决策支持系统在治疗协议演化后性能退化的问题，提出一种两流架构，将生理表征（LSTM）与治疗表征（MLP）分离；在分布/准确率双重触发下，只更新治疗流与融合头，使生理编码器与源模型逐位一致，从而让模型更新可审计。作者在按三年时代划分的 84,792 例 MIMIC-IV 住院数据上评估，选择性适应与无约束完全适应的平均 AUROC 为 0.9316 对 0.9249，且跨适应种子的稳定性提高六倍。摘要还报告运行四个时代转换时，检测器仅在 2020 年边界触发一次，且仅由分布腿触发。
Motivation: 已部署模型的更新障碍不仅是准确率，更是治理问题：一旦重训练触及所有参数，事后无法说明更新作用在何处。临床决策支持会随治疗协议演化而退化，需要一种能够界定更新范围并留下审计痕迹的模型更新方式。
Method: 提出两流架构，将生理（LSTM）与治疗（MLP）表示分离；在双重分布/准确率触发下，把更新限制在治疗流和融合头，生理编码器保持与源模型逐位相同的冻结状态。审计日志记录更新所依赖的治疗特征，证据检索将按实例进行的 PubMed 查询与冻结编码器耦合。
Result: 在 84,792 例 MIMIC-IV 住院（按三年时代划分）上，选择性适应与完全适应的平均 AUROC 为 0.9316 比 0.9249，在血管加压药预测上领先、气管插管预测上略落后，且跨种子稳定性提升约六倍。顺序运行四个时代转换时，检测器只在 2020 边界触发一次，且仅由分布性腿触发。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将更新限制在命名架构块几乎不损失判别力，并按构造而非事后推断来界定每次更新的范围；属性条件检索能追踪源模型的属性却不复现它，权重层面的保证是结构性的，而属性层面的保证留作可观察量。根据 arXiv 注释，作者将主张限定在架构内比较（选择性 vs 完全适应），检索结果属于探索性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Price of Hidden Curvature: Improved Lower Bounds for Bandit Convex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We establish improved lower bounds on the minimax expected regret of stochastic bandit convex optimization for $1$-Lipschitz functions on the $d$-dimensional Euclidean ball. For time horizons $n\ge d^{10/3}$, we prove a lower bound of $Ω(d^{4/3}\sqrt{n})$, the first nontrivial bound that exceeds the $d\sqrt{n}$ dependence of linear bandits, showing that stochastic bandit convex optimization is fundamentally harder than linear bandits. For $d^2\le n\le d^{10/3}$, we obtain a lower bound of $Ω(\sqrt{d}n^{3/4})$, matching the regret of the algorithm of Flaxman et al. (2005), establishing its optimality in this regime. The hard class of convex functions we construct takes the following form in dimension $2d$: for an action $a=(a^1,a^2)\in \mathbb{B}^{2d}$, each function is the scaled soft maximum of a "tube", $r^{-1}\|W^\star a^1-\frac{r}{8\varepsilon}a^2 \|$ (hyperparameterized by $\varepsilon,r$), and a squared distance function, $\frac12\|a^1-u^\star\|^2-\frac12\|u^\star\|^2$. Here $u^\star\in\mathbb{R}^d$ is the unknown target determining the minimizer, while $W^\star\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$ hides the region in which the quadratic curvature is observable. Indeed, observations reveal substantial information about $u^\star$ only when the learner acts near the hidden tube $a^2\approx \frac{8\varepsilon}{r}W^\star a^1$; away from it, the tube branch masks the quadratic branch. Thus the learner must pay to uncover the geometry encoded by $W^\star$ before it can effectively exploit the curvature that identifies $u^\star$. Formalizing this tradeoff yields a sample complexity lower bound of $Ω(\frac{d^{5/2}}{\varepsilon^2}\wedge\frac{d^2}{\varepsilon^4})$ for finding an $\varepsilon$-optimal action, and ultimately the $Ω(d^{4/3}\sqrt{n}\wedge\sqrt{d}n^{3/4})$ regret lower bound. The proof was developed by GPT-5.5 Pro and GPT-5.6 Sol Pro under the authors' guidance.

TL;DR: 本文针对随机带状凸优化 (stochastic bandit convex optimization) 在 d 维欧氏球上 1-Lipschitz 凸函数的 minimax 期望遗憾，建立了改进的下界。当时间范围 n≥d^{10/3} 时，证明遗憾下界为 Ω(d^{4/3}√n)，这是首个超过线性带状 (linear bandits) 的 d√n 依赖的非平凡界，表明该问题本质上比线性带状更难；当 d^2≤n≤d^{10/3} 时，得到 Ω(√d·n^{3/4}) 下界，与 Flaxman et al. (2005) 的算法匹配。证明由 GPT-5.5 Pro 和 GPT-5.6 Sol Pro 在作者指导下完成。
Motivation: 现有随机带状凸优化的下界未能超过线性带状的 d√n，因而无法回答凸性是否使问题本质上更难的问题；同时 Flaxman 等人的算法在中间时间范围是否最优也缺乏下界支撑。
Method: 构造 2d 维的硬实例类：每个函数是管状项 r^{-1}||W^*a^1-(r/(8ε))a^2|| 与平方距离项 (1/2)||a^1-u^*||^2-(1/2)||u^*||^2 的缩放 soft maximum。管状分支只有在学习者靠近隐藏管 a^2≈(8ε/r)W^*a^1 时才暴露二次曲率，从而迫使学习者为发现几何结构付出代价；将此权衡形式化后推导样本复杂度与遗憾下界。

papers.title: Grounded verification of chemical and materials reasoning: detection is the bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Language models are moving into chemistry and materials discovery workflows, where a wrong molecular formula, space group, or formation energy can silently propagate into downstream decisions. These confabulations hide inside fluent reasoning traces and concentrate on rare, long-tail entities, where model confidence is least trustworthy. Retrieving reference data for every prompt would catch them, but at a heavy coverage and abstention cost. We show that deterministic, database-grounded verification catches and repairs these errors selectively, and that the binding constraint is detection rather than repair. Our tiered verifier extracts each checkable claim, tests it against authoritative databases and physical law, and retrieves a reference value only when a check fails. Across four models and over five hundred prompts with pinned conditions, gated correction cuts the error rate of committed formulas from 22% to 4% with 3.2 times fewer retrievals than blanket augmentation, and it outperforms a conversational retrieval oracle when every answer, corrected or not, is scored. When a flag fires, repair almost always succeeds; the benefit reaches the final answer only where the verifier's scope covers it and where long-tail error exists. Checkable claims, checked cheaply, are a practical lever for trustworthy machine reasoning in chemistry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在化学与材料发现流程中的事实错误（confabulation），提出基于数据库的分层验证器（tiered verifier）来检测并修复这类错误。摘要报告在四个模型、超过五百个固定条件的提示上，门控修正（gated correction）把承诺分子式（committed formulas）的错误率从 22% 降到 4%，检索次数比全量增强（blanket augmentation）少 3.2 倍。作者认为限制因素是检测而非修复。
Motivation: 语言模型正进入化学与材料发现工作流，错误的分子式、空间群或形成能会静默传播到下游决策；这类虚构集中在稀有长尾实体上，而模型的置信度在这些情形下最不可靠。对所有提示都检索参考数据可以捕获错误，但会带来高昂的覆盖率和弃权成本。
Method: 提出一个分层验证器，先提取每个可检查的声明，再将其对照权威数据库和物理定律进行检验，并且只在检查失败时才检索参考值，即采用门控修正策略。
Result: 在四个模型和超过五百个固定条件的提示上，门控修正将承诺分子式的错误率从 22% 降至 4%，检索次数比 blanket augmentation 少 3.2 倍；当每个回答（无论是否被修正）都被评分时，该方法优于会话式检索 oracle（conversational retrieval oracle）。一旦标志触发，修复几乎总能成功。
Conclusion: 收益只有在验证器覆盖范围内且存在长尾错误时才能到达最终答案；作者强调检测是瓶颈，廉价地检查可检查声明是化学领域可信机器推理的实用杠杆。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HarmoHOI: Harmonizing Appearance and 3D Motion for Multi-view Hand-Object Interaction Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Hand-Object Interaction (HOI) synthesis is a cornerstone for animation production and embodied AI. Despite the strong priors of video foundation models, multi-view consistent HOI synthesis remains challenging due to complex hand motions and occlusions. We present HarmoHOI, a unified diffusion framework that jointly and harmoniously generates synchronized multi-view HOI videos and globally aligned 3D point tracks. Our core insight is that robust multi-view consistency fundamentally requires globally aligned 3D geometry and motion. To this end, we propose a Mixture of Multi-view Diffusion Transformer that co-models RGB videos and 3D point tracks. By representing point tracks as pseudo-videos, we align 3D geometric signals with the 2D latent space of foundation models, thereby minimizing the domain gap and easing adaptation of priors. To further ensure geometry consistency, we introduce Global Motion Aligning Diffusion, which refines coarse point tracks into metric-scale, globally aligned 3D trajectories. HarmoHOI enables on-the-fly co-evolution of 2D appearance and 3D motion during denoising. To overcome the scarcity of multi-view HOI data, we employ a hybrid data curriculum learning strategy that successfully transfers generic priors from single-view data to synchronized multi-view generation. Experimental results show that HarmoHOI achieves state-of-the-art performance in visual quality, motion plausibility, and multi-view geometric consistency. Project page available at https://droliven.github.io/HarmoHOI_project.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HarmoHOI，一个统一的扩散框架，用于多视角手-物交互 (Hand-Object Interaction, HOI) 视频合成，同时生成同步的多视角 RGB 视频与全局对齐的 3D 点轨迹。方法将点轨迹表示为伪视频 (pseudo-videos)，使其与视频基础模型的 2D 潜空间对齐，并引入全局运动对齐扩散 (Global Motion Aligning Diffusion) 将粗轨迹细化为度量尺度、全局对齐的 3D 轨迹。实验表明该方法在视觉质量、运动合理性和多视角几何一致性上达到当前最优。
Motivation: 多视角一致的 HOI 合成对动画制作和具身 AI 很重要，但由于复杂的手部运动和遮挡，即使有视频基础模型的强先验，多视角一致的 HOI 合成仍具挑战性。现有方法难以同时保证外观质量和全局一致的 3D 几何与运动。
Method: 提出统一的扩散框架，包含 Mixture of Multi-view Diffusion Transformer，联合建模 RGB 视频和 3D 点轨迹；点轨迹以伪视频形式表示以弥合与 2D 潜空间的域差距。引入 Global Motion Aligning Diffusion 细化点轨迹，并通过混合数据课程学习策略将单视角数据的通用先验迁移到同步多视角生成。
Result: 实验结果显示 HarmoHOI 在视觉质量、运动合理性和多视角几何一致性方面达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 2D 外观与 3D 运动在去噪过程中共同演化，并用课程学习解决多视角 HOI 数据稀缺问题，是实现稳健多视角一致 HOI 合成的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reinforcing Egocentric Spatial Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models via Ego Scene Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric Visual Question Answering (VQA) has attracted widespread attention as an important task for enabling Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to interact with the real world. However, existing MLLMs struggle to perform effective spatial reasoning in complex egocentric scenes due to their limited spatial perception capabilities. To this end, we introduce Ego Scene Augmentation (ESA), an egocentric spatial perception framework, which actively enhances the spatial perception capabilities from the egocentric perspective, powered by the proposed Ego-element Graph. Our core insight is leveraging the Ego-element Graph as an intermediary representation to augment the egocentric spatial perception of MLLMs via visual foundational models. Specifically, we 1) construct the Ego-element Graph, which encapsulates and integrates egocentric spatial features enabled by visual foundational models; 2) enhance the spatial perception capabilities of MLLMs via the Ego-element Graph for ego-perspective scenes. Our proposed ESA framework presents significant performance improvement on the EgoTextVQA benchmark. We achieve an 8.14% gain on the indoor setting and an 8.72% gain on the outdoor setting. Furthermore, our ESA shows the most impressive performance improvement in the shopping subset of the indoor setting. The project code is publicly available.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 8 figures. Chi Kit Wong and Ye Pan contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/Chikit-WONG/spatialGraph
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ego Scene Augmentation (ESA) 框架，用于增强多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在自我中心视角 (egocentric) 下的空间感知能力。核心是用 Ego-element Graph 作为中间表示，借助视觉基础模型 (visual foundational models) 对自我中心场景的空间特征进行整合与增强。在 EgoTextVQA 基准上，该框架在室内设置提升 8.14%，室外设置提升 8.72%，其中室内购物子集提升最显著。
Motivation: 现有 MLLMs 在复杂自我中心场景中进行空间推理时能力受限，主要原因是缺乏针对该视角的空间感知能力，这制约了 MLLMs 与真实世界交互的视觉问答任务表现。
Method: 提出 ESA 框架，包含两步：一是构建 Ego-element Graph，封装并整合由视觉基础模型提取的自我中心空间特征；二是利用该图表示增强 MLLMs 对自我中心场景的空间感知能力。
Result: 在 EgoTextVQA 基准上，ESA 在室内设置取得 8.14% 的性能提升，室外设置取得 8.72% 的提升，并且在室内设置的购物子集上表现最为突出。
Conclusion: 作者认为以 Ego-element Graph 作为中间表示可以有效增强 MLLMs 的自我中心空间感知能力，并已公开项目代码。

papers.title: Text-based Tactile Graphics Generation for the Visually Impaired
papers.abstract_en: Tactile graphics are a primary medium for blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals to access non-textual information. However, they are difficult to scale or personalize. While recent generative models have revolutionized visual content creation, they are optimized for screen-based visual realism and fail to satisfy the haptic perceptual and physical fabrication constraints required for touch. We present the first integrated generative system that produces fabrication-ready 2.5D tactile graphics directly from natural language prompts, jointly generating global base geometry, fine-grained tactile surface textures, and standard-compliant braille within a unified 3D-printable representation. Our approach introduces fabrication-aware techniques, including template-guided relief generation, a fast diffusion-based text-to-texture module for high-resolution tileable normal maps, and strict base flattening to ensure tactile readability and printability, while supporting both automatic generation and interactive texture control. Extensive evaluations, together with in-person user studies with BLV participants and blindfolded sighted participants using physically 3D-printed outputs, show that participants consistently prefer our results over baselines. By extending generative graphics beyond screens to touchable reliefs, our work broadens access to generative AI for the BLV community and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个直接从自然语言提示生成可制造 2.5D 触觉图形 (tactile graphics) 的集成生成系统，在统一的 3D 可打印表示中联合生成全局基底几何、细粒度触觉表面纹理和符合标准的盲文。系统引入模板引导浮雕生成、基于扩散的文本到纹理模块（用于高分辨率可平铺法线贴图）以及严格基底压平，并支持自动生成与交互式纹理控制。作者通过包括盲人或低视力 (BLV) 参与者及蒙眼视力正常参与者的实地用户研究，使用物理 3D 打印输出评估，发现参与者一致更偏好本文结果。
Motivation: 触觉图形是 BLV 群体获取非文本信息的主要媒介，但难以规模化或个性化。现有生成模型针对屏幕视觉真实感优化，不能满足触觉感知和物理制造约束。
Method: 提出集成生成系统，从文本提示直接生成可制造的 2.5D 触觉图形；关键技术包括模板引导浮雕生成、用于高分辨率可平铺法线贴图的快速扩散文本到纹理模块，以及确保触觉可读性和可打印性的严格基底压平。
Result: 大量评估和实地用户研究表明，使用物理 3D 打印输出时，BLV 参与者和蒙眼视力正常参与者一致更喜欢本文结果而非基线。
Conclusion: 该工作将生成式图形从屏幕扩展到可触摸浮雕，从而扩大 BLV 群体对生成式 AI 的可及性。

summary_sections.motivation: 触觉图形是 BLV 群体获取非文本信息的主要媒介，但难以规模化或个性化。现有生成模型针对屏幕视觉真实感优化，不能满足触觉感知和物理制造约束。
summary_sections.method: 提出集成生成系统，从文本提示直接生成可制造的 2.5D 触觉图形；关键技术包括模板引导浮雕生成、用于高分辨率可平铺法线贴图的快速扩散文本到纹理模块，以及确保触觉可读性和可打印性的严格基底压平。
summary_sections.result: 大量评估和实地用户研究表明，使用物理 3D 打印输出时，BLV 参与者和蒙眼视力正常参与者一致更喜欢本文结果而非基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作将生成式图形从屏幕扩展到可触摸浮雕，从而扩大 BLV 群体对生成式 AI 的可及性。

papers.title: MulTTiPop: A Multitrack Transcription Dataset for Pop Music
papers.abstract_en: We present MulTTiPop, a dataset of pop music segments and their associated multitrack MIDI recordings for the evaluation of automatic music transcription models. MulTTiPop contains 572 segments of popular music totaling 3.5 hours of audio, and contains songs from diverse genres and decades from the 1930s to 2000s. To collect this dataset, we perform metadata-based matching on song segments from the Lakh MIDI and TheoryTab datasets, manually identify an anchor beat between the audio and MIDI, then use beat tracking on the audio and warp the MIDI to match its tempo and timing. We evaluate state-of-the-art automatic music transcription models on MulTTiPop and find substantial room for improvement, with the best model achieving 29% Onset F1. More details and sound examples of MulTTiPop are available at https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Associated web preview available at https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MulTTiPop，一个面向自动音乐转写 (automatic music transcription) 评估的流行音乐多轨数据集。数据集包含 572 段流行音乐片段、共 3.5 小时音频，涵盖 1930 年代至 2000 年代的多种风格；作者通过 Lakh MIDI 与 TheoryTab 的元数据匹配、人工标注锚点节拍并结合音频节拍跟踪来对齐 MIDI。对当前最先进的转写模型评估表明，最佳模型仅达到 29% Onset F1，说明仍有很大改进空间。
Motivation: 现有自动音乐转写模型的评估缺乏覆盖流行音乐且带有多轨 MIDI 对齐的公开数据集，难以衡量模型在真实流行音乐片段上的表现。
Method: 从 Lakh MIDI 与 TheoryTab 数据集中按元数据匹配歌曲片段，人工确定音频与 MIDI 之间的锚点节拍 (anchor beat)，然后对音频做节拍跟踪并将 MIDI 按音频速度与时序进行弯曲对齐，构建 MulTTiPop 数据集。
Result: 摘要报告在 MulTTiPop 上评估的最先进自动音乐转写模型表现有限，最佳模型的 Onset F1 仅 29%，表明该任务仍有实质性提升空间。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MulTTiPop 可作为流行音乐多轨转写评估基准，并指出当前模型在该数据集上明显不足，相关细节与声音示例已公开。

papers.title: Generalist Vision-Language Models for Fast Radio Burst detection: a zero-shot benchmark against a specialized detector
papers.abstract_en: Fast Radio Burst (FRB) detection increasingly relies on specialized deep learning models that require large task-specific training sets and cannot be redefined without retraining. We evaluate whether small, open-weight, locally run generalist Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can detect FRBs in dynamic spectra under a zero-shot, prompt-only regime. On a balanced binary benchmark of 2000 simulated L-band spectra, Gemma 4 E2B reaches an accuracy of 94.05\%, statistically indistinguishable from the specialized detector SwinYNet (92.85\%), with a far lower false-positive rate on structured RFI (4.8\% vs. 24.6\%) and none on pure noise, though SwinYNet ranks perfectly (ROC-AUC 1.0000 vs. 0.9520). Rewriting the prompt alone reconfigures the same models for three-class FRB/RFI/noise classification, reaching up to 86.0\% accuracy without a single false FRB while classifying each 2 s spectrum in 1.0--1.5 s, faster than the observation itself. Applied unchanged to the 1600 real FAST observations of FAST-FREX, they reject real interference almost perfectly (2 and 5 false positives in 1000 negatives) but recover only 28.5\% and 27.0\% of the 600 catalogued bursts, against 95.7\% reported for SwinYNet on the same files. Stratifying those bursts by the dispersed signal in the image shows the limit to be the input representation rather than the classifier, recall rising to 84--85\% where the sweep is unambiguous and collapsing to 1\% on the 13\% of positives carrying no detectable signal in a 2 s undedispersed full-band view. The simulated bursts are nearly 30 times brighter in median, and at matched brightness the recalls agree to within a few points.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估小型开源权重、本地运行的通用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在零样本、仅提示 (prompt-only) 条件下从动态频谱中检测快速射电暴 (FRB) 的能力，并与专用检测器 SwinYNet 对比。在 2000 条模拟 L 波段频谱的平衡二分类基准上，Gemma 4 E2B 达到 94.05% 准确率，与 SwinYNet 的 92.85% 统计上无显著差异，且在结构化 RFI 上假阳性率远低 (4.8% vs. 24.6%)，对纯噪声零误报；但 SwinYNet 的 ROC-AUC 完美 (1.0000 vs. 0.9520)。仅改写提示即可将同一模型重构为三分类 FRB/RFI/噪声任务，最高准确率 86.0%，且无单个假 FRB，每段 2 秒频谱分类耗时 1.0–1.5 秒。作者将该结果归因于输入表示而非分类器本身。
Motivation: FRB 检测日益依赖需要大规模任务专属训练集且无法在不重训的情况下重新定义的专用深度学习模型；本文想检验小型通用 VLM 是否能在零样本、纯提示条件下完成 FRB 检测，从而避免重训成本。
Method: 采用小规模、开放权重、本地运行的通用 VLM，在零样本提示 (zero-shot, prompt-only) 机制下对模拟与真实动态频谱进行 FRB 检测；通过仅重写提示将二分类任务重构为三分类 FRB/RFI/噪声任务，并与专用检测器 SwinYNet 在模拟基准和 FAST-FREX 真实观测数据上做对比。
Result: 模拟基准上 Gemma 4 E2B 准确率 94.05% 与 SwinYNet 的 92.85% 相当，结构化 RFI 假阳性率 4.8% vs. 24.6%，纯噪声零误报，但 ROC-AUC 0.9520 低于 SwinYNet 的 1.0000。对 1600 条 FAST 真实观测，模型几乎完美拒绝真实干扰 (1000 个负样本中仅 2 和 5 个假阳性)，但仅恢复 600 个已编目暴发的 28.5% 和 27.0%，而 SwinYNet 报告恢复 95.7%。按图像中的色散信号分层后，无歧义扫描的召回率达 84–85%，而 13% 的在 2 秒未去色散全频带视图中无可检测信号的正样本召回率跌至 1%。模拟暴发中位亮度约为真实的 30 倍，在匹配亮度下两者召回率相差仅几个百分点。
Conclusion: 通用 VLM 在零样本提示下能以更快推理和更低假阳性率在模拟数据上匹敌专用检测器，并通过改写提示灵活重配置任务；但在真实 FAST 数据上暴发恢复率远低于 SwinYNet，且该限制被定位为输入表示 (未去色散、2 秒全频带视图) 而非分类器本身。

papers.title: OP3DSG: Open-Vocabulary Part-Aware 3D Scene Graph Generation for Real-World Environments
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene graphs (3DSGs) provide a compact and structured abstraction of 3D environments. Although advances in foundation models have enabled open-vocabulary 3DSG generation, existing approaches remain object-centric and encode limited relational information -- restricting their applicability in real-world scenarios that require fine-grained understanding. We propose OP3DSG, an open-vocabulary part-aware 3DSG generation framework that constructs unified graphs that jointly model objects, interactive parts, spatial relations, functional relations, and affordances. OP3DSG integrates object-part knowledge-guided detection with part-aware 3D fusion to preserve small and interaction-relevant components, and employs a geometry-initialized prior graph with LLM-based refinement to reduce spurious relational predictions while enabling efficient graph construction. To systematically evaluate unified 3D scene graph construction, we introduce UniGraph3D, a benchmark designed for part-aware perception and multi-level relational reasoning. Experimental results show that OP3DSG achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates its effectiveness as a perception backbone in diverse real-world robotics tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OP3DSG，一个开放词表 (open-vocabulary) 的部件感知 3D 场景图生成框架，联合建模物体、可交互部件、空间关系、功能关系和可供性 (affordances)。它通过 object-part 知识引导检测与部件感知 3D 融合保留小且与交互相关的组件，并用几何初始化的先验图加 LLM 精修来减少虚假关系预测、提高图构建效率。作者还提出 UniGraph3D 基准，实验表明 OP3DSG 达到 SOTA，并能作为感知骨干用于真实机器人任务。
Motivation: 现有 3D 场景图生成方法以物体为中心，编码的关系信息有限，难以满足真实世界场景中对细粒度理解的需求。
Method: 整合 object-part 知识引导检测与 part-aware 3D 融合以保留小尺寸、交互相关的部件；采用几何初始化的先验图 (geometry-initialized prior graph) 并配合 LLM 精修 (LLM-based refinement) 来抑制虚假关系预测并提升图构建效率，同时引入 UniGraph3D 基准用于系统评测统一 3D 场景图构建。
Result: 摘要报告 OP3DSG 在相关评测上取得 SOTA 性能，并在多种真实世界机器人任务中展示出作为感知骨干的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过统一图结构联合建模物体、部件、空间/功能关系与可供性，可以实现面向真实环境的开放词表部件感知 3D 场景图生成。

papers.title: Every Step of the Way: Video-based Parkinsonian Turning Step Counting
papers.abstract_en: As a prominent symptom of Parkinson's disease (PD), turning impairment is evaluated through parameters such as turning angle, duration, and particularly, the number of steps required to complete a turn, which directly reflects motor dysfunction. Accurate step counting is challenging due to variability in real-world turning movements and atypical shuffling patterns in parkinsonian gait. Existing methods are predominantly wearable-based, requiring users to wear and manage dedicated devices, which can be inconvenient for continuous daily use. To address this, we propose a passive, video-based framework that estimates step count in a coarse-to-fine manner using diverse motion representations. Specifically, an initial step count is estimated from foot movement signals derived from 3D human mesh recovery, providing high-level motion structures. To incorporate fine-grained motion details, a motion encoder learns complementary gait dynamics from mesh and optical flow to refine the initial estimate. In this process, coarse foot movement signals query the pixel-level motion cues via cross attention to capture subtle parkinsonian gait dynamics. To handle varying video lengths, we partition each video into clips and integrate clip-wise motion embeddings via multiple instance learning (MIL) for step count residual prediction. Extensive experiments show our method consistently outperforms existing step counting methods on real-world PD turning datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种被动的、基于视频的帕金森病（PD）转身步数计数框架，以粗到精的方式估计转身过程中的步数。方法先从 3D 人体网格恢复得到的足部运动信号估计初始步数，再用运动编码器结合网格与光流学习细粒度步态动态，并通过交叉注意力捕获脚部运动信号与像素级运动线索的关系。为处理不同长度的视频，作者将视频切成片段，并用多实例学习（MIL）对各片段的运动嵌入进行集成以预测步数残差。实验表明该方法在真实 PD 转身数据集上持续优于现有步数计数方法。
Motivation: 转身障碍是帕金森病的突出症状，转身所需步数直接反映运动功能障碍，但真实环境中的转身动作多变且帕金森步态常伴随异常拖步，使得准确计数具有挑战性。现有方法主要依赖穿戴式设备，用户需佩戴和管理专用装置，不适合日常连续监测，因此需要一种被动且便捷的视频式方案。
Method: 提出一种基于视频的粗到细步数估计框架：先利用 3D 人体网格恢复获得足部运动信号并估计初始步数，以满足高层运动结构信息；然后运动编码器从网格和光流中学习互补的步态动态，并通过交叉注意力让粗粒度足部信号查询像素级运动线索以细化初始估计。对可变视频长度，将视频划分为片段，使用多实例学习（MIL）集成片段级运动嵌入来预测步数残差。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在真实世界的 PD 转身数据集上持续优于现有步数计数方法，但未给出具体数值或基线细节。
Conclusion: 作者认为被动的基于视频的框架避免了穿戴式设备的不便，并利用多样化的运动表征（mesh 与 optical flow）以及 MIL 策略处理不同长度的视频，从而在 PD 转身步数计数上取得更优结果。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种被动的、基于视频的帕金森病（PD）转身步数计数框架，以粗到精的方式估计转身过程中的步数。方法先从 3D 人体网格恢复得到的足部运动信号估计初始步数，再用运动编码器结合网格与光流学习细粒度步态动态，并通过交叉注意力捕获脚部运动信号与像素级运动线索的关系。为处理不同长度的视频，作者将视频切成片段，并用多实例学习（MIL）对各片段的运动嵌入进行集成以预测步数残差。实验表明该方法在真实 PD 转身数据集上持续优于现有步数计数方法。

summary_sections.method: 提出一种基于视频的粗到细步数估计框架：先利用 3D 人体网格恢复获得足部运动信号并估计初始步数，以满足高层运动结构信息；然后运动编码器从网格和光流中学习互补的步态动态，并通过交叉注意力让粗粒度足部信号查询像素级运动线索以细化初始估计。对可变视频长度，将视频划分为片段，使用多实例学习（MIL）集成片段级运动嵌入来预测步数残差。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法在真实世界的 PD 转身数据集上持续优于现有步数计数方法，但未给出具体数值或基线细节。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为被动的基于视频的框架避免了穿戴式设备的不便，并利用多样化的运动表征（mesh 与 optical flow）以及 MIL 策略处理不同长度的视频，从而在 PD 转身步数计数上取得更优结果。

papers.title: ScaleHP: Scale-Mediated Optimization of Coupled Errors for Metric-Space Hand Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present ScaleHP, a unified framework that explicitly represents per-instance metric scale to resolve the coupled errors in calibrated camera-space hand pose estimation. Under the common root-relative-to-global paradigm, camera-space accuracy depends jointly on relative geometry, root localization, and their scale-dependent composition. ScaleHP treats scale as the shared interface among these terms rather than optimizing them in isolation. Its metric-aware 2D-3D Transformer decoder introduces a dedicated scale token that exchanges information with sparse, semantically indexed 2D/3D joint queries, allowing global metric reasoning and local joint geometry to mutually refine one another. A parameter-free calibrated module then recovers root translation from the predicted unit-scale joints, metric scale, and known camera intrinsics. ScaleHP demonstrates state-of-the-art CS-MPJPE on FreiHand (35.8 mm) and, under benchmark-specific training protocols, state-of-the-art PA-MPJPE on FreiHand, DexYCB, and HO3Dv3 (5.0/4.6/5.9 mm), showing that improved global metric localization is attained together with improved local articulation. Ablations further show that scale-pose interaction improves both camera-space accuracy and relative depth geometry.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables; includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScaleHP，一个在标定相机空间手部姿态估计中显式建模逐实例度量尺度（metric scale）的统一框架，旨在解决全局度量定位与局部关节几何之间的耦合误差。其核心是一个度量感知的 2D-3D Transformer 解码器，引入专用尺度 token 与稀疏的 2D/3D 关节查询进行信息交换，再用无参数标定模块从单位尺度关节、度量尺度和相机内参恢复根平移。在 FreiHand、DexYCB 和 HO3Dv3 上报告了新的最优结果。
Motivation: 在常见的根相对到全局（root-relative-to-global）范式下，相机空间精度同时取决于相对几何、根定位以及两者尺度相关的组合方式，而现有方法往往孤立优化这些项，导致耦合误差难以消除。
Method: ScaleHP 将尺度视为相对几何、根定位与组合项之间的共享接口，通过度量感知的 2D-3D Transformer 解码器引入尺度 token，使全局度量推理与局部关节几何相互细化；随后用无参数标定模块由单位尺度关节、度量尺度和已知相机内参恢复根平移。
Result: 摘要报告 ScaleHP 在 FreiHand 上取得最优 CS-MPJPE（35.8 mm），并在相应训练协议下于 FreiHand、DexYCB、HO3Dv3 上取得最优 PA-MPJPE（5.0/4.6/5.9 mm）；消融实验显示尺度-姿态交互同时改善相机空间精度与相对深度几何。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将改进的全局度量定位与局部关节姿态同时实现是可行的，且尺度与姿态的交互对相机空间精度和相对深度几何均有增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CADRE: Stable, Parameter Efficient Adaptation of Medical Vision Language Models with Bounded Forgetting and Prior Drift
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) such as BiomedCLIP generalize broadly, but adapting them to a clinical service is as much a safety problem as an accuracy one. Updating a deployed model for a new imaging modality can fail silently in two ways that harm patients: it can forget modalities it already handled (catastrophic forgetting), and it can drift from its trustworthy pretrained prior toward modality-specific shortcuts. We study parameter-efficient continual adaptation through these two properties rather than leaderboard accuracy, presenting CADRE: a frozen-backbone framework combining low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with an online, self-scaling, similarity-aware elastic weight consolidation term that bounds retained-competence loss, and an anchor-to-prior penalty bounding embedding drift from the frozen prior. Two short guarantees, a bound on total consolidation mass and a scale-invariance property, remove the scale-related sources of vanilla EWC's order fragility. Using breast cancer across three maximally dissimilar modalities (histopathology, ultrasound, chest radiography) as a controlled cross-modality stress test, under a multi-seed, multi-order protocol with paired significance testing and training approximately 0.23% of parameters, CADRE attains the highest accuracy, SPQ, and backward transfer and the lowest forgetting among adapting methods, reducing forgetting roughly sevenfold versus the strongest regularized baseline (0.075 to 0.011; paired p=0.023) and achieving positive backward transfer where every baseline is negative. We frame these as stability properties aligned with clinical-safety desiderata, not a deployment guarantee; robustness to distribution shift and adversarial inputs is out of scope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CADRE，一个面向医学视觉语言模型（VLM）持续适配的冻结主干（frozen-backbone）框架，结合低秩适配（LoRA）与在线、自缩放、相似度感知的弹性权重巩固（EWC）项以及锚定到先验的惩罚项，分别约束保留能力损失和嵌入漂移。作者以乳腺癌的三种差异极大的模态（组织病理学、超声、胸部X线）作为跨模态压力测试，仅训练约 0.23% 的参数，取得最高准确率、SPQ 和正向后向迁移（backward transfer），并将遗忘率从最强正则化基线的 0.075 降至 0.011。
Motivation: 将预训练医学 VLM 适配到临床服务时，安全性与准确率同样重要；更新模型可能默默遗忘已处理的模态（灾难性遗忘），或从可信预训练先验漂移到模态特有捷径，这两类失败都会伤害患者，但常被排行榜准确率掩盖。
Method: CADRE 采用冻结主干加 LoRA 的持续适配，包含两个损失项：一个在线、自缩放、相似度感知的 EWC 项，用于界定保留能力损失的上界；一个锚定到先验的惩罚项，用于约束嵌入相对冻结先验的漂移。作者还给出两个简短保证——总巩固质量上界和尺度不变性——以消除普通 EWC 中与尺度相关的顺序脆弱性来源。
Result: 在乳腺癌三种差异最大的模态（组织病理、超声、胸部X线）上，采用多随机种子、多顺序、配对显著性检验协议，CADRE 在适配方法中获得最高准确率、SPQ 和后向迁移以及最低遗忘；遗忘率约降低七倍（0.075 到 0.011，配对 p=0.023），并在所有基线均为负后向迁移时取得正向后向迁移。
Conclusion: 作者将 CADRE 的收益表述为与临床安全需求对齐的稳定性属性，而非部署保证；对分布偏移和对抗输入的鲁棒性不在研究范围内。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continuous Behavioral Authentication via Multi-Expert BERT Log Analysis for Secure Data Sharing
papers.abstract_en: Continuous authentication for mobile and zero-trust systems requires nonintrusive evidence confirming the enrolled user-device context remains valid after initial login. This paper presents a BERT log analysis framework for continuous behavioral authentication using Android system logs. The proposed pipeline parses logcat streams into event templates and dynamic variables, pre-trains a domain-adapted BERT encoder on Android log syntax, and fine-tunes three expert models for network/device identity, battery-transition timing, and Wi-Fi topology. The expert confidence scores are fused through a log-space transformation and a 5-nearest-neighbor distance classifier to generate a normality score that is provided to a Policy Decision Point (PDP) for risk-aware access control. Experiments on normal traces, controlled anomaly injections, and benign Wi-Fi perturbations indicate that multi-expert BERT log analysis can detect semantic, battery-timing, and topology deviations in the evaluated setting while maintaining sub-1% False Positive Rate (FPR). The results suggest that Android system logs are a practical sensor-free signal for continuous authentication and user-device context assurance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 22nd International Conference on Wireless and Mobile Computing, Networking and Communications (WiMob 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Android 系统日志的持续行为认证框架，将 logcat 流解析为事件模板与动态变量，预训练领域自适应的 BERT 编码器，并微调三个专家模型分别处理网络/设备身份、电池转换时序和 Wi-Fi 拓扑。专家置信度通过对数空间变换与 5 近邻距离分类器融合，生成正常性分数并传递给策略决策点（PDP）用于风险感知访问控制。实验在正常轨迹、受控异常注入和良性 Wi-Fi 扰动下表明该方法能检测语义、电池时序和拓扑偏差，同时保持低于 1% 的假阳性率。
Motivation: 移动与零信任系统在初始登录后需要非侵入式且持续的证据来确认用户-设备上下文仍然有效；现有方案缺乏利用系统日志这种无需额外传感器的持续认证信号。
Method: 论文构建 logcat 解析流水线，将日志转化为事件模板和动态变量，在 Android 日志语法上预训练领域自适应 BERT 编码器，并微调网络/设备身份、电池转换时序、Wi-Fi 拓扑三个专家模型；专家置信度经 log-space 变换后由 5 近邻距离分类器融合，输出正常性分数给 PDP 以实现风险感知访问控制。
Result: 实验表明多专家 BERT 日志分析能够检测语义、电池时序和拓扑偏差，并在评估设置中保持低于 1% 的假阳性率（FPR）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Android 系统日志可作为一种实用的无传感器信号，用于持续认证和用户-设备上下文保证。

papers.title: PO-PDDL: Learning Symbolic POMDPs from Visual Demonstrations for Robot Planning Under Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Real-world robot task planning must operate under both stochastic action execution and partial observability, yet constructing Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) models for real robotics domains remains difficult and labor-intensive. We introduce PO-PDDL, a symbolic formulation of POMDPs that preserves the relational structure and LLM-friendly syntax of the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), while explicitly modeling partial observability, stochasticity, and beliefs. Building on this formulation, we propose a demonstration-driven pipeline for learning PO-PDDL models. The proposed method reconstructs latent symbolic state trajectories from real-robot execution videos, identifies partial observability via inconsistencies between inferred states and visual observations, and learns stochastic transition and observation models accordingly. The resulting PO-PDDL domains are reusable across tasks and enable online belief-space planning under both perception and execution uncertainty. Experiments on real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks show that our method consistently outperforms existing PDDL and POMDP model-learning approaches, achieving robust task planning under uncertainty with significantly lower planning cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PO-PDDL，一种将 POMDP 表示为符号形式的方法，保留 PDDL 的关系结构和 LLM 友好语法，并显式建模部分可观测性、随机性与信念。作者进一步提出基于演示的学习流程：从真实机器人执行视频重建潜在符号状态轨迹，通过推断状态与视觉观测的不一致识别部分可观测性，并学习随机转移与观测模型。在真实世界长时程操作任务上的实验表明，该方法一致优于现有 PDDL 和 POMDP 模型学习方法，以显著更低的规划成本实现不确定性下的鲁棒任务规划。
Motivation: 真实机器人任务规划需要同时处理随机动作执行和部分可观测性，但为真实机器人领域构建 POMDP 模型困难且劳动密集。
Method: 提出 PO-PDDL 符号化 POMDP 表述，并结合演示驱动管线：从执行视频重建潜在符号状态轨迹，利用推断状态与视觉观测的不一致检测部分可观测性，进而学习随机转移与观测模型；得到的 PO-PDDL 领域可跨任务复用，支持在线信念空间规划。
Result: 在真实长时程操作任务上，该方法一致优于现有 PDDL 与 POMDP 模型学习方法，实现不确定条件下的鲁棒规划，并显著降低规划成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PO-PDDL 领域可复用且能同时处理感知与执行不确定性；实验验证其在实际机器人长期操作中的优势与更低规划开销。

summary_sections.result: 在真实长时程操作任务上，该方法一致优于现有 PDDL 与 POMDP 模型学习方法，实现不确定条件下的鲁棒规划，并显著降低规划成本。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 PO-PDDL 领域可复用且能同时处理感知与执行不确定性；实验验证其在实际机器人长期操作中的优势与更低规划开销。

papers.title: Detecting Explanatory Insufficiency in Learned Representations: A Framework for Representational Vigilance
papers.abstract_en: Learned representations are central to modern machine learning, but predictive performance, robustness, uncertainty estimation, and generalization do not by themselves establish representational adequacy. A model may remain operationally successful while preserving structured residuals that indicate explanatory insufficiency. We introduce VER (Vigilant Evaluator of Representations), a conceptual and methodological framework for monitoring learned representations and detecting when their limits become scientifically relevant. VER does not propose a new learning algorithm, loss function, or model architecture. It defines a diagnostic process that identifies persistent residual structure and evaluates whether it is better explained by uncertainty, noise, data limitations, local model error, distribution shift, or a limitation of the active representation. The framework comprises five operations: representation identification, explanatory-domain delimitation, residual-structure detection, explanatory-resistance evaluation, and vigilance signaling. VER complements conventional performance evaluation by making representational adequacy an explicit object of inquiry. It provides an operational bridge between representation learning and the diagnosis of explanatory insufficiency described by the Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence (TBER). The long-term objective is to support systems capable not only of learning representations, but also of recognizing when those representations no longer provide an adequate basis for explanation, generalization, or further reasoning.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, no tables, 16 references. Version 3. Conceptual and methodological framework for monitoring representational adequacy and detecting explanatory insufficiency in learned representations. Introduces a five-operation representational-vigilance process
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VER（Vigilant Evaluator of Representations），一个概念与方法层面的诊断框架，用于监测学习表示（learned representations）并检测其解释力不足（explanatory insufficiency）。VER 不引入新的学习算法或模型架构，而是定义包含五个操作（表示识别、解释域界定、残差结构检测、解释阻力评估、警觉信号）的诊断流程，补充传统性能评估。其长期目标是支持系统在学习表示之外，还能识别表示何时不再适合用于解释、泛化或进一步推理，并与 Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence (TBER) 相联系。
Motivation: 预测性能、鲁棒性、不确定性估计和泛化本身无法确证表示充分性（representational adequacy），模型可能在操作上成功的同时保留结构化残差，而这些残差反映了解释力不足。因此需要将表示充分性作为显式研究对象进行监测。
Method: VER 框架包含五个操作：representation identification（表示识别）、explanatory-domain delimitation（解释域界定）、residual-structure detection（残差结构检测）、explanatory-resistance evaluation（解释阻力评估）和 vigilance signaling（警觉信号）。该框架通过诊断流程评估持久残差结构究竟源于不确定性、噪声、数据限制、局部模型误差、分布漂移还是当前表示的局限。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果或数值指标；本文定位为概念与方法论框架，共 14 页、2 图、无表格、16 篇参考文献。
Conclusion: VER 补充了传统性能评估，将表示充分性作为明确的探究对象，并在表示学习与 TBER 所描述的解释不足诊断之间建立操作桥梁。其长期目标是支持既能学习表示、又能识别表示不再足以支撑解释、泛化或进一步推理的系统。

papers.title: Right Family, Wrong Skill: Benchmarking Risk Exposure in Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Agent skill libraries are becoming routable software assets: a retrieved skill can contribute instructions, scripts, resource bindings, and execution assumptions to an agent. This makes retrieval failures more specific than broad irrelevance. A system can find the right capability family yet expose the wrong same-capability representative. We study this failure as same-capability risk-exposure retrieval. Each benchmark unit pairs a helpful skill with a query-specific risky sibling that shares the capability family but differs on an execution-controlling contract, such as the required resource, precondition, procedure, or artifact. We introduce SameCapRisk-Bench, an auditable benchmark with 1,190 skill-risk units and 1,686 evaluation query cases: 694 marked-sibling units under public library pressure and 496 hard role-flip units where the same two skills swap helpful/risky roles across paired queries. The release records admission evidence, cue/leakage checks, source hashes, family relations, and fixed candidate pools. The benchmark reports helpful ranking together with harmful sibling rate (HSR@K), the top-K exposure of the marked risky sibling. On this benchmark, public SkillRouter, SkillRet, and R3-Skill retrieve helpful skills at high Recall@3 (0.848--0.888) but also expose marked risky siblings frequently (HSR@3 0.346--0.372). A fully public score-and-cluster pipeline lowers HSR@3 to 0.128--0.182, with Recall@3 of 0.713--0.776. Under a benchmark-trained reference scorer, public text-cluster and controlled resolvers reach HSR@3 0.012 and 0.007; the latter attains Recall@3 0.833. Skill retrieval should therefore report both capability matching and same-family risk exposure, with HSR serving as a targeted exposure certificate for fixed skill libraries.
papers.comment: Preprint. 21 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Supersedes arXiv:2606.10388
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出同能力风险暴露检索 (same-capability risk-exposure retrieval) 问题：智能体技能库检索可能找到正确的能力族，却暴露同一能力族中的危险同族技能。作者引入基准 SameCapRisk-Bench，包含 1,190 个技能-风险单元和 1,686 条评测查询，并用有害同族率 (HSR@K) 与有用技能排行共同评测。结果显示现有公开检索方法 Recall@3 较高但 HSR@3 也较高，而完全公开的 score-and-cluster 流水线以及基准训练的参考打分器能显著降低 HSR。
Motivation: 技能库正成为可路由的软件资产，检索到的技能会向智能体注入指令、脚本、资源绑定和执行假设，因此检索失败不只是笼统的不相关，而可能是找到正确能力族但选错同能力代表，带来执行层面的风险暴露。现有评测没有专门刻画这种同族风险。
Method: 将每个基准单元构造成一个有用技能与一个查询相关的风险同族技能配对，二者共享能力族但在执行控制契约（如资源、前提条件、过程或产物）上不同；发布包含 admission evidence、线索/泄漏检查、源哈希、族关系和固定候选池的可审计基准 SameCapRisk-Bench，并以 HSR@K 度量标记风险同族技能在 Top-K 中的暴露率。
Result: 公开的 SkillRouter、SkillRet 和 R3-Skill 在 Recall@3 上达到 0.848--0.888，但 HSR@3 高达 0.346--0.372；完全公开的 score-and-cluster 流水线把 HSR@3 降至 0.128--0.182，同时 Recall@3 为 0.713--0.776；基准训练的参考打分器配合公开文本聚类和受控解析器可达到 HSR@3 0.012 与 0.007，后者 Recall@3 为 0.833。
Conclusion: 技能检索应同时报告能力匹配与同族风险暴露，HSR 可作为固定技能库的定向暴露证书；摘要强调同族风险不可仅由能力召回率体现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-supervised Learning Matters: A Simple Ensemble Solution for Micro-Gesture Recognition
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present XInsight Lab's solution to the micro-gesture classification track of the 4th MiGA Challenge at IJCAI 2026, in which our solution ranked first and achieved a new state-of-the-art result. We propose a multimodal ensemble framework that integrates a self-supervised RGB-based model with supervised multi-stream models from previous solutions. The self-supervised RGB model is pretrained on 120K unlabeled clips via masked video modeling and then fine-tuned on iMiGUE. This simple yet effective RGB baseline achieves 69.224% top-1 accuracy on the iMiGUE test set, demonstrating the benefit of learning transferable representations from unlabeled in-domain videos. By incorporating this model as a complementary branch, the final ensemble reaches 74.419% top-1 accuracy, surpassing the previous state of the art by 1.206 percentage points. Experimental results on iMiGUE, including ablation studies on the ensemble strategy, validate the effectiveness of self-supervised RGB representation learning for micro-gesture recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 XInsight Lab 在 IJCAI 2026 第四届 MiGA 挑战赛微手势分类赛道中的方案，最终排名第一并刷新 SOTA。方法将基于自监督 RGB 的模型与先前方案中的有监督多流模型组成多模态集成框架；其中自监督 RGB 模型在 120K 无标签视频片段上用掩码视频建模预训练，再在 iMiGUE 上微调，单模型即可达 69.224% top-1 准确率，最终集成达到 74.419%，超过此前 SOTA 1.206 个百分点。
Motivation: 微手势识别是细粒度视频理解任务，此前挑战赛方案主要依赖有监督多流模型。作者旨在验证自监督 RGB 表征学习能否作为补充分支提升集成性能，并探索其单独作为基线的有效性。
Method: 提出多模态集成框架：包含一个自监督 RGB 模型分支与来自先前解决方案的有监督多流模型分支。自监督分支先在 120K 无标签域内视频上通过掩码视频建模（masked video modeling）预训练，再在 iMiGUE 上微调；集成策略通过消融实验验证。
Result: 自监督 RGB 基线在 iMiGUE 测试集取得 69.224% top-1 准确率；加入该分支后的最终集成达到 74.419% top-1，超过此前最佳结果 1.206 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自监督 RGB 表征学习对微手势识别的有效性，并表明借助无标签域内视频学习的可迁移表征可作为互补分支融入集成模型。

papers.title: PROBE-Web: An Interactive System for Probing Evaluation Landscapes of Knowledge Graph Completion Models
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph completion (KGC) models are commonly evaluated using rank-based metrics such as MRR and Hits@K, despite different users often requiring different evaluation perspectives. In this demo, we present PROBE-Web, an interactive system for probing diverse evaluation landscapes for KGC models. PROBE-Web enables users to flexibly evaluate KGC models by adjusting two critical perspectives: (P1) predictive sharpness and (P2) popularity-bias robustness. Through a user-friendly GUI, users easily evaluate multiple KGC models and analyze their strengths and weaknesses. PROBE-Web provides four key functionalities: (1) conventional evaluation toolkit, (2) flexible perspective-aware evaluation, (3) explainable case studies, and (4) evaluation landscape exploration. We believe that PROBE-Web can help users better understand KGC models aligning with their objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以 demo 形式介绍 PROBE-Web，一个用于探测知识图谱补全（KGC）模型评估景观的交互式系统。系统允许用户通过 GUI 调整预测锐度（predictive sharpness）与流行度偏差鲁棒性（popularity-bias robustness）两个视角来灵活评估多个 KGC 模型，并提供常规评估工具包、视角感知评估、可解释案例研究和评估景观探索四项功能。摘要未报告量化实验结果。
Motivation: 现有 KGC 模型通常仅用 MRR、Hits@K 等基于排名的指标评估，但不同用户往往需要不同的评估视角，缺少能够灵活探索多种评估景观的工具。
Method: 提出 PROBE-Web 交互式系统，通过友好 GUI 让用户调整两个关键评估视角（预测锐度与流行度偏差鲁棒性），并集成四项功能：常规评估工具包、灵活的视角感知评估、可解释案例研究以及评估景观探索。
Result: 摘要未给出具体的实验数值或基准结果，仅描述系统功能与演示性质。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PROBE-Web 能帮助用户结合自身目标更深入地理解 KGC 模型的强弱项。

papers.title: Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence (TBER): Explanatory Insufficiency, Transition Regimes, and the Emergence of New Representational Levels
papers.abstract_en: Representation learning is central to modern machine learning, yet most research focuses on optimizing representations after a framework has been selected. The Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence (TBER) addresses a prior question: when does a new representational level become necessary? Version 4 identifies explanatory insufficiency as a positive epistemic signal for representational transition. A representation may remain useful while becoming unable to make relevant relations, transformations, distinctions, or organizational properties intelligible. TBER distinguishes two dimensions. Explanatory insufficiency may be descriptive, transformational, or related to generalization. The resulting response may belong to a local-corrective, representationally resolutive, or structurally recurrent regime. The bootstrap process is recursive: stabilized representations enable observation; anomalies expose persistent insufficiencies; candidate re-representations are generated; discriminating tests constrain them; surviving representations undergo provisional stabilization and closure assessment. Formal cases such as Kaprekar's routine and Gödelian incompleteness are used only as boundary examples of distinct transition regimes, not as proofs of TBER or models of physical or biological dynamics. The framework concerns transitions between scientific, mathematical, or computational representations. It has implications for representation learning, latent spaces, foundation models, world models, adaptive biological systems, scientific discovery, and autonomous AI. TBER suggests that future intelligent systems should not only learn representations, but also diagnose their limits, determine when re-representation is warranted, test alternatives, and recognize whether a limitation is locally resolved or structurally recurrent.
papers.comment: Version 4. Major theoretical revision introducing the distinction between manifestations of explanatory insufficiency and resolution regimes (local-corrective, representationally resolutive, and structurally recurrent), together with regime-sensitive diagnosis and closure assessment. Formal mathematical boundary cases have been clarified. 28 references, no figures or tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出表征涌现的引导理论 (Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence, TBER) 的 V4 理论修订，核心主张是把解释性不足 (explanatory insufficiency) 视为表征层次转变的积极认知信号，而非单纯失败。该版本区分了解释性不足的类型（描述性、变换性、泛化性）与响应机制（局部修正、表征消解、结构循环），并刻画了一个递归的 bootstrap 过程：稳定表征支撑观察、异常暴露不足、生成候选再表征、判别性检验筛选、存续表征经历临时稳定化与闭合评估。文章是纯理论框架，并明确声明 Kaprekar 过程和 Gödel 不完全性只作为边界示例，不是证明或物理/生物动力学模型。
Motivation: 表征学习的主流研究集中在选定表示框架后如何优化表征，而 TBER 追问一个更根本的问题：何时需要出现新的表征层次，并把解释性不足重新理解为推动表征转变的正向信号。
Method: 提出了一个二维分析框架：一方面按性质区分解释性不足（描述性、变换性、泛化性相关），另一方面按响应区分局部修正 (local-corrective)、表征消解 (representationally resolutive) 和结构循环 (structurally recurrent) 三种机制，并给出递归的 bootstrap 转变流程与对转换机制敏感的诊断和闭合评估。
Result: V4 的主要成就是澄清了边界情形并引入不足表现与解决机制的系统区分；摘要中不含经验实验或量化结果，理论提及涉及表征学习、潜在空间、基础模型、世界模型、科学发现与自主 AI 等广泛领域。
Conclusion: 框架面向科学、数学和计算表征之间的转换，作者认为未来智能系统不仅要学习表征，还需诊断其局限、判断何时需要再表征、检验替代方案，并识别局限是局部可解还是结构性循环；同时强调边界示例不应被解读为对 TBER 的证明或对物理/生物系统的模型。

papers.title: MPCoT: Reward-Guided Multi-Path Latent Reasoning for Test-Time Scalable Vision-Language-Action
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies remain brittle in long-horizon and high-uncertainty control, where one-pass action decoding provides limited inference-time deliberation. Explicit chain-of-thought can increase reasoning depth, but introduces token latency and an indirect text-to-action interface. We propose MPCoT, a reward-guided multi-path latent reasoning framework that initializes M hypotheses, refines them for K weight-tied steps, and softly aggregates them before action decoding. A training-only path-preference objective combines expert-trajectory consistency, frozen Qwen3-VL progress scoring, and endpoint-success feedback to align the latent path scorer with downstream execution quality. MPCoT preserves the original 8-step action interface, generates zero reasoning tokens, and exposes configurable inference controls (K, M). Under matched protocols on LIBERO and CALVIN, MPCoT improves long-horizon performance, with ablations confirming depth-width effects, confidence-weighted aggregation, and reward-guided path supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MPCoT，一种奖励引导的多路径隐式推理框架，用于提升 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 策略在长时程和高不确定性控制任务中的推理期计算能力。该方法初始化 M 条潜变量路径，经 K 步权重共享的迭代细化后软聚合得到动作解码输入，并引入仅训练阶段的路径偏好目标来对齐路径评分与下游执行质量。MPCoT 不生成推理 token，保持原有 8 步动作接口，并提供 K、M 等可配置推理控制。
Motivation: VLA 策略在长时程和高不确定性控制中仍较脆弱，单次动作解码缺乏推理期的深思熟虑；显式思维链虽然能增加推理深度，却引入 token 延迟和间接的文本到动作接口。
Method: 提出 MPCoT 框架：初始化 M 个潜变量假设，用 K 个权重共享步骤进行细化，并在动作解码前进行软聚合；训练时通过路径偏好目标对齐潜路径得分，该目标结合专家轨迹一致性、冻结的 Qwen3-VL 进度评分和端点成功反馈。
Result: 在 LIBERO 和 CALVIN 上采用匹配的实验协议时，MPCoT 提升了长时程任务表现；消融实验确认了深度-宽度效应、置信度加权聚合以及奖励引导的路径监督的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者将 MPCoT 定位为不改变动作接口、不产生推理 token 的前提下，通过多路径潜变量推理提升 VLA 长时程性能的测试时可扩展方法，并提供 K、M 等可配置的推理控制。

papers.title: From Prediction to Self: Developmental Conditions for Agency in Minimal Neural Systems
papers.abstract_en: How does a system that merely predicts the world come to distinguish its own causal influence from everything else? We trace this transition in a minimal 192-dimensional GRU through a developmental sequence -- 6 experimental stages, 12 falsified alternatives, and cross-signal validation. Starting with no action or self-representation, we add components one at a time, tracking whether the system distinguishes self-caused from world-caused changes. The central finding is the encoding gap: a system can perfectly compensate for its own actions in prediction while failing to encode "I am acting" as a readable state -- implicit causal use and explicit self-representation are dissociated capabilities. The developmental path crosses this gap when four conditions are jointly satisfied: (1) persistent state that forms stable attractors, (2) a causal action loop linking the system's output to its input, (3) proprioceptive feedback that makes implicit causal knowledge explicit, and (4) asynchronous awakening -- consolidating perceptual learning before action learning, which yields the only configuration robust to hyperparameter choice. We propose agency gain (A = Err_world - Err_self), the predictive advantage of knowing one's own action, as a continuous metric that generalizes across signal types. A decisive test confirms the causal grounding of the encoding: after the external training signal is removed, the causal agent retains its self-representation at 94.9% while a statistically-matched control collapses to 53.9%. Self-representation persists only when causally useful for prediction -- an intrinsic property of the causal loop, not a training artifact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在一个 192 维的最小 GRU 系统中追踪从纯预测到具备自我表征的发展过程，提出"编码间隙"(encoding gap) 概念：系统可以在预测层面完美补偿自身动作，却没有把"我在行动"编码为可读状态。作者通过 6 个实验阶段、12 个被证伪的替代解释和跨信号验证，发现只有当持续状态、因果动作环、本体感觉反馈和异步唤醒四个条件同时满足时，系统才能跨越这一间隙。作者还提出连续指标 agency gain，并用外部训练信号移除实验证明自我表征只在因果上有用时才保留。
Motivation: 现有预测性系统如何区分自身因果影响与外部世界变化这一问题尚不清楚；作者希望在一个极简神经系统中明确从隐含因果使用到显式自我表征的转变条件，并解释两者为何可以分离。
Method: 采用最小 192 维 GRU，通过逐步添加组件（动作、反馈、唤醒时序等）构成 6 个实验阶段，并检验 12 个替代假说；提出衡量自身动作预测优势的连续指标 agency gain（A = Err_world - Err_self），并在移除外部训练信号后进行交叉信号验证。
Result: 核心发现是编码间隙：系统可在预测中完全补偿自身动作却无法显式表征"我在行动"。四个条件联合满足才能跨越间隙，其中异步唤醒（先巩固感知学习再学动作）是唯一对超参数选择稳健的配置。决定性测试中，移除外部训练信号后因果智能体保持 94.9% 的自我表征，而统计匹配的控制组降至 53.9%，表明自我表征仅在因果上有用时持续存在。
Conclusion: 自我表征不是训练伪影，而是因果环路的内在属性；只有当自我表征对预测有因果用途时才会保留。摘要强调该结果将隐含因果使用与显式自我表征视为分离能力，并提供了可推广的连续度量。
